      const lvl = Math.min(want, industryCap(k, r.res, r.pop, r.city.port) + (INDUSTRIES[k].urban ? r.cm.room : 0));
      if (lvl > 0) r.ind.push({ kind: k, lvl });
    }
  }

  /* Sites on the map: mines, oil fields, logging camps and harbors. Each needs a road to a town;
     its workers come from the nearest town; its output goes onto the market of the network its road joins. */
  const reach = roadAccess(g, nid, cities, netOf);
  const siteList = [];
  for (const s of g.sites || []) {
    if (!held(s.cell)) continue;
    const x = siteEntry(w, g, s, nation, last, reach, networks);
    if (x.status === "working" && s.kind === "fishing" && g.sea) { const sc = portSeaCell(w, s.cell); if (sc >= 0 && zoneHostile(g, zoneOf(w, sc), nid)) x.status = "blockaded"; }
    x.haulMult = WB.haul;
    let best = 0, bd = Infinity;
    for (let k = 0; k < cities.length; k++) { const d = dist(cities[k].cell, s.cell); if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = k; } }
    x.region = regions[best];
    x.townId = cities[best].id;
    { const cm = regions[best].cm; x.haulMult = (x.haulMult ?? 1) * cm.haul; if (x.status === "working") { x.mult *= cm.siteOut; x.wmult *= cm.siteW; } }
    siteList.push(x);
    if (x.status === "working") {
      regions[best].ind.push(x);
      // a smelter at the mine works the ore as it comes up, as far as its coal, power and workers allow
      if (s.smelter && s.kind === "mine") { const sm = { kind: "smelter", lvl: s.level * (x.mult || 1), lvlFull: s.level * (x.mult || 1), mine: x, smelterOf: s, isoFixed: x.isoFixed }; x.smelterX = sm; regions[best].ind.push(sm); }
    }
  }

  /* Food: farmland, fishing fleets and fertilizer */
  const mech = (last.machinery ?? 0.4) * (hasTech(nation, "mech") ? 0.55 : 0.28);
  const fert = (last.chemicals ?? 0.4) * (hasTech(nation, "fert") ? 0.2 : 0.07);
  const laborPerFood = ECON7.farmLabor * (1 - mech);
  for (const r of regions) {
    const fish = r.ind.filter(x => x.kind === "fishing").reduce((s, x) => s + Math.min(x.lvl * INDUSTRIES.fishing.out.food * (x.mult ?? 1), x.capYear ?? Infinity), 0);
    r.fish = fish;
    r.food = r.farmland * harvestFactor(nation) * (1 + modSum(nation, "food")) * (1 + fert) * (WB.damCell >= 0 && dist(r.city.cell, WB.damCell) <= 6 ? 1.12 : 1) * r.cm.food + fish;
    networks[r.net].food += r.food;
  }

  /* Workers: farms first, then industry in order, then the jobs in services the town can pay for; the rest have no work */
  let pop = 0, food = 0, faminePop = 0;
  const foodprocLevels = regions.reduce((s, r) => s + r.ind.filter(x => x.kind === "foodproc").reduce((a, x) => a + x.lvl, 0), 0);
  const foodprocWant = foodprocLevels * INDUSTRIES.foodproc.in.food;
  const gran = granaryPlan(nation, regions.reduce((s, r) => s + r.pop, 0));
  // the reserve serves the capital's network; if the capital is lost, the government feeds the largest part still held
  const resNet = networks.find(x => x.capital) || networks.slice().sort((a, b) => b.pop - a.pop)[0];
  const foodTrade = TB ? tradeFoodPlan(w, g, TC, networks, resNet, foodprocWant, mech) : null;
  if (TB) for (const net of networks) {
    // farms grow what the people eat, what was sold abroad and what the state buys for its reserve
    const base = net.foodBase + net.foodOut;
    const wanted = base + (net === resNet ? gran.fillWant * 4 : 0);
    net.foodMade = Math.min(net.food, wanted);
    if (net === resNet) {
      gran.spare = Math.max(0, net.food - base) / 4;
      gran.fill = clamp((net.foodMade - base) / 4, 0, gran.fillWant);
      // grain bought abroad comes first; what is still short is made up from the reserve, as far as it goes
      const short = Math.max(0, net.pop - (net.food - net.foodOut) - net.foodIn) / 4;
      gran.release = Math.min(gran.stock, short);
      gran.short = short - gran.release;
      net.reserveFood = gran.release * 4;
    }
  }
  else for (const net of networks) {
    // farms grow food for export only when machinery makes farm work pay; the state buys extra for its reserve
    const exportRoom = (net.port || net.partners.length) ? 0.25 * clamp(mech / 0.4, 0, 1) : 0;
    const base = net.pop * (1.02 + exportRoom) + (net.capital ? foodprocWant : 0);
    const wanted = base + (net === resNet ? gran.fillWant * 4 : 0);
    net.foodMade = Math.min(net.food, wanted);
    if (net === resNet) {
      gran.spare = Math.max(0, net.food - base) / 4;
      gran.fill = clamp((net.foodMade - base) / 4, 0, gran.fillWant);
      // a harvest short of what the people eat is made up from the reserve, as far as it goes
      const short = Math.max(0, net.pop - net.food) / 4;
      gran.release = Math.min(gran.stock, short);
      gran.short = short - gran.release;
      net.reserveFood = gran.release * 4;
    }
  }
  for (const r of regions) { const net = networks[r.net]; r.market = 1 - Math.exp(-((net.pop + net.foreign) * (net.capital ? 1 + WB.market : 1)) / ECON.tradeScaleM); }
  const soldiersNow = nation ? (nation.mil ? nation.mil.men : nation.soldiers || 0) : 0;
  const LF = labourForce(nation, laws);
  const armed = clamp(soldiersNow / Math.max(1, regions.reduce((s, r) => s + r.pop, 0) * 1e6 * LF.lf), 0, 0.3);
  const pubShare = publicJobShare(nation);
  const MW = labourLaw(laws, "minwage");
  let workforce = 0, unemployed = 0, vacancies = 0, publicJobs = 0;
  for (const r of regions) {
    const net = networks[r.net];
    r.foodRatio = (net.food - (net.foodOut || 0) + (net.foodIn || 0) + (net.reserveFood || 0)) / Math.max(0.001, net.pop);
    r.foodMade = net.food > 0 ? net.foodMade * r.food / net.food : 0;
    r.workforce = r.pop * LF.lf * (1 - armed);
  }
  peoplePools(nation, regions, networks, LF.lf > 0 ? LF.adults / LF.lf : 1);
  for (const r of regions) {
    r.farmWorkers = Math.min(r.workforce * 0.85, r.foodMade * laborPerFood * r.cm.farmLabor);
    r.farmTake = { u: 0, s: 0, e: 0 };
    takeAny(r.pool, r.farmWorkers, r.farmTake);
    r.farmTake.over = Math.max(0, r.farmTake.s + r.farmTake.e - r.farmWorkers * JOB_MIX.farm[1]);
    let indWorkers = 0;
    for (const x of r.ind) {
      const def = INDUSTRIES[x.kind];
      if (x.kind === "smelter") x.lvl = x.lvlFull * clamp(x.mine.fill ?? 1, 0, 1);   // it can only smelt what the miners dig
      const need = x.lvl * def.workers * (x.site ? x.wmult : hasTech(nation, "automation") && def.sector === "secondary" ? 0.7 : 1);
      indWorkers += jobFill(x, need, r.pool);
    }
    r.indWorkers = indWorkers;
  }
  shareSkills(regions, networks);
  for (const r of regions) {
    const net = networks[r.net];
    const avail = poolSum(r.pool), indWorkers = r.indWorkers, unfilled = r.unfilledInd || 0;
    r.publicJobs = r.workforce * (pubShare + (r.city.capital ? JOBS.capital : 0) + r.cm.pubJobs);
    r.svcJobs = (r.workforce * (JOBS.base + JOBS.market * r.market) + JOBS.perIndustry * indWorkers) * (1 - MW.cut) + r.publicJobs;
    r.serviceWorkers = Math.max(0, Math.min(avail, r.svcJobs));
    r.svcTake = takeServices(r.pool, r.serviceWorkers, r.publicJobs);
    // a minimum wage prices some of the lowest-paid jobs out
    r.minwageLost = MW.cut * Math.max(0, r.svcTake.u - (r.svcTake.pub ? r.svcTake.pub.u : 0));
    if (r.minwageLost > 0) { r.svcTake.u -= r.minwageLost; r.serviceWorkers -= r.minwageLost; r.pool.u += r.minwageLost; }
    r.svcSkill = r.serviceWorkers > 1e-6 ? skillIndex(r.svcTake.s / r.serviceWorkers, r.svcTake.e / r.serviceWorkers) : skill;
    r.unemployed = Math.max(0, avail - r.serviceWorkers);
    // in a town cut off from the national market, people without a job farm family plots on the land nobody else farms
    r.smallholders = 0;
    if (!net.capital && r.unemployed > 0) {
      r.smallholders = Math.min(r.unemployed, Math.max(0, r.food - r.foodMade) * laborPerFood);
      r.unemployed -= r.smallholders;
    }
    r.vacancies = Math.max(0, r.svcJobs - Math.max(0, avail)) + unfilled;
    workforce += r.workforce; unemployed += r.unemployed; vacancies += r.vacancies; publicJobs += Math.min(r.publicJobs, r.serviceWorkers);
    pop += r.pop; food += r.food;
    if (r.foodRatio < ECON.famineLine) faminePop += r.pop;
  }

  /* The goods market: what everyone wants at full output, then what can actually be made */
  const demand = {}, supply = {}, imports = {}, exports = {}, sat = {};
  GOOD_ORDER.forEach(k => { demand[k] = 0; supply[k] = 0; imports[k] = 0; exports[k] = 0; sat[k] = 1; });
  const all = regions.flatMap(r => r.ind.map(x => { x.region = r; x.iso = (x.isoFixed ?? (networks[r.net].capital ? (joined.bySea.has(r.city.id) ? 0.95 : 1) : ECON7.isolatedRate)) * (1 - strikeCut(nation, x.kind)); return x; }));
  for (const x of all) {
    const def = INDUSTRIES[x.kind];
    for (const g2 in def.in || {}) demand[g2] += def.in[g2] * x.lvl * x.fill;
    if (def.power) demand.power += def.power * x.lvl * x.fill;
  }
  // households, farms, hospitals, builders and the army
  const health = SERVICE_ORDER.indexOf(laws.services || "basic");
  demand.goods += pop * 0.25 * (1 + 0.6 * skill);
  demand.power += pop * 0.06;
  demand.electronics += pop * 0.03 * skill;
  demand.machinery += regions.reduce((s, r) => s + r.foodMade, 0) * 0.04 + pop * 0.02;
  demand.chemicals += regions.reduce((s, r) => s + r.farmland, 0) * 0.03 + pop * 0.01 * (1 + health);
  const build = (nation && nation.buildAvg) || 0;               // $B a season spent on construction, smoothed
  demand.timber += build * 4 * 0.06; demand.metals += build * 4 * 0.03; demand.machinery += build * 4 * 0.02;
  const arms = (nation && nation.armsAvg) || 0;                 // $B a season spent on equipment, smoothed
  demand.metals += arms * 4 * 0.12; demand.machinery += arms * 4 * 0.06; demand.chemicals += arms * 4 * 0.05; demand.electronics += arms * 4 * 0.02;
  let tanks = 0, wings = 0;
  if (g.divisions) for (const d of g.divisions) if (d.owner === nid && d.type === "arm") tanks++;
  if (g.airwings) for (const a of g.airwings) if (a.owner === nid) wings++;
  const fuelNeed = tanks * 0.12 + wings * 0.1 + (g.sea ? navyOil(g, nid) : 0);
  demand.oil += fuelNeed;

  const produce = (x, rate) => {
    x.rate = rate;
    const def = INDUSTRIES[x.kind];
    if (x.site) {
      const k = SITE_KINDS[x.kind].good;
      x.outUnits = Math.max(0, Math.min(def.out[k] * x.lvl * rate * x.mult, x.capYear * Math.min(1, rate)));
      if (k !== "food") supply[k] += x.outUnits;
      return;
    }
    for (const g2 in def.out || {}) if (g2 !== "food") supply[g2] += def.out[g2] * x.lvl * rate * (def.sector === "secondary" && def.sub === "Energy" && hasTech(nation, "electrify") ? 1.33 : 1) * (def.sub === "Manufacturing" && hasTech(nation, "assembly") ? 1.25 : 1);
  };
  if (TB) Object.assign(TC, { demand, supply, imports, exports, sat });
  const settle = TB ? (k => tradeSettle(w, g, TC, k)) : k => {
    const short = Math.max(0, demand[k] - supply[k]);
    imports[k] = GOODS[k].local ? 0 : Math.min(short, demand[k] * importCapShare);
    sat[k] = demand[k] > 1e-6 ? Math.min(1, (supply[k] + imports[k]) / demand[k]) : 1;
    const surplus = Math.max(0, supply[k] - demand[k]);
    exports[k] = GOODS[k].local ? 0 : Math.min(surplus, Math.max(supply[k], 0.5) * exportCapShare + (k === "gold" ? surplus : 0));
  };
  const inputSat = def => Math.min(1, ...Object.keys(def.in || {}).filter(k => k !== "food").map(k => sat[k]));
  // 1. raw materials
  for (const x of all) if (INDUSTRIES[x.kind].sector === "primary") produce(x, x.fill * x.iso);
  ["timber", "metals", "coal", "oil", "gold"].forEach(settle);
  // 2. power stations
  for (const x of all) if (INDUSTRIES[x.kind].sub === "Energy") produce(x, x.fill * x.iso * inputSat(INDUSTRIES[x.kind]));
  supply.power += WB.power * (hasTech(nation, "electrify") ? 1.33 : 1);
  supply.power *= 1 + modSum(nation, "power");
  settle("power");
  const powerFactor = Math.pow(sat.power, 0.8);
  // 3. factories, then offices
  const foodSurplus = Math.max(0, food - pop);
  for (const x of all) {
    const def = INDUSTRIES[x.kind];
    if (def.sector !== "secondary" || def.sub === "Energy") continue;
    let s = inputSat(def);
    if (def.in && def.in.food) s = Math.min(s, foodSurplus / Math.max(0.01, foodprocWant));
    produce(x, x.fill * x.iso * Math.min(1, s) * powerFactor);
    if (x.kind === "smelter") { x.processed = Math.min(x.lvl * x.rate, x.mine.outUnits || 0); x.mine.smeltShare = (x.mine.outUnits || 0) > 1e-6 ? x.processed / x.mine.outUnits : 0; }
  }
  ["goods", "machinery", "chemicals"].forEach(settle);
  settle("electronics");
  for (const x of all) {
    const def = INDUSTRIES[x.kind];
    if (def.sector !== "tertiary" && def.sector !== "quaternary") continue;
    produce(x, x.fill * x.iso * powerFactor * (def.in ? inputSat(def) : 1));
  }
  demand.food = pop + foodprocLevels * INDUSTRIES.foodproc.in.food + gran.fill * 4;   // the reserve's purchase is bought, not sold abroad
  supply.food = regions.reduce((s, r) => s + r.foodMade, 0) + gran.release * 4;          // grain handed out from the store
  if (TB) {
    // grain: what came in fed the hungry before the famine was counted; what went out was grown for it
    imports.food = foodTrade.foodIn; exports.food = foodTrade.foodOut;
    sat.food = demand.food > 1e-6 ? Math.min(1, (supply.food - exports.food + imports.food) / demand.food) : 1;
    TC.trade.positions.food = { demand: demand.food, supply: supply.food, short: TC.trade.foodGap, surplus: TC.trade.foodOffer };
  } else settle("food");

  /* What the sold share of each good is worth to its makers: a glut with no buyers earns little */
  const util = {};
  GOOD_ORDER.forEach(k => { util[k] = supply[k] > 1e-6 ? Math.min(1, (demand[k] + exports[k]) / supply[k]) : 1; });

  /* Value added, by sector and sub-sector */
  const tech = (nation ? nation.tech : 1) * (1 + modSum(nation, "output")) * (1 + labourLaw(laws, "hours").out);
  const levelsOf = k => all.filter(x => x.kind === k).reduce((s, x) => s + x.lvl * (x.rate ?? 0), 0);
  INDUSTRY_ORDER.forEach(k => { levels[k] = levelsOf(k); });
  const efficiency = 1 + Math.min(0.1, 0.02 * levels.business);
  const skillMult = 0.8 + 0.5 * skill;
  const staffNow = publicStaffing(regions);
  const healthMult = 1 + (SERVICE_LAWS[laws.services || "basic"].prod || 0) * ((SERVICE_LAWS[laws.services || "basic"].prod || 0) > 0 ? staffNow.f : 1) * (0.5 + 0.5 * sat.chemicals) * (hasTech(nation, "medicine") ? 1.5 : 1);
  const sectors = { primary: { va: 0, workers: 0 }, secondary: { va: 0, workers: 0 }, tertiary: { va: 0, workers: 0 }, quaternary: { va: 0, workers: 0 } };
  const subs = {};
  const addSub = (sector, sub, va, workers) => {
    sectors[sector].va += va; sectors[sector].workers += workers;
    const key = `${sector}|${sub}`;
    if (!subs[key]) subs[key] = { sector, sub, va: 0, workers: 0 };
    subs[key].va += va; subs[key].workers += workers;
  };
  const atPeace = !(g.wars && g.wars.some(war => war.sideA.includes(nid) || war.sideB.includes(nid)));
  const stab = nation ? nation.stability : 60;
  for (const x of all) {
    const def = INDUSTRIES[x.kind];
    const outKey = Object.keys(def.out || {})[0];
    let u = outKey && outKey !== "food" ? util[outKey] : 1;
    if (x.kind === "resort") u = (atPeace ? 1 : 0.3) * clamp(stab / 60, 0.3, 1.2);
    const importPenalty = Object.keys(def.in || {}).some(k => (TB ? TC.worldIn[k] || 0 : imports[k]) > 0.05 * demand[k]) ? 1 - ECON7.importPremium * 0.5 : 1;
    const va = x.site ? siteVA(g, x, u, skillMult * efficiency * tech * healthMult)
      : x.kind === "smelter" ? (x.processed || 0) * SMELT.vaPerUnit * priceOf(g, "metals") * (util.metals ?? 1) * importPenalty * skillMult * efficiency * tech * healthMult
      : def.workers * x.lvl * (x.rate ?? 0) * def.va * u * importPenalty * skillMult * efficiency * tech * healthMult;
    const vaC = va * x.region.cm.out * (!x.site && def.sector === "secondary" ? x.region.cm.ind : 1) * (x.kind === "resort" ? x.region.cm.resort : 1);
    x.va = vaC;
    x.region.gdp = (x.region.gdp || 0) + vaC;
    addSub(def.sector, def.sub, vaC, x.workers);
  }
  // farms
  for (const r of regions) {
    const va = r.foodMade * ECON7.farmValueB * (1 + 0.5 * mech) * tech * healthMult
      + (r.smallholders || 0) / Math.max(1e-6, laborPerFood) * ECON7.farmValueB * JOBS.smallVA * tech * healthMult;   // family plots: a little food and income
    const vaF = va * r.cm.out;
    r.farmVA = vaF;
    r.gdp = (r.gdp || 0) + vaF;
    addSub("primary", "Agriculture", vaF, r.farmWorkers + (r.smallholders || 0));
  }
  // services: everyone else, as productive as the market, skills and tools around them allow
  const itBoost = Math.min(0.25, 0.04 * levels.techpark) + (hasTech(nation, "computing") ? 0.08 : 0);
  const finLaw = FINANCE_LAWS[laws.finance || "balanced"];
  const goldBoost = supply.gold > 0.1 ? 0.03 : 0;
  const logistics = clamp(0.35 + 0.35 * (1 - regions.filter(r => !networks[r.net].capital).length / regions.length) + (anyPort ? 0.15 : 0) + 0.15 * Math.min(sat.oil, sat.machinery) + WB.logistics, 0, 1);
  const tourism = levels.resort;
  for (const r of regions) {
    const net = networks[r.net];
    const market = 1 - Math.exp(-((net.pop + net.foreign) * (net.capital ? 1 + WB.market : 1)) / ECON.tradeScaleM);
    r.market = market;
    const mult = 1 + 0.45 * market + 0.5 * (r.svcSkill ?? skill) + 0.15 * (sat.goods - 0.5) + itBoost + finLaw.services + goldBoost + 0.12 * (net.port ? 1 : 0) + 0.1 * logistics + WB.finance + (WB.harborCity === r.city.id ? 0.08 : 0) + (WB.tourismCity === r.city.id ? 0.04 : 0) + r.cm.svc;
    r.serviceK = ECON7.serviceK * mult * (0.85 + 0.15 * sat.power) * tech * efficiency * healthMult * (net.capital ? 1 : 0.85) * r.cm.out * r.cm.size;
    const va = r.serviceWorkers * r.serviceK;
    r.svcVA = va;
    r.gdp = (r.gdp || 0) + va;
    // split services into their parts, by what drives each
    const parts = { "Retail and wholesale": 0.3 * (0.5 + sat.goods), "Transport and logistics": 0.18 * (0.5 + logistics), "Finance and banking": 0.08 * (1 + 3 * finLaw.services + 3 * goldBoost),
      "Healthcare": 0.1 * (0.6 + 0.3 * health), "Education": 0.1 * (0.6 + 0.4 * EDU_ORDER.indexOf(laws.education || "basic")), "Government and other services": 0.24 };
    const tot = Object.values(parts).reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0);
    for (const p in parts) addSub("tertiary", p, va * parts[p] / tot, r.serviceWorkers * parts[p] / tot);
    r.outputK = r.gdp / Math.max(0.001, r.pop);
  }
  // construction is counted where it happens
  if (build > 0) addSub("secondary", "Construction", build * 4 * 0.35 * tech, build * 4 * 0.35 / 24);
  // shipping: what your own freighters earn carrying your trade
  if (seaT && seaT.income > 0.001) addSub("tertiary", "Shipping", seaT.income, (seaT.tradeF || 0) * SHIP_TYPES.freighter.crew / 1e6);
  // trade: the cost of what had to be imported, and tariffs collected on it
  let importBill = 0, exportValue = 0;
  GOOD_ORDER.forEach(k => { const pr = GOODS[k].price * priceOf(g, k); importBill += imports[k] * pr; exportValue += exports[k] * pr; });
  // with the book: what imports cost beyond their world price is transport by land, the middlemen's cut on the world
  // market, and foreign shipowners' fees; without it, the old flat premium on everything imported
  const tradeLoss = TB ? TC.transport + TC.premium : importBill * ECON7.importPremium;
  let gdp = Object.values(sectors).reduce((s, x) => s + x.va, 0) - tradeLoss - (seaT ? seaT.fees || 0 : 0);
  let tradeOut = emptyTradeEcon();
  if (TB) {
    tradeOut = TC.trade;
    Object.assign(tradeOut, { importCost: importBill + tradeLoss, tariffBase: TC.tariffBase, transportCost: TC.transport, premiumCost: TC.premium, seaMtWanted: TC.seaMt, seaMtIn: TC.seaMtIn,
      open: access > 0 || Object.keys(TRD.links).some(o => !tradeBlocked(g, Number(o), nid, "goods") || !tradeBlocked(g, nid, Number(o), "goods")) });
  }

  const constructionSat = Math.min(sat.timber, (sat.metals + sat.machinery) / 2);
  const isolated = regions.filter(r => !networks[r.net].capital).map(r => r.city);
  const cityResearch = regions.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.cm.learning ? 2 + r.ind.filter(x => x.kind === "university" || x.kind === "techpark").reduce((a, x) => a + x.lvl * (x.rate ?? 0), 0) : 0), 0);
  const research = all.reduce((s, x) => s + (INDUSTRIES[x.kind].research || 0) * x.lvl * (x.rate ?? 0), 0) + cityResearch;
  const armsSat = Math.min(sat.metals, (sat.machinery + sat.chemicals) / 2);
  const people = peopleSummary(nation, regions, all, { gdp, pop, unemployed, sat }, LF, armed);
  return {
    people,
    cities, regions, networks, gdp, pop, food, faminePop, famineShare: faminePop / Math.max(0.001, pop), isolated, roadEdges, area,
    sectors, subs: Object.values(subs), goods: { demand, supply, imports, exports, util }, sat, levels, workers: pop * LF.lf,
    research, mech, fert, logistics, tourism, importBill, exportValue, tariffs: (TB ? TC.tariffBase : importBill) * tradeLaw.tariff, tariffBase: TB ? TC.tariffBase : importBill,
    trade: tradeOut, foodIn: TB ? foodTrade.foodIn : 0, foodOut: TB ? foodTrade.foodOut : 0,
    constructionIndex: (1 + 0.6 * (1 - constructionSat)) * (1 - Math.min(0.1, 0.02 * levels.business)) * (1 + modSum(nation, "build")) * (hasTrait(nation, "pragmatic") ? 0.95 : 1),
    armsSat, fuelSat: fuelNeed > 0 ? Math.min(1, sat.oil) : 1, healthMult, access, seaAccess, seaLinks: joined.links, bySea: joined.bySea, byRiver: joined.byRiver, freightFees: seaT ? seaT.fees || 0 : 0,
    effects: { goodsSat: sat.goods, powerSat: sat.power },
    workforce, unemployed, unemployment: unemployed / Math.max(1e-6, workforce), vacancies, armed, publicJobs, smallholders: regions.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.smallholders || 0), 0), harvest: harvestFactor(nation),
    granary: { ...gran, turn: g.turn }, lostToIdle: regions.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.unemployed || 0) * (r.serviceK || 0), 0),
    sites: siteList, reach,
    researchMult: 1 + WB.research + modSum(nation, "research"), skillBonus: WB.skill, capitalMult: 1 + WB.capital, interestCut: WB.interest, works: WB,
    programs: regions.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.cm.focus ? focusUpkeepCost(r.cm.focus, r) : 0) + (r.cm.seat && r.cm.focus !== "seat" ? focusUpkeepCost("seat", r) : 0), 0), seats: regions.filter(r => r.cm.seat).length,
    citySkill: Math.min(0.02, 0.01 * regions.filter(r => r.cm.learning).length), cityResearch,
    provGrants: provGrantsTotal(g, nid, regions),   // the money for the provinces this season (10v)
  };
}

/* =====================================================================
   8. Budget and stability (pure)
   ===================================================================== */
function taxLaw(v) { return TAX_LAWS.find(t => t.v === v) || TAX_LAWS[1]; }

function computeBudget(n, econ, laws) {
  const gdp = econ.gdp, q = gdp / 4;
  const collection = clamp(ECON.collectFloor + (1 - ECON.collectFloor) * n.stability / ECON.collectFullAt, ECON.collectFloor, 1);
  const revenue = q * (laws.tax / 100) * collection * (hasTrait(n, "corrupt") ? 0.95 : 1) * (1 + modSum(n, "revenue") + (hasTrait(n, "greedy") ? 0.05 : 0));
  const services = econ.pop * SERVICE_LAWS[laws.services].costK / 4;
  const education = econ.pop * EDU_LAWS[laws.education || "basic"].costK / 4;
  const research = q * RESEARCH_LAWS[laws.research || "low"].share;
  // import tax on what pays duty (everything from the world market, and from nations without a trade agreement)
  const tariffs = (econ.tariffBase ?? econ.importBill ?? 0) / 4 * TRADE_LAWS[laws.trade || "balanced"].tariff;
  const mil = n.mil || { men: n.soldiers || 0, value: 0 };
  const soldiersNext = mil.men, recruits = 0;
  const armyUpkeep = (mil.men * MIL.upkeepK) / 4e6 + mil.value * MIL.maintenance;
  const arms = armsPlan(n, econ, laws);
  const army = armyUpkeep + arms.spend;
  const upkeep = econ.roadEdges * ECON.roadUpkeepB + portsUpkeep(econ.cities);
  const navy = n.navyUpkeep || 0;
  const gc = granaryCost(n, econ, laws);
  const cab = cabinetUpkeep(n, econ);
  const programs = econ.programs || 0;
  const provinces = econ.provGrants || 0;   // money for the provinces, spent by their governors (10v)
  const pensions = pensionCostYear(n, econ, laws) / 4;
  const debt = Math.max(0, -n.treasury);
  const debtRatio = debt / Math.max(1, gdp);
  const interestRate = Math.max(0.01, ECON.interestBase + ECON.interestRisk * Math.max(0, debtRatio - ECON.riskRef) - (hasTech(n, "finance") ? 0.01 : 0) - ((econ.goods && econ.goods.supply.gold > 0.3) ? 0.005 : 0) - (econ.interestCut || 0));
  const interest = (debt * interestRate) / 4;
  return {
    gdp, collection, revenue, services, education, research, tariffs, army, armyUpkeep, arms, soldiersNext, recruits, upkeep, interest, interestRate, debt, debtRatio, navy,
    granary: gc.cost, granaryFill: gc.fill, ministries: cab, programs, pensions, provinces,
    balance: revenue + tariffs - services - education - research - army - navy - upkeep - interest - gc.cost - cab - programs - pensions - provinces,
  };
}

function stabilityTerms(n, econ, budget, laws, mood, extra = []) {
  const terms = [{ label: "Founding conditions (shape of the realm)", value: n.baseStability, base: true }];
  // each province capital eases governing a large country (10u), at most as much as two provincial seats did before v38
  const seatN = Math.min(PROV.seatEaseMax, econ.seats || 0), seatCut = 1 - PROV.seatEase * seatN;
  const sizeTerm = -Math.max(0, econ.area - FOUNDING.sizeThreshold) / FOUNDING.sizePerPoint * seatCut;
  if (sizeTerm < -0.05) terms.push({ label: `Governing ${fmtArea(econ.area)}${seatCut < 1 ? ` (eased by ${seatN} province capital${seatN > 1 ? "s" : ""})` : ""}`, value: sizeTerm });
  const tax = taxLaw(laws.tax);
  if (tax.stab) terms.push({ label: `${tax.label} taxes`, value: tax.stab });
  const sv = SERVICE_LAWS[laws.services];
  if (sv.stab) terms.push({ label: `${sv.label} healthcare`, value: sv.stab });
  const ed = EDU_LAWS[laws.education || "basic"];
  if (ed.stab) terms.push({ label: `${ed.label} schools and universities`, value: ed.stab });
  const tr = TRADE_LAWS[laws.trade || "balanced"];
  if (tr.stab) terms.push({ label: tr.stab > 0 ? "Protected industries keep jobs safe" : "Free trade unsettles local workers", value: tr.stab });
  if (econ.sat) {
    if (econ.sat.goods < 0.6) terms.push({ label: `Empty shops (${pct(econ.sat.goods)} of consumer goods wanted)`, value: -(0.6 - econ.sat.goods) * 15 });
    else if (econ.sat.goods > 0.95) terms.push({ label: "Shops are full", value: 2 });
    if (econ.sat.power < 0.95) terms.push({ label: `Blackouts (${pct(econ.sat.power)} of electricity needed)`, value: -(0.95 - econ.sat.power) * 12 });
    if ((econ.levels.broadcast || 0) > 0) terms.push({ label: "Radio and press rally the nation", value: Math.min(4.5, 1.5 * econ.levels.broadcast) });
  }
  const jobsTerm = unemploymentStabTerm(n, econ, laws);
  if (jobsTerm) terms.push(jobsTerm);
  terms.push(...peopleStabTerms(n, econ, laws));
  for (const t of cabinetStabTerms(n)) terms.push(t);
  if (n.crisisActive) terms.push({ label: "Banking crisis", value: -6 });
  if (hasTrait(n, "charismatic")) terms.push({ label: `${leaderName(n)} is loved by the people`, value: 4 });
  if (hasTrait(n, "corrupt")) terms.push({ label: `${leaderName(n)}'s corruption`, value: -3 });
  const ar = ARMY_LAWS[laws.army];
  if (ar.stab) terms.push({ label: `Conscription: ${ar.label.toLowerCase()}`, value: ar.stab });
  const am = ARMS_LAWS[laws.arms || "low"];
  if (am.stab) terms.push({ label: `Arms production: ${am.label.toLowerCase()} (rationing, long shifts)`, value: am.stab });
  if (Math.abs(mood) >= 0.05) terms.push({ label: mood >= 0 ? "Rising prosperity" : "Falling living standards", value: mood });
  if (econ.famineShare > 0.001) terms.push({ label: `Food shortage (${pct(econ.famineShare)} of people)${modSum(n, "famineShield") > 0 ? ", eased by full granaries" : ""}`, value: -ECON.famineWeight * econ.famineShare * (1 - Math.min(0.9, modSum(n, "famineShield"))) });
  if (econ.isolated.length) terms.push({ label: `${econ.isolated.length} town${econ.isolated.length > 1 ? "s" : ""} cut off from the capital`, value: -Math.min(ECON.isolationCap, ECON.isolationEach * econ.isolated.length) });
  if (budget.debtRatio > ECON.riskRef) terms.push({ label: `Debt at ${pct(budget.debtRatio)} of GDP`, value: -ECON.debtWeight * (budget.debtRatio - ECON.riskRef) });
  if (budget.debtRatio > ECON.lendersCloseAt) terms.push({ label: "Lenders refuse new loans", value: -ECON.lendersClosedStab });
  terms.push(...extra);
  return terms;
}
function sumTerms(terms) { return terms.reduce((s, t) => s + t.value, 0); }

function techGrowth(n, econ, laws, rng) {
  const armyShare = Math.min(0.2, n.soldiers / Math.max(1e5, econ.pop * 1e6));
  return ECON.techBase * EDU_LAWS[laws.education || "basic"].tech
    - ECON.taxDrag * (laws.tax / 100 - 0.25)
    - ECON.unrestDrag * Math.max(0, 50 - n.stability)
    - ECON.armyLaborDrag * Math.max(0, armyShare - 0.01)
    - ARMS_LAWS[laws.arms || "low"].drag
    + (hasTrait(n, "reformer") ? 0.0008 : 0)
    + (rng ? gaussian(rng) * ECON.shockSd : 0);
}

/* Forecast for the season ahead without changing anything. */
function forecast(w, g, nid, laws) {
  const n = g.nations[nid];
  const econ = computeEconomy(w, g, nid);
  const budget = computeBudget(n, econ, laws);
  const tg = techGrowth({ ...n, soldiers: budget.soldiersNext }, econ, laws, null);
  const mood = clamp(ECON.moodWeight * tg * 4, -ECON.moodCap, ECON.moodCap);
  const terms = stabilityTerms(n, econ, budget, laws, mood, (g.wars ? warStabilityTerms(g, nid) : []).concat(storyStabilityTerms(g, n)));
  const target = clamp(sumTerms(terms), 0, 100);
  return { econ, budget, terms, target };
}

/* =====================================================================
   9. Projects: roads, towns, ports, irrigation — quotes, value, ordering
   ===================================================================== */
function hypothetical(g, change) {
  const h = { ...g };
  if (change.edges) { h.roads = new Set(g.roads); change.edges.forEach(e => h.roads.add(e)); }
  if (change.claim) { h.owner = g.owner.slice(); change.claim.forEach(c => { h.owner[c] = change.nid; }); h.owner[change.city.cell] = change.nid; }
  if (change.city) h.cities = g.cities.concat([change.city]);
  if (change.portCity) h.cities = g.cities.map(c => (c.id === change.portCity ? { ...c, port: true } : c));
  if (change.portUp) h.cities = (h.cities || g.cities).map(c => (c.id === change.portUp.cityId ? { ...c, portLvl: change.portUp.level } : c));
  if (change.wharfCity) h.cities = (h.cities || g.cities).map(c => (c.id === change.wharfCity ? { ...c, wharf: true } : c));
  if (change.freighters) h.nations = g.nations.map(n => (n.id === change.nid ? { ...n, freighters: (n.freighters || 0) + change.freighters } : n));
  if (change.irrigate) { h.irrigated = g.irrigated.slice(); change.irrigate.forEach(c => { h.irrigated[c] = 1; }); }
  if (change.treaty) h.treaties = (g.treaties || []).concat([{ id: -1, ...change.treaty }]);
  // embargoes live in the trade book (10s): the copy gets its own list, the contracts stay shared (never changed)
  if ((change.embargo || change.lift) && g.trade) {
    let E = g.trade.embargoes || [];
    if (change.lift) E = E.filter(e => !(change.lift.id !== undefined ? e.id === change.lift.id : e.by === change.lift.by && e.on === change.lift.on));
    if (change.embargo) E = E.concat([change.embargo]);
    h.trade = { ...g.trade, embargoes: E };
  }
  // "this season": merchants have not yet looked for other sellers for what an embargo or war cut off (10s)
  if (change.noReroute) h.noReroute = true;
  if (change.site) {
    const sp = change.site;
    if (sp.id !== undefined) h.sites = g.sites.map(x => (x.id === sp.id ? { ...x, level: sp.level } : x));
    else h.sites = g.sites.concat([{ id: -1, cell: sp.cell, kind: sp.kind, level: sp.level || 1, pace: "normal", paused: false, opened: g.turn, extracted: 0, name: sp.name || "" }]);
  }
  if (change.work) {
    const k = change.work.key;
    h.works = { ...(g.works || {}), [k]: { owner: change.work.nid, done: g.turn, cell: change.work.cell, builders: {} } };
  }
  if (change.smelter) h.sites = (h.sites || g.sites).map(x => (x.id === change.smelter ? { ...x, smelter: true } : x));
  if (change.focus) h.cities = (h.cities || g.cities).map(c => (c.id === change.focus.cityId ? { ...c, focus: change.focus.key, focusAt: g.turn } : c));
  if (change.industry) {
    const { cityId, kind } = change.industry;
    h.cities = (h.cities || g.cities).map(c => (c.id === cityId ? { ...c, ind: { ...(c.ind || {}), [kind]: ((c.ind || {})[kind] || 0) + 1 } } : c));
  }
  return h;
}

function projectValue(w, g, nid, change, baseEcon) {
  const base = baseEcon || computeEconomy(w, g, nid);
  const after = computeEconomy(w, hypothetical(g, change), nid);
  const perPerson = base.gdp / Math.max(0.001, base.pop);
  const dGdp = after.gdp - base.gdp;
  const dFood = after.food - base.food;
  const famineRelief = Math.max(0, base.faminePop - after.faminePop);
  const value = dGdp + Math.max(0, dFood) * perPerson * ECON.futureFoodWeight + famineRelief * perPerson * 0.5;
  const satChanges = GOOD_ORDER.filter(k => base.sat && after.sat && base.goods.demand[k] > 0.05 && after.sat[k] - base.sat[k] > 0.02).map(k => ({ good: k, from: base.sat[k], to: after.sat[k] }));
  const satLosses = GOOD_ORDER.filter(k => base.sat && after.sat && base.goods.demand[k] > 0.05 && base.sat[k] - after.sat[k] > 0.02).map(k => ({ good: k, from: base.sat[k], to: after.sat[k] }));
  // a smelter: how much ore it would really smelt, and whether it would have coal and electricity to do it
  const sx = change && change.smelter != null ? (after.sites || []).find(y => y.site && y.site.id === change.smelter) : null;
  const smelt = sx && sx.smelterX ? { smelted: sx.smelterX.processed || 0, smeltCoal: after.sat ? after.sat.coal ?? 1 : 1, smeltPower: after.sat ? after.sat.power ?? 1 : 1 } : {};
  return { dGdp, dFood, famineRelief, value, gdpBase: base.gdp, reconnected: base.isolated.length - after.isolated.length, satChanges, satLosses, ...smelt };
}

function canAfford(n, gdp, cost) {
  if (gdp > 0 && Math.max(0, -n.treasury) / gdp > ECON.lendersCloseAt) return { ok: false, reason: "Lenders refuse new loans while debt is above 120% of GDP." };
  if (n.treasury - cost < BUILD.creditFloorShare * gdp) return { ok: false, reason: `Not enough money. This would push debt past ${pct(-BUILD.creditFloorShare)} of GDP.` };
  return { ok: true };
}

function busyCity(g, cityId, kind) { return g.projects.some(p => p.cityId === cityId && p.kind === kind); }

/* A road into another nation's land is a trade road: it needs a trade agreement (or alliance), and crosses only
   our land, wild land and theirs. We pay for all of it. */
function tradeRoadBlock(g, nid, other) {
  if (!g.nations[other] || !g.nations[other].alive) return "That nation no longer exists.";
  if (atWar(g, nid, other)) return `You are at war with the ${nameOf(g, other)}.`;
  if (!hasTreaty(g, nid, other, "trade") && !hasTreaty(g, nid, other, "alliance"))
    return `A road into the ${nameOf(g, other)}'s land needs a trade agreement with them first. Agree to trade, then build the road: the road is what lets the goods move.`;
  return null;
}
function quoteTradeRoad(w, g, nid, fromCity, toCity) {
  const other = toCity.owner;
  const block = tradeRoadBlock(g, nid, other);
  if (block) return { ok: false, kind: "road", reason: block };
  const path = findRoadPath(w, g, nid, fromCity.cell, toCity.cell, new Set([nid, -1, other]));
  if (!path) return { ok: false, kind: "road", reason: `No route over land joins ${fromCity.name} and ${toCity.name} without crossing a third nation.` };
  if (path.length > BUILD.roadMaxReach * 1.8) return { ok: false, kind: "road", path, reason: "Too far for one road. Start from a town closer to the border." };
  const q = roadQuote(w, g, path);
  if (!q.newEdges.length) return { ok: false, kind: "road", path, reason: "These towns are already connected by road." };
  // they build the stretch inside their own land; we pay for ours and the wild land between
  const theirs = q.newEdges.filter(e => edgeEnds(e).every(c => g.owner[c] === other));
  const theirShare = theirs.length ? roadQuote(w, { ...g, roads: new Set([...g.roads, ...q.newEdges.filter(e => !theirs.includes(e))]) }, path).cost : 0;
  q.partnerCost = theirShare;
  q.cost = Math.max(0, q.cost - theirShare);
  const value = projectValue(w, g, nid, { edges: q.newEdges });
  return { ok: true, kind: "road", trade: other, nid, path, from: fromCity, to: toCity, ...q, ...value, label: `Trade road from ${fromCity.name} to ${toCity.name} (the ${nameOf(g, other)})` };
}
/* The cheapest trade road between two nations, if one can be built. */
function bestTradeRoad(w, g, nid, other) {
  const mine = g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === nid && !(g.occ && g.occ[c.cell] >= 0));
  const theirs = g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === other && !(g.occ && g.occ[c.cell] >= 0));
  const pairs = [];
  for (const a of mine) for (const b of theirs) pairs.push({ a, b, d: dist(a.cell, b.cell) });
  pairs.sort((x, y) => x.d - y.d);
  for (const p of pairs.slice(0, 3)) {
    if (p.d > BUILD.roadMaxReach * 1.4) break;
    const q = quoteTradeRoad(w, g, nid, p.a, p.b);
    if (q.ok) return q;
  }
  return null;
}

function quoteRoad(w, g, nid, fromCity, toCity) {
  if (fromCity.id === toCity.id) return { ok: false, kind: "road", reason: "Pick a different town." };
  if (fromCity.owner !== nid) return { ok: false, kind: "road", reason: "Start the road at one of your own towns." };
  if (toCity.owner !== nid) return quoteTradeRoad(w, g, nid, fromCity, toCity);
  const path = findRoadPath(w, g, nid, fromCity.cell, toCity.cell);
  if (!path) return { ok: false, kind: "road", reason: "No route through your own land connects these towns." };
  const q = roadQuote(w, g, path);
  if (!q.newEdges.length) return { ok: false, kind: "road", path, reason: "These towns are already connected by road." };
  if (path.length > BUILD.roadMaxReach * 1.6) return { ok: false, kind: "road", path, reason: "Too far for one road. Connect a closer town first." };
  const value = projectValue(w, g, nid, { edges: q.newEdges });
  if (value.reconnected > 0) value.value += 0.012 * value.gdpBase * value.reconnected;
  return { ok: true, kind: "road", nid, path, from: fromCity, to: toCity, ...q, ...value, label: `Road from ${fromCity.name} to ${toCity.name}` };
}

function townClaim(w, g, site) {
  const claim = [];
  const R = Math.ceil(BUILD.townClaimRadius);
  for (let dy = -R; dy <= R; dy++) for (let dx = -R; dx <= R; dx++) {
    const x = cellX(site) + dx, y = cellY(site) + dy;
    if (!inBounds(x, y) || dx * dx + dy * dy > BUILD.townClaimRadius ** 2) continue;
    const i = idx(x, y);
    if (isLand(w, i) && g.owner[i] === -1) claim.push(i);
  }
  return claim;
}

function nearOwnLand(g, nid, cell, reach) {
  for (let dy = -reach; dy <= reach; dy++) for (let dx = -reach; dx <= reach; dx++) {
    const x = cellX(cell) + dx, y = cellY(cell) + dy;
    if (inBounds(x, y) && g.owner[idx(x, y)] === nid) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

function quoteTown(w, g, nid, site) {
  const fail = reason => ({ ok: false, kind: "town", site, reason });
  if (!isLand(w, site)) return fail("Towns must be built on land.");
  const owner = g.owner[site];
  if (owner !== nid && owner !== -1) return fail("That land belongs to another nation.");
  if (g.occ && g.occ[site] >= 0) return fail("That land is occupied by an enemy army.");
  for (const t of g.treaties || []) {
    if (t.type !== "border" || (t.a !== nid && t.b !== nid)) continue;
    const other = t.a === nid ? t.b : t.a;
    if (distanceToNation(g, other, site) <= DIPLO.nearBorderCells) return fail(`Your border accord with the ${g.nations[other].name} forbids new towns this close to them.`);
  }
  const nearest = g.cities.reduce((m, c) => Math.min(m, dist(c.cell, site)), Infinity);
  const pendingNear = g.projects.some(p => p.kind === "town" && dist(p.site, site) < BUILD.townMinSpacing);
  if (nearest < BUILD.townMinSpacing || pendingNear) return fail("Too close to another town.");
  let overseas = null;
  if (owner === -1 && !nearOwnLand(g, nid, site, BUILD.townReach)) {
    overseas = overseasTownCheck(w, g, nid, site);
    if (!overseas.ok) return fail(overseas.reason);
  }
  const claim = townClaim(w, g, site);
  const name = uniqueName({ usedNames: new Set(g.usedNames) }, mulberry32(site * 977 + g.turn * 13 + nid));
  const city = { id: -1, owner: nid, cell: site, name, capital: false, port: false, irrigated: false };
  const value = projectValue(w, g, nid, { nid, claim, city });
  let claimFood = 0;
  claim.forEach(c => { claimFood += cellFood(w, g, c); });
  return {
    ok: true, kind: "town", nid, site, claim, name, claimFood, ...value, overseas: !!overseas, fromPort: overseas ? overseas.port.id : null,
    cost: (BUILD.townBaseB + BUILD.townPerCellB * claim.length) * (1 + 0.12 * g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === nid).length) + (overseas ? 1 : 0), seasons: 1, label: overseas ? `New town of ${name}, across the sea` : `New town of ${name}`,
  };
}

function quotePort(w, g, nid, city) {
  const fail = reason => ({ ok: false, kind: "port", reason });
  if (city.owner !== nid) return fail("Not your town.");
  if (city.port) return fail(`${city.name} already has a port.`);
  if (!w.coastal[city.cell]) return fail(`${city.name} is not on the coast.`);
  if (portSeaCell(w, city.cell) < 0) return fail(`${city.name} lies on a lake, not the open sea: ships could not reach it.`);
  if (busyCity(g, city.id, "port")) return fail("A port is already being built here.");
  const value = projectValue(w, g, nid, { portCity: city.id });
  const room = g.sea ? portRoomValue(w, g, nid, PORT_LEVELS[1].tradeMt) : 0;
  value.dGdp += room; value.value += room; value.room = room;
  return { ok: true, kind: "port", nid, cityId: city.id, cost: BUILD.portB, seasons: 1, ...value, label: `Harbor at ${city.name}` };
}

function regionCellsOf(w, g, nid, city) {
  const econ = computeEconomy(w, g, nid);
  const r = econ.regions.find(r => r.city.id === city.id);
  return r ? r.cells : [];
}

function quoteIrrigation(w, g, nid, city) {
  const fail = reason => ({ ok: false, kind: "irrigation", reason });
  if (city.owner !== nid) return fail("Not your town.");
  if (city.irrigated) return fail(`${city.name}'s fields are already irrigated.`);
  if (busyCity(g, city.id, "irrigation")) return fail("Irrigation is already being dug here.");
  const plains = regionCellsOf(w, g, nid, city).filter(c => w.terrain[c] === T.PLAINS && !g.irrigated[c]);
  if (plains.length < BUILD.irrigationMinPlains) return fail(`Too little farmland around ${city.name} to irrigate.`);
  const value = projectValue(w, g, nid, { irrigate: plains });
  return {
    ok: true, kind: "irrigation", nid, cityId: city.id, cells: plains,
    cost: BUILD.irrigationBaseB + BUILD.irrigationPerPlainsB * plains.length,
    seasons: BUILD.irrigationSeasons, ...value, label: `Irrigation around ${city.name}`,
  };
}

function orderProject(g, quote, reason, isPrivate = false) {
  if (quote.kind === "work") { startWork(g, quote); return { kind: "work", label: quote.label }; }
  const n = g.nations[quote.nid];
  if (!isPrivate) { n.treasury -= quote.cost; n.buildSpend = (n.buildSpend || 0) + quote.cost; }
  const p = { id: g.nextId++, kind: quote.kind, nid: quote.nid, cost: quote.cost, label: quote.label, seasons: quote.seasons, progress: 0, reason: reason || null, private: isPrivate };
  if (quote.kind === "industry") { p.cityId = quote.cityId; p.ind = quote.ind; }
  if (quote.kind === "site") { p.cell = quote.cell; p.siteKind = quote.siteKind; p.siteId = quote.siteId; p.level = quote.level; p.name = quote.name; }
  if (quote.kind === "survey") p.cell = quote.cell;
  if (quote.kind === "smelter") { p.cell = quote.cell; p.siteId = quote.siteId; }
  if (quote.partnerCost && quote.trade !== undefined && g.nations[quote.trade]) g.nations[quote.trade].treasury -= quote.partnerCost;
  if (quote.kind === "road") { p.edges = quote.newEdges; p.path = quote.path; }
  if (quote.kind === "town") { p.site = quote.site; p.name = quote.name; g.usedNames.add(quote.name); if (quote.overseas) { p.overseas = true; p.fromPort = quote.fromPort; n.lastOverseas = g.turn; } }
  if (quote.kind === "portup") { p.cityId = quote.cityId; p.level = quote.level; }
  if (quote.kind === "wharf") p.cityId = quote.cityId;
  if (quote.kind === "ships") {
    p.cityId = quote.cityId; p.ship = quote.ship; p.count = quote.count; p.slips = quote.slips || 0; p.ordered = g.turn;
    if (quote.seller !== undefined) { p.seller = quote.seller; if (quote.yardId !== undefined) p.yardId = quote.yardId; if (quote.seller >= 0 && g.nations[quote.seller]) g.nations[quote.seller].treasury += quote.cost; }
  }
  if (quote.kind === "focus") { p.cityId = quote.cityId; p.focus = quote.focus; }
  if (quote.kind === "capital") { p.cityId = quote.cityId; addNationMod(g, n, { key: "capital_move", label: "The government is moving to a new capital", stab: -3, seasons: quote.seasons }); }
  if (quote.kind === "port" || quote.kind === "irrigation") p.cityId = quote.cityId;
  if (quote.kind === "irrigation") p.cells = quote.cells;
  if (quote.kind === "province") p.op = quote.op;
  g.projects.push(p);
  return p;
}

/* Advance construction one season. Roads appear on the map piece by piece. */
function advanceProjects(w, g) {
  const finished = [];
  for (const p of g.projects) {
    p.progress += 1;
    if (p.kind === "road") {
      const built = Math.min(p.edges.length, p.progress * BUILD.roadEdgesPerSeason);
      p.edges.slice(0, built).forEach(e => g.roads.add(e));
    }
    if (p.progress >= p.seasons) finished.push(p);
  }
  for (const p of finished) {
    if (p.kind === "town") {
      const siteOwner = g.owner[p.site];
      if (siteOwner !== -1 && siteOwner !== p.nid) { p.failed = true; g.nations[p.nid].treasury += p.cost * 0.5; continue; }
      townClaim(w, g, p.site).forEach(c => { g.owner[c] = p.nid; });
      g.owner[p.site] = p.nid;
      const born = { id: g.nextId++, owner: p.nid, cell: p.site, name: p.name, capital: false, port: false, irrigated: false, founded: g.turn, origin: p.nid, loyalty: 85, mood: 60, hist: [] };
      g.cities.push(born);
      cityHist(g, born, `Founded by the ${nameOf(g, p.nid)}${p.overseas ? ", by settlers who came across the sea" : ""}.`, "good");
      leaderDeed(g, p.nid, "towns");
      if (g.rel) {
        bumpWorld(g);
        for (const z of g.nations) {
          if (z.id === p.nid || !z.alive) continue;
          const d = distanceToNation(g, z.id, p.site);
          if (d > DIPLO.nearBorderCells) continue;
          addMod(g, z.id, p.nid, "settled_near", "Settled land near our border", -10, 0.5, -30);
          remember(g, z.id, `The ${g.nations[p.nid].name} founded ${p.name} only ${Math.round(d)} cells from our border.`);
        }
      }
    }
    if (p.kind === "port") { const c = g.cities.find(c => c.id === p.cityId); if (c) { c.port = true; c.portLvl = Math.max(1, c.portLvl || 1); } }
    if (p.kind === "portup" || p.kind === "wharf" || p.kind === "ships") finishSeaProject(w, g, p);
    if (p.kind === "site") {
      if (g.owner[p.cell] !== p.nid) { p.failed = true; g.nations[p.nid].treasury += p.cost * 0.5; continue; }
      if (p.siteId) { const st = g.sites.find(x => x.id === p.siteId); if (st) st.level = Math.max(st.level, p.level); }
      else if (!g.sites.some(x => x.cell === p.cell)) g.sites.push({ id: g.nextId++, cell: p.cell, kind: p.siteKind, level: 1, pace: "normal", paused: false, opened: g.turn, extracted: 0, name: p.name || siteName(g, p.cell, p.siteKind) });
    }
    if (p.kind === "survey") p.found = finishSurvey(w, g, p);
    if (p.kind === "smelter") {
      const st = g.sites.find(x => x.id === p.siteId);
      if (!st || g.owner[st.cell] !== p.nid || st.exhausted) { p.failed = true; g.nations[p.nid].treasury += p.cost * 0.5; continue; }
      st.smelter = true; st.smelterSince = g.turn;
    }
    if (p.kind === "industry") {
      const c = g.cities.find(c => c.id === p.cityId);
      if (!c || c.owner !== p.nid) { p.failed = true; continue; }
      c.ind = { ...(c.ind || {}), [p.ind]: ((c.ind || {})[p.ind] || 0) + 1 };
    }
    if (p.kind === "irrigation") {
      const c = g.cities.find(c => c.id === p.cityId);
      if (c) c.irrigated = true;
      p.cells.forEach(i => { if (w.terrain[i] === T.PLAINS) g.irrigated[i] = 1; });
    }
    if (p.kind === "focus") finishFocus(g, p);
    if (p.kind === "capital") finishCapitalMove(g, p);
    if (p.kind === "province") finishProvince(w, g, p);
  }
  g.projects = g.projects.filter(p => !finished.includes(p));
  return finished;
}

/* ---------- Building industry: quotes, the state's projects and private investment ---------- */
function industryBlock(w, g, nid, city, kind, econ) {
  const def = INDUSTRIES[kind], n = g.nations[nid];
  if (!def) return "Unknown industry.";
  if (SITE_KINDS[kind]) return "Opened on the map, at a deposit, forest or coast.";
  if (city.owner !== nid) return "Not your town.";
  if (g.occ && g.occ[city.cell] >= 0) return `${city.name} is occupied.`;
  if (def.tech && !hasTech(n, def.tech)) return `Needs the ${TECHS[def.tech].label} technology.`;
  if (def.skill && (n.skill ?? 0.35) < def.skill) return `Needs a more skilled workforce (skill ${pct(def.skill)}, yours ${pct(n.skill ?? 0.35)}). Spend more on education.`;
  const r = econ.regions.find(x => x.city.id === city.id);
  if (!r) return `${city.name} is cut off.`;
  const lvl = cityLevels(city)[kind] || 0;
  const pending = g.projects.filter(p => p.kind === "industry" && p.cityId === city.id && p.ind === kind).length;
  if (pending) return `A ${def.label.toLowerCase()} is already being built in ${city.name}.`;
  if (def.cap) {
    const cap = industryCap(kind, r.res, r.pop, city.port);
    if (lvl >= cap) {
      const why = { fish: "fishing grounds on its coast", forest: "forest in its land", metals: "metal ore", coal: "coal", gold: "gold", oil: "oil or gas", hydro: "rivers in hills or mountains", scenery: "coast or mountains for visitors" }[def.cap];
      return cap === 0 ? `${city.name}'s land has no ${why}.` : `${city.name}'s ${why} can support only ${cap} level${cap > 1 ? "s" : ""}.`;
    }
  }
  if (def.urban) {
    const cap = industryCap(kind, r.res, r.pop, city.port);
    const pendingUrban = g.projects.filter(p => p.kind === "industry" && p.cityId === city.id && INDUSTRIES[p.ind].urban).length;
    if (urbanLevels(city) + pendingUrban >= cap + (cityFocusOn(g, city, "industry") ? 2 : 0)) return `${city.name} (${r.pop.toFixed(1)}M people) has no room for more factories or offices. Bigger towns hold more.`;
  }
  if (def.minMarket) {
    const net = econ.networks[r.net];
    if (net.pop + net.foreign < def.minMarket) return `Needs a market of ${def.minMarket}M people within reach by road (this one has ${(net.pop + net.foreign).toFixed(1)}M).`;
  }
  if (def.perNation) {
    const have = g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === nid).reduce((s, c) => s + (cityLevels(c)[kind] || 0), 0) + g.projects.filter(p => p.nid === nid && p.ind === kind).length;
    if (have >= def.perNation) return `A nation can run at most ${def.perNation} of these.`;
  }
  return null;
}

function quoteIndustry(w, g, nid, city, kind, base) {
  const econ = base || computeEconomy(w, g, nid);
  const block = industryBlock(w, g, nid, city, kind, econ);
  const def = INDUSTRIES[kind];
  if (block) return { ok: false, kind: "industry", ind: kind, cityId: city.id, reason: block };
  const lvl = cityLevels(city)[kind] || 0;
  const value = projectValue(w, g, nid, { industry: { cityId: city.id, kind } }, econ);
  // what GDP alone misses: research, morale and influence
  if (def.research) value.value += def.research * 0.0012 * econ.gdp;
  if (kind === "broadcast") value.value += 0.012 * econ.gdp;
  const cost = def.costB * (1 + 0.15 * lvl) * econ.constructionIndex * (def.urban && cityFocusOn(g, city, "industry") ? 0.8 : 1);
  return { ok: true, kind: "industry", ind: kind, nid, cityId: city.id, cost, seasons: def.seasons, ...value,
    label: `${def.label} at ${city.name}${lvl ? ` (level ${lvl + 1})` : ""}` };
}

/* The few industries worth quoting in each town, so rivals and investors don't weigh hundreds of options. */
function industryCandidates(w, g, n, econ, privateOnly) {
  const out = [];
  for (const kind of INDUSTRY_ORDER) {
    const def = INDUSTRIES[kind];
    if (SITE_KINDS[kind] || (privateOnly && def.state)) continue;
    const towns = econ.regions.filter(r => !industryBlock(w, g, n.id, r.city, kind, econ));
    if (!towns.length) continue;
    towns.sort((a, b) => b.pop - a.pop);
    for (const r of towns.slice(0, def.urban ? 2 : 1)) {
      const q = quoteIndustry(w, g, n.id, r.city, kind, econ);
      if (q.ok) out.push(q);
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/* Businesses invest a share of output wherever it pays best. Finance law and stability set how much. */
function runPrivateInvestment(w, g, n) {
  const econ = computeEconomy(w, g, n.id);
  if (!econ.cities.length) return [];
  const fin = FINANCE_LAWS[n.laws.finance || "balanced"];
  const climate = clamp(n.stability / 60, 0.3, 1.2) * clamp(1.25 - n.laws.tax / 100, 0.6, 1.1) * (hasTech(n, "finance") ? 1.2 : 1) * (enemiesOf(g, n.id).length ? 0.6 : 1) * Math.max(0.2, 1 + modSum(n, "invest"));
  n.capital = (n.capital || 0) + (econ.gdp / 4) * fin.invest * climate * (econ.capitalMult || 1) * profitFactor(n);
  const news = [];
  for (let k = 0; k < 2; k++) {
    const cands = industryCandidates(w, g, n, econ, true).concat(siteCandidates(w, g, n, econ, true)).map(q => ({ q, roi: q.dGdp / q.cost })).filter(x => x.roi > 0.07).sort((a, b) => b.roi - a.roi);
    const best = cands[0];
    if (!best) break;
    if (n.capital < best.q.cost) break;
    n.capital -= best.q.cost;
    orderProject(g, best.q, "private", true);
    n.buildSpend = (n.buildSpend || 0) + best.q.cost;
    news.push(best.q);
  }
  n.capital = Math.min(n.capital, 30);
  return news;
}

/* ---------- Research, skills and the business cycle, each season ---------- */
const AI_RESEARCH = {
  militarist:   ["mech", "combined", "electrify", "assembly", "electronics", "jets", "medicine", "media", "fert", "finance", "computing", "nuclear", "automation"],
  expansionist: ["mech", "fert", "assembly", "electrify", "combined", "medicine", "electronics", "media", "finance", "jets", "computing", "nuclear", "automation"],
  agrarian:     ["mech", "fert", "medicine", "electrify", "assembly", "media", "electronics", "finance", "computing", "combined", "nuclear", "jets", "automation"],
  mercantile:   ["electrify", "finance", "assembly", "mech", "media", "electronics", "computing", "medicine", "fert", "automation", "nuclear", "combined", "jets"],
};
function researchPoints(n, econ) {
  const spend = (econ.gdp / 4) * RESEARCH_LAWS[n.laws.research || "low"].share;
  return (spend * 10 * (0.4 + (n.skill ?? 0.35)) + econ.research) * (econ.researchMult || 1);
}
function advanceResearch(g, n, econ) {
  n.research = n.research || { target: null, progress: 0 };
  const R = n.research;
  if (!R.target || hasTech(n, R.target) || !techAvailable(n, R.target)) {
    const own = (R.queue || []).find(t => techAvailable(n, t));
    R.target = own || (n.isPlayer ? TECH_ORDER : AI_RESEARCH[n.archetype] || TECH_ORDER).find(t => techAvailable(n, t)) || null;
    R.auto = !own;
  }
  R.progress += researchPoints(n, econ);
  if (!R.target || R.progress < TECHS[R.target].cost) return null;
  const done = R.target;
  R.progress -= TECHS[done].cost;
  n.techs = { ...(n.techs || {}), [done]: g.turn };
  n.tech *= 1.015;
  R.target = null;
  if (R.queue) R.queue = R.queue.filter(t => t !== done);
  return done;
}
function updateSkill(n, econ) {
  const target = EDU_LAWS[n.laws.education || "basic"].skill + Math.min(0.1, 0.02 * (econ.levels.university || 0)) + (econ.skillBonus || 0) + (econ.citySkill || 0);
  n.skill = (n.skill ?? 0.35) + (target - (n.skill ?? 0.35)) * 0.04;
}

/* A loose financial system grows faster and sometimes crashes. */
function financialCrisis(g, n, econ, rng) {
  const fin = FINANCE_LAWS[n.laws.finance || "balanced"];
  if (n.crisisUntil > g.turn) return null;
  const debt = Math.max(0, -n.treasury) / Math.max(1, econ.gdp);
  const chance = fin.crisis * (1 + 2 * debt) * (n.stability < 40 ? 1.5 : 1) * (hasTech(n, "finance") ? 0.7 : 1) * (econ.sat.gold < 1 && econ.goods.supply.gold > 0.1 ? 0.6 : 1);
  if (rng() >= chance) return null;
  n.tech *= 0.95;
  n.crisisUntil = g.turn + 3;
  n.capital = 0;
  return `A banking crisis: lenders panicked, investment stopped and output fell 5%.`;
}

/* ---------- Every nation starts with the industry its land and character suggest ---------- */
function seedIndustries(w, g, n) {
  let econ = computeEconomy(w, g, n.id);
  // every nation starts with at least one source of energy: if its land has none, a coal seam is found in its hills or forests
  const fuel = econ.regions.some(r => r.res.coal || r.res.oil || industryCap("power_hydro", r.res, r.pop, false) > 0);
  if (!fuel) {
    const cells = econ.regions.flatMap(r => r.cells).filter(i => !w.dep[i] && (w.terrain[i] === T.HILLS || w.terrain[i] === T.FOREST));
    const spot = cells.sort((a, b) => hash2(a, 3, w.seed) - hash2(b, 3, w.seed))[0] ?? econ.regions[0].cells.find(i => !w.dep[i]);
    if (spot !== undefined) { w.dep[spot] = 2; w.hid[spot] = 0; setDepositSize(w, spot, 2, false); g.depLeft[spot] = w.depTotal[spot]; (g.extraDeposits = g.extraDeposits || []).push([spot, 2]); econ = computeEconomy(w, g, n.id); }
  }
  const add = (city, kind, k = 1) => { city.ind = city.ind || {}; city.ind[kind] = (city.ind[kind] || 0) + k; };
  const regions = econ.regions.slice().sort((a, b) => b.pop - a.pop);
  const cap = regions.find(r => r.city.capital) || regions[0];
  if (!cap) return;
  const has = { metals: 0, coal: 0, oil: 0, gold: 0 };
  for (const r of regions) {
    for (const k of ["metals", "coal", "oil", "gold"]) has[k] += r.res[k];
  }
  seedSites(w, g, n);
  seedFuel(w, g, n);
  const fuelSite = g.sites.some(s => s.kind === "coalmine" && g.owner[s.cell] === n.id) ? "power_coal" : g.sites.some(s => s.kind === "oilfield" && g.owner[s.cell] === n.id) ? "power_gas" : null;
  add(cap.city, fuelSite || (industryCap("power_hydro", cap.res, cap.pop, false) > 0 ? "power_hydro" : has.coal ? "power_coal" : has.oil ? "power_gas" : "power_coal"));
  add(cap.city, "light");
  add(cap.city, "foodproc");
  add(cap.city, "university");
  if ((has.metals && has.coal) || n.archetype === "militarist" || n.archetype === "expansionist") add(cap.city, "heavy");
  if (n.archetype === "militarist" && has.oil) add(cap.city, "chemical");
  if (regions[1]) add(regions[1].city, "light");
  if (regions[1] && n.archetype !== "agrarian") add(regions[1].city, fuelSite === "power_gas" ? "power_gas" : "power_coal");
}

/* =====================================================================
   10. Rival projects: what each nation could build, and why
   ===================================================================== */
function directionWord(from, to) {
  const ang = Math.atan2(cellY(to) - cellY(from), cellX(to) - cellX(from)) * 180 / Math.PI;
  const dirs = ["east", "south-east", "south", "south-west", "west", "north-west", "north", "north-east"];
  return dirs[Math.round(((ang + 360) % 360) / 45) % 8];
}

function distanceToNation(g, nid, cell) {
  let best = Infinity;
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (g.owner[i] === nid) best = Math.min(best, dist(i, cell));
  return best;
}

function explainProject(g, q, n) {
  const gain = q.dGdp > 0.05 ? ` Expects output +${fmtMoney(q.dGdp)} a year.` : "";
  if (q.kind === "work") return `Building the ${WORKS[q.work].label}, like ${WORKS[q.work].inspired}: ${WORKS[q.work].gives.charAt(0).toLowerCase()}${WORKS[q.work].gives.slice(1)}. ${fmtMoney(q.installment)} a season for ${q.seasons} seasons.`;
  if (q.kind === "road" && q.access) return `Building a road ${q.label.replace(/^Road /, "")} so it can be worked.${q.dGdp > 0.05 ? ` A site there could add ${fmtMoney(q.dGdp)} a year.` : ""}`;
  if (q.kind === "site") return `${q.siteId ? "Expanding" : "Opening"} ${q.name}: ${INDUSTRIES[q.siteKind].does}${gain}`;
  if (q.kind === "smelter") return `Building a smelter at ${(g.sites.find(x => x.id === q.siteId) || { name: "the mine" }).name}, so the ore leaves as metal.${gain}`;
  if (q.kind === "road") {
    if (q.trade !== undefined) return `Building a trade road to the ${nameOf(g, q.trade)} so goods can flow between us.${gain}`;
    if (q.famineRelief > 0.05) return `Linking ${q.from.name} and ${q.to.name} to move food to hungry towns.${gain}`;
    return `Linking ${q.from.name} and ${q.to.name} to join their markets and share timber and ore.${gain}`;
  }
  if (q.kind === "town") {
    const toPlayer = distanceToNation(g, PLAYER, q.site);
    const near = toPlayer <= 6 ? ` It lies only ${Math.round(toPlayer)} cells from your border.` : "";
    const capital = g.cities.find(c => c.owner === n.id && c.capital);
    const where = capital ? ` ${directionWord(capital.cell, q.site)} of ${capital.name}` : "";
    const why = n.archetype === "expansionist" ? "Land is what this nation values most." : `It claims farmland for ${q.claimFood.toFixed(1)}M more people.`;
    return `Settling ${q.name}${where}${q.overseas ? ", across the sea" : ""}. ${why}${near}`;
  }
  if (q.kind === "port") return `Building a harbor at ${g.cities.find(c => c.id === q.cityId).name} to open sea trade.${gain}`;
  if (q.kind === "portup") return `Enlarging the harbor at ${g.cities.find(c => c.id === q.cityId).name} into a ${PORT_LEVELS[q.level].label.toLowerCase()}: ${q.level === 2 ? "slipways for freighters and destroyers" : "a home for the battle fleet, with yards that build cruisers"}.`;
  if (q.kind === "wharf") return `Building a river wharf at ${g.cities.find(c => c.id === q.cityId).name}: barges join the towns on the same river.${gain}`;
  if (q.kind === "ships") return `${q.label}.`;
  if (q.kind === "irrigation") return `Irrigating the fields around ${g.cities.find(c => c.id === q.cityId).name} so it can feed more people.`;
  if (q.kind === "industry") return `${INDUSTRIES[q.ind].does}${gain}`;
  if (q.kind === "focus") { const c = g.cities.find(x => x.id === q.cityId); return `Making ${c ? c.name : "a town"} ${aAn(FOCI[q.focus].label.toLowerCase())}: ${FOCI[q.focus].does.charAt(0).toLowerCase()}${FOCI[q.focus].does.slice(1)}`; }
  if (q.kind === "capital") return q.label + ".";
  return "";
}

function aiCandidates(w, g, n, econ) {
  const out = [];
  const nid = n.id;
  const cities = econ.cities;
  for (let a = 0; a < cities.length; a++) for (let b = a + 1; b < cities.length; b++) {
    if (econ.regions[a].net === econ.regions[b].net) continue;
    if (dist(cities[a].cell, cities[b].cell) > BUILD.roadMaxReach) continue;
    if (g.projects.some(p => p.kind === "road" && p.nid === nid)) continue;
    const q = quoteRoad(w, g, nid, cities[a], cities[b]);
    if (q.ok) out.push(q);
  }
  const sites = [];
  const wild = new Set([-1]), own = new Set([nid]);
  // a city-state stays a city-state: it may found a couple of satellite towns, no more
  const townRoom = !n.minor || cities.length + g.projects.filter(p => p.nid === nid && p.kind === "town").length < 3;
  const needSea = !n.minor && !g.cities.some(c => c.owner === nid && portSeaCell(w, c.cell) >= 0);
  for (let i = 0; townRoom && i < N_CELLS; i++) {
    if (!isLand(w, i)) continue;
    if (g.owner[i] !== nid && g.owner[i] !== -1) continue;
    if (g.owner[i] === -1 && !nearOwnLand(g, nid, i, BUILD.townReach)) continue;
    if (g.cities.some(c => dist(c.cell, i) < BUILD.townMinSpacing + 1)) continue;
    sites.push({ i, food: foodWithin(w, g, i, BUILD.townClaimRadius, wild) + 0.3 * foodWithin(w, g, i, 2, own) + (needSea ? (portSeaCell(w, i) >= 0 ? 1.5 : 1.2 * Math.max(0, 1 - seaGeo(w).coastDist[i] / 6)) : 0) });
  }
  sites.sort((a, b) => b.food - a.food).slice(0, 6).forEach(s => {
    const q = quoteTown(w, g, nid, s.i);
    if (!q.ok) return;
    // a first town on the open sea is worth more than its fields: it can have a harbor
    if (needSea && portSeaCell(w, s.i) >= 0) q.value += econ.gdp * 0.04 * ({ mercantile: 1, expansionist: 0.8, militarist: 0.6, agrarian: 0.4 }[n.archetype] || 0.5);
    if (q.dGdp < 0) q.value -= q.dGdp * 0.6;   // most of the work lost while it is cut off comes back once a road joins it
    out.push(q);
  });
  for (const c of cities) {
    const qp = quotePort(w, g, nid, c);
    if (qp.ok) out.push(qp);
    const qi = quoteIrrigation(w, g, nid, c);
    if (qi.ok) out.push(qi);
  }
  out.push(...industryCandidates(w, g, n, econ, false));
  out.push(...siteCandidates(w, g, n, econ, false));
  out.push(...workCandidates(w, g, n, econ));
  out.push(...aiSeaCandidates(w, g, n, econ));
  out.push(...focusCandidates(w, g, n, econ));
  if (!g.projects.some(p => p.kind === "road" && p.nid === nid)) {
    for (const t of g.treaties || []) {
      if (t.type !== "trade" || (t.a !== nid && t.b !== nid)) continue;
      const other = t.a === nid ? t.b : t.a;
      if (econ.networks.some(net => net.partners.includes(other))) continue;
      const q = bestTradeRoad(w, g, nid, other);
      if (q) out.push(q);
    }
  }
  return out;
}


function stepLaw(order, current, dir) { return order[clamp(order.indexOf(current) + dir, 0, order.length - 1)]; }
function stepTax(v, dir) { return TAX_LAWS[clamp(TAX_LAWS.findIndex(t => t.v === v) + dir, 0, TAX_LAWS.length - 1)].v; }


/* =====================================================================
   11. Running a season for every nation
   ===================================================================== */
const EVENTS = [
  { id: "strike", when: c => c.tax >= 35 && SERVICE_ORDER.indexOf(c.services) <= 1, chance: c => 0.08 + (c.tax - 35) * 0.01,
    make: c => ({ title: "General strike", tone: "bad", text: `${taxLaw(c.tax).label} taxes with only ${SERVICE_LAWS[c.services].label.toLowerCase()} public services pushed the unions to walk out.`, tech: -0.015, stability: -4 }) },
  { id: "riots", when: c => c.stability < 35, chance: c => (35 - c.stability) / 50,
    make: c => ({ title: "Riots in the capital", tone: "bad", text: `With stability at ${Math.round(c.stability)}, protests turned violent. Repairs and policing cost money.`, stability: -3, costShare: 0.01 }) },
  { id: "hunger", when: c => c.famineShare > 0.05, chance: c => 0.2 + c.famineShare,
    make: c => ({ title: "Bread protests", tone: "bad", text: `${pct(c.famineShare)} of your people live where there isn't enough food. Roads to farmland or irrigation would help.`, stability: -3 }) },
  { id: "bonds", when: c => c.debtRatio > 0.9, chance: c => 0.15 + (c.debtRatio - 0.9) * 0.3,
    make: c => ({ title: "Bond market jitters", tone: "bad", text: `Debt at ${pct(c.debtRatio)} of GDP worried lenders, and refinancing cost extra.`, stability: -2, costDebt: 0.01 }) },
  { id: "scandal", when: c => c.stability < 50, chance: () => 0.07,
    make: () => ({ title: "Corruption scandal", tone: "bad", text: "Weak institutions let officials skim public funds.", stability: -3, costShare: 0.015 }) },
  { id: "boom", when: c => c.biggestMarket > 14 && c.stability > 60, chance: () => 0.07,
    make: c => ({ title: "Trade boom", tone: "good", text: `Your largest road network now reaches ${c.biggestMarket.toFixed(1)}M people, and merchants are thriving.`, tech: 0.01 }) },
  { id: "drought", when: () => true, chance: () => 0.05,
    make: c => SERVICE_ORDER.indexOf(c.services) >= 2
      ? { title: "Drought", tone: "warn", text: "A dry season cut the harvest. Relief programs kept people fed.", popShare: -0.003, stability: -1 }
      : { title: "Drought", tone: "bad", text: `A dry season cut the harvest, and ${SERVICE_LAWS[c.services].label.toLowerCase()} public services gave little relief.`, popShare: -0.01, stability: -5 } },
  { id: "harvest", when: () => true, chance: () => 0.05,
    make: () => ({ title: "Bumper harvest", tone: "good", text: "Good weather across the farmland lifted spirits, and families grew.", popShare: 0.005, stability: 2 }) },
];

function rollEvent(ctx, rng) {
  for (const ev of EVENTS) if (ev.when(ctx) && rng() < ev.chance(ctx)) return { id: ev.id, ...ev.make(ctx) };
  return null;
}

function scalePopulation(g, cells, factor) { for (const c of cells) g.pop[c] *= factor; }

function applyEvent(g, n, econ, ev) {
  const effects = [];
  if (ev.tech) { n.tech *= 1 + ev.tech; effects.push(`${signedPct(ev.tech, 1)} output`); }
  if (ev.popShare) { econ.regions.forEach(r => scalePopulation(g, r.cells, 1 + ev.popShare)); effects.push(`${signedPct(ev.popShare, 1)} population`); }
  if (ev.stability) { n.stability = clamp(n.stability + ev.stability, 0, 100); effects.push(`${signed(ev.stability)} stability`); }
  let cost = 0;
  if (ev.costShare) cost += ev.costShare * econ.gdp / 4;
  if (ev.costDebt) cost += ev.costDebt * Math.max(0, -n.treasury);
  if (cost > 0) { n.treasury -= cost; effects.push(`${fmtMoney(-cost)}`); }
  return { ...ev, effects, cost };
}

/* ---------- Statistics: what the world remembers each season ---------- */
const STATS_KEEP = 240; // seasons of history kept per nation (60 years)
function sr(v, d = 2) { const k = 10 ** d; return Math.round(v * k) / k; }

function historyEntry(n, econ, turn, g) {
  const e = { turn, gdp: sr(econ.gdp), pop: sr(econ.pop, 3), stability: sr(n.stability, 1), treasury: sr(n.treasury), soldiers: Math.round(n.soldiers || 0), prestige: Math.round(n.prestige || 0) };
  if (!g) return e;
  let divs = 0, tanks = 0, planes = 0;
  for (const d of g.divisions) if (d.owner === n.id) { divs++; tanks += d.tanks || 0; }
  for (const a of g.airwings) if (a.owner === n.id) planes += a.planes;
  const sec = econ.sectors || {};
  Object.assign(e, {
    area: econ.area || 0, towns: econ.cities.length, divs, tanks: Math.round(tanks + ((n.stock && n.stock.tanks) || 0)), planes: Math.round(planes),
    power: Math.round(armyPower(g, n.id)), techs: Object.keys(n.techs || {}).length, food: sr(econ.pop > 0.01 ? econ.food / econ.pop : 0),
    skill: sr(n.skill ?? 0.35), exp: sr(econ.exportValue || 0), imp: sr(econ.importBill || 0), fin: sr(econ.foodIn || 0), research: sr(econ.research || 0),
    sec: ["primary", "secondary", "tertiary", "quaternary"].map(k => sr(sec[k] ? sec[k].va : 0, 1)),
    opP: n.isPlayer ? null : Math.round(opinionDetail(g, n.id, PLAYER).value),
  });
  if (g.sea) { const nc = navyCounts(g, n.id); e.ships = nc.destroyer + nc.cruiser; e.fr = nc.freighter; const T = g.sea.trade[n.id]; e.seaMt = T ? sr(T.carry, 1) : 0; }
  e.unemp = sr(econ.unemployment || 0, 3);
  if (econ.people) { const D = demoOf(n), ed = eduOf(n); e.ls = sr(econ.people.ls, 1); e.tfr = sr(D.tfr, 2); e.e0 = sr(D.e0, 1); e.old = sr(D.old, 3); e.kids = sr(D.kids, 3); e.edS = sr(ed.s, 3); e.edE = sr(ed.e, 3); e.lam = sr(econ.people.lam, 3); }
  e.resM = sr(monthsOfFood((n.granary && n.granary.stock) || 0, econ.pop), 1);
  if (g.villages) { let vc = 0, vp = 0; for (const v of g.villages) if (v.status !== "ruin" && g.owner[v.cell] === n.id) { vc++; vp += v.pop; } e.vil = vc; e.vpop = sr(vp, 4); }   // villages (10w)
  return e;
}

function natStats(g, nid) {
  g.stats.nat = g.stats.nat || {};
  return g.stats.nat[nid] || (g.stats.nat[nid] = { battles: 0, won: 0, lost: 0, menLost: 0, menKilled: 0, tanksLost: 0, townsGained: 0, townsLost: 0, treaties: 0, peakGdp: 0, peakArmy: 0, peakArea: 0 });
}

/* Called once at the end of each season, after the armies have moved. */
function recordSeasonStats(g, reports, ownersBefore) {
  const S = g.stats;
  S.wars = S.wars || []; S.world = S.world || []; S.records = S.records || {};
  let deaths = 0;
  for (const r of reports) {
    const A = r.attacker, D = r.defender;
    const la = (r.losses[A] && r.losses[A].men) || 0, ld = (r.losses[D] && r.losses[D].men) || 0;
    deaths += la + ld;
    const a = natStats(g, A), d = natStats(g, D);
    a.battles++; d.battles++;
    if (r.won) { a.won++; d.lost++; } else { a.lost++; d.won++; leaderDeed(g, D, "held"); }
    a.menLost += la; d.menLost += ld; a.menKilled += ld; d.menKilled += la;
    a.tanksLost += (r.losses[A] && r.losses[A].tanks) || 0; d.tanksLost += (r.losses[D] && r.losses[D].tanks) || 0;
    const war = g.wars.find(x => (x.sideA.includes(A) && x.sideB.includes(D)) || (x.sideB.includes(A) && x.sideA.includes(D)));
    if (war) {
      const e = syncWar(g, war);
      e.battles++; e.losses[A] = (e.losses[A] || 0) + la; e.losses[D] = (e.losses[D] || 0) + ld;
    }
    S.battleLog = S.battleLog || [];
    S.battleLog.push({ turn: g.turn, place: r.town || r.terrain.toLowerCase(), a: A, d: D, won: r.won, ratio: r.ratio, la, ld });
    if (S.battleLog.length > 80) S.battleLog.shift();
    if (!S.records.bloodiest || la + ld > S.records.bloodiest.men) S.records.bloodiest = { men: la + ld, turn: g.turn, place: r.town || r.terrain.toLowerCase(), a: A, d: D, won: r.won };
  }
  for (const war of g.wars) syncWar(g, war);
  for (const e of S.wars) {
    if (e.ended !== null) continue;
    if (!g.wars.some(x => x.id === e.id)) e.ended = g.turn;
  }
  if (S.wars.length > 60) S.wars = S.wars.filter((e, i) => e.ended === null || i >= S.wars.length - 60);
  for (const c of g.cities) {
    const before = ownersBefore.get(c.id);
    if (before === undefined || before === c.owner || before < 0 || c.owner < 0) continue;
    natStats(g, c.owner).townsGained++;
    natStats(g, before).townsLost++;
  }
  S.world.push({ turn: g.turn, wars: g.wars.length, battles: reports.length, deaths, treaties: g.treaties.filter(t => t.type !== "truce").length });
  if (S.world.length > STATS_KEEP) S.world.shift();
}
function syncWar(g, war) {
  const S = g.stats;
  let e = S.wars.find(x => x.id === war.id);
  if (!e) { e = { id: war.id, a: [], b: [], since: war.since, cb: war.cb, ended: null, battles: 0, losses: {}, score: 0 }; S.wars.push(e); }
  for (const id of war.sideA) if (!e.a.includes(id)) e.a.push(id);
  for (const id of war.sideB) if (!e.b.includes(id)) e.b.push(id);
  e.score = war.score;
  return e;
}
/* Peaks and records, kept as the history rolls on */
function updatePeaks(g, n, h) {
  const s = natStats(g, n.id);
  s.peakGdp = Math.max(s.peakGdp, h.gdp || 0);
  s.peakArmy = Math.max(s.peakArmy, h.soldiers || 0);
  s.peakArea = Math.max(s.peakArea, h.area || 0);
  const R = g.stats.records = g.stats.records || {};
  const top = (key, v) => { if (!R[key] || v > R[key].v) R[key] = { v, nid: n.id, turn: h.turn }; };
  top("richest", h.gdp || 0);
  top("largestArmy", h.soldiers || 0);
  top("largestLand", h.area || 0);
  top("mostPeople", h.pop || 0);
  if (h.pop > 0.5) top("bestPerPerson", (h.gdp || 0) / h.pop);
}

/* One nation's season: money, army, growth, then stability. Returns a report with every cause. */
function runNationSeason(w, g, n, rng) {
  for (const s of g.sites) if (s.pausedUntil !== undefined && g.turn >= s.pausedUntil && g.owner[s.cell] === n.id) { s.paused = false; delete s.pausedUntil; }
  const econ = computeEconomy(w, g, n.id);
  const pf = freshPopFlow(n, g);
  const siteNews = workSites(w, g, n, econ);
  if (!n.isPlayer) aiManageSites(w, g, n, econ);
  const budget = computeBudget(n, econ, n.laws);
  n.treasury += budget.balance;
  n.provPaid = budget.provinces || 0;   // the governors spend it at the end of the season (10v)
  settleGranary(n, econ, budget);
  for (const k of EQUIP_ORDER) n.stock[k] += budget.arms.units[k];
  // what this season's market looked like steers next season's farms, builders and arms makers
  n.market = { ...econ.sat };
  n.buildAvg = (n.buildAvg || 0) * 0.7 + (n.buildSpend || 0) * 0.3;
  n.buildSpend = 0;
  n.armsAvg = (n.armsAvg || 0) * 0.7 + budget.arms.spend * 0.3;
  n.fuelSat = econ.fuelSat;
  n.logistics = econ.logistics;
  n.mediaLevels = econ.levels.broadcast || 0;
  n.softPower = Math.min(8, 2 * (econ.levels.broadcast || 0) + 0.6 * (econ.levels.resort || 0)) + (econ.works ? econ.works.soft : 0) + 0.5 * econ.regions.filter(r => r.cm && r.cm.focus === "resort").length;
  const discovered = advanceResearch(g, n, econ);
  const crisis = financialCrisis(g, n, econ, rng);
  n.crisisActive = n.crisisUntil > g.turn;

  const tg = econ.cities.length ? clamp(techGrowth(n, econ, n.laws, rng), -0.03, 0.03) : 0;
  n.tech = Math.max(0.2, n.tech * (1 + tg));

  const svGrowth = SERVICE_LAWS[n.laws.services].growth;
  for (const r of econ.regions) {
    const fed = ECON.growthMax * clamp((r.foodRatio - 1) / ECON.growthHeadroom, ECON.famineFloor, 1);
    const hunger = fed < 0 ? fed * (1 - Math.min(0.9, modSum(n, "famineShield"))) : 0;
    const growth = (fed < 0 ? hunger : peopleGrowth(fed, n)) + modSum(n, "growth") + cityGrowthBonus(g, r.city);
    pf.famine += r.pop * hunger; pf.births += r.pop * (growth - hunger);
    scalePopulation(g, r.cells, 1 + growth);
  }
  peopleSeason(w, g, n, econ, pf, econ.pop);
  const migr = migrateNation(w, g, n, econ);
  pf.moved = migr.moved;

  const event = null;   // situations now come to you as decisions with a choice (section 11c)

  const after = computeEconomy(w, g, n.id);
  const perCap = after.people ? after.people.ls : after.gdp / Math.max(0.001, after.pop);
  const mood = n.lastLs ? clamp(ECON.moodWeight * (perCap / n.lastLs - 1) * 4, -ECON.moodCap, ECON.moodCap) : 0;
  n.lastLs = perCap;
  n.lastGdpPerCap = after.gdp / Math.max(0.001, after.pop);
  const terms = stabilityTerms(n, econ, budget, n.laws, mood, warStabilityTerms(g, n.id).concat(storyStabilityTerms(g, n)));
  const target = clamp(sumTerms(terms), 0, 100);
  const from = n.stability;
  n.stability = clamp(n.stability + ECON.stabPull * (target - n.stability), 0, 100);
  return { budget, terms, target, from, to: n.stability, event, discovered, crisis, siteNews, econ: after, migr, granary: econ.granary };
}

function regimeChange(n, rng) {
  const old = n.name;
  const kinds = n.minor ? Object.keys(MINOR_TITLES) : Object.keys(ARCHETYPES);
  n.archetype = pick(rng, kinds.filter(k => k !== n.archetype));
  const base = old.replace(/^(Republic of |Kingdom of |Free City of |Principality of )/, "").replace(/ (Dominion|Directorate)$/, "");
  n.name = n.minor ? MINOR_TITLES[n.archetype](base) : ARCHETYPES[n.archetype].title(base);
  n.laws = { ...n.laws, ...ARCHETYPES[n.archetype].laws };
  n.research = { target: null, progress: 0, queue: [] };
  n.leader = makeLeader(n, rng, n.history.length ? n.history[n.history.length - 1].turn : 0);
  n.stability = 40;
  n.baseStability = Math.max(n.baseStability, 50);
  return `${old} fell into civil war. The ${n.name} has taken power as a ${ARCHETYPES[n.archetype].label.toLowerCase()} state, led by ${leaderName(n)}.`;
}

function addChronicle(g, text, tone = "neutral", nid = null) {
  g.chronicle.unshift({ turn: g.turn, text, tone, nid });
  if (g.chronicle.length > 400) g.chronicle.length = 400;
}


/* The whole world takes one season. Touches no DOM; returns the dispatch to show the player.
   `plan` carries the rivals' decisions (from Claude or the built-in rules), made at the start of the season. */
function runSeason(w, g, plan) {
  const rng = mulberry32((w.seed * 7919 + g.turn * 104729 + 17) >>> 0);
  const dispatch = { season: seasonLabel(g.turn), player: null, abroad: [], built: [], warnings: [], war: [], diplomacy: [], economy: [], ambitions: [], firsts: [], decisions: [], leader: [], cabinet: [], opening: [], cities: [], groups: [], trade: [] };
  const ownersBefore = new Map(g.cities.map(c => [c.id, c.owner]));
  const pn = g.nations[PLAYER];
  const last = pn.history[pn.history.length - 1];

  // Envoys left unanswered count as a refusal, and a small slight.
  for (const it of g.inbox) {
    if (it.status !== "open" || g.turn < it.expires) continue;
    respondToEnvoy(g, w, it, false, true);
    dispatch.diplomacy.push(`You left the ${nameOf(g, it.from)}'s envoy without an answer. They took it as a refusal.`);
  }
