      case "academy": B.research += 0.25; B.skill += 0.04; break;
      case "exchange": B.capital += 0.3; B.interest += 0.01; B.finance += 0.03; break;
      case "fair": { const cap = g.cities.find(c => c.owner === nid && c.capital); B.tourismCity = cap ? cap.id : null; break; }
      case "forts": B.forts = true; break;
      case "monument": B.stab += 4; break;
      case "broadcast": B.stab += 2; B.soft += 3; break;
      case "atomic": B.atomic = true; break;
    }
  }
  return B;
}
function workStabilityTerms(g, n) {
  const out = [];
  if (workHolder(g, "monument") === n.id) out.push({ label: "The National Monument", value: 4 });
  if (workHolder(g, "broadcast") === n.id) out.push({ label: "The National Broadcasting Tower", value: 2 });
  return out;
}
/* The Line of Fortresses: border lands of its holder. */
function fortHere(g, cell, D) {
  if (workHolder(g, "forts") !== D || g.owner[cell] !== D) return false;
  for (let dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++) for (let dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++) {
    const x = cellX(cell) + dx, y = cellY(cell) + dy;
    if (!inBounds(x, y)) continue;
    const o = g.owner[idx(x, y)];
    if (o >= 0 && o !== D) return true;
  }
  return false;
}

/* What the AI could build: one great work at a time, and only with money in the bank. */
function workCandidates(w, g, n, econ) {
  if (Object.values(g.works).some(x => x.builders && x.builders[n.id])) return [];
  if (n.stability < 40 || (n.minor && econ.gdp < 120)) return [];
  const out = [];
  for (const key of WORK_ORDER) {
    if (n.minor && key !== "monument") continue;
    const lite = quoteWorkLite(w, g, n.id, key, econ);
    if (!lite.ok || n.treasury < 2 * lite.installment) continue;
    const q = quoteWork(w, g, n.id, key, econ);
    if (key === "forts" || key === "atomic") { const t = maxThreatTo(w, g, n.id); q.value += t.level * econ.gdp * (key === "atomic" ? 0.03 : 0.02); }
    q.value *= (WORK_TASTE[n.archetype] || {})[key] || 1;
    q.upfront = q.installment * 2;
    out.push(q);
  }
  return out.sort((a, b) => b.value / b.cost - a.value / a.cost).slice(0, 2);
}

/* ---------- World firsts and eras ---------- */
const ERAS = [
  { key: "steam", name: "Age of Steam", tech: null },
  { key: "electric", name: "Age of Electricity", tech: "electrify" },
  { key: "radio", name: "Age of Radio", tech: "media" },
  { key: "electronic", name: "Electronic Age", tech: "electronics" },
  { key: "atomic", name: "Atomic Age", tech: "nuclear" },
  { key: "info", name: "Information Age", tech: "computing" },
];
function worldEra(g) {
  const k = g.era || 0;
  const next = ERAS[k + 1];
  return next && g.nations.some(n => hasTech(n, next.tech)) ? k + 1 : k;
}
const FIRSTS = [
  ...TECH_ORDER.map(t => ({ key: `tech_${t}`, cat: "science", pts: 8, test: n => hasTech(n, t), text: `discover ${TECHS[t].label.toLowerCase()}` })),
  { key: "gdp500", cat: "wealth", pts: 15, test: (n, h) => h.gdp >= 500, text: "build an economy of $500B a year" },
  { key: "gdp1000", cat: "wealth", pts: 20, test: (n, h) => h.gdp >= 1000, text: "build an economy of $1T a year" },
  { key: "gdp2000", cat: "wealth", pts: 30, test: (n, h) => h.gdp >= 2000, text: "build an economy of $2T a year" },
  { key: "pop50", cat: "people", pts: 15, test: (n, h) => h.pop >= 50, text: "reach 50 million people" },
  { key: "pop100", cat: "people", pts: 20, test: (n, h) => h.pop >= 100, text: "reach 100 million people" },
  { key: "towns10", cat: "people", pts: 10, test: (n, h) => h.towns >= 10, text: "found or hold ten towns" },
  { key: "sites6", cat: "wealth", pts: 10, test: (n, h, g) => g.sites.filter(s => g.owner[s.cell] === n.id && !s.exhausted && !s.paused).length >= 6, text: "work six mines, oil fields, camps or harbors" },
  { key: "trade3", cat: "diplomacy", pts: 10, test: (n, h, g) => g.treaties.filter(t => t.type === "trade" && (t.a === n.id || t.b === n.id)).length >= 3, text: "trade with three nations at once" },
  { key: "skill60", cat: "science", pts: 10, test: n => (n.skill ?? 0) >= 0.6, text: "train a workforce of 60% skill" },
  { key: "divs20", cat: "power", pts: 10, test: (n, h) => h.divs >= 20, text: "field twenty divisions" },
];
function checkFirsts(w, g, dispatch) {
  for (const F of FIRSTS) {
    if (g.firsts[F.key]) continue;
    const winners = liveNations(g).filter(n => { const h = n.history[n.history.length - 1]; return h && F.test(n, h, g); });
    if (!winners.length) continue;
    const n = winners.sort((a, b) => (b.prestige || 0) - (a.prestige || 0))[0];
    g.firsts[F.key] = { nid: n.id, turn: g.turn };
    const pts = addPrestige(g, n.id, F.pts, F.cat, `World first: ${F.text}`);
    const text = n.isPlayer ? `World first! You are the first nation to ${F.text}. +${pts} prestige.` : `World first: the ${n.name} became the first nation to ${F.text}.`;
    dispatch.firsts.push({ nid: n.id, tone: n.isPlayer ? "good" : "neutral", text });
    addChronicle(g, n.isPlayer ? `World first: we became the first nation to ${F.text}.` : text, n.isPlayer ? "good" : "neutral", n.id);
  }
  const era = worldEra(g);
  if (era > (g.era || 0)) {
    g.era = era;
    const E = ERAS[era];
    const first = g.firsts[`tech_${E.tech}`];
    const by = first ? g.nations[first.nid] : null;
    if (by) addPrestige(g, by.id, 5, "science", `Led the world into the ${E.name}`);
    const text = `A new era begins: the ${E.name}.${by ? ` The ${by.isPlayer ? "world follows our lead" : `${by.name} led the way`}.` : ""}`;
    dispatch.firsts.push({ nid: by ? by.id : null, tone: by && by.isPlayer ? "good" : "neutral", text });
    addChronicle(g, text, "good", by ? by.id : null);
  }
}

/* ---------- Intelligence: which neighbors are planning war against you, and why ---------- */
const RISK_LABELS = ["Low", "Watchful", "High", "Imminent"];
function warRisk(w, g, x, y = PLAYER) {
  const n = g.nations[x];
  if (!n || !n.alive || x === y || atWar(g, x, y) || !sharesBorder(g, x, y)) return null;
  if (n.minor) return { level: 0, label: RISK_LABELS[0], lines: [], why: "A small state cannot hope to win a war against us alone." };
  if (hasTreaty(g, x, y, "truce")) return { level: 0, label: RISK_LABELS[0], lines: [], why: "A truce still binds them." };
  if (hasTreaty(g, x, y, "alliance")) return { level: 0, label: RISK_LABELS[0], lines: [], why: "We are allies." };
  const wa = warAssessment(w, g, x, y);
  if (!wa) return { level: 0, label: RISK_LABELS[0], lines: [], why: g.turn < (y === PLAYER ? OPENING.grace : 8) ? "Too early: every government is still finding its feet." : "They have no cause for war and no great grudge against us." };
  const v = wa.value;
  // the same lines the rival governments use: a war option is on their table once its value is above zero
  const level = v >= 6 ? 3 : v > 0 ? 2 : v > -12 ? 1 : 0;
  const why = level === 3 ? "Their generals see a war against us as worth it, and may strike soon."
    : level === 2 ? "A war against us is one of the options their government is weighing."
    : level === 1 ? "They have thought about it, but the costs still hold them back."
    : "The costs of a war hold them back.";
  return { level, label: RISK_LABELS[level], value: v, lines: wa.lines, wa, why, chance: wa.winChance, ratio: wa.ratio };
}
function checkIntel(w, g, dispatch) {
  const pn = g.nations[PLAYER];
  if (!pn.alive) return;
  const th = hasTrait(pn, "paranoid") ? 1 : 2;
  g.intel = g.intel || {};
  for (const z of liveNations(g)) {
    if (z.isPlayer) continue;
    const r = warRisk(w, g, z.id);
    const lvl = r ? r.level : 0;
    const prev = g.intel[z.id] ?? 0;
    if (r && lvl >= th && prev < th) {
      const motive = (r.lines || []).filter(l => l.pts > 0).sort((a, b) => b.pts - a.pts).slice(0, 2).map(l => l.label.toLowerCase()).join("; ");
      dispatch.warnings.push(`Intelligence: the ${z.name}'s generals are drawing up plans for war against us (risk: ${r.label.toLowerCase()}).${motive ? ` Their reasons: ${motive}.` : ""} A stronger army, an ally or a pact would make them think again.`);
    }
    g.intel[z.id] = lvl;
  }
}

/* =====================================================================
   10j. The World Assembly: one hall where every nation can speak to all the others
   A topic is opened by one nation. The season after, every nation answers (and votes, on a motion).
   The season after that, the main parties answer back and the motion is decided.
   Code decides every vote and every effect; Claude only writes the speeches.
   ===================================================================== */
const ASSEMBLY = { maxOpen: 4, aiCooldown: 8, playerCooldown: 2, aidShare: 0.005, sanctionSeasons: 12, peaceSeasons: 8, defyAfter: 4, playerPostsPerSeason: 2 };
const MOTIONS = {
  statement: { label: "Statement", vote: false, blurb: "Say something to the whole world. Every government can answer. Nothing is voted on, but who agrees with whom is remembered." },
  condemn:   { label: "Condemnation", vote: true, needsTarget: true, blurb: "Ask the world to condemn a nation. If it passes, every supporter thinks less of it, it is trusted less, and its people lose confidence (−4 stability)." },
  sanction:  { label: "Sanctions", vote: true, needsTarget: true, blurb: "Ask the world to stop trading with a nation for three years. If it passes, no nation that voted for it may buy from it or sell to it, their trade agreements with it end, and none may sign a new one. Its trade with the world beyond the map goes on." },
  peace:     { label: "Call for peace", vote: true, needsWar: true, blurb: "Ask the sides of a war to make peace. If it passes, both sides lean toward peace for two years, and whoever is still fighting a year later angers every supporter." },
  aid:       { label: "Appeal for aid", vote: true, blurb: "Ask the world for help. If it passes, every supporter sends 0.5% of its yearly output to the nation that asked." },
};
const VOTE_LABEL = { yes: "Supports", no: "Opposes", abstain: "Abstains" };

function ensureAssembly(g) {
  if (!g.assembly) g.assembly = { topics: [], nextId: 1, last: {}, sanctions: [], seen: {} };
  return g.assembly;
}
function openTopics(g) { return ensureAssembly(g).topics.filter(t => t.status === "open"); }
function sanctioned(g, a, b) {
  return ensureAssembly(g).sanctions.some(s => s.until > g.turn && ((s.target === a && s.by.includes(b)) || (s.target === b && s.by.includes(a))));
}
function warById(g, id) { return g.wars.find(x => x.id === id) || null; }
function warName(g, war) { return `${war.sideA.map(id => nameOf(g, id)).join(" and ")} against ${war.sideB.map(id => nameOf(g, id)).join(" and ")}`; }

function topicTitle(g, spec) {
  const T = spec.target !== null && spec.target !== undefined ? nameOf(g, spec.target) : "";
  const war = spec.warId ? warById(g, spec.warId) : null;
  switch (spec.kind) {
    case "condemn": return `Condemn the ${T}`;
    case "sanction": return `Sanctions on the ${T}`;
    case "peace": return war ? `Peace in the war of the ${war.sideA.map(id => nameOf(g, id)).join(" and ")} on the ${war.sideB.map(id => nameOf(g, id)).join(" and ")}` : "A call for peace";
    case "aid": return `Aid for the ${nameOf(g, spec.author)}`;
    default: return cleanText(spec.title, 80) || `A statement from the ${nameOf(g, spec.author)}`;
  }
}

function validateTopic(g, spec) {
  const A = ensureAssembly(g), M = MOTIONS[spec.kind];
  if (!M) return "Choose what kind of topic this is.";
  const author = g.nations[spec.author];
  if (!author || !author.alive) return "That nation no longer exists.";
  const cool = author.isPlayer ? ASSEMBLY.playerCooldown : ASSEMBLY.aiCooldown;
  if (A.last[spec.author] !== undefined && g.turn - A.last[spec.author] < cool) return `You opened a topic recently. You can open another in ${cool - (g.turn - A.last[spec.author])} season${cool - (g.turn - A.last[spec.author]) === 1 ? "" : "s"}.`;
  if (openTopics(g).length >= ASSEMBLY.maxOpen + (author.isPlayer ? 1 : 0)) return "The Assembly is busy. Wait for a topic to close.";
  if (M.needsTarget) {
    const t = g.nations[spec.target];
    if (!t || !t.alive) return "Choose a nation.";
    if (spec.target === spec.author) return "You cannot propose this against yourself.";
    if (openTopics(g).some(x => x.kind === spec.kind && x.target === spec.target)) return "This is already being debated.";
  }
  if (M.needsWar) {
    const war = warById(g, spec.warId);
    if (!war) return "Choose a war.";
    if (openTopics(g).some(x => x.kind === "peace" && x.warId === spec.warId)) return "Peace in this war is already being debated.";
  }
  if (spec.kind === "aid" && openTopics(g).some(x => x.kind === "aid" && x.author === spec.author)) return "Your appeal is already being heard.";
  if (spec.text !== undefined && author.isPlayer && cleanText(spec.text, 600).length < 10) return "Write a statement of at least a few words.";
  return null;
}

function openTopic(g, spec, text, pending = false) {
  const A = ensureAssembly(g);
  const t = {
    id: A.nextId++, kind: spec.kind, author: spec.author, target: MOTIONS[spec.kind].needsTarget ? spec.target : null, warId: spec.kind === "peace" ? spec.warId : null,
    title: topicTitle(g, spec), opened: g.turn, round: 0, status: "open", votes: {}, msgs: [], result: null, playerPosts: {},
  };
  if (MOTIONS[t.kind].vote) t.votes[t.author] = "yes";
  postMsg(t, { nid: t.author, turn: g.turn, kind: "open", stance: MOTIONS[t.kind].vote ? "yes" : null, text: pending ? null : text, fallback: text, pending });
  A.topics.unshift(t);
  A.last[spec.author] = g.turn;
  if (A.topics.length > 40) A.topics = A.topics.filter((x, i) => x.status === "open" || i < 40);
  return t;
}
function postMsg(t, m) { t.msgs.push({ id: t.msgs.length + 1, reasons: [], ...m }); }

/* ---------- How a government votes ---------- */
function assemblyStance(g, w, X, t) {
  const nx = g.nations[X], per = personality(nx);
  const reasons = [];
  let s = 0;
  const add = (v, why) => { s += v; if (Math.abs(v) >= 0.6) reasons.push(why); };
  const opA = opinionDetail(g, X, t.author).value;
  if (X === t.author) return { vote: "yes", reasons: ["it is our own motion"] };
  if (t.kind === "statement") {
    add(opA / 15, opA >= 0 ? `we think well of the ${nameOf(g, t.author)}` : `we distrust the ${nameOf(g, t.author)}`);
    return { vote: s > 1 ? "agree" : s < -1 ? "disagree" : "neutral", reasons };
  }
  if (t.kind === "condemn" || t.kind === "sanction") {
    const T = t.target;
    if (X === T) return { vote: "no", reasons: ["the motion is aimed at us"] };
    const opT = opinionDetail(g, X, T).value;
    add(-opT / 18, opT < 0 ? `we have no love for the ${nameOf(g, T)}` : `the ${nameOf(g, T)} is a friend`);
    add(opA / 40, `our view of the ${nameOf(g, t.author)}`);
    if (atWar(g, X, T)) add(5, `we are at war with the ${nameOf(g, T)}`);
    if (hasTreaty(g, X, T, "alliance")) add(-4, `we are allied with the ${nameOf(g, T)}`);
    // what our trade with them is really worth (10t): a need they fill weighs most; sanctions would end it
    const ex = tradeExposure(g, X, T), book = !!(g.trade && g.trade.v), sanc = t.kind === "sanction";
    if (book) {
      if (ex.buy && ex.buy.share >= EMBARGO_AI.dependShare) add(-(sanc ? 1 + 3 * ex.buy.share : 0.5 + ex.buy.share), `we buy ${pct(ex.buy.share)} of our ${tradeGoodWord(ex.buy.k)} from the ${nameOf(g, T)}`);
      if (ex.sellPct >= EMBARGO_AI.material) add(-(sanc ? clamp(1 + 50 * ex.sellPct, 1, 3) : 0.6), `the ${nameOf(g, T)} buys our ${tradeGoodWord(ex.sell.k)} (${pct1(ex.sellPct)} of our output)`);
      if (!ex.material && hasTreaty(g, X, T, "trade")) add(sanc ? -1 : -0.5, `we have a trade agreement with the ${nameOf(g, T)}`);
    } else if (hasTreaty(g, X, T, "trade")) add(sanc ? -3 : -1, `we trade with the ${nameOf(g, T)}`);
    // trade used as a weapon (10t): their embargo on us, hunger, and a government that uses embargoes itself
    if (book && embargoesBy(g, T, X).length) add(1.5, `the ${nameOf(g, T)} cut off our trade (${embargoGoodsText(embargoesBy(g, T, X))})`);
    if (t.why === "starve") add(hasTrait(nx, "honorable") ? 2.5 : 1.5, "hunger must never be a weapon");
    if (t.why === "bully" && embargoesBy(g, X).filter(e => e.why !== "retaliation").length >= 2) add(-1.5, "we use embargoes ourselves");
    if (hasTreaty(g, X, T, "tribute")) add(-1.5, "tribute binds us");
    const started = g.stats.warsStarted[T] || 0;
    const aggressor = g.wars.some(war => war.sideA[0] === T);
    if (aggressor) add(per.aggression < 1 ? 1.5 : 0.5, `the ${nameOf(g, T)} started a war`);
    if (started >= 2) add(0.8, "it has started wars before");
    if (hasTrait(nx, "honorable") && aggressor) add(1, "our leader despises aggression");
    if (hasTrait(nx, "greedy") && t.kind === "sanction" && (book ? ex.material : hasTreaty(g, X, T, "trade"))) add(-1.5, "sanctions would cost us money");
    // fear: a small or weak state does not provoke a strong neighbor
    const ratio = armyPower(g, T) / Math.max(1, armyPower(g, X));
    if (!atWar(g, X, T) && sharesBorder(g, X, T) && ratio > 1.5) add(-1.2 * per.caution, `we fear the ${nameOf(g, T)}'s army`);
    if (alliesOf(g, T).some(z => hasTreaty(g, X, z, "alliance"))) add(-1, "our allies are its allies");
  } else if (t.kind === "peace") {
    const war = warById(g, t.warId);
    if (!war) return { vote: "abstain", reasons: ["the war is already over"] };
    const party = war.sideA.includes(X) || war.sideB.includes(X);
    if (party) {
      const sc = sideScore(war, X);
      add(sc < -15 ? 3 : sc > 25 ? -3 : 0.5, sc < -15 ? "the war is going badly for us" : sc > 25 ? "we are winning" : "the war is costly");
      if (per.aggression > 1.2 && sc > 0) add(-1, "our generals want to finish the job");
    } else {
      add(1.2, "war is bad for trade and for everyone's safety");
      const friendA = war.sideA.reduce((m, id) => Math.max(m, opinionDetail(g, X, id).value), -100);
      const friendB = war.sideB.reduce((m, id) => Math.max(m, opinionDetail(g, X, id).value), -100);
      const winning = war.score > 25 ? "A" : war.score < -25 ? "B" : null;
      if (winning === "A" && friendA > 30) add(-2, "our friends are winning this war");
      if (winning === "B" && friendB > 30) add(-2, "our friends are winning this war");
      if (winning === "A" && friendB > 20) add(1.5, "our friends are losing this war");
      if (winning === "B" && friendA > 20) add(1.5, "our friends are losing this war");
      if (per.aggression > 1.2) add(-0.8, "we respect strength more than appeals");
    }
  } else if (t.kind === "aid") {
    if (X === t.author) return { vote: "yes", reasons: [] };
    add(opA / 15, opA >= 0 ? `we think well of the ${nameOf(g, t.author)}` : `we distrust the ${nameOf(g, t.author)}`);
    add(0.6, "helping costs little and earns goodwill");
    if (nx.treasury < 0) add(-2, "our own treasury is in debt");
    if (atWar(g, X, t.author)) add(-6, `we are at war with the ${nameOf(g, t.author)}`);
    if (hasTrait(nx, "greedy")) add(-1.2, "our leader counts every coin");
    if (hasTrait(nx, "charismatic")) add(0.5, "generosity plays well at home");
  }
  return { vote: s > 0.8 ? "yes" : s < -0.8 ? "no" : "abstain", reasons };
}

/* ---------- Words when Claude is not writing them ---------- */
function assemblyFallback(g, X, t, stance, phase) {
  const n = g.nations[X], T = t.target !== null ? nameOf(g, t.target) : "", Au = nameOf(g, t.author);
  const war = t.warId ? warById(g, t.warId) : null;
  const pickBy = arr => arr[(X * 7 + t.id * 3 + phase.length) % arr.length];
  if (phase === "open") {
    return {
      condemn: t.why === "starve" ? `The ${T} has cut off grain to a people who are already hungry. Hunger must never be a weapon between nations. We ask the world to condemn it.`
        : t.why === "bully" ? `The ${T} cuts off the trade of nation after nation to bend them to its will. We ask the world to condemn it, before every market is closed by threats.`
        : t.why === "treaty" ? `The ${T} signed a treaty with us and then broke it. If a signature means nothing, no agreement in this hall is safe. We ask the world to condemn it.`
        : t.why === "threat" ? `The ${T} gathers its army on our border and answers our questions with silence. We ask the world to condemn these threats before they become a war.`
        : `The ${T} has chosen war over law. We ask every nation in this hall to condemn it, so that no government believes it may take what it wants by force.`,
      sanction: `The ${T} has shown it cannot be trusted. We propose that no nation trade with it until it changes course. Words alone have not stopped it.`,
      peace: `The war of ${war ? warName(g, war) : "our neighbors"} has cost enough lives. We call on both sides to stop and on this Assembly to stand with us.`,
      aid: `Our people are in hardship. We ask our neighbors for help in this hour, and we will remember who answered.`,
      statement: `The government of the ${n.name} wishes to address all nations. We seek peace, fair trade and respect for borders, and we hope others will say the same.`,
    }[t.kind];
  }
  if (phase === "result") return "";
  if (t.kind === "statement") {
    return pickBy({
      agree: [`The ${n.name} welcomes these words from the ${Au}.`, `We stand with the ${Au} on this.`, `Well said. The ${n.name} agrees.`],
      disagree: [`The ${n.name} has heard fine words from the ${Au} before. We will judge them by their deeds.`, `We do not share this view.`],
      neutral: [`The ${n.name} takes note.`, `We have listened and will consider what was said.`],
    }[stance] || [`The ${n.name} takes note.`]);
  }
  if (phase === "rebuttal") return `The ${n.name} rejects this motion. It is built on half-truths, and those who vote for it will be remembered.`;
  if (phase === "closing") return `We thank those who stood with us. The record of this hall will show who did and who did not.`;
  const lines = {
    yes: { condemn: [`The ${n.name} supports this condemnation.`, `What the ${T} has done cannot go unanswered. We vote yes.`], sanction: [`We will close our markets to the ${T}.`, `The ${n.name} supports sanctions.`], peace: [`The ${n.name} supports peace. Enough blood has been spilled.`, `Let the guns fall silent. We vote yes.`], aid: [`The ${n.name} will help the ${Au}.`, `We will send what we can.`] },
    no: { condemn: [`The ${n.name} will not join this condemnation.`, `This motion serves the ${Au}, not justice. We vote no.`], sanction: [`Sanctions would hurt ordinary people. We vote no.`, `The ${n.name} will not cut its trade over this.`], peace: [`This war will end when its causes are settled, not before. We vote no.`, `The ${n.name} opposes this call.`], aid: [`The ${n.name} cannot support this appeal.`, `Each nation must manage its own house. We vote no.`] },
    abstain: { condemn: [`The ${n.name} abstains.`], sanction: [`The ${n.name} abstains.`], peace: [`The ${n.name} abstains.`], aid: [`The ${n.name} abstains.`] },
  };
  return pickBy((lines[stance] || lines.abstain)[t.kind] || [`The ${n.name} abstains.`]);
}

/* ---------- One season in the hall ---------- */
function runAssembly(w, g, rng, dispatch) {
  const A = ensureAssembly(g);
  const news = [];
  for (const t of openTopics(g)) {
    if (!g.nations[t.author].alive) { closeTopic(g, t, "closed", "The nation that opened this topic no longer exists."); continue; }
    t.round++;
    if (t.round === 1) assemblyReplies(g, w, t, rng);
    else if (t.round >= 2) {
      assemblyFollowups(g, w, t, rng);
      const res = resolveTopic(g, w, t);
      if (res) news.push({ topicId: t.id, text: res.text, tone: res.tone });
    }
  }
  // a call for peace that was ignored
  for (const war of g.wars) {
    if (war.assemblyDefyAt === g.turn) {
      const winners = war.score >= 0 ? war.sideA : war.sideB;
      for (const s of war.assemblyBy || []) for (const x of winners) if (s !== x && g.nations[s].alive) addMod(g, s, x, "defied_assembly", "Defied the Assembly's call for peace", -8, 0.5, -16);
      const text = `The ${winners.map(id => nameOf(g, id)).join(" and ")} ignored the Assembly's call for peace and fought on.`;
      news.push({ topicId: null, text, tone: "bad" });
      addChronicle(g, text, "bad", winners[0]);
    }
  }
  A.sanctions = A.sanctions.filter(s => s.until > g.turn && g.nations[s.target].alive);
  const t = aiOpenTopic(g, w, rng);
  if (t) news.push({ topicId: t.id, text: `The ${nameOf(g, t.author)} opened a topic in the Assembly: “${t.title}”.`, tone: "neutral", fresh: true });
  dispatch.assembly = news;
  return news;
}

function assemblyReplies(g, w, t, rng) {
  for (const n of liveNations(g)) {
    if (n.id === t.author || n.isPlayer) continue;
    const st = assemblyStance(g, w, n.id, t);
    if (MOTIONS[t.kind].vote) t.votes[n.id] = st.vote;
    // great powers always speak; small states speak when they take a side, or now and then
    const speaks = !n.minor || st.vote === "yes" || st.vote === "no" || st.vote === "agree" || st.vote === "disagree" || rng() < 0.35;
    if (!speaks) continue;
    postMsg(t, { nid: n.id, turn: g.turn, kind: "reply", stance: st.vote, reasons: st.reasons, text: null, fallback: assemblyFallback(g, n.id, t, st.vote, "reply"), pending: true });
  }
}

function assemblyFollowups(g, w, t, rng) {
  const tally = voteTally(g, t);
  const target = t.target !== null ? g.nations[t.target] : null;
  if (target && target.alive && !target.isPlayer && MOTIONS[t.kind].vote && tally.yes.length >= tally.no.length)
    postMsg(t, { nid: target.id, turn: g.turn, kind: "followup", stance: "no", reasons: ["the motion is aimed at us"], text: null, fallback: assemblyFallback(g, target.id, t, "no", "rebuttal"), pending: true });
  // someone answers the player if the player spoke in this topic
  const playerSpoke = t.msgs.some(m => m.nid === PLAYER && m.kind !== "open" && m.turn >= g.turn - 1);
  if (playerSpoke) {
    const cands = liveNations(g).filter(n => !n.isPlayer && n.id !== t.author && n.id !== t.target);
    const strong = cands.map(n => ({ n, op: opinionDetail(g, n.id, PLAYER).value })).sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.op) - Math.abs(a.op))[0];
    if (strong) postMsg(t, { nid: strong.n.id, turn: g.turn, kind: "followup", stance: strong.op > 5 ? "agree" : strong.op < -5 ? "disagree" : "neutral", reasons: [`answering the ${nameOf(g, PLAYER)}`], replyTo: PLAYER, text: null, fallback: strong.op >= 0 ? `The ${strong.n.name} has heard the ${nameOf(g, PLAYER)} and finds sense in it.` : `The ${strong.n.name} has heard the ${nameOf(g, PLAYER)}. We are not persuaded.`, pending: true });
  }
  const author = g.nations[t.author];
  if (!author.isPlayer && author.alive && (t.msgs.filter(m => m.kind === "reply").length >= 3 || playerSpoke))
    postMsg(t, { nid: author.id, turn: g.turn, kind: "followup", stance: MOTIONS[t.kind].vote ? "yes" : "agree", reasons: ["closing the debate"], text: null, fallback: assemblyFallback(g, author.id, t, "yes", "closing"), pending: true });
}

function voteTally(g, t) {
  const out = { yes: [], no: [], abstain: [] };
  for (const n of liveNations(g)) out[t.votes[n.id] || "abstain"].push(n.id);
  return out;
}

function closeTopic(g, t, status, text) {
  t.status = status;
  t.closed = g.turn;
  if (text) postMsg(t, { nid: -1, turn: g.turn, kind: "result", text, fallback: text });
}

function resolveTopic(g, w, t) {
  if (!MOTIONS[t.kind].vote) {
    // a statement: those who agreed or disagreed are remembered
    for (const m of t.msgs) {
      if (m.nid < 0 || m.nid === t.author) continue;
      if (m.stance === "agree") addMod(g, t.author, m.nid, "assembly_agree", "Spoke up for us in the Assembly", 3, 0.25, 6);
      if (m.stance === "disagree") addMod(g, t.author, m.nid, "assembly_disagree", "Spoke against us in the Assembly", -3, 0.25, -6);
    }
    closeTopic(g, t, "closed", "The debate is closed.");
    return null;
  }
  const tally = voteTally(g, t);
  const passed = tally.yes.length > tally.no.length && tally.yes.length >= 2;
  const counts = `${tally.yes.length} for, ${tally.no.length} against, ${tally.abstain.length} abstaining`;
  const AuN = nameOf(g, t.author);
  // votes are remembered whatever the result
  for (const y of tally.yes) if (y !== t.author) addMod(g, t.author, y, "assembly_backed", "Backed our motion in the Assembly", 4, 0.25, 10);
  for (const x of tally.no) if (x !== t.author) addMod(g, t.author, x, "assembly_opposed", "Opposed our motion in the Assembly", -3, 0.25, -8);
  if (t.target !== null) {
    for (const y of tally.yes) addMod(g, t.target, y, "assembly_against", "Voted against us in the Assembly", -6, 0.25, -15);
    for (const x of tally.no) if (x !== t.target) addMod(g, t.target, x, "assembly_defended", "Defended us in the Assembly", 4, 0.25, 10);
  }
  let text, tone = passed ? "good" : "neutral";
  if (!passed) {
    text = `The motion “${t.title}” failed (${counts}).`;
  } else if (t.kind === "condemn") {
    const T = g.nations[t.target];
    for (const y of tally.yes) if (y !== t.target) { addMod(g, y, t.target, "condemned", "Condemned by the Assembly", -10, 0.5, -20); rel(g, y, t.target).trust = Math.max(0, rel(g, y, t.target).trust - 4); }
    T.stability = Math.max(1, T.stability - 4);
    text = `The Assembly condemned the ${T.name} (${counts}).`;
    tone = t.target === PLAYER ? "bad" : "good";
  } else if (t.kind === "sanction") {
    const T = g.nations[t.target];
    const by = tally.yes.filter(y => y !== t.target);
    let cut = 0;
    for (const y of by) for (const tr of g.treaties.filter(x => x.type === "trade" && ((x.a === y && x.b === T.id) || (x.b === y && x.a === T.id)))) { g.treaties = g.treaties.filter(x => x !== tr); cut++; }
    for (const y of by) addMod(g, T.id, y, "sanctioned_us", "Placed sanctions on us", -10, 0.5, -20);
    ensureAssembly(g).sanctions.push({ target: T.id, by, until: g.turn + ASSEMBLY.sanctionSeasons, topicId: t.id });
    bumpWorld(g);
    text = `The Assembly placed sanctions on the ${T.name} for three years (${counts}).${cut ? ` ${cut} trade agreement${cut > 1 ? "s were" : " was"} ended.` : ""}`;
    tone = t.target === PLAYER ? "bad" : "good";
  } else if (t.kind === "peace") {
    const war = warById(g, t.warId);
    if (!war) { text = `The war ended before the vote. The motion lapsed.`; tone = "neutral"; }
    else {
      war.assemblyCall = g.turn + ASSEMBLY.peaceSeasons;
      war.assemblyDefyAt = g.turn + ASSEMBLY.defyAfter;
      war.assemblyBy = tally.yes.filter(y => !war.sideA.includes(y) && !war.sideB.includes(y));
      text = `The Assembly called for peace in the war of ${warName(g, war)} (${counts}).`;
    }
  } else if (t.kind === "aid") {
    const to = g.nations[t.author];
    let total = 0;
    const donors = [];
    for (const y of tally.yes) {
      if (y === t.author) continue;
      const d = g.nations[y];
      const amount = Math.round(computeEconomy(w, g, y).gdp * ASSEMBLY.aidShare * 10) / 10;
      if (amount <= 0) continue;
      d.treasury -= amount; to.treasury += amount; total += amount;
      donors.push(`${d.name} ${fmtMoney(amount)}`);
      addMod(g, t.author, y, "sent_aid", "Sent us aid when we needed it", 10, 0.25, 20);
    }
    text = total > 0 ? `The Assembly agreed to help the ${to.name}: ${fmtMoney(total)} in aid (${donors.join(", ")}). Vote: ${counts}.` : `The Assembly agreed to help the ${to.name}, but nobody could pay.`;
    if (t.author === PLAYER) tone = "good";
  }
  closeTopic(g, t, passed ? "passed" : "failed", text);
  t.result = { passed, yes: tally.yes, no: tally.no, abstain: tally.abstain };
  if (passed) addPrestige(g, t.author, 5, "diplomacy", `The Assembly passed our motion: ${t.title}`);
  addChronicle(g, text, tone === "bad" ? "bad" : "neutral", t.author);
  for (const n of liveNations(g)) if (!n.isPlayer && (n.id === t.author || n.id === t.target)) remember(g, n.id, text);
  return { text, tone };
}

/* ---------- When a government decides to bring something to the hall ---------- */
function aiOpenTopic(g, w, rng) {
  const A = ensureAssembly(g);
  if (openTopics(g).length >= ASSEMBLY.maxOpen) return null;
  const cands = [];
  const ready = id => !g.nations[id].isPlayer && g.nations[id].alive && (A.last[id] === undefined || g.turn - A.last[id] >= ASSEMBLY.aiCooldown);
  const recent = (kind, pred) => A.topics.some(t => t.kind === kind && pred(t) && g.turn - t.opened < 12);
  for (const war of g.wars) {
    const att = war.sideA[0], def = war.sideB[0];
    // the attacked side asks the world to condemn its attacker
    if (g.turn - war.since <= 2 && ready(def) && !recent("condemn", t => t.target === att)) cands.push({ score: 3, spec: { kind: "condemn", author: def, target: att, why: "attacked" } });
    // a long war: the losing side, or a worried neutral, calls for peace
    if (g.turn - war.since >= 6 && !(war.assemblyCall > g.turn) && !recent("peace", t => t.warId === war.id)) {
      const losing = war.score > 25 ? def : war.score < -25 ? att : null;
      if (losing !== null && ready(losing)) cands.push({ score: 2.5, spec: { kind: "peace", author: losing, warId: war.id } });
      for (const n of liveNations(g)) if (ready(n.id) && !war.sideA.includes(n.id) && !war.sideB.includes(n.id) && (n.minor || n.archetype === "mercantile")) cands.push({ score: 1.5, spec: { kind: "peace", author: n.id, warId: war.id } });
    }
  }
  for (const n of liveNations(g)) {
    if (!ready(n.id)) continue;
    const econ = computeEconomy(w, g, n.id);
    // hardship: famine, collapse, crushing debt
    if ((econ.famineShare > 0.06 || n.stability < 28 || n.treasury < -0.8 * econ.gdp) && !recent("aid", t => t.author === n.id)) cands.push({ score: 2, spec: { kind: "aid", author: n.id } });
    // a serial aggressor: sanctions from those who fear or hate it
    for (const z of liveNations(g)) {
      if (z.id === n.id) continue;
      const binds = g.trade && g.trade.v ? tradeExposure(g, n.id, z.id).material : hasTreaty(g, n.id, z.id, "trade");   // we would not sanction our own trade
      if ((g.stats.warsStarted[z.id] || 0) >= 2 && opinionDetail(g, n.id, z.id).value < -30 && !binds && !recent("sanction", t => t.target === z.id))
        cands.push({ score: 1.2, spec: { kind: "sanction", author: n.id, target: z.id } });
    }
    for (const z of liveNations(g)) {
      if (z.id === n.id) continue;
      // a broken treaty is brought before the world
      const broke = rel(g, n.id, z.id).mods.find(m => m.key === "broke_treaty" && m.value < -30);
      if (broke && !recent("condemn", t => t.target === z.id)) cands.push({ score: 2.5, spec: { kind: "condemn", author: n.id, target: z.id, why: "treaty" } });
      // a frightened government warns the world about a hostile neighbor's army
      if (threatFrom(w, g, n.id, z.id) >= 0.9 && opinionDetail(g, n.id, z.id).value < -25 && !atWar(g, n.id, z.id) && (hasTrait(n, "paranoid") || personality(n).caution >= 1.2) && !recent("condemn", t => t.target === z.id))
        cands.push({ score: 1.3, spec: { kind: "condemn", author: n.id, target: z.id, why: "threat" } });
    }
    // a new great-power leader introduces the government
    if (!n.minor && n.leader && n.leader.since === g.turn && g.turn > 0 && rng() < 0.6) cands.push({ score: 1, spec: { kind: "statement", author: n.id, title: `A new government in the ${n.name}` } });
  }
  // grain cut off from the hungry, or a nation that bullies its trading partners (10t)
  cands.push(...tradeTopicCandidates(w, g, ready, recent));
  const valid = cands.filter(c => !validateTopic(g, c.spec)).sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
  if (!valid.length || rng() > 0.75) return null;
  const c = valid[0];
  const t = openTopic(g, c.spec, assemblyFallback(g, c.spec.author, { ...c.spec, id: A.nextId, target: c.spec.target ?? null, warId: c.spec.warId ?? null }, "yes", "open"), true);
  t.why = c.spec.why || null;
  t.msgs[0].reasons = [{ attacked: `the ${nameOf(g, t.target)} attacked us`, treaty: `the ${nameOf(g, t.target)} broke its treaty with us`, threat: `the ${nameOf(g, t.target)}'s army on our border frightens us`, starve: `the ${nameOf(g, t.target)} cut off grain while people go hungry`, bully: `the ${nameOf(g, t.target)} bullies its trading partners` }[c.spec.why] || { peace: "the war must end", aid: "our people are suffering", sanction: "it keeps starting wars", statement: "a new leader takes office and introduces the government" }[t.kind] || "our interests"];
  return t;
}

/* The player opens a topic or speaks. Player text is in-world words: it never changes how anyone votes. */
function playerOpenTopic(g, spec, text) {
  const s = { ...spec, author: PLAYER, text };
  const err = validateTopic(g, s);
  if (err) return { ok: false, reason: err };
  const t = openTopic(g, s, cleanText(text, 600));
  t.msgs[0].text = cleanText(text, 600);
  return { ok: true, topic: t };
}
function playerPost(g, t, text, vote) {
  if (t.status !== "open") return { ok: false, reason: "This topic is closed." };
  const clean = cleanText(text, 600);
  const used = t.playerPosts[g.turn] || 0;
  if (clean.length && used >= ASSEMBLY.playerPostsPerSeason) return { ok: false, reason: "You have spoken twice in this topic this season. Wait for the others to answer." };
  if (vote && MOTIONS[t.kind].vote && t.author !== PLAYER) t.votes[PLAYER] = vote;
  if (clean.length >= 2) {
    postMsg(t, { nid: PLAYER, turn: g.turn, kind: "player", stance: MOTIONS[t.kind].vote ? (t.votes[PLAYER] || null) : null, text: clean, fallback: clean });
    t.playerPosts[g.turn] = used + 1;
  }
  return { ok: true };
}

/* The player answers an envoy (a rival's proposal, demand, or call to arms). */
function respondToEnvoy(g, w, item, accept, ignored = false) {
  const from = item.from;
  if (!g.nations[from] || !g.nations[from].alive) { item.status = "void"; return { ok: false, reason: "That nation no longer exists." }; }
  if (item.kind === "call") {
    const war = g.wars.find(x => x.id === item.warId);
    if (accept && war) {
      joinWar(g, war, PLAYER, war.sideA.includes(from) ? "A" : "B");
      addMod(g, from, PLAYER, "honored", "Came to our aid in war", 20, 0.5, 30);
      remember(g, from, `The ${nameOf(g, PLAYER)} honored our alliance and joined the war.`);
    } else if (war) abandonAlly(g, PLAYER, from);
    item.status = accept ? "accepted" : "declined";
    return { ok: true };
  }
  if (accept) {
    const err = validateDeal(g, w, from, PLAYER, item.terms);
    if (err) { item.status = "void"; item.note = err; return { ok: false, reason: err }; }
    applyDeal(g, w, from, PLAYER, item.terms);
    if (item.threat) {
      remember(g, from, `The ${nameOf(g, PLAYER)} gave in to our demand. We promised peace in return.`);
      addTreaty(g, "truce", from, PLAYER);
    }
    item.status = "accepted";
    return { ok: true };
  }
  addMod(g, from, PLAYER, "refused", "Rejected our proposal", -3, 1, -9);
  if (ignored) addMod(g, from, PLAYER, "ignored", "Ignored our envoy", -2, 1, -6);
  if (!item.threat && item.kind && !item.kind.startsWith("peace") && !item.kind.startsWith("demand")) {
    const fn = g.nations[from];
    fn.lastAsked = { ...(fn.lastAsked || {}), [`${item.kind}:${PLAYER}`]: g.turn + 6 }; // don't pester: ask again in about three years
  }
  if (item.threat) addCommitment(g, from, PLAYER, termsText(g, item.terms));
  remember(g, from, `The ${nameOf(g, PLAYER)} ${ignored ? "ignored" : "refused"} our proposal of ${termsText(g, item.terms)}.`);
  item.status = ignored ? "ignored" : "declined";
  return { ok: true };
}

/* =====================================================================
   10b. Diplomacy: relations, opinions, trust, treaties
   ===================================================================== */
const PERSONALITY = {
  expansionist: { pride: 1.2, caution: 0.7, aggression: 1.2, tradeWeight: 0.8, moneyWeight: 1.0, landWeight: 1.5,
    voice: "proud and ambitious; speaks of destiny, land and the future of its people" },
  mercantile:   { pride: 0.7, caution: 1.0, aggression: 0.4, tradeWeight: 1.6, moneyWeight: 1.3, landWeight: 0.8,
    voice: "polished and transactional; courteous, precise about money, allergic to waste and war" },
  agrarian:     { pride: 0.9, caution: 1.4, aggression: 0.5, tradeWeight: 0.9, moneyWeight: 1.0, landWeight: 1.0,
    voice: "plain-spoken and cautious; speaks of harvests, patience and keeping the peace" },
  militarist:   { pride: 1.5, caution: 0.6, aggression: 1.5, tradeWeight: 0.6, moneyWeight: 0.9, landWeight: 1.2,
    voice: "curt and martial; speaks of strength, order and honor; despises weakness" },
};
const PLAYER_PERSONALITY = { pride: 1, caution: 1, aggression: 0.8, tradeWeight: 1, moneyWeight: 1, landWeight: 1 };
function personality(n) {
  const base = n.archetype ? PERSONALITY[n.archetype] : PLAYER_PERSONALITY;
  if (!n.leader) return base;
  const out = { ...base };
  for (const t of n.leader.traits) for (const k in LEADER_TRAITS[t].mod) out[k] = Math.max(0.1, (out[k] || 0) + LEADER_TRAITS[t].mod[k]);
  if (n.minor) { out.aggression = Math.min(out.aggression, 0.3); out.caution = Math.max(out.caution, 1.3); }
  return out;
}

const AFFINITY = {
  "mercantile|mercantile": 8, "agrarian|agrarian": 6, "militarist|militarist": 4, "expansionist|expansionist": -4,
  "mercantile|militarist": -6, "agrarian|expansionist": -6, "agrarian|militarist": -4, "mercantile|expansionist": -2,
  "mercantile|agrarian": 4, "expansionist|militarist": 2,
};
function affinity(a, b) { if (!a || !b) return 0; return AFFINITY[`${a}|${b}`] ?? AFFINITY[`${b}|${a}`] ?? 0; }

const TREATY_INFO = {
  trade:    { label: "Trade agreement",     seasons: null },
  nap:      { label: "Non-aggression pact", seasons: 12 },
  alliance: { label: "Defensive alliance",  seasons: null },
  border:   { label: "Border accord",       seasons: 16 },
  tribute:  { label: "Tribute",             seasons: null },
  truce:    { label: "Truce",               seasons: 8 },
};
const BINDING = ["nap", "alliance", "border", "truce", "tribute"];

const DIPLO = {
  tradeForeignShare: 0.4,     // a trade partner's people count for 40% in your market
  horizonYears: 4,            // how far ahead nations value lasting gains
  nearBorderCells: 4,         // "near our border" for settling and border accords
  inboxSeasons: 2,            // envoys wait this long for an answer
  counterGap: 6,              // largest shortfall (in points) a nation will try to close with a counter-offer
};

function nameOf(g, id) { return g.nations[id] ? g.nations[id].name : "someone"; }
function liveNations(g) { return g.nations.filter(n => n.alive); }
function controller(g, i) { return g.occ[i] >= 0 ? g.occ[i] : g.owner[i]; }
function bumpWorld(g) { g.ver = (g.ver || 0) + 1; }

function contactMatrix(g) {
  const k = g.nations.length;
  const m = Array.from({ length: k }, () => new Array(k).fill(0));
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) {
    const a = controller(g, i);
    if (a < 0) continue;
    if (cellX(i) + 1 < GRID_W) { const b = controller(g, i + 1); if (b >= 0 && b !== a) { m[a][b]++; m[b][a]++; } }
    if (cellY(i) + 1 < GRID_H) { const b = controller(g, i + GRID_W); if (b >= 0 && b !== a) { m[a][b]++; m[b][a]++; } }
  }
  return m;
}
function contact(g) {
  if (!g._contact || g._contactVer !== g.ver) { g._contact = contactMatrix(g); g._contactVer = g.ver; }
  return g._contact;
}
function sharesBorder(g, a, b) { return contact(g)[a][b] > 0; }

function territoryGap(w, g, a, b) {
  if (sharesBorder(g, a, b)) return 0;
  const src = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (controller(g, i) === a) src.push(i);
  if (!src.length) return Infinity;
  const d = distanceField(w, src);
  let best = Infinity;
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (controller(g, i) === b && d[i] < best) best = d[i];
  return best === Infinity ? 99 : Math.max(1, best - 1);
}
function gap(w, g, a, b) {
  if (!g._gap || g._gapVer !== g.ver) { g._gap = {}; g._gapVer = g.ver; }
  const k = a < b ? `${a}-${b}` : `${b}-${a}`;
  if (!(k in g._gap)) g._gap[k] = territoryGap(w, g, a, b);
  return g._gap[k];
}

function nationPop(g, nid) {
  let p = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (g.owner[i] === nid && g.occ[i] < 0) p += g.pop[i];
  return p;
}
function defenseMult(n) { return 0.75 + n.defense / 100; }

/* ---------- Relations ---------- */
function rel(g, a, b) {
  const k = `${a}>${b}`;
  if (!g.rel[k]) g.rel[k] = { mods: [], trust: 50, cred: 0.6 };
  return g.rel[k];
}
function addMod(g, from, to, key, label, value, decay, cap) {
  if (from === to || !g.nations[from] || !g.nations[to]) return;
  const r = rel(g, from, to);
  const limit = v => (cap === undefined ? v : value < 0 ? Math.max(cap, v) : Math.min(cap, v));
  const m = r.mods.find(x => x.key === key);
  if (m) { m.value = limit(m.value + value); m.label = label; m.decay = decay; }
  else r.mods.push({ key, label, value: limit(value), decay });
}
function decayRelations(g) {
  for (const k in g.rel) {
    const r = g.rel[k];
    r.mods.forEach(m => { m.value = m.value > 0 ? Math.max(0, m.value - m.decay) : Math.min(0, m.value + m.decay); });
    r.mods = r.mods.filter(m => Math.abs(m.value) >= 0.5);
  }
}
function driftTrust(g) {
  for (const a of liveNations(g)) for (const b of liveNations(g)) {
    if (a.id === b.id) continue;
    const r = rel(g, a.id, b.id);
    if (treatiesBetween(g, a.id, b.id).some(t => t.type !== "truce")) r.trust = Math.min(85, r.trust + 1);
    else r.trust += (50 - r.trust) * 0.04;
  }
}

/* How `from` sees `to`: items worked out from the world now, then remembered events. `opts.noEmbargo` leaves out
   everything that comes from embargoes (an old grudge must not feed on the embargo it would justify). */
function opinionDetail(g, from, to, opts = {}) {
  const items = [];
  const A = g.nations[from], B = g.nations[to];
  const aff = affinity(A.archetype, B.archetype);
  if (aff) items.push({ label: aff > 0 ? "Kindred character" : "Clashing character", value: aff });
  for (const t of treatiesBetween(g, from, to)) {
    const v = { trade: 10, nap: 5, alliance: 20, border: 5, truce: 0, tribute: t.a === from ? -10 : 4 }[t.type];
    if (v) items.push({ label: t.type === "tribute" ? (t.a === from ? "We pay them tribute" : "They pay us tribute") : TREATY_INFO[t.type].label, value: v });
  }
  const war = atWar(g, from, to);
  if (war) items.push({ label: "At war with us", value: -40 });
  if (!war && sharesBorder(g, from, to)) {
    const ratio = armyPower(g, to) / Math.max(1, armyPower(g, from));
    if (ratio > 1.3) items.push({ label: "Their army dwarfs ours", value: -Math.round(clamp(12 * (ratio - 1.3) + 4, 0, 20)) });
  }
  for (const z of liveNations(g)) {
    if (z.id === from || z.id === to) continue;
    if (atWar(g, from, z.id) && atWar(g, to, z.id)) items.push({ label: `Common enemy: ${z.name}`, value: 15 });
  }
  if (!war && B.softPower >= 1) items.push({ label: "Their films, radio and resorts", value: Math.round(B.softPower) });
  if (hasTrait(B, "honorable")) items.push({ label: "Their leader keeps every promise", value: 5 });
  const fmItem = foreignOpinionItem(B);
  if (fmItem) items.push(fmItem);
  if (A.archetype === "mercantile" && B.laws && B.laws.trade !== (A.laws && A.laws.trade)) items.push({ label: B.laws.trade === "protect" ? "Their tariffs shut out our merchants" : B.laws.trade === "free" ? "Their open markets" : "", value: B.laws.trade === "protect" ? -5 : B.laws.trade === "free" ? 4 : 0 });
  // trade (10t): their embargo while it stands, a need they fill, good customers (read from the book, no economy)
  for (const it of tradeOpinionItems(g, from, to, opts.noEmbargo)) items.push(it);
  rel(g, from, to).mods.forEach(m => { if (!(opts.noEmbargo && embargoModKey(m.key))) items.push({ label: m.label, value: Math.round(m.value) }); });
  const value = clamp(items.reduce((s, x) => s + x.value, 0), -100, 100);
  return { value, items: items.filter(x => x.value !== 0) };
}
function opinionLabel(v) {
  return v <= -50 ? "Hostile" : v <= -20 ? "Unfriendly" : v < -5 ? "Wary" : v <= 10 ? "Neutral" : v < 35 ? "Cordial" : "Friendly";
}

function threatFrom(w, g, E, Z) {
  if (E === Z || !g.nations[Z].alive || !g.nations[E].alive) return 0;
  if (atWar(g, E, Z)) return 1.5;
  const d = gap(w, g, E, Z);
  const reach = d === 0 ? 1 : d <= 4 ? 0.6 : d <= 10 ? 0.3 : 0.1;
  const ratio = armyPower(g, Z) / Math.max(1, armyPower(g, E) * defenseMult(g.nations[E]));
  const base = clamp(ratio - 0.5, 0, 1.5);
  const op = opinionDetail(g, E, Z).value;
  const hostility = op < -30 ? 1.3 : op < 0 ? 1 : op < 30 ? 0.75 : 0.5;
  const zn = g.nations[Z];
  const temper = zn.archetype ? personality(zn).aggression : 0.8 + 0.3 * Math.min(3, g.stats.warsStarted[Z] || 0);
  return clamp(base * reach * hostility * (0.6 + 0.4 * temper) * (hasTrait(g.nations[E], "paranoid") ? 1.35 : 1), 0, 1.5);
}

/* ---------- Memory: what each government remembers, in plain sentences ---------- */
function remember(g, nid, text) {
  if (!g.nations[nid] || g.nations[nid].isPlayer) return;
  if (!g.memory[nid]) g.memory[nid] = [];
  g.memory[nid].unshift({ turn: g.turn, text });
  if (g.memory[nid].length > 24) g.memory[nid].length = 24;
}
function rememberBoth(g, a, b, text) { remember(g, a, text); remember(g, b, text); }

/* ---------- Treaties ---------- */
function treatiesBetween(g, a, b) { return g.treaties.filter(t => (t.a === a && t.b === b) || (t.a === b && t.b === a)); }
function hasTreaty(g, a, b, type) { return treatiesBetween(g, a, b).some(t => t.type === type); }
function addTreaty(g, type, a, b, extra = {}) {
  if (type !== "tribute" && hasTreaty(g, a, b, type)) return null;
  const seasons = extra.seasons ?? TREATY_INFO[type].seasons;
  const t = { id: g.nextId++, type, a, b, since: g.turn, until: seasons ? g.turn + seasons : null, ...extra };
  g.treaties.push(t);
  if (type !== "truce" && g.stats) { natStats(g, a).treaties++; natStats(g, b).treaties++; }
  if (["trade", "nap", "alliance", "border"].includes(type)) { leaderDeed(g, a, "treaties"); leaderDeed(g, b, "treaties"); }
  return t;
}
function endTreaty(g, t, breaker) {
  g.treaties = g.treaties.filter(x => x !== t);
  if (breaker === null || breaker === undefined) return;
  const victim = t.a === breaker ? t.b : t.a;
  if (t.type === "trade") { addMod(g, victim, breaker, "ended_trade", "Ended our trade", -10, 1, -20); remember(g, victim, `${nameOf(g, breaker)} ended our trade agreement.`); return; }
  if (t.type === "tribute" && t.b === breaker) { remember(g, victim, `${nameOf(g, breaker)} released us from paying tribute.`); return; }
  addMod(g, victim, breaker, "broke_treaty", `Broke our ${TREATY_INFO[t.type].label.toLowerCase()}`, -50, 1, -80);
  const r = rel(g, victim, breaker);
  r.trust = Math.max(0, r.trust - 35);
  for (const z of liveNations(g)) {
    if (z.id === breaker || z.id === victim) continue;
    addMod(g, z.id, breaker, "faithless", "Breaks its treaties", -15, 0.5, -30);
    rel(g, z.id, breaker).trust = Math.max(0, rel(g, z.id, breaker).trust - 15);
    remember(g, z.id, `${nameOf(g, breaker)} broke its ${TREATY_INFO[t.type].label.toLowerCase()} with ${nameOf(g, victim)}.`);
  }
  remember(g, victim, `${nameOf(g, breaker)} broke its ${TREATY_INFO[t.type].label.toLowerCase()} with us.`);
}
function expireTreaties(g) {
  const news = [];
  for (const t of [...g.treaties]) {
    if (t.until !== null && t.until !== undefined && g.turn >= t.until) {
      g.treaties = g.treaties.filter(x => x !== t);
      news.push({ a: t.a, b: t.b, text: `The ${TREATY_INFO[t.type].label.toLowerCase()} between ${nameOf(g, t.a)} and ${nameOf(g, t.b)} has run its course.` });
    }
  }
  return news;
}
function payTributes(g) {
  for (const t of g.treaties) if (t.type === "tribute") {
    g.nations[t.a].treasury -= t.amount;
    g.nations[t.b].treasury += t.amount;
  }
}

/* ---------- Commitments: threats made, and whether they were carried out ----------
   A threat is of war (the default) or of an embargo ({kind: "embargo", k: good or null}). War carries out any
   threat; an embargo carries out only a threat of embargo. */
function commitKind(c) { return c.kind || "war"; }
function addCommitment(g, by, against, label, extra = {}) {
  const kind = extra.kind || "war";
  if (g.commitments.some(c => c.by === by && c.against === against && commitKind(c) === kind)) return;
  g.commitments.push({ by, against, turn: g.turn, label, ...(kind !== "war" ? { kind, k: extra.k ?? null } : {}) });
}
function fulfilCommitment(g, by, against, kind) {
  const kept = g.commitments.filter(c => c.by === by && c.against === against && (kind !== "embargo" || commitKind(c) === "embargo"));
  if (!kept.length) return;
  const r = rel(g, against, by);
  r.cred = clamp(r.cred + 0.25, 0, 1);
  for (const z of liveNations(g)) if (z.id !== by) rel(g, z.id, by).cred = clamp(rel(g, z.id, by).cred + 0.1, 0, 1);
  g.commitments = g.commitments.filter(c => !kept.includes(c));
}
function checkCommitments(g) {
  const news = [];
  for (const c of [...g.commitments]) {
    if (g.turn - c.turn < 3) continue;
    g.commitments = g.commitments.filter(x => x !== c);
    if (!g.nations[c.by].alive || !g.nations[c.against].alive) continue;
    // a threat to cut off trade is carried out by an embargo in force, and made moot by a war (no trade passes)
    if (commitKind(c) === "embargo" && (atWar(g, c.by, c.against) || embargoesBy(g, c.by, c.against).length)) continue;
    const r = rel(g, c.against, c.by);
    r.cred = clamp(r.cred - 0.25, 0, 1);
    const what = commitKind(c) === "embargo" ? `to cut off ${c.k && GOODS[c.k] ? `our ${GOODS[c.k].label.toLowerCase()}` : "our trade"}` : "war";
    remember(g, c.against, `${nameOf(g, c.by)} threatened ${what} over ${c.label} but never acted.`);
    if (c.by === PLAYER) news.push(commitKind(c) === "embargo" ? `The ${nameOf(g, c.against)} noted that you never cut off their trade as you threatened over ${c.label}. Your threats now carry less weight with them.` : `The ${nameOf(g, c.against)} noted that you never carried out your threat over ${c.label}. Your threats now carry less weight with them.`);
    if (c.against === PLAYER) news.push(commitKind(c) === "embargo" ? `The ${nameOf(g, c.by)} threatened to cut off your trade over ${c.label} but did not act. Their threats will worry you less.` : `The ${nameOf(g, c.by)} threatened you over ${c.label} but did not act. Their threats will worry you less.`);
  }
  return news;
}

/* =====================================================================
   10c. Deals: terms, validation, evaluation from each nation's own interests
   ===================================================================== */
function termText(g, t) {
  switch (t.type) {
    case "trade": return "a trade agreement";
    case "nap": return `a non-aggression pact for ${TREATY_INFO.nap.seasons} seasons`;
    case "alliance": return "a defensive alliance";
    case "border": return `a border accord for ${TREATY_INFO.border.seasons} seasons`;
    case "payment": return `${nameOf(g, t.from)} pays ${fmtMoney(t.amount)} at once`;
    case "tribute": return `${nameOf(g, t.from)} pays ${fmtMoney(t.amount)} a season for ${t.seasons} seasons`;
    case "city": { const c = g.cities.find(x => x.id === t.cityId); return `${nameOf(g, t.from)} hands over ${c ? c.name : "a town"} and its land`; }
    case "peace": return "peace";
    case "lift_embargo": {
      // a noun phrase like the other terms ("agreed on an end to ..."); the goods while the embargo still stands
      if (t.by === "both") return "an end to the embargoes on both sides";
      const es = embargoesBy(g, t.by, t.on);
      const ons = t.on !== undefined ? [t.on] : [...new Set(es.map(e => e.on))];
      const the = id => (id === PLAYER ? nameOf(g, id) : `the ${nameOf(g, id)}`);   // the player's own name takes no "the"
      return `an end to ${the(t.by)}'s embargo${ons.length === 1 ? ` on ${the(ons[0])}${es.length ? ` (${embargoGoodsText(es)})` : ""}` : ""}`;
    }
    default: return "an unknown term";
  }
}
function termsText(g, terms) {
  const parts = terms.map(t => termText(g, t));
  return parts.length <= 1 ? parts.join("") : `${parts.slice(0, -1).join(", ")} and ${parts[parts.length - 1]}`;
}

function regionCellsForCity(g, city) {
  const own = g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === city.owner);
  const cells = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) {
    if (g.owner[i] !== city.owner) continue;
    let best = null, bd = Infinity;
    for (const c of own) {
      const d = (cellX(i) - cellX(c.cell)) ** 2 + (cellY(i) - cellY(c.cell)) ** 2;
      if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = c; }
    }
    if (best === city) cells.push(i);
  }
  return cells;
}
function regionValue(w, g, city) {
  const cells = regionCellsForCity(g, city);
  let pop = 0;
  cells.forEach(i => { pop += g.pop[i]; });
  const econ = computeEconomy(w, g, city.owner);
  const perPerson = econ.pop > 0.01 ? econ.gdp / econ.pop : ECON.baseOutputK;
  return { cells, pop, gdp: pop * perPerson };
}

function validateDeal(g, w, a, b, terms) {
  if (!terms.length) return "Add at least one term.";
  if (terms.length > 6) return "Too many terms in one proposal.";
  if (!g.nations[a].alive || !g.nations[b].alive) return "That nation no longer exists.";
  const war = atWar(g, a, b);
  const seen = new Set();
  for (const t of terms) {
    if (["trade", "nap", "alliance", "border", "peace", "lift_embargo"].includes(t.type)) {
      if (seen.has(t.type)) return "The same term appears twice.";
      seen.add(t.type);
    }
    if (["trade", "nap", "alliance", "border"].includes(t.type)) {
      if (war) return `You are at war. Make peace before proposing a ${TREATY_INFO[t.type].label.toLowerCase()}.`;
      if (hasTreaty(g, a, b, t.type)) return `A ${TREATY_INFO[t.type].label.toLowerCase()} is already in force.`;
      if (t.type === "trade" && sanctioned(g, a, b)) return "Sanctions voted by the World Assembly forbid trade between you.";
    }
    if (t.type === "peace" && !war) return "You are not at war with them.";
    if (t.type === "lift_embargo") {
      if (t.by !== "both" && t.by !== a && t.by !== b) return "The nation that lifts the embargo must be one of the two.";
      for (const L of t.by === "both" ? [a, b] : [t.by]) {
        const V = L === a ? b : a;
        if (!embargoesBy(g, L, V).length) return t.by === "both" ? `Only one side has an embargo: ask the ${nameOf(g, V)} to lift theirs.` : `The ${nameOf(g, L)} has no embargo on the ${nameOf(g, V)}.`;
      }
    }
    if (t.type === "payment" || t.type === "tribute") {
      if (t.from !== a && t.from !== b) return "The payer must be one of the two nations.";
      if (!(t.amount > 0) || !isFinite(t.amount)) return "Payments must be more than zero.";
      if (t.type === "tribute" && !(t.seasons >= 1 && t.seasons <= 20)) return "Tribute can last 1 to 20 seasons.";
      if (t.type === "payment") {
        const p = g.nations[t.from];
        const gdp = computeEconomy(w, g, t.from).gdp;
        if (p.treasury - t.amount < BUILD.creditFloorShare * gdp) return `The ${p.name} cannot afford ${fmtMoney(t.amount)}.`;
      }
    }
    if (t.type === "city") {
      const c = g.cities.find(x => x.id === t.cityId);
      if (!c || c.owner !== t.from || (t.from !== a && t.from !== b)) return "That town is not theirs to give.";
      if (g.cities.filter(x => x.owner === t.from).length <= 1) return "A nation cannot give away its last town.";
    }
  }
  return null;
}

/* Score a deal from nation E's point of view when P proposes it.
   1 point ≈ 1% of E's yearly output, so money, land, trade and security compare on one scale. */
function evaluateDeal(g, w, E, P, terms, ctx = {}) {
  const lines = [];
  const add = (label, pts) => { if (Math.abs(pts) >= 0.5) lines.push({ label, pts: Math.round(pts * 10) / 10 }); };
  const nE = g.nations[E], nP = g.nations[P], per = personality(nE);
  const econE = computeEconomy(w, g, E);
  const gdpE = Math.max(1, econE.gdp);
  const once = x => (100 * x) / gdpE;
  const flow = x => (100 * x * DIPLO.horizonYears) / gdpE;
  const r = rel(g, E, P);
  const trustF = clamp(r.trust / 60, 0.3, 1.3);
  const op = opinionDetail(g, E, P).value;
  const args = ctx.args || {};
  let asksFromE = false, commits = false;

  for (const t of terms) {
    if (t.type === "trade") {
      commits = true;
      const h = hypothetical(g, { treaty: { type: "trade", a: E, b: P } });
      const dE = computeEconomy(w, h, E).gdp - econE.gdp;
      const dP = computeEconomy(w, h, P).gdp - computeEconomy(w, g, P).gdp;
      if (dE < 0.05) add("No shared border, trade road or pair of ports for goods to pass through yet", -2);
      else add(`Trade would add ${fmtMoney(dE)} a year to our economy`, flow(dE) * per.tradeWeight * (args.mutual_prosperity ? 1 : 0.8));
      const th = threatFrom(w, g, E, P);
      if (th > 0.4) add(`It would also enrich a dangerous neighbor (+${fmtMoney(dP)} a year for them)`, -flow(dP) * 0.5 * th);
    }
    if (t.type === "nap") {
      commits = true;
      const th = threatFrom(w, g, E, P);
      if (th > 0.1) add(`Security against the ${nP.name}'s army`, th * 22 * per.caution * trustF);
      else add("We don't see them as a danger", -2);
      const wa = warAssessment(w, g, E, P);
      if (wa && wa.value > 0) add("It would tie our hands", -Math.min(25, wa.value));
    }
    if (t.type === "alliance") {
      commits = true;
      let best = 0, bestZ = null;
      for (const z of liveNations(g)) {
        if (z.id === E || z.id === P) continue;
        const s = Math.min(threatFrom(w, g, E, z.id), threatFrom(w, g, P, z.id));
        if (s > best) { best = s; bestZ = z.id; }
      }
      if (bestZ !== null && best > 0.05) add(`Shared danger from the ${nameOf(g, bestZ)}`, best * 30 * (args.shared_threat === bestZ ? 1 : 0.6) * trustF);
      else add("No common enemy to stand against", -4);
      const wars = enemiesOf(g, P).length;
      if (wars) add("They are at war; we could be dragged in", -12 * wars);
      const started = g.stats.warsStarted[P] || 0;
      if (started) add(`They have started ${started} war${started > 1 ? "s" : ""}`, -5 * Math.min(3, started));
      if (op < 15) add("We are not close enough for an alliance", -(15 - op) / 2);
    }
    if (t.type === "border") {
      commits = true;
      if (r.mods.some(m => m.key === "settled_near")) add("It would stop them settling near our border", 10);
      if (nE.archetype === "expansionist" && gap(w, g, E, P) > 0) add("It would limit our expansion", -10 * per.landWeight);
      add("Clear borders keep the peace", 2);
    }
    if (t.type === "payment") {
      if (t.from === P) add(`They pay us ${fmtMoney(t.amount)}`, once(t.amount) * per.moneyWeight);
      else { asksFromE = true; add(`We would pay ${fmtMoney(t.amount)}`, -once(t.amount) * 1.1); }
    }
    if (t.type === "tribute") {
      const total = t.amount * t.seasons;
      if (t.from === P) add(`Tribute of ${fmtMoney(t.amount)} a season`, once(total) * per.moneyWeight * Math.min(1, r.trust / 70));
      else { asksFromE = true; add(`We would pay ${fmtMoney(total)} in tribute`, -once(total) * 1.1); add("Paying tribute is humiliating", -8 * per.pride); }
    }
    if (t.type === "city") {
      const c = g.cities.find(x => x.id === t.cityId);
      const reg = regionValue(w, g, c);
      if (t.from === E) {
        asksFromE = true;
        const war = warBetween(g, E, P);
        const lost = war && g.occ[c.cell] >= 0 && !sameSide(war, g.occ[c.cell], E);
        const regain = lost ? clamp(0.5 + sideScore(war, E) / 150, 0.08, 0.6) : 1;
        add(lost ? `Losing ${c.name}, which their army already holds (${pct(regain)} chance we could win it back)` : `Losing ${c.name} (${fmtMoney(reg.gdp)} of output a year)`, -flow(reg.gdp) * regain);
        add(c.capital ? `${c.name} is our capital` : "Giving up our own land", (c.capital ? -150 : -12 * per.pride) * (lost ? 0.5 : 1));
        add(`${c.name} matters to us (importance ${c.imp || "?"}${cityRoleWords(c)})`, -clamp(c.imp || 20, 0, 110) * 0.15 * (lost ? 0.5 : 1));
        if (c.origin === P && (c.loyalty ?? CITY.loyalNative) < 60) add(`${c.name}'s people never felt at home with us`, 5);
      } else {
        add(`Gaining ${c.name} (${fmtMoney(reg.gdp)} of output a year)`, flow(reg.gdp) * per.landWeight * 0.8 + 4);
        add(`What ${c.name} adds to our standing (importance ${c.imp || "?"})`, clamp(c.imp || 20, 0, 110) * 0.08);
        if (c.origin === E) add(`Our own people in ${c.name} come home`, 12);
      }
    }
    if (t.type === "peace") {
      const war = warBetween(g, E, P);
      const pd = war ? peaceDesire(g, E, war) : 0;
      add(pd >= 0 ? "We want this war over" : "We are winning; peace now wastes our gains", pd);
      if (war && war.assemblyCall > g.turn) add("The World Assembly has called for peace", 10);
    }
    if (t.type === "lift_embargo") {
      // each side's embargoes, worked out on a copy of the world where they are lifted (merchants find their old buyers)
      const baseE = econBaseFor(w, g, E, econE);
      for (const L of t.by === "both" ? [P, E] : [t.by]) {
        const V = L === E ? P : E;
        const es = embargoesBy(g, L, V);
        if (!es.length) continue;
        const hE = computeEconomy(w, hypothetical(g, { lift: { by: L, on: V } }), E);
        const dE = hE.gdp - baseE.gdp;
        const goods = embargoGoodsText(es);
        if (L === P) {
          // their embargo on us ends; worth half to us, since it would end some day anyway
          if (dE > 0.005) add(`Their embargo on our trade ends (${goods}): ${fmtSignedMoney(dE)} a year for us`, flow(dE) * per.tradeWeight * 0.5);
          // fuel, arms and food count as in an embargo's hurt: a whole key supply is worth 6% of output a year
          const fuel = (hE.fuelSat ?? 1) - (baseE.fuelSat ?? 1), arms = (hE.armsSat ?? 1) - (baseE.armsSat ?? 1), fed = baseE.famineShare - hE.famineShare;
          const key = Math.max(fuel, arms, fed, 0);
          const keyText = fed >= Math.max(fuel, arms) ? `${pct(key)} more of our people would be fed` : fuel >= arms ? `Our army would get back ${pct(key)} of the fuel it needs` : `Our arms factories would get back ${pct(key)} of the metal and parts they need`;
          if (key >= 0.02) add(keyText, 0.5 * DIPLO.horizonYears * 6 * key);
          if (terms.some(x => (x.type === "payment" || x.type === "tribute") && x.from === E)) add("Paying them to end it is giving in to pressure", -3 * per.pride);
        } else {
          // we lift ours: our merchants trade again, but we give up the pressure it puts on them
          asksFromE = true;
          if (dE > 0.005) add(`Our merchants could trade with them again (${goods}): ${fmtSignedMoney(dE)} a year`, flow(dE) * per.tradeWeight);
          const cause = es.reduce((best, e) => { const c = embargoCause(w, g, e, { ignoreAnswers: t.by === "both" }); return c.score > best.score ? c : best; }, { score: 0, lines: [] });
          if (cause.score > 0) add(`It ends the pressure our embargo puts on them (${lcFirst(cause.lines.slice().sort((a, b) => b.pts - a.pts)[0].label)})`, -cause.score);
          if (terms.some(x => (x.type === "payment" || x.type === "tribute") && x.from === P)) add("Paid to lift it, we may not bring it back for four years", -1);
        }
      }
    }
  }
  add(`How we feel about the ${nP.name}`, op / 5);
  if (commits) add("Caution about new commitments", -1.5 * per.caution);

  if (ctx.threat && (asksFromE || terms.some(t => ["peace", "trade", "border", "nap"].includes(t.type)))) {
    const near = sharesBorder(g, E, P) ? 1 : gap(w, g, E, P) <= 3 ? 0.5 : 0.1;
    const ratio = armyPower(g, P) / Math.max(1, armyPower(g, E) * defenseMult(nE));
    const C = r.cred * clamp((ratio - 0.7) / 0.8, 0, 1) * near;
    if (C >= 0.25) {
      add(`Fear of war with the ${nP.name}`, C * 35 * per.caution);
      add("We resent being threatened", -8 * per.pride);
    } else add(near < 0.5 ? "An empty threat: they cannot reach us" : "An empty threat: their army is not strong enough", -8);
  }
  for (const l of ctx.extraLines || []) add(l.label, l.pts);
  if (ctx.tone === "insulting") add("Your insulting tone", -6);
  else if (ctx.tone === "hostile") add("Your hostile tone", -2);
  else if (ctx.tone === "respectful") add("Your courteous tone", 1);
  if (ctx.manipulation) add("Your letter tried to deceive our court", -10);

  const points = Math.round(lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.pts, 0) * 10) / 10;
  let verdict = points >= 0 ? "accept" : "reject";
  let counter = null;
  if (verdict === "reject" && !ctx.noCounter) {
    counter = counterOffer(g, w, E, P, terms, points, gdpE, ctx);
    if (counter) verdict = "counter";
  }
  return { points, lines, verdict, counter };
}

function counterOffer(g, w, E, P, terms, points, gdpE, ctx) {
  if (terms.some(t => t.type === "alliance") && !hasTreaty(g, E, P, "nap")) {
    const alt = terms.filter(t => t.type !== "alliance").concat([{ type: "nap" }]);
    if (!validateDeal(g, w, P, E, alt)) {
      const ev = evaluateDeal(g, w, E, P, alt, { ...ctx, noCounter: true });
      if (ev.points >= 0) return { terms: alt, why: "They would sign a non-aggression pact, but not an alliance." };
    }
  }
  if (terms.some(t => t.type === "trade") && !terms.some(t => t.type !== "trade" && t.type !== "payment")) {
    const h = hypothetical(g, { treaty: { type: "trade", a: E, b: P } });
    if (computeEconomy(w, h, E).gdp - computeEconomy(w, g, E).gdp < 0.05) return null;
  }
  // asked to lift our embargo while theirs on us stands: both, or nothing
  const lift = terms.find(t => t.type === "lift_embargo" && t.by === E);
  if (lift && embargoesBy(g, P, E).length) {
    const alt = terms.map(t => (t === lift ? { type: "lift_embargo", by: "both" } : t));
    if (!validateDeal(g, w, P, E, alt)) {
      const ev = evaluateDeal(g, w, E, P, alt, { ...ctx, noCounter: true });
      if (ev.points >= 0) return { terms: alt, why: "They would lift their embargo if you lift yours." };
    }
  }
  const shortfall = -points + 1;
  if (shortfall > 0 && shortfall <= DIPLO.counterGap) {
    const amount = Math.max(0.5, Math.ceil(((shortfall * gdpE) / 100) * 2) / 2);
    const payer = g.nations[P];
    if (amount <= 0.5 * Math.max(0, payer.treasury)) {
      const existing = terms.find(t => t.type === "payment" && t.from === P);
      const alt = existing ? terms.map(t => (t === existing ? { ...t, amount: t.amount + amount } : t)) : terms.concat([{ type: "payment", from: P, amount }]);
      return { terms: alt, why: `They would agree if you also pay ${fmtMoney(amount)}${existing ? " more" : ""}.` };
    }
  }
  return null;
}

function transferCity(g, city, to) {
  const from = city.owner;
  if (to >= 0 && to !== from) leaderDeed(g, to, "conquered");
  const cells = regionCellsForCity(g, city);
  cells.forEach(i => { g.owner[i] = to; g.occ[i] = -1; });
  city.owner = to;
  cityChangedHands(g, city, from, to);
  groupsCityChanged(g, city, from, to);
  const wasCapital = city.capital;
  city.capital = false;
  if (wasCapital && to >= 0 && to !== from) city.wasCapital = g.turn;
  g.projects = g.projects.filter(p => p.cityId !== city.id || (p.kind === "ships" && p.seller !== undefined));
  if (wasCapital) ensureCapital(g, from);
  g._contact = null;
  sendHome(g);
  bumpWorld(g);
}
function ensureCapital(g, nid) {
  const own = g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === nid);
  if (!own.length || own.some(c => c.capital)) return;
  // the government moves to a province capital it still holds, or else to its most important city
  let best = own[0], bestScore = -Infinity;
  for (const c of own) {
    const pop = regionCellsForCity(g, c).reduce((s, i) => s + g.pop[i], 0);
    const score = (g.occ[c.cell] >= 0 ? -1e6 : 0) + (c.focus === "seat" || provSeat(g, c) ? 1e4 : 0) + (c.imp || 0) * 10 + pop;
    if (score > bestScore) { bestScore = score; best = c; }
  }
  best.capital = true;
  if (typeof cityHist === "function") cityHist(g, best, `Became the capital of the ${nameOf(g, nid)} after the old capital was lost.`, "warn");
}

function applyDeal(g, w, A, B, terms) {
  const done = [];
  let peace = false;
  const paidBy = new Set();   // who paid to have an embargo lifted
  for (const t of terms) {
    if (["trade", "nap", "alliance", "border"].includes(t.type)) { addTreaty(g, t.type, A, B); done.push(TREATY_INFO[t.type].label); }
    if (t.type === "payment") {
      const to = t.from === A ? B : A;
      g.nations[t.from].treasury -= t.amount;
      g.nations[to].treasury += t.amount;
      done.push(`${fmtMoney(t.amount)} paid by the ${nameOf(g, t.from)}`);
    }
    if (t.type === "tribute") {
      const to = t.from === A ? B : A;
      addTreaty(g, "tribute", t.from, to, { amount: t.amount, seasons: t.seasons });
      done.push(`Tribute of ${fmtMoney(t.amount)} a season`);
    }
    if (t.type === "city") {
      const to = t.from === A ? B : A;
      const c = g.cities.find(x => x.id === t.cityId);
      if (c && c.owner === t.from) { transferCity(g, c, to); done.push(`${c.name} passed to the ${nameOf(g, to)}`); }
    }
    if (t.type === "peace") peace = true;
    if (t.type === "lift_embargo") {
      for (const L of t.by === "both" ? [A, B] : [t.by]) {
        const V = L === A ? B : A;
        const paid = terms.some(x => (x.type === "payment" || x.type === "tribute") && x.from === V);
        // a paid lift is a promise not to bring it back for four years (10s)
        for (const e of embargoesBy(g, L, V)) liftWithAnswers(w, g, e, "agreed in a deal", null, null, { paid });
        if (paid) paidBy.add(V);
        done.push(`The ${nameOf(g, L)} lifted its embargo`);
      }
    }
  }
  if (peace) { const war = warBetween(g, A, B); if (war) endWarBetween(g, war, A, B); done.push("Peace"); }
  // paying to have trade restored leaves a bitter taste, not goodwill
  if (paidBy.has(A)) addMod(g, A, B, "paid_to_trade", "Made us pay to trade", -8, 0.5, -16); else addMod(g, A, B, "agreed", "Reached agreements with us", 5, 0.5, 15);
  if (paidBy.has(B)) addMod(g, B, A, "paid_to_trade", "Made us pay to trade", -8, 0.5, -16); else addMod(g, B, A, "agreed", "Reached agreements with us", 5, 0.5, 15);
  rememberBoth(g, A, B, `The ${nameOf(g, A)} and the ${nameOf(g, B)} agreed to ${termsText(g, terms)}.`);
  return done;
}

/* =====================================================================
   10d. War: declarations, fronts, occupation, peace
   ===================================================================== */
const TERRAIN_DEF = { [T.PLAINS]: 1, [T.FOREST]: 1.25, [T.HILLS]: 1.45, [T.MOUNTAIN]: 1.9 };

function warBetween(g, a, b) {
  return g.wars.find(x => (x.sideA.includes(a) && x.sideB.includes(b)) || (x.sideA.includes(b) && x.sideB.includes(a)));
}
function atWar(g, a, b) { return !!warBetween(g, a, b); }
function enemiesOf(g, a) {
  const s = new Set();
  for (const x of g.wars) {
    if (x.sideA.includes(a)) x.sideB.forEach(v => s.add(v));
    if (x.sideB.includes(a)) x.sideA.forEach(v => s.add(v));
  }
  return [...s];
}
function alliesOf(g, a) {
  return g.treaties.filter(t => t.type === "alliance" && (t.a === a || t.b === a)).map(t => (t.a === a ? t.b : t.a)).filter(x => g.nations[x].alive);
}
function sideScore(war, nid) { return war.sideA.includes(nid) ? war.score : -war.score; }
function sameSide(war, a, b) { return (war.sideA.includes(a) && war.sideA.includes(b)) || (war.sideB.includes(a) && war.sideB.includes(b)); }

function occupiedShare(g, nid) {
  let own = 0, occ = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (g.owner[i] === nid) { own++; if (g.occ[i] >= 0) occ++; }
  return own ? occ / own : 0;
}

/* x's reason for a war on y, the first that applies (strength 0: none). `w` lets it see hunger (a food embargo). */
function casusBelli(g, x, y, w) {
  const r = rel(g, x, y);
  if (r.mods.some(m => m.key === "broke_treaty")) return { label: `the ${nameOf(g, y)} broke a treaty with us`, strength: 3 };
  if (r.mods.some(m => m.key === "claim_town")) return { label: `our claim to ${g.opening ? g.opening.town : "a border town"}`, strength: 2 };
  const lostC = g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === y && c.origin === x && (c.loyalty ?? CITY.loyalNative) < CITY.integrate).sort((a, b) => (b.imp || 0) - (a.imp || 0))[0];
  if (lostC) return { label: `to win back ${lostC.name}`, strength: (lostC.loyalty ?? CITY.loyalNative) < 60 ? 2 : 1 };
  const ally = alliesOf(g, x).find(a => atWar(g, a, y));
  if (ally !== undefined) return { label: `defending our ally, the ${nameOf(g, ally)}`, strength: 3 };
  if (r.mods.some(m => m.key === "abandoned")) return { label: `the ${nameOf(g, y)} betrayed us in war`, strength: 2 };
  if (r.mods.some(m => m.key === "settled_near" && m.value <= -8)) return { label: "a border dispute over settled land", strength: 2 };
  // their embargo on us (10t): food cut off while our people go hungry, or trade strangled
  const st = strangledTrade(g, x, y, w);
  if (st && st.food) return { label: `the ${nameOf(g, y)} cut off our food while our people went hungry`, strength: 2 };
  if (st) return { label: `the ${nameOf(g, y)} strangled our trade`, strength: 1 };
  if (g.commitments.some(c => c.by === x && c.against === y && commitKind(c) === "war")) return { label: `the ${nameOf(g, y)} rejected our demands`, strength: 1 };
  if (r.mods.some(m => ["insult", "threatened", "deceived"].includes(m.key))) return { label: "insults to our honor", strength: 1 };
  return { label: "a war of conquest", strength: 0 };
}

function warAssessment(w, g, x, y) {
  if (x === y || !g.nations[y].alive || atWar(g, x, y) || !sharesBorder(g, x, y)) return null;
  if ((g.turn < (y === PLAYER ? OPENING.grace : 8) && !openingWarAllowed(g, x, y)) || g.nations[x].minor) return null;
  const nx = g.nations[x], ny = g.nations[y], per = personality(nx);
  let enemyPower = armyPower(g, y) * defenseMult(ny);
  for (const a of alliesOf(g, y)) if (a !== x && sharesBorder(g, a, x)) enemyPower += armyPower(g, a) * 0.8;
  const busy = enemiesOf(g, x).length;
  const ratio = armyPower(g, x) / Math.max(1, enemyPower) / (1 + busy);
  const winChance = 1 / (1 + Math.exp(-4 * (ratio - 1.25)));
  const econX = computeEconomy(w, g, x);
  const mine = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (controller(g, i) === x) mine.push(i);
  const d = distanceField(w, mine);
  let prize = 0;
  const prizeTowns = [];
  const portless = !g.cities.some(c => c.owner === x && oceanPort(w, c));
  let wantsPort = null, lostTown = null;
  const prizeList = [];
  for (const c of g.cities) {
    if (c.owner !== y || d[c.cell] > 6) continue;
    let v = regionValue(w, g, c).gdp * (0.5 + clamp(c.imp || 50, 0, 110) / 100);
    if (c.origin === x) { v *= 1.3; lostTown = lostTown || c.name; }
    if (portless && oceanPort(w, c)) { v *= 1.4; wantsPort = wantsPort || c.name; }
    prize += v;
    prizeList.push(c);
  }
  prizeList.sort((a, b) => (b.imp || 0) - (a.imp || 0)).forEach(c => prizeTowns.push(c.name));
  const lines = [];
  const prizePts = Math.min(60, (100 * prize * DIPLO.horizonYears * 0.5) / Math.max(1, econX.gdp) * per.landWeight);
  let v = winChance * prizePts * per.aggression;
  lines.push({ label: `Chance of winning about ${pct(winChance)} (our strength ${ratio.toFixed(2)}× theirs)`, pts: 0 });
  lines.push({ label: prizeTowns.length ? `Towns within reach: ${prizeTowns.slice(0, 3).join(", ")}` : "No towns within easy reach", pts: Math.round(v) });
  if (lostTown) lines.push({ label: `${lostTown} was ours, and its people remember`, pts: 0 });
  if (wantsPort) lines.push({ label: `${wantsPort}: a harbor on the open sea, which we lack`, pts: 0 });
  const cost = 14 * per.caution;
  v -= cost; lines.push({ label: "Cost of war: lives, money and unrest", pts: -Math.round(cost) });
  if ((g.treaties || []).some(t => t.type === "tribute" && t.a === y && t.b === x)) { v -= 30; lines.push({ label: "They pay us tribute", pts: -30 }); }
  const cb = casusBelli(g, x, y, w);
  if (hasTreaty(g, x, y, "truce") && cb.strength < 3) return null;
  if (hasTreaty(g, x, y, "nap")) {
    const c = (nx.archetype === "militarist" ? 25 : 45) + (hasTrait(nx, "honorable") ? 30 : 0);
