      money -= u * EQUIP[k].costB; cap -= u * EQUIP[k].pp;
      spend += u * EQUIP[k].costB; ppUsed += u * EQUIP[k].pp;
    }
  }
  const avionics = 0.4 + 0.6 * ((econ.sat && econ.sat.electronics) ?? 1);
  if (avionics < 0.999) { const cut = units.planes - Math.floor(units.planes * avionics); units.planes -= cut; }
  return { budget, pp, spend, ppUsed, units, limit: spend < budget * 0.9 ? "factories" : "money", avionics };
}

function manpowerCap(n, econ) { return econ.pop * 1e6 * ARMY_LAWS[n.laws.army].share; }
function manpowerFree(n, econ) { return Math.max(0, manpowerCap(n, econ) - (n.mil ? n.mil.men : n.soldiers || 0)); }

/* ---------- Setting up each nation's forces at founding ---------- */
function initMilitary(w, g, n) {
  const econ = computeEconomy(w, g, n.id);
  n.stock = { kits: 6, guns: 60, tanks: 0, planes: 0 };
  n.prod = { ...(PROD_DEFAULTS[n.archetype || "player"]) };
  n.divCount = {};
  n.warPlan = { stance: n.archetype && PERSONALITY[n.archetype].aggression >= 1 ? "offensive" : "defensive" };
  const cities = g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === n.id);
  const capital = cities.find(c => c.capital) || cities[0];
  const men = econ.pop * 1e6 * ARMY_LAWS[n.laws.army].share * 0.7;
  const infCount = clamp(Math.round(men / DIV_TYPES.inf.men), 2, 9);
  const place = k => freeCellNear(w, g, n.id, cities[k % cities.length].cell);
  const add = (type, cell, fill = 1) => {
    const t = DIV_TYPES[type];
    g.divisions.push({ id: g.nextId++, owner: n.id, type, name: nextName(n, type), cell, men: Math.round(t.men * fill), kits: t.kits, guns: Math.round(t.guns * fill), tanks: Math.round(t.tanks * fill),
      org: 1, exp: EXPS.start, entrench: 0.1, path: [], training: 0, supplied: true, auto: true });
  };
  for (let k = 0; k < infCount; k++) add("inf", place(k));
  const extra = { militarist: ["arm", "art"], expansionist: ["arm"], agrarian: ["art"], mercantile: [], player: ["art"] }[n.archetype || "player"];
  extra.forEach((type, k) => add(type, place(k + 1), 0.8));
  const planes = { militarist: 120, expansionist: 60, agrarian: 0, mercantile: 120, player: 60 }[n.archetype || "player"];
  if (planes) g.airwings.push({ id: g.nextId++, owner: n.id, base: capital.id, planes, mission: "support", name: nextName(n, "air") });
  refreshMilitary(g, n.id);
}

/* The nearest cell of our own land, starting from a town, that still has room for another division. */
function freeCellNear(w, g, nid, cell) {
  const seen = new Set([cell]);
  const queue = [cell];
  while (queue.length) {
    const c = queue.shift();
    if (g.owner[c] === nid && stackAt(g, c, nid) < MIL.maxStack) return c;
    for (const k of stepNeighbors(g, c)) if (!seen.has(k) && isLand(w, k) && g.owner[k] === nid) { seen.add(k); queue.push(k); }
  }
  return cell;
}

/* ---------- Raising forces ---------- */
function stackAt(g, cell, nid) { return g.divisions.filter(d => d.cell === cell && (nid === undefined || d.owner === nid)).length; }

function raiseQuote(w, g, nid, type, cityId) {
  const n = g.nations[nid];
  const city = g.cities.find(c => c.id === cityId);
  if (!city || city.owner !== nid || g.occ[city.cell] >= 0) return { ok: false, reason: "Choose one of your own towns that is not occupied." };
  if ((city.loyalty ?? CITY.loyalNative) < CITY.loyalRaise && city.origin !== nid) return { ok: false, reason: `The people of ${city.name} would not serve a government they do not yet see as their own (loyalty ${Math.round(city.loyalty)}). Raise divisions in another town.` };
  const econ = computeEconomy(w, g, nid);
  if (type === "air") {
    if (n.stock.planes < 30) return { ok: false, reason: `You need at least 30 aircraft in stock (you have ${fmtCount(n.stock.planes)}). Raise aircraft production.` };
    return { ok: true, type, cityId, cost: AIR.costB, planes: Math.min(AIR.planes, n.stock.planes), label: `New air wing at ${city.name}` };
  }
  const t = DIV_TYPES[type];
  const free = manpowerFree(n, econ);
  const men = Math.min(t.men, Math.floor(free));
  if (men < t.men * 0.5) return { ok: false, reason: `Not enough manpower: ${fmtCount(free)} available, ${fmtCount(t.men * 0.5)} needed at least. Widen conscription or wait for your population to grow.` };
  if (stackAt(g, city.cell, nid) >= MIL.maxStack) return { ok: false, reason: `${city.name} already holds ${MIL.maxStack} divisions. Move one out first.` };
  const take = k => Math.min(t[k], Math.floor(n.stock[k]));
  const q = { ok: true, type, cityId, men, kits: take("kits"), guns: take("guns"), tanks: take("tanks"), cost: (men * MIL.raiseK) / 1e6, label: `New ${t.label.toLowerCase()} division at ${city.name}` };
  q.fill = equipFill({ type, kits: q.kits, guns: q.guns, tanks: q.tanks });
  return q;
}

function raiseForce(g, nid, q) {
  const n = g.nations[nid];
  const city = g.cities.find(c => c.id === q.cityId);
  n.treasury -= q.cost;
  if (q.type === "air") {
    n.stock.planes -= q.planes;
    const wing = { id: g.nextId++, owner: nid, base: q.cityId, planes: q.planes, mission: "support", name: nextName(n, "air") };
    g.airwings.push(wing);
    refreshMilitary(g, nid);
    return wing;
  }
  n.stock.kits -= q.kits; n.stock.guns -= q.guns; n.stock.tanks -= q.tanks;
  const d = { id: g.nextId++, owner: nid, type: q.type, name: nextName(n, q.type), cell: city.cell, men: q.men, kits: q.kits, guns: q.guns, tanks: q.tanks,
    org: 0.3, exp: 0, entrench: 0, path: [], training: MIL.trainSeasons, supplied: true, auto: true };
  g.divisions.push(d);
  refreshMilitary(g, nid);
  return d;
}

function disbandDivision(g, d) {
  const n = g.nations[d.owner];
  n.stock.kits += d.kits; n.stock.guns += d.guns; n.stock.tanks += d.tanks;
  g.divisions = g.divisions.filter(x => x !== d);
  refreshMilitary(g, d.owner);
}

/* ---------- Supply: armies live on what reaches them from towns and roads ---------- */
function friendlyTo(g, nid) { const s = new Set(alliesOf(g, nid)); s.add(nid); return s; }

function supplyMap(w, g, nid, noSea) {
  const rem = new Int8Array(N_CELLS).fill(-1);
  const friends = friendlyTo(g, nid);
  const passable = i => isLand(w, i) && (friends.has(controller(g, i)) || (g.owner[i] === -1 && g.occ[i] < 0));
  const econ = computeEconomy(w, g, nid);
  const buckets = Array.from({ length: MIL.supplyRange + 1 }, () => []);
  const reach = MIL.supplyRange + ((g.nations[nid].logistics ?? 0) >= 0.75 ? 1 : 0);
  if (buckets.length < reach + 1) buckets.push([]);
  const seed = (cell, r) => { r = Math.min(r, reach); if (rem[cell] < r) { rem[cell] = r; buckets[r].push(cell); } };
  const capNet = econ.networks.findIndex(x => x.capital);
  econ.regions.forEach(r => seed(r.city.cell, r.net === capNet ? reach : MIL.isolatedRange));
  for (const c of g.cities) if (g.occ[c.cell] === nid) seed(c.cell, MIL.isolatedRange + 1);   // captured towns become depots
  if (!noSea && g.sea) for (const src of seaSupplySources(w, g, nid, econ)) seed(src.cell, src.range);   // ports and beachheads supplied by sea
  const capital = econ.regions.find(r => r.city.capital);
  if (capital) {
    const adj = new Map();
    for (const k of g.roads) {
      const [a, b] = edgeEnds(k);
      if (controller(g, a) !== nid || controller(g, b) !== nid) continue;
      if (!adj.has(a)) adj.set(a, []); if (!adj.has(b)) adj.set(b, []);
      adj.get(a).push(b); adj.get(b).push(a);
    }
    const seen = new Set([capital.city.cell]);
    const queue = [capital.city.cell];
    while (queue.length) {
      const c = queue.pop();
      seed(c, reach);
      for (const nb of adj.get(c) || []) if (!seen.has(nb)) { seen.add(nb); queue.push(nb); }
    }
  }
  for (let r = reach; r > 0; r--) {
    for (const c of buckets[r]) {
      if (rem[c] !== r) continue;
      for (const [dx, dy] of DIRS4) {
        const x = cellX(c) + dx, y = cellY(c) + dy;
        if (!inBounds(x, y)) continue;
        const k = idx(x, y);
        if (passable(k)) seed(k, r - 1);
      }
    }
  }
  const sup = new Uint8Array(N_CELLS);
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (rem[i] >= 0) sup[i] = 1;
  return sup;
}

/* ---------- Movement ---------- */
function canEnter(w, g, nid, cell) {
  if (!isLand(w, cell)) return false;
  const c = controller(g, cell);
  if (c === -1 || c === nid) return true;
  if (alliesOf(g, nid).includes(c)) return true;
  return atWar(g, nid, c);
}
function roadNeighbors(g, cell) {
  const out = [];
  for (const [dx, dy] of [[1, 1], [1, -1], [-1, 1], [-1, -1]]) {
    const x = cellX(cell) + dx, y = cellY(cell) + dy;
    if (!inBounds(x, y)) continue;
    const k = idx(x, y);
    if (g.roads.has(edgeKey(cell, k))) out.push(k);
  }
  return out;
}
function stepNeighbors(g, cell) {
  const out = [];
  for (const [dx, dy] of DIRS4) {
    const x = cellX(cell) + dx, y = cellY(cell) + dy;
    if (inBounds(x, y)) out.push(idx(x, y));
  }
  return out.concat(roadNeighbors(g, cell));
}
function moveCost(w, g, type, from, to, nid) {
  if (g.roads.has(edgeKey(from, to)) && controller(g, from) === controller(g, to)) return 0.5;
  const sw = seasonWar(g), tt = w.terrain[to];
  let c = MOVE_COST[tt] + ((tt === T.HILLS || tt === T.MOUNTAIN ? sw.rugged : sw.offRoad) || 0);   // mud and snow off the roads
  if (DIV_TYPES[type].armor && tt !== T.PLAINS) c *= 1.5;
  if (DIV_TYPES[type].armor && sw.armorMove) c *= sw.armorMove;
  // rivers without a bridge (a road) take time to cross, unless winter has frozen them over
  const rv = g.roads.has(edgeKey(from, to)) ? null : riverBetween(w, from, to);
  if (rv && !(sw.frozen && rv.cls < 4)) c += rv.cls >= 4 ? 1.5 : 1;
  const ctl = controller(g, to);
  if (ctl >= 0 && ctl !== nid && !alliesOf(g, nid).includes(ctl)) c += 0.5;
  return c;
}
/* A division's movement points this season (the same numbers the season uses), and why it has fewer than its
   kind's full points. Each step on the way costs points (moveCost); a division always makes at least one step a
   season, then stops when the next step costs more than it has left. */
function divMovePoints(g, d) {
  const t = DIV_TYPES[d.type], full = t.mp;
  if (d.training) return { mp: 0, full, why: [`still training (ready in ${d.training} season${d.training > 1 ? "s" : ""})`] };
  if (d.sailed === g.turn) return { mp: 0, full, why: ["came ashore from the ships this season"] };
  if (d.voyage && d.voyage.loading) return { mp: 0, full, why: ["boarding the ships"] };
  if (t.armor && !d.supplied) return { mp: 1, full, why: ["out of supply: tanks without fuel and spare parts crawl"] };
  let mp = full;
  const why = [];
  if (d.org < 0.2) { mp *= 0.5; why.push("exhausted (organization under 20%): half speed"); }
  if (t.armor) {
    const fuel = g.nations[d.owner] ? g.nations[d.owner].fuelSat ?? 1 : 1, f = 0.5 + 0.5 * fuel;
    if (f < 0.995) { mp *= f; why.push(`short of fuel (${pct(fuel)} of the oil the army needs)`); }
  }
  return { mp, full, why };
}
/* How a march goes season by season, by the same rule as the season itself (enemies met on the way aside):
   each step's cost, whether it is on a road, and in which season it is made. */
function pathSchedule(w, g, d, path) {
  const P = divMovePoints(g, d);
  const mp = P.mp > 0 ? P.mp : P.full;
  let left = mp, season = 1 + (d.training || 0), from = d.cell, total = 0;
  const steps = [];
  for (const c of path || []) {
    const cost = moveCost(w, g, d.type, from, c, d.owner);
    if (cost > left + 1e-6 && left < mp - 1e-6) { season++; left = mp; }
    left -= cost; total += cost;
    steps.push({ cell: c, cost, road: g.roads.has(edgeKey(from, c)) && controller(g, from) === controller(g, c), season });
    from = c;
  }
  return { steps, total, mp, full: P.full, why: P.why, seasons: steps.length ? steps[steps.length - 1].season : 0 };
}
/* A small binary heap keyed by cost, for path searches. */
function heapPush(h, cell, pri) {
  h.push([pri, cell]);
  let i = h.length - 1;
  while (i > 0) { const p = (i - 1) >> 1; if (h[p][0] <= h[i][0]) break; [h[p], h[i]] = [h[i], h[p]]; i = p; }
}
function heapPop(h) {
  const top = h[0], last = h.pop();
  if (h.length) {
    h[0] = last;
    let i = 0;
    for (;;) {
      const l = 2 * i + 1, r = l + 1;
      let m = i;
      if (l < h.length && h[l][0] < h[m][0]) m = l;
      if (r < h.length && h[r][0] < h[m][0]) m = r;
      if (m === i) break;
      [h[m], h[i]] = [h[i], h[m]]; i = m;
    }
  }
  return top[1];
}
function findDivPath(w, g, d, target) {
  if (d.cell === target || !canEnter(w, g, d.owner, target)) return null;
  const cost = new Float32Array(N_CELLS).fill(Infinity);
  const prev = new Int32Array(N_CELLS).fill(-1);
  const done = new Uint8Array(N_CELLS);
  const enterable = new Map();
  const ok = k => { if (!enterable.has(k)) enterable.set(k, canEnter(w, g, d.owner, k)); return enterable.get(k); };
  cost[d.cell] = 0;
  const open = [];
  heapPush(open, d.cell, 0);
  while (open.length) {
    const c = heapPop(open);
    if (done[c]) continue;
    done[c] = 1;
    if (c === target) break;
    for (const k of stepNeighbors(g, c)) {
      if (done[k] || !ok(k)) continue;
      const nc = cost[c] + moveCost(w, g, d.type, c, k, d.owner);
      if (nc < cost[k]) { cost[k] = nc; prev[k] = c; heapPush(open, k, nc); }
    }
  }
  if (cost[target] === Infinity) return null;
  const path = [];
  for (let c = target; c !== d.cell; c = prev[c]) path.push(c);
  path.reverse();
  return { path, cost: cost[target], seasons: Math.max(1, Math.ceil(cost[target] / DIV_TYPES[d.type].mp)) };
}

function divIndex(g) {
  const m = new Map();
  for (const d of g.divisions) { if (!m.has(d.cell)) m.set(d.cell, []); m.get(d.cell).push(d); }
  return m;
}
function enemyDivAdjacent(g, index, cell, nid) {
  for (const k of stepNeighbors(g, cell)) for (const e of index.get(k) || []) if (atWar(g, e.owner, nid)) return true;
  return false;
}

function occupyCell(g, cell, nid, news) {
  const owner = g.owner[cell];
  const before = controller(g, cell);
  if (owner === nid || (owner >= 0 && alliesOf(g, nid).includes(owner))) g.occ[cell] = -1;
  else g.occ[cell] = nid;
  g._contact = null;
  bumpWorld(g);
  recOcc(g, cell);
  const city = g.cities.find(c => c.cell === cell);
  if (city && before !== controller(g, cell) && news) {
    news.push(owner === nid ? `The ${nameOf(g, nid)} retook ${city.name}.` : `The ${nameOf(g, nid)} captured ${city.name} from the ${nameOf(g, owner)}.`);
    const wing = g.airwings.filter(a => a.base === city.id && a.owner === owner);
    wing.forEach(a => rebaseWing(g, a));
  }
}
function rebaseWing(g, a) {
  const home = g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === a.owner && g.occ[c.cell] < 0).sort((x, y) => (y.capital ? 1 : 0) - (x.capital ? 1 : 0))[0];
  if (home) a.base = home.id; else g.airwings = g.airwings.filter(x => x !== a);
}

/* ---------- Air power ---------- */
function theaterPlanes(g, nid) {
  const n = g.nations[nid];
  return g.airwings.filter(a => a.owner === nid && a.mission === "support").reduce((s, a) => s + a.planes, 0) * (hasTech(n, "jets") ? 1.4 : 1) * (0.5 + 0.5 * ((n && n.fuelSat) ?? 1));
}
function airBalance(g, a, b) {
  const pa = theaterPlanes(g, a), pb = theaterPlanes(g, b);
  if (pa + pb < 1) return 0;
  return (pa - pb) / (pa + pb);
}

/* ---------- Battle ---------- */
function battlePower(w, g, d, role, cell, sideSupplied) {
  const t = DIV_TYPES[d.type];
  const terrain = w.terrain[cell];
  const owner = g.nations[d.owner];
  let v = (role === "att" ? t.attack : t.defense) * Math.pow(menFill(d), 0.8) * equipFill(d) * (0.25 + 0.75 * d.org) * expFactor(d);
  if (hasTech(owner, "combined")) v *= 1.1;
  if (t.armor) v *= 0.5 + 0.5 * (owner.fuelSat ?? 1);
  if (!sideSupplied) v *= 0.6;
  if (d.training) v *= 0.5;
  if (role === "att") {
    if (t.armor) v *= ARMOR_TERRAIN[terrain];
    if (terrain === T.PLAINS) v += t.breakthrough * 0.5 * menFill(d) * equipFill(d);
  } else {
    v *= 1 + d.entrench;
  }
  return v * 1000;
}

function resolveBattle(w, g, cell, attackers, defenders, rng, sup, opts) {
  const A = attackers[0].owner, D = defenders[0].owner;
  const lines = [];
  const terrain = w.terrain[cell];
  const city = g.cities.find(c => c.cell === cell);
  let pa = 0, pd = 0;
  let paDry = 0, crossing = null;
  attackers.forEach(d => {
    const v = battlePower(w, g, d, "att", cell, sup[d.owner][d.cell]);
    paDry += v;
    const rv = opts && opts.landing ? null : riverBetween(w, d.cell, cell);
    if (!rv) { pa += v; return; }
    const road = g.roads.has(edgeKey(d.cell, cell));
    const ice = !road && seasonWar(g).frozen && rv.cls < 4;
    const m = road ? 0.9 : ice ? 0.95 : rv.cls >= 4 ? 0.65 : 0.75;
    if (!crossing || m < crossing.m) crossing = { rv, m, road, ice };
    pa += v * m;
  });
  defenders.forEach(d => { pd += battlePower(w, g, d, "def", cell, sup[d.owner][cell]); });
  const cdm = city ? cityDefMult(city) : 1;
  const terr = TERRAIN_DEF[terrain] * cdm;
  if (terr > 1.01) lines.push({ label: city ? `${TERRAIN[terrain].name} and the streets of ${city.name}${city.pop >= 1 ? ` (${fmtPeople(city.pop)} people)` : ""} favor the defender` : `${TERRAIN[terrain].name} favor the defender`, mult: Math.round(terr * 100) / 100, side: "def" });
  pd *= terr;
  if (g.owner[cell] === D && g.occ[cell] < 0) {
    const home = 0.85 + g.nations[D].defense / 200;
    if (Math.abs(home - 1) > 0.02) lines.push({ label: home > 1 ? "Defenders know this ground (good defensive borders)" : "Exposed borders weaken the defense", mult: home, side: "def" });
    pd *= home;
  }
  if (fortHere(g, cell, D)) { lines.push({ label: "The Line of Fortresses", mult: 1.3, side: "def" }); pd *= 1.3; }
  for (const L of cityBattleLines(g, city, A, D)) { lines.push(L); pd *= L.mult; }
  if (crossing && paDry > 0) lines.push({ label: crossing.road ? `Fighting over the bridges on ${riverLabel(crossing.rv)}` : crossing.ice ? `Crossing ${riverLabel(crossing.rv)} on the ice` : `Attacking across ${riverLabel(crossing.rv)}`, mult: Math.round((pa / paDry) * 100) / 100, already: true, side: "att" });
  if (opts && opts.landing) {
    pa *= 0.5; lines.push({ label: "Landing from the sea: troops wade ashore under fire", mult: 0.5, side: "att" });
    const k = opts.landing.cruisers || 0;
    if (k > 0) { const m = Math.min(1.3, 1 + 0.08 * k); pa *= m; lines.push({ label: `Naval gunfire from ${k} cruiser${k > 1 ? "s" : ""}`, mult: m, side: "att" }); }
    if (city && portLevel(city) >= 3 && controller(g, city.cell) === D) { pd *= 1.3; lines.push({ label: `Shore batteries of the naval base at ${city.name}`, mult: 1.3, side: "def" }); }
  }
  if (hasTrait(g.nations[D], "cautious")) { lines.push({ label: `${leaderName(g.nations[D])} is a careful commander`, mult: 1.1, side: "def" }); pd *= 1.1; }
  if (hasTrait(g.nations[A], "aggressive")) { lines.push({ label: `${leaderName(g.nations[A])} demands the attack`, mult: 1.1, side: "att" }); pa *= 1.1; }
  const dug = defenders.reduce((s, d) => s + d.entrench, 0) / defenders.length;
  if (dug > 0.05) lines.push({ label: `Defenders were dug in`, mult: 1 + dug, already: true, side: "def" });
  if (attackers.some(d => DIV_TYPES[d.type].armor) && terrain !== T.PLAINS) lines.push({ label: `Tanks slowed by ${TERRAIN[terrain].name.toLowerCase()}`, mult: ARMOR_TERRAIN[terrain], already: true, side: "att" });
  if (attackers.some(d => DIV_TYPES[d.type].armor) && terrain === T.PLAINS) lines.push({ label: "Open plains let the tanks break through", mult: 1.15, already: true, side: "att" });
  const attOut = attackers.filter(d => !sup[d.owner][d.cell]).length, defOut = defenders.filter(d => !sup[d.owner][cell]).length;
  if (attOut) lines.push({ label: `${attOut === attackers.length ? "Attackers" : "Some attackers"} out of supply`, mult: 0.6, already: true, side: "att" });
  if (defOut) lines.push({ label: `${defOut === defenders.length ? "Defenders" : "Some defenders"} out of supply`, mult: 0.6, already: true, side: "def" });
  const sides = new Set(attackers.map(d => d.cell)).size;
  if (sides >= 2) { const m = sides >= 3 ? 1.2 : 1.1; pa *= m; lines.push({ label: `Attacked from ${sides} sides`, mult: m, side: "att" }); }
  const hasArmor = attackers.some(d => DIV_TYPES[d.type].armor);
  const atGuns = defenders.reduce((s, d) => s + d.guns, 0) / Math.max(1, defenders.reduce((s, d) => s + d.men, 0) / 1000);
  if (hasArmor && atGuns < 3) { pa *= 1.2; lines.push({ label: "Defenders lack anti-tank guns", mult: 1.2, side: "att" }); }
  const air = airBalance(g, A, D);
  if (Math.abs(air) > 0.1) {
    const m = 1 + 0.25 * Math.abs(air);
    if (air > 0) pa *= m; else pd *= m;
    lines.push({ label: `Air superiority: ${air > 0 ? `the ${nameOf(g, A)}` : `the ${nameOf(g, D)}`}`, mult: m, side: air > 0 ? "att" : "def" });
  }
  // the season: snow and frost, mud for the tanks, winter seas for a landing
  const sw = seasonWar(g);
  if (sw.attack && !(opts && opts.landing)) {
    const rugged = terrain === T.HILLS || terrain === T.MOUNTAIN;
    const m = rugged ? sw.ruggedAttack : sw.attack;
    pa *= m;
    lines.push({ label: rugged ? `Winter in the ${terrain === T.MOUNTAIN ? "mountains" : "hills"}: attacking through deep snow` : "Winter: attacking through snow and frost", mult: m, side: "att" });
  }
  if (sw.armorAttack && attackers.some(d => DIV_TYPES[d.type].armor)) {
    const armorPow = attackers.filter(d => DIV_TYPES[d.type].armor).reduce((s2, d) => s2 + battlePower(w, g, d, "att", cell, sup[d.owner][d.cell]), 0);
    const m = 1 - (armorPow / Math.max(1, paDry)) * (1 - sw.armorAttack);
    if (m < 0.995) { pa *= m; lines.push({ label: `${sw.name}: the tanks bog down in the mud`, mult: Math.round(m * 100) / 100, side: "att" }); }
  }
  if (opts && opts.landing && sw.landing) { pa *= sw.landing; lines.push({ label: "Winter seas: waves swamp the landing craft", mult: sw.landing, side: "att" }); }
  // veterans and green troops
  for (const L of [sideExpLine(attackers, "att"), sideExpLine(defenders, "def")]) if (L) lines.push(L);
  const luck = 0.85 + 0.3 * rng();
  const R = (pa * luck) / Math.max(1, pd);
  const won = R >= MIL.winRatio;
  const lossA = clamp(0.05 / Math.sqrt(R), 0.012, 0.22), lossD = clamp(0.045 * Math.sqrt(R) * (won ? 1.3 : 1), 0.01, 0.3);
  const report = {
    cell, turn: g.turn, town: city ? city.name : null, terrain: TERRAIN[terrain].name, attacker: A, defender: D,
    attDivs: attackers.map(d => d.name), defDivs: defenders.map(d => d.name), ratio: Math.round(R * 100) / 100, won, lines,
    attPower: Math.round(pa), defPower: Math.round(pd), losses: {}, destroyed: [], retreated: [],
  };
  const apply = (list, frac, side) => {
    let men = 0, tanks = 0;
    for (const d of list) {
      const armorShield = DIV_TYPES[d.type].armor && side === "att" ? 0.7 : 1;
      const m = Math.round(d.men * frac);
      const tk = Math.round(d.tanks * frac * (side === "att" && atGuns > 6 ? 1.4 : armorShield));
      d.men -= m; d.tanks -= tk;
      d.kits = Math.max(0, d.kits - (m / 1000) * 0.9);
      d.guns = Math.max(0, Math.round(d.guns - d.guns * frac * 0.7));
      d.org = clamp(d.org - (side === "att" ? (won ? 0.2 : 0.45) / Math.sqrt(R) : 0.3 * Math.sqrt(R)), 0, 1);
      const wonIt = (side === "att") === won;
      d.fought = g.turn;
      d.exp = Math.min(1, (d.exp || 0) + (wonIt ? EXPS.win : EXPS.loss));
      d.battles = (d.battles || 0) + 1;
      if (wonIt) d.wins = (d.wins || 0) + 1;
      men += m; tanks += tk;
    }
    return { men, tanks };
  };
  report.losses[A] = apply(attackers, lossA, "att");
  report.losses[D] = apply(defenders, lossD, "def");
  return report;
}

function retreatCell(w, g, index, d, from, enemyNid) {
  const friends = friendlyTo(g, d.owner);
  let best = -1, bestScore = -Infinity;
  for (const k of stepNeighbors(g, from)) {
    if (!isLand(w, k) || !friends.has(controller(g, k))) continue;
    const here = index.get(k) || [];
    if (here.some(e => e.owner !== d.owner && atWar(g, e.owner, d.owner))) continue;
    if (here.filter(e => e.owner === d.owner).length >= MIL.maxStack) continue;
    const enemyNear = stepNeighbors(g, k).some(j => (index.get(j) || []).some(e => e.owner === enemyNid));
    const s = (g.cities.some(c => c.cell === k) ? 2 : 0) - (enemyNear ? 3 : 0) + rngless(k);
    if (s > bestScore) { bestScore = s; best = k; }
  }
  return best;
}
function rngless(k) { return hash2(k, 7, 3) * 0.5; }

/* While a season is simulated for playback, movements and captures are recorded here (see section 17b). */
let REC = null;
function recMove(d, from, to) { if (REC) REC.events.push({ t: "move", id: d.id, from, to, phase: REC.phase, step: REC.step }); }
function recOcc(g, cell) { if (REC) REC.events.push({ t: "occ", cell, occ: g.occ[cell], phase: REC.phase, step: REC.phase === "sweep" ? REC.sweep++ : REC.step }); }

function moveDivTo(index, d, cell) {
  recMove(d, d.cell, cell);
  const arr = index.get(d.cell);
  if (arr) index.set(d.cell, arr.filter(x => x !== d));
  d.cell = cell;
  if (!index.has(cell)) index.set(cell, []);
  index.get(cell).push(d);
}

function removePopulationLoss(g, nid, deaths) {
  if (deaths <= 0) return;
  const pop = nationPop(g, nid) * 1e6;
  if (pop <= 0) return;
  if (g.nations[nid] && g.nations[nid].popFlow) g.nations[nid].popFlow.war -= Math.min(deaths, pop) / 1e6;
  const f = Math.max(0, 1 - deaths / pop);
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (g.owner[i] === nid && g.occ[i] < 0) g.pop[i] *= f;
}

/* One season of military operations for the whole world. */
function resolveMilitary(g, w, rng) {
  const news = [], reports = [];
  for (const n of g.nations) n.lastLosses = 0;
  const live = liveNations(g);
  const sup = {};
  for (const n of live) sup[n.id] = supplyMap(w, g, n.id);
  const index = divIndex(g);
  for (const d of g.divisions) {
    d.supplied = !!(sup[d.owner] && sup[d.owner][d.cell]);
    d.mpLeft = divMovePoints(g, d).mp;
    d.fullMp = d.mpLeft;
    d.engaged = false; d.moved = d.sailed === g.turn;
    d.halt = null; d.hadPath = !!(d.path && d.path.length); d.fought = false;
  }

  // Movement in small steps so armies on both sides move at the same time.
  const attacks = new Map();
  const movers = g.divisions.filter(d => d.path && d.path.length && d.mpLeft > 0);
  if (REC) REC.phase = "move";
  for (let step = 0; step < 14; step++) {
    if (REC) REC.step = step;
    let any = false;
    const order = movers.slice().sort(() => rng() - 0.5);
    for (const d of order) {
      if (!d.path.length || d.mpLeft <= 0 || d.engaged) continue;
      const next = d.path[0];
      if (!canEnter(w, g, d.owner, next)) { d.path = []; d.halt = { why: "closed", to: next }; continue; }
      const cost = moveCost(w, g, d.type, d.cell, next, d.owner);
      if (cost > d.mpLeft + 1e-6 && d.mpLeft < d.fullMp) { d.mpLeft = 0; d.halt = { why: "mp" }; continue; }
      const here = index.get(next) || [];
      const foes = here.filter(e => e.owner !== d.owner && atWar(g, e.owner, d.owner));
      if (foes.length) {
        if (!attacks.has(next)) attacks.set(next, []);
        attacks.get(next).push(d);
        d.engaged = true; d.mpLeft = 0; any = true; d.halt = { why: "attack", to: next };
        continue;
      }
      if (here.filter(e => e.owner === d.owner).length >= MIL.maxStack) { d.mpLeft = 0; d.halt = { why: "stack", to: next }; continue; }
      moveDivTo(index, d, next);
      d.path.shift();
      d.mpLeft -= cost; d.moved = true; d.entrench = 0; any = true;
      const ctl = controller(g, next);
      if (ctl !== d.owner && (ctl === -1 ? false : atWar(g, ctl, d.owner) || g.owner[next] === d.owner)) occupyCell(g, next, d.owner, news);
      if (enemyDivAdjacent(g, index, next, d.owner)) { d.mpLeft = 0; if (d.path.length) d.halt = { why: "enemy" }; }
    }
    if (!any) break;
  }
  for (const d of g.divisions) if (d.hadPath && !d.halt && d.path && d.path.length) d.halt = { why: d.mpLeft <= 0 && d.fullMp <= 0 ? "still" : "mp" };

  // Battles
  const cells = [...attacks.keys()].sort(() => rng() - 0.5);
  if (REC) { REC.phase = "battle"; REC.step = -1; }
  for (const cell of cells) {
    const byOwner = new Map();
    for (const d of attacks.get(cell)) { if (!byOwner.has(d.owner)) byOwner.set(d.owner, []); byOwner.get(d.owner).push(d); }
    for (const [owner, list] of byOwner) {
      const att = list.filter(d => d.men > 0).sort((a, b) => divCombatValue(b) - divCombatValue(a)).slice(0, MIL.maxAttackers);
      for (const d of list) if (!att.includes(d)) d.halt = { why: "crowded", to: cell };
      const def = (index.get(cell) || []).filter(e => e.owner !== owner && atWar(g, e.owner, owner));
      if (!att.length) continue;
      if (REC) REC.step++;
      if (!def.length) {
        att.forEach(d => { d.halt = { why: "mp" }; });   // the enemy left before the battle: they march on
        if ((index.get(cell) || []).filter(e => e.owner === owner).length < MIL.maxStack && canEnter(w, g, owner, cell)) {
          const lead = att[0];
          moveDivTo(index, lead, cell); lead.path.shift(); lead.moved = true; lead.entrench = 0;
          occupyCell(g, cell, owner, news);
        }
        continue;
      }
      const r = resolveBattle(w, g, cell, att, def, rng, sup);
      if (REC) {
        REC.events.push({ t: "battle", cell, attacker: r.attacker, defender: r.defender, won: r.won, phase: "battle", step: REC.step });
        for (const d of att) REC.events.push({ t: "engage", id: d.id, from: d.cell, to: cell, phase: "battle", step: REC.step });
      }
      if (r.won) {
        for (const d of def) {
          const to = retreatCell(w, g, index, d, cell, owner);
          if (to < 0) { r.destroyed.push(d.name); d.men = 0; if (REC) REC.events.push({ t: "destroy", id: d.id, phase: "battle", step: REC.step }); }
          else { moveDivTo(index, d, to); d.path = []; d.voyage = null; d.entrench = 0; r.retreated.push(d.name); }
        }
        const lead = att[0];
        if (canEnter(w, g, owner, cell)) {
          moveDivTo(index, lead, cell); lead.path.shift(); lead.moved = true; lead.entrench = 0;
          occupyCell(g, cell, owner, news);
        }
        att.forEach(d => { d.halt = { why: "won", to: cell }; d.fought = true; });
      } else att.forEach(d => { d.path = []; d.halt = { why: "lost", to: cell }; d.fought = true; });
      for (const nid of [r.attacker, r.defender]) {
        const l = r.losses[nid];
        g.nations[nid].lastLosses += l.men;
        const nn = g.nations[nid];
        removePopulationLoss(g, nid, l.men * MIL.deathShare * (hasTech(nn, "medicine") ? 0.75 : 1) * (1 - 0.05 * SERVICE_ORDER.indexOf(nn.laws.services)));
      }
      reports.push(r);
    }
  }
  for (const d of g.divisions) if (d.men <= 0) {
    const r = reports.find(x => x.destroyed.includes(d.name) && (x.defender === d.owner));
    if (!r) news.push(`The ${nameOf(g, d.owner)}'s ${d.name} was destroyed.`);
  }
  g.divisions = g.divisions.filter(d => d.men > 300);
  noteMarches(w, g);
  const fresh = divIndex(g);
  if (REC) { REC.phase = "sweep"; REC.sweep = 0; }

  // Armies take control of undefended ground next to them.
  for (const d of g.divisions) {
    if (d.training || !d.supplied) continue;
    let swept = 0;
    for (const k of stepNeighbors(g, d.cell)) {
      if (swept >= 3) break;
      const ctl = controller(g, k);
      if (ctl < 0 || ctl === d.owner || !atWar(g, ctl, d.owner) && g.owner[k] !== d.owner) continue;
      if (g.owner[k] === d.owner && g.occ[k] < 0) continue;
      if (g.cities.some(c => c.cell === k)) continue;
      if ((fresh.get(k) || []).length || enemyDivAdjacent(g, fresh, k, d.owner)) continue;
      occupyCell(g, k, d.owner, null);
      swept++;
    }
  }

  if (REC) REC.phase = "after";
  // Supply, attrition, recovery
  for (const n of liveNations(g)) sup[n.id] = supplyMap(w, g, n.id);
  const sw = seasonWar(g);
  for (const d of g.divisions) {
    d.supplied = !!(sup[d.owner] && sup[d.owner][d.cell]);
    if (d.training) { d.training--; d.org = Math.min(1, d.org + 0.3); d.exp = Math.min(EXPS.trainCap, (d.exp || 0) + EXPS.train); continue; }
    if (!d.supplied) {
      const loss = Math.round(d.men * 0.04 * (sw.frost || 1));
      d.men -= loss; d.org = Math.max(0, d.org - 0.25);
      g.nations[d.owner].lastLosses += loss;
    } else {
      if (!d.engaged) d.org = Math.min(1, d.org + 0.3);
      if (sw.mountainFrost && w.terrain[d.cell] === T.MOUNTAIN) { const loss = Math.round(d.men * sw.mountainFrost); d.men -= loss; g.nations[d.owner].lastLosses += loss; }
      if (!d.engaged && d.fought !== g.turn && (d.exp || 0) < drillCapFor(g.nations[d.owner])) d.exp = Math.min(drillCapFor(g.nations[d.owner]), (d.exp || 0) + EXPS.drill);   // drill between battles
    }
    if (!d.moved && !d.engaged) d.entrench = Math.min(0.3, d.entrench + 0.1);
  }

  // Air war: fighters duel wherever both sides fly; dominance wears down enemy divisions.
  for (const war of g.wars) for (const a of war.sideA) for (const b of war.sideB) {
    const pa = theaterPlanes(g, a), pb = theaterPlanes(g, b);
    if (pa > 0 && pb > 0) {
      const la = 0.06 * (pb / (pa + pb)), lb = 0.06 * (pa / (pa + pb));
      g.airwings.forEach(x => { if (x.owner === a && x.mission === "support") x.planes = Math.round(x.planes * (1 - la)); if (x.owner === b && x.mission === "support") x.planes = Math.round(x.planes * (1 - lb)); });
    }
    const bal = airBalance(g, a, b);
    if (Math.abs(bal) > 0.3) {
      const victim = bal > 0 ? b : a;
      g.divisions.forEach(d => { if (d.owner === victim && enemyDivAdjacent(g, fresh, d.cell, victim)) d.org = Math.max(0, d.org - 0.08 * Math.abs(bal)); });
    }
  }
  g.airwings = g.airwings.filter(x => x.planes >= 5);

  for (const n of liveNations(g)) {
    refreshMilitary(g, n.id);
    n.recentLosses = Math.round((n.recentLosses || 0) * 0.6 + n.lastLosses);
  }
  for (const war of g.wars) war.score = warScore(g, war);
  g.battles = reports.slice(-40);
  return { news, reports };
}

/* ---------- Reinforcement and production each season ---------- */
function reinforce(g, w, n, econ) {
  const sup = supplyMap(w, g, n.id);
  let pool = manpowerFree(n, econ);
  const index = divIndex(g);
  const mine = g.divisions.filter(d => d.owner === n.id).sort((a, b) => (enemyDivAdjacent(g, index, b.cell, n.id) ? 1 : 0) - (enemyDivAdjacent(g, index, a.cell, n.id) ? 1 : 0));
  for (const d of mine) {
    if (!sup[d.cell]) continue;
    const t = DIV_TYPES[d.type];
    const add = Math.floor(Math.max(0, Math.min(t.men - d.men, pool, t.men * MIL.menRefill)));
    if (add > 0) d.exp = ((d.exp || 0) * d.men + EXPS.recruit * add) / (d.men + add);   // replacements arrive green
    d.men += add; pool -= add;
    for (const k of ["kits", "guns", "tanks"]) {
      const give = Math.max(0, Math.min(t[k] - d[k], n.stock[k]));
      d[k] += give; n.stock[k] -= give;
    }
  }
  for (const a of g.airwings) if (a.owner === n.id) {
    const give = Math.max(0, Math.min(AIR.planes - a.planes, n.stock.planes));
    a.planes += give; n.stock.planes -= give;
  }
  refreshMilitary(g, n.id);
}

/* Divisions left on foreign soil after a peace go home. */
function mayStand(g, nid, cell) {
  const c = controller(g, cell);
  return c === -1 || c === nid || alliesOf(g, nid).includes(c) || atWar(g, nid, c);
}
function sendHome(g) {
  for (const d of g.divisions) {
    if (mayStand(g, d.owner, d.cell)) continue;
    const home = g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === d.owner && g.occ[c.cell] < 0).sort((a, b) => dist(a.cell, d.cell) - dist(b.cell, d.cell))[0];
    if (home) { d.cell = home.cell; d.path = []; d.voyage = null; } else d.men = 0;
  }
  g.divisions = g.divisions.filter(d => d.men > 0);
  for (const a of g.airwings) { const base = g.cities.find(c => c.id === a.base); if (!base || base.owner !== a.owner) rebaseWing(g, a); }
}


/* ---------- What happened to each march this season, in words (for the season report and the division card) ---------- */
/* Every division that had a route records how the season went: d.lastMove = { turn, why, at, to }. A player's
   order (d.order: where to, and whether to attack) is forgotten once it is done or can no longer be carried out. */
function noteMarches(w, g) {
  for (const d of g.divisions) {
    if (!d.hadPath) { d.hadPath = false; continue; }
    let why = d.halt ? d.halt.why : "arrived";
    const to = d.order ? d.order.cell : d.halt && d.halt.to !== undefined ? d.halt.to : d.cell;
    if (!d.path || !d.path.length) {
      if (why === "mp" || why === "enemy" || why === "won" || why === "arrived" || why === "attack") why = d.order && d.order.attack && !d.fought && d.cell === d.order.cell ? "gone" : why === "won" ? "won" : "arrived";
    }
    d.lastMove = { turn: g.turn, why, at: d.cell, to, attack: !!(d.order && d.order.attack), why2: divMovePoints(g, d).why.slice(0, 1) };
    if (!d.path || !d.path.length) d.order = null;
    d.hadPath = false;
  }
}
function marchText(w, g, d) {
  const m = d.lastMove;
  if (!m) return null;
  const at = placeNameW(w, g, m.at);
  const left = d.path && d.path.length ? pathSchedule(w, g, d, d.path).seasons : 0;
  // two nearby places can share a name: then say how far it still is
  const to = m.to >= 0 && placeNameW(w, g, m.to) !== at ? placeNameW(w, g, m.to) : `its goal, ${d.path && d.path.length ? d.path.length : 0} step${d.path && d.path.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} away`;
  const slow = m.why2 && m.why2.length ? ` (${m.why2[0]})` : "";
  switch (m.why) {
    case "arrived": return `reached ${at}.`;
    case "gone": return `reached ${at}, but the enemy division had already left.`;
    case "won": return `won the battle at ${placeNameW(w, g, m.to)}${left ? `, and marches on: about ${left} more season${left > 1 ? "s" : ""} to ${to}` : ""}.`;
    case "lost": return `attacked ${placeNameW(w, g, m.to)} and was thrown back. Its order is cancelled: give it a new one.`;
    case "closed": return `stopped at ${at}: the way is closed (land of a nation you are not at war with). Its order is cancelled.`;
    case "stack": return `waits at ${at}: ${placeNameW(w, g, m.to)} already holds ${MIL.maxStack} of your divisions, the most one place can hold.`;
    case "crowded": return `waited at ${at}: at most ${MIL.maxAttackers} divisions can attack one place at once, and stronger ones went first.`;
    case "enemy": return `stopped at ${at}, next to an enemy army: a march halts when it meets the enemy. It goes on next season${left ? ` (about ${left} more to ${to})` : ""}.`;
    case "attack": return `is fighting at ${placeNameW(w, g, m.to)}.`;
    case "still": return `could not move this season${slow}.`;
    default: return `is on the way: at ${at}, about ${left} more season${left > 1 ? "s" : ""} to ${to}${slow}.`;
  }
}
/* The season report's lines about your own orders (generals' divisions are left out). Same news for several
   divisions is told once. */
function marchNews(w, g, nid) {
  const by = new Map();
  for (const d of g.divisions) {
    if (d.owner !== nid || d.auto || !d.lastMove || d.lastMove.turn !== g.turn) continue;
    const t = marchText(w, g, d);
    if (!t) continue;
    if (!by.has(t)) by.set(t, { names: [], why: d.lastMove.why });
    by.get(t).names.push(d.name);
  }
  const rank = { lost: 0, closed: 1, gone: 2, stack: 3, crowded: 4, enemy: 5, still: 6, won: 7, arrived: 8, attack: 9, mp: 10 };
  return [...by.entries()].sort((a, b) => (rank[a[1].why] ?? 9) - (rank[b[1].why] ?? 9))
    .map(([t, x]) => {
      const many = x.names.length > 1;
      const said = many ? t.replace(/^is /, "are ").replace(/^was /, "were ").replace(/^waits /, "wait ").replace(/^stopped at ([^:]+): the way is closed/, "stopped at $1: the way is closed").replace(" It goes on", " They go on").replace("Its order is cancelled: give it a new one", "Their orders are cancelled: give them new ones").replace("Its order is cancelled", "Their orders are cancelled") : t;
      return { tone: ["lost", "closed", "gone", "stack", "crowded", "still"].includes(x.why) ? "warn" : "neutral", text: `${bJoin(x.names.map((n, k) => `${k ? "the" : "The"} ${n}`))} ${said}` };
    });
}
/* =====================================================================
   10i. Generals: how rival commanders (and yours, if you delegate) use their forces
   ===================================================================== */
function estPower(w, g, d, role, cell) {
  return battlePower(w, g, d, role, cell, d.supplied !== false) * (role === "def" ? TERRAIN_DEF[w.terrain[cell]] * cityAtCellDef(g, cell) : seasonAttackMult(w, g, d, cell));
}

function planOperations(w, g, n) {
  const mine = g.divisions.filter(d => d.owner === n.id && !d.training && !d.voyage && (!n.isPlayer || d.auto));
  if (!mine.length) return;
  const enemies = enemiesOf(g, n.id);
  if (!enemies.length) { planGarrisons(w, g, n, mine); return; }
  const stance = (n.warPlan && n.warPlan.stance) || "defensive";
  const index = divIndex(g);
  const sup = supplyMap(w, g, n.id);
  const isEnemy = id => id >= 0 && enemies.includes(id);
  const busy = new Set();

  // Units cut off from supply fall back toward friendly supply; worn-out units rest.
  for (const d of mine) {
    if (sup[d.cell]) { if (d.org < 0.3) { d.path = []; busy.add(d); } continue; }
    let best = null, bd = Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (sup[i] && dist(i, d.cell) < bd && (index.get(i) || []).length < MIL.maxStack) { bd = dist(i, d.cell); best = i; }
    if (best !== null) { const p = findDivPath(w, g, d, best); if (p) { d.path = p.path; busy.add(d); } }
  }

  // The capital and the great cities are not left empty when an enemy army is a few days away.
  if (mine.length >= 3) {
    const threatened = c => g.divisions.some(e => isEnemy(e.owner) && !e.voyage && dist(e.cell, c.cell) <= 4);
    const keep = g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === n.id && !(g.occ[c.cell] >= 0) && (c.capital || (c.imp || 0) >= 45) && threatened(c))
      .sort((a, b) => (b.capital ? 200 : 0) + (b.imp || 0) - (a.capital ? 200 : 0) - (a.imp || 0)).slice(0, Math.min(2, Math.floor(mine.length / 3)));
    for (const c of keep) {
      const here = mine.find(d => d.cell === c.cell && !busy.has(d));
      if (here) { here.path = []; busy.add(here); continue; }
      const cand = mine.filter(d => !busy.has(d) && d.org >= 0.3 && dist(d.cell, c.cell) <= 5).sort((a, b) => dist(a.cell, c.cell) - dist(b.cell, c.cell))[0];
      if (cand) { const p = findDivPath(w, g, cand, c.cell); if (p && p.seasons <= 2) { cand.path = p.path; busy.add(cand); } }
    }
  }

  // Attacks where the odds are good.
  const targets = new Map();
  for (const d of mine) {
    if (busy.has(d)) continue;
    for (const k of stepNeighbors(g, d.cell)) {
      if (!isLand(w, k) || !isEnemy(controller(g, k)) && !(g.owner[k] === n.id && g.occ[k] >= 0 && isEnemy(g.occ[k]))) continue;
      if (!targets.has(k)) targets.set(k, []);
      targets.get(k).push(d);
    }
  }
  const threshold = stance === "offensive" ? 1.3 : 1.9;
  const scored = [...targets.entries()].map(([cell, atts]) => {
    const defs = (index.get(cell) || []).filter(e => isEnemy(e.owner));
    const pa = atts.map(d => estPower(w, g, d, "att", cell)).sort((a, b) => b - a).slice(0, MIL.maxAttackers).reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0);
    const pd = defs.reduce((s, e) => s + estPower(w, g, e, "def", cell), 0);
    const townC = g.cities.find(c => c.cell === cell);
    const town = !!townC;
    const ours = g.owner[cell] === n.id;
    const odds = pd > 0 ? pa / pd : 99;
    const value = (town ? Math.min(6, 1.5 + (townC.imp || 50) / 20) : 1) + (ours ? 2 : 0) + (defs.length ? 1 : 0);
    return { cell, atts, defs, odds, value };
  }).sort((a, b) => b.value * Math.min(b.odds, 3) - a.value * Math.min(a.odds, 3));
  for (const t of scored) {
    const free = t.atts.filter(d => !busy.has(d) && d.org >= 0.35);
    if (!free.length) continue;
    if (t.defs.length && t.odds < threshold) continue;
    if (!t.defs.length && stance !== "offensive" && g.owner[t.cell] !== n.id) continue;
    const use = t.defs.length ? free.slice(0, MIL.maxAttackers) : free.slice(0, 1);
    for (const d of use) { d.path = [t.cell]; busy.add(d); }
  }

  // Everyone else moves up to the front where it is thinnest, or holds.
  const front = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) {
    const ci = controller(g, i);
    if (!sup[i] || (ci !== n.id && !(stance === "offensive" && ci === -1 && isLand(w, i)))) continue;
    let pressure = 0, touches = false;
    for (const k of stepNeighbors(g, i)) {
      if (isEnemy(controller(g, k))) touches = true;
      for (const e of index.get(k) || []) if (isEnemy(e.owner)) pressure += divCombatValue(e);
    }
    if (touches) front.push({ cell: i, pressure, mine: (index.get(i) || []).filter(e => e.owner === n.id).length });
  }
  front.sort((a, b) => b.pressure - a.pressure);
  if (!front.length) { planGarrisons(w, g, n, mine.filter(d => !busy.has(d))); return; }
  for (const d of mine) {
    if (busy.has(d)) continue;
    if (enemyDivAdjacent(g, index, d.cell, n.id)) { d.path = []; continue; }
    const spot = front.find(f => f.mine < (f.pressure > 0 ? 2 : 1));
    if (stance === "offensive" && DIV_TYPES[d.type].armor && d.org >= 0.6) {
      const town = g.cities.filter(c => isEnemy(controller(g, c.cell)) && dist(c.cell, d.cell) <= 8).sort((a, b) => dist(a.cell, d.cell) - dist(b.cell, d.cell))[0];
      if (town) { const p = findDivPath(w, g, d, town.cell); if (p) { d.path = p.path; continue; } }
    }
    if (spot) {
      const p = findDivPath(w, g, d, spot.cell);
      if ((!p || p.seasons > 3) && aiSeaMove(w, g, d, spot.cell, p)) { spot.mine++; continue; }
      if (p) { d.path = p.path; spot.mine++; continue; }
    }
    d.path = [];
  }
}

function planGarrisons(w, g, n, mine) {
  const towns = g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === n.id && g.occ[c.cell] < 0);
  if (!towns.length) return;
  const threats = liveNations(g).filter(z => z.id !== n.id).map(z => ({ id: z.id, t: threatFrom(w, g, n.id, z.id) })).filter(x => x.t > 0.1);
  const weight = c => {
    let s = 0.08 + clamp(c.imp || 15, 0, 110) / 140 + (c.capital ? 0.1 : 0);
    for (const th of threats) { const d = distanceToNation(g, th.id, c.cell); if (d <= 8) s += th.t * (9 - d) / 4; }
    return s;
  };
  const ranked = towns.map(c => ({ c, w: weight(c), have: 0 })).sort((a, b) => b.w - a.w);
  const total = ranked.reduce((s, r) => s + r.w, 0) || 1;
  ranked.forEach(r => { r.want = Math.max(r === ranked[0] ? 1 : 0, Math.round((r.w / total) * mine.length)); });
  const assigned = new Set();
  for (const r of ranked) for (const d of mine) {
    if (r.have >= Math.min(r.want, MIL.maxStack)) break;
    if (assigned.has(d)) continue;
    if (d.cell === r.c.cell) { assigned.add(d); r.have++; d.path = []; }
  }
  for (const d of mine) {
    if (assigned.has(d)) continue;
    const r = ranked.find(x => x.have < Math.min(x.want, MIL.maxStack)) || ranked.find(x => x.have < MIL.maxStack);
    if (!r) break;
    const p = findDivPath(w, g, d, r.c.cell);
    if ((!p || p.seasons > 3) && aiSeaMove(w, g, d, r.c.cell, p)) { r.have++; assigned.add(d); continue; }
    if (p) { d.path = p.path; r.have++; assigned.add(d); }
  }
}

function stockValue(n) { return EQUIP_ORDER.reduce((s, k) => s + (n.stock ? n.stock[k] : 0) * EQUIP[k].costB, 0); }

/* What the divisions already in the field are missing, by kind of equipment. */
function shortfall(g, nid) {
  const out = { kits: 0, guns: 0, tanks: 0, planes: 0 };
  for (const d of g.divisions) if (d.owner === nid) { const t = DIV_TYPES[d.type]; for (const k of ["kits", "guns", "tanks"]) out[k] += Math.max(0, t[k] - d[k]); }
  for (const a of g.airwings) if (a.owner === nid) out.planes += Math.max(0, AIR.planes - a.planes);
  return out;
}

/* Rival quartermasters keep factories making what the army will need, and stop when the depots are full. */
function aiManageProduction(g, n) {
  const mix = MIX[n.archetype];
  const short = shortfall(g, n.id);
  const wings = g.airwings.filter(a => a.owner === n.id).length;
  const want = {
    kits: short.kits + 2 * DIV_TYPES.inf.kits,
    guns: short.guns + DIV_TYPES.art.guns,
    tanks: short.tanks + (mix.arm >= 0.2 ? DIV_TYPES.arm.tanks : mix.arm > 0 ? 60 : 0),
    planes: short.planes + (wings < mix.air ? AIR.planes : 20),
  };
  const base = PROD_DEFAULTS[n.archetype];
  const prod = {};
  for (const k of EQUIP_ORDER) {
    const have = n.stock[k];
    prod[k] = have >= 2 * want[k] ? "off" : have >= want[k] ? "low" : n.focus === k ? "high" : base[k];
  }
  n.prod = prod;
}

/* Rivals raise forces according to character, danger and what their factories have made. */
function aiRecruit(w, g, n) {
  const econ = computeEconomy(w, g, n.id);
  const mix = MIX[n.archetype];
  const atWarNow = enemiesOf(g, n.id).length > 0;
  const threat = maxThreatTo(w, g, n.id).level;
  const reserve = 0.03 * econ.gdp;
  const towns = g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === n.id && g.occ[c.cell] < 0);
  if (!towns.length) return [];
  const raised = [];
  const enemyNear = c => {
    let best = Infinity;
    for (const z of liveNations(g)) if (z.id !== n.id) best = Math.min(best, distanceToNation(g, z.id, c.cell));
    return best;
  };
  const base = towns.filter(c => stackAt(g, c.cell, n.id) < MIL.maxStack && !((c.loyalty ?? CITY.loyalNative) < CITY.loyalRaise && c.origin !== n.id)).sort((a, b) => enemyNear(a) - enemyNear(b))[0];
  // In peace a government keeps only part of its allowed manpower under arms: more when it feels threatened or is ruled by generals.
  const lean = { militarist: 0.3, expansionist: 0.15, agrarian: 0, mercantile: -0.05 }[n.archetype] || 0;
  const desire = atWarNow ? 1 : clamp(0.45 + 0.4 * threat + lean, 0.35, 0.95);
  const underArms = n.mil ? n.mil.men : 0;
  const limit = underArms >= manpowerCap(n, econ) * desire ? 0 : atWarNow ? 2 : 1;
  for (let k = 0; k < limit && base; k++) {
    const mine = g.divisions.filter(d => d.owner === n.id);
    const counts = { inf: 0, art: 0, arm: 0 };
    mine.forEach(d => { counts[d.type]++; });
    const total = mine.length || 1;
    const want = DIV_ORDER.map(t => ({ t, gap: mix[t] - counts[t] / total })).sort((a, b) => b.gap - a.gap);
    for (const { t } of want) {
      const q = raiseQuote(w, g, n.id, t, base.id);
      if (!q.ok || n.treasury - q.cost < reserve) continue;
      if (t !== "inf" && q.fill < 0.5) continue;
      raiseForce(g, n.id, q);
      raised.push(`Raised the ${g.divisions[g.divisions.length - 1].name} at ${base.name}.`);
      break;
    }
  }
  const wings = g.airwings.filter(a => a.owner === n.id).length;
  if (wings < mix.air && n.stock.planes >= 60) {
    const cap = towns.find(c => c.capital) || towns[0];
    const q = raiseQuote(w, g, n.id, "air", cap.id);
    if (q.ok && n.treasury - q.cost > reserve) { const wing = raiseForce(g, n.id, q); raised.push(`Formed the ${wing.name} at ${cap.name}.`); }
  }
  return raised;
}

/* Military choices offered to rival minds: the stance of their generals and what their factories favor. */
function militaryCandidates(w, g, n) {
  const out = [];
  const enemies = enemiesOf(g, n.id);
  const stance = (n.warPlan && n.warPlan.stance) || "defensive";
  if (enemies.length) {
    const names = enemies.map(e => `the ${nameOf(g, e)}`).join(" and ");
    if (stance !== "offensive") out.push({ kind: "stance", value: "offensive", label: `Order the generals onto the offensive against ${names}`, why: "press the attack where the odds are good" });
    if (stance !== "defensive") out.push({ kind: "stance", value: "defensive", label: `Order the generals to hold defensive lines against ${names}`, why: "preserve the army and hold what we have" });
  }
  const mix = MIX[n.archetype];
  const mine = g.divisions.filter(d => d.owner === n.id);
  const total = mine.length || 1;
  const armorShare = mine.filter(d => d.type === "arm").length / total;
  const wings = g.airwings.filter(a => a.owner === n.id).length;
  const p = { ...n.prod, [n.focus]: "high" };
  if (armorShare < mix.arm && p.tanks !== "high") out.push({ kind: "focus", value: "tanks", label: "Shift factories toward tanks", why: "we have too few armored divisions for our plans" });
  if (wings < mix.air && p.planes !== "high") out.push({ kind: "focus", value: "planes", label: "Shift factories toward aircraft", why: "our skies are thinly defended" });
  if (enemies.length && p.kits !== "high") out.push({ kind: "focus", value: "kits", label: "Shift factories toward infantry weapons", why: "the war needs riflemen more than prestige weapons" });
  return out.slice(0, 3).concat(navalCandidates(g, n));
}

function applyMilitaryOption(g, n, o) {
  if (o.kind === "stance") { n.warPlan = { stance: o.value }; return `Ordered its generals ${o.value === "offensive" ? "onto the offensive" : "to hold defensive lines"}.`; }
  if (o.kind === "navy") { n.navyStance = o.value; return o.value === "offensive" ? "Ordered its admirals to seek battle and blockade the enemy's ports." : "Ordered its admirals to guard its own waters and convoys."; }
  if (o.kind === "focus") {
    n.focus = o.value;
    aiManageProduction(g, n);
    return `Shifted its factories toward ${EQUIP[o.value].label.toLowerCase()}.`;
  }
  return null;
}

/* ---------- The military season, called from runSeason ---------- */
function sameSideAs(g, a, b) {
  if (a === b) return true;
  return g.wars.some(war => sameSide(war, a, b)) || alliesOf(g, a).includes(b);
}

function runMilitarySeason(w, g, rng, dispatch) {
  for (const n of liveNations(g)) {
    if (n.isPlayer) continue;
    for (const t of aiRecruit(w, g, n)) noteFor(n, g, t, null, "rules");
    for (const t of aiBuildShips(w, g, n)) noteFor(n, g, t, null, "rules");
    aiManageProduction(g, n);
  }
  for (const n of liveNations(g)) reinforce(g, w, n, computeEconomy(w, g, n.id));
  const voyageNews = maintainVoyages(w, g);
  for (const n of liveNations(g)) planOperations(w, g, n);
  for (const n of liveNations(g)) {
    if (!n.isPlayer) for (const t of aiLandings(w, g, n)) noteFor(n, g, t, null, "rules");
    planNaval(w, g, n);
  }
  const sea = resolveSea(w, g, rng);
  const res = resolveMilitary(g, w, rng);
  res.reports.unshift(...sea.landReports);
  g.battles = sea.landReports.concat(g.battles || []).slice(0, 40);
  const after = seaAftermath(w, g, rng);
  const seaNews = voyageNews.concat(sea.news, after);
  dispatch.sea = seaNews.filter(x => x.nid === PLAYER || (x.other === PLAYER && x.shared));
  dispatch.seaBattles = sea.reports.filter(r => r.attacker === PLAYER || r.defender === PLAYER || sameSideAs(g, PLAYER, r.attacker) || sameSideAs(g, PLAYER, r.defender));
  g.sea.seaBattles = sea.reports;
  for (const r of sea.reports) {
    if (dispatch.seaBattles.includes(r)) continue;
    const lost = Object.values(r.sunk).reduce((a, l) => a + l.length, 0);
    dispatch.war.push(`Sea battle in the ${r.zoneName}: the ${nameOf(g, r.won ? r.attacker : r.defender)} beat the ${nameOf(g, r.won ? r.defender : r.attacker)}${lost ? `; ${lost} ship${lost > 1 ? "s" : ""} sunk` : ""}.`);
  }
  for (const x of seaNews) if (!dispatch.sea.includes(x) && x.blockade) dispatch.war.push(x.text);
  for (const x of seaNews) if (x.tone === "bad" || x.blockade) addChronicle(g, x.text, x.tone === "bad" ? "bad" : "warn", x.nid);
  dispatch.war.push(...res.news);
  for (const r of res.reports) {
    if (r.attacker === PLAYER || r.defender === PLAYER) continue;
    const where = r.town ? r.town : `the ${r.terrain.toLowerCase()}`;
    if (r.town || r.destroyed.length) dispatch.war.push(`Battle at ${where}: the ${nameOf(g, r.attacker)} ${r.won ? "defeated" : "was thrown back by"} the ${nameOf(g, r.defender)}${r.destroyed.length ? `; ${r.destroyed.join(", ")} destroyed` : ""}.`);
  }
  return res;
}

/* Rule-based choice among the military options, so rivals still steer their wars without Claude. */
function ruleMilitaryChoice(g, w, n, options) {
  if (!options.length) return null;
  const enemies = enemiesOf(g, n.id);
  const per = personality(n);
  if (enemies.length) {
    const war = warBetween(g, n.id, enemies[0]);
    const score = war ? sideScore(war, n.id) : 0;
    const mine = armyPower(g, n.id), theirs = enemies.reduce((s, e) => s + armyPower(g, e), 0);
    const off = options.find(o => o.kind === "stance" && o.value === "offensive");
    const def = options.find(o => o.kind === "stance" && o.value === "defensive");
    if (off && (mine > theirs * (per.aggression >= 1 ? 1.0 : 1.3) || (score > 10 && mine > theirs * 0.8))) return off;
    if (def && mine < theirs * 0.8 && score < 5) return def;
  }
  const nav = options.find(o => o.kind === "navy");
  if (nav && enemies.length) {
    const mine = navyPower(g, n.id), theirs = enemies.reduce((s, e) => s + navyPower(g, e), 0);
    if (nav.value === "offensive" && mine > theirs * 1.3) return nav;
    if (nav.value === "defensive" && mine < theirs * 0.8) return nav;
  }
  if (g.turn % 3 === n.id % 3) return options.find(o => o.kind === "focus") || null;
  return null;
}

function economyBrief(n, econ) {
  const sec = Object.entries(econ.sectors).map(([k, v]) => `${SECTORS[k].label.toLowerCase()} ${pct(v.va / Math.max(1, econ.gdp))}`).join(", ");
  const short = GOOD_ORDER.filter(k => econ.goods.demand[k] > 0.05 && econ.sat[k] < 0.8).map(k => `${GOODS[k].label.toLowerCase()} (${pct(econ.sat[k])})`);
  const glut = GOOD_ORDER.filter(k => econ.goods.util[k] < 0.8).map(k => GOODS[k].label.toLowerCase());
  const known = Object.keys(n.techs || {}).map(t => TECHS[t].label);
  return `Economy: ${sec}; workforce skill ${pct(n.skill ?? 0.35)}; unemployment ${pct(econ.unemployment || 0)}; food reserve ${fmt1(monthsOfFood((n.granary && n.granary.stock) || 0, econ.pop))} months; shortages: ${short.join(", ") || "none"}; unsold surplus: ${glut.join(", ") || "none"}; technologies: ${known.join(", ") || "none yet"}.`;
}

function militaryBrief(g, w, n, econ) {
  const mine = g.divisions.filter(d => d.owner === n.id);
  const c = { inf: 0, art: 0, arm: 0 };
  mine.forEach(d => { c[d.type]++; });
  const planes = g.airwings.filter(a => a.owner === n.id).reduce((s, a) => s + a.planes, 0);
  const plan = armsPlan(n, econ, n.laws);
  return `Forces: ${mine.length} divisions (${c.inf} infantry, ${c.art} artillery, ${c.arm} armored), ${planes} aircraft; manpower ${fmtCount(n.mil ? n.mil.men : 0)} of ${fmtCount(manpowerCap(n, econ))} allowed; factories turn out about ${EQUIP_ORDER.map(k => `${fmtCount(plan.units[k])} ${EQUIP[k].unit}`).join(", ")} a season; generals' stance: ${(n.warPlan && n.warPlan.stance) || "defensive"}. ${navalBrief(w, g, n)}`;
}

/* =====================================================================
   10k. The sea and the rivers
   Ports you build in three steps, ships you build or buy, fleets that hold sea zones, convoys that carry
   soldiers, settlers, supplies and trade, blockades, landings, and rivers that carry barges and slow armies.
   The geography is worked out from the world itself, so worlds saved before version 19 keep their seas.
   Real figures behind the numbers: a Liberty ship carried about 10,000 tons at 11 knots; armies of the 1940s
   needed about 5 tons of shipping per soldier sent to a port and 9 per soldier landed on a beach; one berth with
   cranes loaded about 1,500 tons a day; a Fletcher-class destroyer displaced 2,050 tons, a Cleveland-class
   cruiser 11,800.
   ===================================================================== */

/* ---------- Geography of the sea: the open ocean, its zones and their names ---------- */
const SEA_GEO_V = 1;
const SEA_NAME_TAILS = ["a", "ia", "is", "or", "en", "ar", "ane", "ova", "ica", "esh", "um", "eth", "wyn", "mere", "ven", "ara", "ine"];
function seaNameAt(w, cell, salt) {
  const h1 = hash2(cell, 911 + salt, w.seed + 71), h2 = hash2(911 + salt, cell, w.seed + 73);
  return NAME_HEADS[Math.floor(h1 * NAME_HEADS.length)] + SEA_NAME_TAILS[Math.floor(h2 * SEA_NAME_TAILS.length)];
}
/* Ships move between sea cells like this: 8 directions, but never across a corner of land. */
function seaSteps(w, ocean, c, fn) {
  const x = cellX(c), y = cellY(c);
  for (const [dx, dy] of DIRS8) {
    const X = x + dx, Y = y + dy;
    if (!inBounds(X, Y)) continue;
    const k = idx(X, Y);
    if (!ocean[k]) continue;
    if (dx && dy && (!ocean[idx(x + dx, y)] || !ocean[idx(x, y + dy)])) continue;
    fn(k, dx && dy ? 1.414 : 1);
  }
}
function seaGeo(w) {
  if (w._sea && w._sea.seed === w.seed && w._sea.v === SEA_GEO_V) return w._sea;
  // 1. the open ocean: the water that reaches the edge of the map; lakes are not navigable
  const body = new Int32Array(N_CELLS).fill(-1);
  const ocean = new Uint8Array(N_CELLS);
  let nb = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) {
    if (w.terrain[i] !== T.SEA || body[i] >= 0) continue;
    const id = nb++, q = [i], cells = [];
    body[i] = id;
    let edge = false;
    while (q.length) {
      const c = q.pop(); cells.push(c);
      const x = cellX(c), y = cellY(c);
      if (x === 0 || y === 0 || x === GRID_W - 1 || y === GRID_H - 1) edge = true;
      for (const [dx, dy] of DIRS4) { const X = x + dx, Y = y + dy; if (!inBounds(X, Y)) continue; const k = idx(X, Y); if (w.terrain[k] === T.SEA && body[k] < 0) { body[k] = id; q.push(k); } }
    }
    if (edge) for (const c of cells) ocean[c] = 1;
  }
  // 2. distance from land, for every ocean cell
  const shore = new Float32Array(N_CELLS).fill(Infinity);
  const sq = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (ocean[i] && DIRS8.some(([dx, dy]) => { const X = cellX(i) + dx, Y = cellY(i) + dy; return inBounds(X, Y) && w.terrain[idx(X, Y)] !== T.SEA; })) { shore[i] = 1; sq.push(i); }
  for (let qi = 0; qi < sq.length; qi++) { const c = sq[qi]; seaSteps(w, ocean, c, k => { if (shore[k] === Infinity) { shore[k] = shore[c] + 1; sq.push(k); } }); }
  const coast = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (ocean[i] && DIRS4.some(([dx, dy]) => { const X = cellX(i) + dx, Y = cellY(i) + dy; return inBounds(X, Y) && w.terrain[idx(X, Y)] !== T.SEA; })) coast.push(i);
  // 3. zone seeds spread along the coast, then every ocean cell joins the nearest seed by water
  const bfs = (sources, out) => {
    const d = out || new Float32Array(N_CELLS).fill(Infinity);
    const q = [];
    for (const s of sources) { d[s] = 0; q.push(s); }
    for (let qi = 0; qi < q.length; qi++) { const c = q[qi]; seaSteps(w, ocean, c, k => { if (d[k] > d[c] + 1) { d[k] = d[c] + 1; q.push(k); } }); }
    return d;
  };
  const seeds = [];
  if (coast.length) {
    seeds.push(coast.reduce((b, c) => (cellY(c) * 1000 + cellX(c) < cellY(b) * 1000 + cellX(b) ? c : b), coast[0]));
    let d = bfs(seeds);
    for (let k = 0; k < 40; k++) {
      let best = -1, bd = -1;
      for (const c of coast) if (d[c] !== Infinity && d[c] > bd) { bd = d[c]; best = c; }
      if (best < 0 || bd < 11) break;
      seeds.push(best);
      const d2 = bfs([best]);
      for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (d2[i] < d[i]) d[i] = d2[i];
    }
  }
  const zone = new Int16Array(N_CELLS).fill(-1);
  {
    const q = [];
    seeds.forEach((s, k) => { zone[s] = k; q.push(s); });
    for (let qi = 0; qi < q.length; qi++) { const c = q[qi]; seaSteps(w, ocean, c, k => { if (zone[k] < 0) { zone[k] = zone[c]; q.push(k); } }); }
  }
  // 4. tiny zones (in narrow inlets) join the neighbour they touch most
  let count = seeds.length;
  for (let pass = 0; pass < 3; pass++) {
    const size = new Array(count).fill(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (zone[i] >= 0) size[zone[i]]++;
    let changed = false;
    for (let z = 0; z < count; z++) {
      if (size[z] === 0 || size[z] >= 30) continue;
      const touch = new Map();
      for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (zone[i] === z) for (const [dx, dy] of DIRS4) { const X = cellX(i) + dx, Y = cellY(i) + dy; if (!inBounds(X, Y)) continue; const o = zone[idx(X, Y)]; if (o >= 0 && o !== z) touch.set(o, (touch.get(o) || 0) + 1); }
      const to = [...touch.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0];
      if (!to) continue;
      for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (zone[i] === z) zone[i] = to[0];
      size[to[0]] += size[z]; size[z] = 0; changed = true;
    }
    if (!changed) break;
  }
  // renumber, so zone ids run 0..n-1 in seed order
  const remap = new Map();
  for (let k = 0; k < seeds.length; k++) {
    const z = zone[seeds[k]];
    if (z >= 0 && !remap.has(z)) remap.set(z, remap.size);
  }
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (zone[i] >= 0) zone[i] = remap.has(zone[i]) ? remap.get(zone[i]) : zone[i];
  count = remap.size;
  // 5. each zone: its size, where its name sits, how enclosed it is, who its neighbours are
  const zones = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, id) => ({ id, cells: 0, coastCells: 0, sx: 0, sy: 0, sn: 0, enclosed: 0, en: 0, adj: new Set(), label: -1, anchor: -1, name: "", kind: "Sea", seed: -1 }));
  for (const [z, k] of remap) zones[k].seed = seeds[z];
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) {
    const z = zone[i];
    if (z < 0) continue;
    const Z = zones[z];
    Z.cells++;
    if (shore[i] <= 6) { Z.sx += cellX(i) + 0.5; Z.sy += cellY(i) + 0.5; Z.sn++; }
    if (shore[i] <= 3) {
      let land = 0, all = 0;
      for (let dy = -3; dy <= 3; dy++) for (let dx = -3; dx <= 3; dx++) { const X = cellX(i) + dx, Y = cellY(i) + dy; all++; if (inBounds(X, Y) && w.terrain[idx(X, Y)] !== T.SEA) land++; }
      Z.enclosed += land / all; Z.en++;
    }
    if (shore[i] === 1) Z.coastCells++;
    for (const [dx, dy] of DIRS4) { const X = cellX(i) + dx, Y = cellY(i) + dy; if (!inBounds(X, Y)) continue; const o = zone[idx(X, Y)]; if (o >= 0 && o !== z) Z.adj.add(o); }
  }
  const used = new Set();
  for (const Z of zones) {
    Z.enclosed = Z.en ? Z.enclosed / Z.en : 0;
    const cx = Z.sn ? Z.sx / Z.sn : 0, cy = Z.sn ? Z.sy / Z.sn : 0;
    let best = -1, bd = Infinity, abest = -1, ad = Infinity;
    for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) {
      if (zone[i] !== Z.id) continue;
      const dd = (cellX(i) + 0.5 - cx) ** 2 + (cellY(i) + 0.5 - cy) ** 2;
      if (shore[i] >= 2 && shore[i] <= 6 && dd < bd) { bd = dd; best = i; }
      if (shore[i] >= 2 && shore[i] <= 3 && dd < ad) { ad = dd; abest = i; }
    }
    if (best < 0) for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) if (zone[i] === Z.id) { best = i; break; }
    Z.label = best;
    Z.anchor = abest >= 0 ? abest : best;
    Z.kind = Z.enclosed > 0.37 ? "Gulf" : Z.enclosed > 0.3 ? "Bay" : "Sea";
    let nm = "";
    for (let salt = 0; salt < 30; salt++) { nm = seaNameAt(w, Z.seed >= 0 ? Z.seed : Z.label, salt); if (!used.has(nm)) break; }
    used.add(nm);
    Z.base = nm;
    Z.name = Z.kind === "Sea" ? `${nm} Sea` : `${Z.kind} of ${nm}`;
    Z.adj = [...Z.adj].sort((a, b) => a - b);
  }
  // 6. hops between zones
  const hops = zones.map(Z => {
    const d = new Array(count).fill(Infinity);
    d[Z.id] = 0;
    const q = [Z.id];
    for (let qi = 0; qi < q.length; qi++) for (const o of zones[q[qi]].adj) if (d[o] === Infinity) { d[o] = d[q[qi]] + 1; q.push(o); }
    return d;
  });
  // 7. how far each piece of land lies from the open sea, in cells
  const coastDist = new Float32Array(N_CELLS).fill(Infinity);
  const lq = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) {
    if (w.terrain[i] === T.SEA) continue;
    if (DIRS4.some(([dx, dy]) => { const X = cellX(i) + dx, Y = cellY(i) + dy; return inBounds(X, Y) && ocean[idx(X, Y)]; })) { coastDist[i] = 0; lq.push(i); }
  }
  for (let qi = 0; qi < lq.length; qi++) {
    const c = lq[qi];
    for (const [dx, dy] of DIRS4) { const X = cellX(c) + dx, Y = cellY(c) + dy; if (!inBounds(X, Y)) continue; const k = idx(X, Y); if (w.terrain[k] !== T.SEA && coastDist[k] === Infinity) { coastDist[k] = coastDist[c] + 1; lq.push(k); } }
  }
  w._sea = { seed: w.seed, v: SEA_GEO_V, ocean, zone, zones, shore, hops, coastDist, paths: new Map() };
  return w._sea;
}
function isOcean(w, i) { return i >= 0 && seaGeo(w).ocean[i] === 1; }
function zoneOf(w, i) { return i >= 0 ? seaGeo(w).zone[i] : -1; }
function zoneName(w, z) { const Z = seaGeo(w).zones[z]; return Z ? Z.name : "the open sea"; }

/* The cheapest route by sea between two ocean cells, as a list of cells (cached). */
function seaPath(w, from, to) {
  const G = seaGeo(w);
  if (!G.ocean[from] || !G.ocean[to]) return null;
  if (from === to) return { cells: [from], km: 0 };
  const key = `${from}>${to}`;
  if (G.paths.has(key)) return G.paths.get(key);
  const cost = new Float32Array(N_CELLS).fill(Infinity), prev = new Int32Array(N_CELLS).fill(-1), done = new Uint8Array(N_CELLS);
  cost[from] = 0;
  const open = [];
  heapPush(open, from, 0);
  while (open.length) {
    const c = heapPop(open);
    if (done[c]) continue;
    done[c] = 1;
    if (c === to) break;
    seaSteps(w, G.ocean, c, (k, step) => {
      // ships keep a little off the coast where they can
      const nc = cost[c] + step * (G.shore[k] <= 1 ? 1.15 : 1);
      if (nc < cost[k]) { cost[k] = nc; prev[k] = c; heapPush(open, k, nc); }
    });
  }
  let res = null;
  if (cost[to] !== Infinity) {
    const cells = [];
    for (let c = to; c !== -1; c = prev[c]) cells.push(c);
    cells.reverse();
    let km = 0;
    for (let k = 1; k < cells.length; k++) km += (cellX(cells[k]) !== cellX(cells[k - 1]) && cellY(cells[k]) !== cellY(cells[k - 1]) ? 70.7 : 50);
    res = { cells, km };
  }
  if (G.paths.size > 400) G.paths.clear();
  G.paths.set(key, res);
  return res;
}
/* The zones a route passes through, in order. */
function routeZones(w, cells) {
  const out = [];
  for (const c of cells) { const z = zoneOf(w, c); if (z >= 0 && out[out.length - 1] !== z) out.push(z); }
  return out;
}

/* Where a town meets the open sea: the ocean cell beside it (the most open one), or -1 for inland and lake towns. */
function portSeaCell(w, cell) {
  const G = seaGeo(w);
  let best = -1, bs = -1;
  for (const [dx, dy] of DIRS8) {
    const X = cellX(cell) + dx, Y = cellY(cell) + dy;
    if (!inBounds(X, Y)) continue;
    const k = idx(X, Y);
    if (!G.ocean[k]) continue;
    const s = G.shore[k] + (dx && dy ? 0 : 0.5);
    if (s > bs) { bs = s; best = k; }
  }
  return best;
}
/* A coast where troops can land: land beside the open sea (4 directions), not a mountain cliff. */
function beachSeaCell(w, cell) {
  if (!isLand(w, cell)) return -1;
  const G = seaGeo(w);
  for (const [dx, dy] of DIRS4) {
    const X = cellX(cell) + dx, Y = cellY(cell) + dy;
    if (inBounds(X, Y) && G.ocean[idx(X, Y)]) return portSeaCell(w, cell);
  }
  return -1;
}

/* ---------- Rivers: barges on the big ones, and every river a line to defend ---------- */
const RIVER_GEO_V = 1;
function riverGeo(w) {
  if (w._riv && w._riv.seed === w.seed && w._riv.v === RIVER_GEO_V) return w._riv;
  const F = riverField(w);
  const { R, GW, N, land, down, acc } = F;
  const cls = a => (a < 190 ? 1 : a < 520 ? 2 : a < 1400 ? 3 : 4);
  // the mouth each river pixel drains to, and the biggest flow in each basin
  const mouth = new Int32Array(N).fill(-2);
  const findMouth = p => {
    const stack = [];
    let c = p;
    while (c >= 0 && land[c] && mouth[c] === -2) { stack.push(c); c = down[c]; }
    const m = c < 0 ? -1 : land[c] ? mouth[c] : c;
    for (const s of stack) mouth[s] = m;
    return m;
  };
  const basinMax = new Map();
  for (let p = 0; p < N; p++) {
    if (!land[p] || acc[p] < 190) continue;
    const m = findMouth(p);
    basinMax.set(m, Math.max(basinMax.get(m) || 0, acc[p]));
  }
  const names = new Map(), usedNames = new Set();
  for (const [m, a] of [...basinMax.entries()].sort((x, y) => y[1] - x[1])) {
    if (a < 520) continue;
    let nm = "";
    for (let salt = 0; salt < 30; salt++) { nm = seaNameAt(w, m + 7, 50 + salt); if (!usedNames.has(nm)) break; }
    usedNames.add(nm);
    names.set(m, nm);
  }
  // crossings: a river (class 2 or more) running between the centres of two neighbouring cells
  const cross = new Map();
  const segHit = (ax, ay, bx, by, cx, cy, dx, dy) => {
    const d = (bx - ax) * (dy - cy) - (by - ay) * (dx - cx);
    if (Math.abs(d) < 1e-9) return false;
    const t = ((cx - ax) * (dy - cy) - (cy - ay) * (dx - cx)) / d;
    const u = ((cx - ax) * (by - ay) - (cy - ay) * (bx - ax)) / d;
    return t >= 0 && t <= 1 && u >= 0 && u <= 1;
  };
  for (let p = 0; p < N; p++) {
    if (!land[p] || acc[p] < 190) continue;
    const q = down[p];
    if (q < 0) continue;
    const ax = ((p % GW) + 0.5) / R, ay = (((p / GW) | 0) + 0.5) / R, bx = ((q % GW) + 0.5) / R, by = (((q / GW) | 0) + 0.5) / R;
    const c = cls(acc[p]);
    const x0 = Math.floor(Math.min(ax, bx) - 1), x1 = Math.floor(Math.max(ax, bx)), y0 = Math.floor(Math.min(ay, by) - 1), y1 = Math.floor(Math.max(ay, by));
    for (let cy = y0; cy <= y1; cy++) for (let cx = x0; cx <= x1; cx++) {
      if (!inBounds(cx, cy)) continue;
      const a = idx(cx, cy);
      // to the east neighbour, and to the south neighbour
      if (inBounds(cx + 1, cy) && segHit(ax, ay, bx, by, cx + 0.5, cy + 0.5, cx + 1.5, cy + 0.5)) {
        const k = edgeKey(a, idx(cx + 1, cy)), old = cross.get(k);
        if (!old || old.cls < c) cross.set(k, { cls: c, basin: mouth[p] });
      }
      if (inBounds(cx, cy + 1) && segHit(ax, ay, bx, by, cx + 0.5, cy + 0.5, cx + 0.5, cy + 1.5)) {
        const k = edgeKey(a, idx(cx, cy + 1)), old = cross.get(k);
        if (!old || old.cls < c) cross.set(k, { cls: c, basin: mouth[p] });
      }
    }
  }
  // navigable water: cells crossed by a river of class 3 or more, joined into systems
  const cellsCls = riverCells(w);
  const nav = new Int16Array(N_CELLS).fill(-1);
  let systems = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) {
    if (cellsCls[i] < 3 || nav[i] >= 0 || !isLand(w, i)) continue;
    const id = systems++, q = [i];
    nav[i] = id;
    while (q.length) {
      const c = q.pop();
      for (const [dx, dy] of DIRS8) { const X = cellX(c) + dx, Y = cellY(c) + dy; if (!inBounds(X, Y)) continue; const k = idx(X, Y); if (nav[k] < 0 && cellsCls[k] >= 3 && isLand(w, k)) { nav[k] = id; q.push(k); } }
    }
  }
  // the name of each navigable system: the basin of its biggest river
  const sysName = new Array(systems).fill(null);
  const sysBest = new Array(systems).fill(0);
  for (let p = 0; p < N; p++) {
    if (!land[p] || acc[p] < 520) continue;
    const i = idx(Math.floor((p % GW) / R), Math.floor(((p / GW) | 0) / R));
    const s = nav[i];
    if (s < 0 || acc[p] <= sysBest[s]) continue;
    sysBest[s] = acc[p];
    sysName[s] = names.get(mouth[p]) || null;
  }
  w._riv = { seed: w.seed, v: RIVER_GEO_V, cross, names, mouth, nav, systems, sysName };
  return w._riv;
}
/* The river between two neighbouring cells, if any: { cls, name } (cls 2 river, 3 big river, 4 great river). */
function riverBetween(w, a, b) {
  const r = riverGeo(w).cross.get(edgeKey(a, b));
  if (!r) return null;
  return { cls: r.cls, name: riverGeo(w).names.get(r.basin) || null };
}
function riverLabel(r) { return r && r.name ? `the ${r.name}` : "the river"; }
/* The navigable river cell a town can load barges from: its own cell or one beside it. */
function wharfCell(w, cell) {
  const RG = riverGeo(w);
  if (RG.nav[cell] >= 0) return cell;
  for (const [dx, dy] of DIRS4) { const X = cellX(cell) + dx, Y = cellY(cell) + dy; if (inBounds(X, Y) && RG.nav[idx(X, Y)] >= 0) return idx(X, Y); }
  return -1;
}
function riverSystemName(w, cell) {
  const RG = riverGeo(w), s = RG.nav[cell];
  return s >= 0 && RG.sysName[s] ? `the ${RG.sysName[s]}` : "the river";
}

/* ---------- Ports, ships and the numbers behind them ---------- */
const PORT_LEVELS = [
  null,
  { key: "harbor", label: "Harbor", costB: 12, seasons: 1, upkeepB: 0.25, berths: 2, tradeMt: 20, slips: 0,
    does: "Quays for merchant ships: sea trade and the world market for every town on its road network, a base for fishing fleets, and a place where soldiers can board ships." },
  { key: "port", label: "Port and shipyard", costB: 10, seasons: 2, upkeepB: 0.4, berths: 5, tradeMt: 50, slips: 4,
    does: "Five berths with cranes load ships two and a half times as fast, more trade can pass, and four slipways build freighters and destroyers." },
  { key: "naval", label: "Naval base", costB: 16, seasons: 3, upkeepB: 0.7, berths: 8, tradeMt: 80, slips: 8,
    does: "Dry docks, arsenals and shore batteries: eight slipways that can also build cruisers, quick repairs for damaged warships, and coastal guns that make the town hard to take from the sea." },
];
const SHIP_TYPES = {
  freighter: { label: "Freighter", plural: "Freighters", like: "a Liberty ship of the 1940s", tons: 10000, disp: 14000, knots: 11, crew: 44, costB: 0.04, seasons: 1, upkeepB: 0.0008, yard: 2,
    attack: 0, hull: 1, escort: 0, raid: 0, oil: 0.004,
    does: "Carries 10,000 tons: about 2,000 soldiers with their weapons, a town's food and goods, or trade. Unarmed." },
  destroyer: { label: "Destroyer", plural: "Destroyers", like: "a Fletcher-class destroyer", tons: 2050, disp: 2050, knots: 36, crew: 330, costB: 0.6, seasons: 3, upkeepB: 0.012, yard: 2,
    attack: 3, hull: 3, escort: 2, raid: 1, oil: 0.008,
    does: "Fast and cheap. Guards convoys against raiders and hunts enemy merchant ships." },
  cruiser: { label: "Cruiser", plural: "Cruisers", like: "a Cleveland-class cruiser", tons: 11800, disp: 11800, knots: 32, crew: 1250, costB: 1.6, seasons: 6, upkeepB: 0.035, yard: 3,
    attack: 10, hull: 10, escort: 0.5, raid: 2, oil: 0.016,
    does: "Heavy guns that win sea battles and hold the sea lanes, and shell the coast to cover a landing." },
};
const SHIP_ORDER = ["freighter", "destroyer", "cruiser"];
const WARSHIPS = ["destroyer", "cruiser"];
const SEA = {
  berthTonsDay: 1500,     // tons a day one berth with cranes loads (with lighters only about 800)
  kmPerDay: 489,          // 11 knots, the speed of a loaded freighter
  tonsPerMan: { inf: 5, art: 7, arm: 12 },   // shipping per soldier with his weapons, vehicles and first supplies, into a port
  beachFactor: 1.8,       // loaded for a landing on a beach: about 9 tons per infantryman
  beachDays: 4,           // the assault waves get ashore in the first days
  beachTonsDay: 8000,     // then landing craft, lighters and amphibious trucks bring in about 8,000 tons a day
  seasonDays: 90,
  supplyPerDiv: { inf: 1, art: 1, arm: 2 },  // freighters that keep a division supplied across the sea
  linkPerM: 4,            // freighters that join a cut-off town of 1M people to the national market
  tradeMtPerFreighter: 0.12,   // million tons a year one freighter carries on trade routes: 12 voyages of 10,000 tons
  freightRate: 25, warFreightRate: 75,   // $ a ton charged by foreign shipowners, in peace and when war is at sea
  neutralShareWar: 0.4,   // the share of foreign ships still willing to come when an enemy with warships is at war with you
  settlerFreighters: 2,
  buyFreighterB: 0.06, buyPerSeason: 6, buyWarshipMult: 1.3,
  wharfB: 3, wharfUpkeepB: 0.05,
  tonsPerUnit: { food: 1, timber: 2, metals: 2, coal: 4, oil: 2.5, gold: 0, power: 0, goods: 0.4, machinery: 0.3, chemicals: 1, electronics: 0.05 },
  raidRate: 0.15,
};

function portLevel(c) { return c && c.port ? clamp(c.portLvl || 1, 1, 3) : 0; }
function portSpec(c) { return PORT_LEVELS[portLevel(c)] || null; }
function oceanPort(w, c) { return portLevel(c) > 0 && portSeaCell(w, c.cell) >= 0; }
function portZoneOf(w, c) { const s = portSeaCell(w, c.cell); return s >= 0 ? zoneOf(w, s) : -1; }

function seaState(g) {
  if (!g.sea) g.sea = { fleets: [], presence: {}, ctl: {}, trade: {}, supplyNeed: {}, supplyOk: {}, busy: {}, reports: [], news: [], names: {}, fleetCount: {}, blockaded: [], losses: {}, links: {} };
  const S = g.sea;
  for (const k of ["presence", "ctl", "trade", "supplyNeed", "supplyOk", "busy", "names", "fleetCount", "losses", "links"]) if (!S[k]) S[k] = {};
  for (const k of ["fleets", "reports", "news", "blockaded"]) if (!S[k]) S[k] = [];
  return S;
}

/* Who is at sea in a zone, after last season's battles: our side, the enemy, and what each can do. */
function zonePowers(g, z, nid) {
  const S = g.sea;
  let own = 0, foe = 0, raid = 0, escort = 0, foeNids = [];
  if (!S || !S.presence) return { own, foe, raid, escort, foeNids };
  const allies = alliesOf(g, nid);
  for (const p of S.presence[z] || []) {
