    if (!orig || opts.ignoreAnswers) return { score: 0, lines: [], ended: true, text: "the embargo it answered has been lifted" };
  }
  const est = { hurt: e.hurt || 0, keyDrop: e.keyDrop ?? (e.hurt || 0) / 6, armyDrop: e.armyDrop ?? 0, lossThem: e.lossThem ?? 0, lossUs: 0 };
  const P = embargoPair(w, g, e.by, e.on);
  const lines = embargoReasonLines(g, P, e.k, est, { original: orig, inForce: true });
  const score = Math.min(EMBARGO_AI.cap, embargoPtsSum(lines));
  const has = code => lines.some(l => l.code === code);
  const endText = { pressure: g.opening && g.opening.by === e.by ? (g.opening.stage === "over" ? "the claim is settled" : "it will press its claim in other ways") : "the quarrel over the refused demands is over", ally_war: "the war it was about is over", war_goods: "the trade in war goods it was about has stopped" };
  const ended = !!endText[e.why] && !has(e.why);
  return { score, lines, ended, text: ended ? endText[e.why] : "" };
}

/* ---------- Carrying out a chosen option (checked again: menus are made before the player moves) ---------- */
function executeRivalEmbargo(g, w, n, o, why, letterText, dispatch, say) {
  const x = n.id, y = o.target, T = g.trade;
  if (!T || !T.v || embargoBlock(g, x, y, o.good, o.dir) || hasTreaty(g, x, y, "alliance")) return false;
  const q = tradeSells(g, x, y)[o.good] || 0;
  if (q <= 1e-4 || q < 0.5 * ((o.est && o.est.q) || 0)) return false;          // most of that trade is gone already
  let orig = null;
  if (o.answers !== null && o.answers !== undefined) {
    orig = T.embargoes.find(e => e.id === o.answers && !e.answered) || null;
    if (!orig) return false;                                                    // what it answered was lifted
  }
  const pv = embargoPreview(w, g, x, y, o.good, o.dir, o.food);
  const est = estFromPreview(pv, q);
  if (est.hurt < EMBARGO_AI.minHurt && est.keyDrop < EMBARGO_AI.minDrop) return false;
  const reasons = embargoReasonLines(g, embargoPair(w, g, x, y), o.good, est, { original: orig });
  if (embargoPtsSum(reasons) < EMBARGO_AI.liftCause) return false;                     // the cause no longer stands
  const code = embargoMainWhy(reasons);
  const r = declareEmbargo(w, g, x, y, o.good, o.dir, code, { preview: pv, answers: orig ? orig.id : null, food: !!o.food, letter: letterText || templateLetter(g, n, { ...o, why: code }) });
  if (!r.ok) return false;
  Object.assign(r.e, { keyDrop: sr(est.keyDrop, 3), armyDrop: sr(est.armyDrop, 3), lossThem: sr(est.lossThem, 3), cost: sr(est.lossUs, 3) });
  if (orig) orig.answered = r.e.id;
  const top = reasons.slice().sort((a, b) => b.pts - a.pts)[0];
  if (y === PLAYER) {
    const heard = embargoWhyHeard(g, r.e);
    const it = g.inbox[g.inbox.length - 1];
    if (it && it.kind === "embargo" && it.from === x) { it.why = code; it.reason = heard; }
    const key = o.good === "all" || TRADE.key.includes(o.good);
    dispatch.trade.push({ text: `The ${n.name} ${embargoVerb(r.e)} us${heard ? `, ${heard}` : ""}. Our merchants are looking for other sellers.`, tone: key ? "bad" : "warn", nid: x, minister: o.good === "food" ? "agriculture" : "economy", pause: key, key });
  }
  say(`${embargoVerb(r.e).replace(/^./, ch => ch.toUpperCase())} ${theNation(g, y)}.`, why || (top ? top.label : ""));
  return true;
}
function executeRivalLift(g, w, n, o, why, dispatch, say) {
  const e = ((g.trade && g.trade.embargoes) || []).find(x => x.id === o.embargoId && x.by === n.id);
  if (!e) return false;
  return liftWithAnswers(w, g, e, why || "", dispatch, say);
}
/* Lift an embargo, and with it the rivals' embargoes that answered it (a retaliation ends with what it answered). */
function liftWithAnswers(w, g, e, why, dispatch, say, opts = {}) {
  const T = g.trade;
  const answering = T.embargoes.filter(x => x.answers === e.id && x.by !== e.by);
  const r = liftEmbargo(w, g, e.id, e.by, opts);
  if (!r.ok) return false;
  tellLift(g, e, why, dispatch, say);
  for (const a of answering) {
    if (!T.embargoes.includes(a)) continue;
    if (g.nations[a.by].isPlayer) {
      if (dispatch) dispatch.trade.push({ text: `The ${nameOf(g, e.by)} lifted its embargo on us. Ours, which answered it (${embargoGoodsText([a])}), still stands: you can lift it in the Trade panel.`, tone: "neutral", nid: e.by, minister: "economy" });
      continue;
    }
    const r2 = liftEmbargo(w, g, a.id, a.by);
    if (r2.ok) tellLift(g, a, "the embargo it answered has been lifted", dispatch, null);
  }
  return true;
}
function tellLift(g, e, why, dispatch, say) {
  const goods = embargoGoodsText([e]);
  if (e.by !== PLAYER) remember(g, e.by, `We lifted our embargo on the ${nameOf(g, e.on)} (${goods})${why ? `: ${why}` : ""}.`);
  if (!dispatch) return;
  if (e.on === PLAYER) dispatch.trade.push({ text: `The ${nameOf(g, e.by)} lifted its embargo on us (${goods})${why ? `: ${why}` : ""}. Our merchants can trade with them again.`, tone: "good", nid: e.by, minister: e.k === "food" ? "agriculture" : "economy" });
  const text = `Lifted its embargo on ${theNation(g, e.on)} (${goods}).`;
  const cap = why ? why.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + why.slice(1) + "." : null;
  if (say) say(text, cap);
  else if (e.by !== PLAYER) { dispatch.abroad.push({ nid: e.by, text, why: cap }); noteFor(g.nations[e.by], g, text, cap); }
}

/* ---------- The season's review: embargoes rivals keep or lift, by fixed rules (no chance) ----------
   Start of the season, before the rivals act. A rival lifts when the embargo is at least a year old and its
   reasons are weak, when it costs the rival more than its reasons are worth, or when what it was for is over. */
function reviewEmbargoes(w, g, dispatch) {
  const T = g.trade;
  if (!T || !T.v || !(T.embargoes || []).length) return;
  for (let pass = 0; pass < 3; pass++) {
    let lifted = false;
    for (const e of T.embargoes.slice().sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id)) {
      if (!T.embargoes.includes(e)) continue;
      const n = g.nations[e.by];
      if (!n || !n.alive || n.isPlayer) continue;
      const c = embargoCause(w, g, e);
      const age = g.turn - e.since;
      const lossPts = (100 * (e.cost || 0) * DIPLO.horizonYears) / Math.max(1, lastRecordedGdp(g, e.by)) * personality(n).tradeWeight;
      let why = null;
      if (c.ended) why = c.text;
      else if (age >= EMBARGO_AI.liftAge && c.score < EMBARGO_AI.liftCause) why = "its reasons have faded";
      else if (lossPts > c.score + EMBARGO_AI.liftLoss) why = `the lost sales cost more than it was worth (${fmtMoney(e.cost)} a year)`;
      if (!why) continue;
      if (liftWithAnswers(w, g, e, why, dispatch, null)) lifted = true;
    }
    if (!lifted) break;
  }
}
/* Before the contracts are signed again: what each new embargo cut, read from the contracts it stopped (the
   victim's purchases `in` and sales `out`, units a year). Kept on the entry to judge it later. */
function noteEmbargoCuts(g) {
  const T = g.trade;
  if (!T || !T.v) return;
  for (const e of T.embargoes || []) {
    if (e.q0) continue;
    const q0 = { in: {}, out: {} };
    for (const f of T.flows || []) {
      if (f.s === e.by && f.b === e.on && e.dir !== "buy" && embargoCovers(e, f.k)) q0.in[f.k] = sr((q0.in[f.k] || 0) + f.q, 4);
      if (f.s === e.on && f.b === e.by && e.dir !== "sell" && embargoCovers(e, f.k)) q0.out[f.k] = sr((q0.out[f.k] || 0) + f.q, 4);
    }
    e.q0 = q0;
    if (e.hurt0 === undefined) e.hurt0 = e.hurt || 0;
  }
}
/* After the contracts are signed: how much each embargo still hurts. The target's share of what it cut that it still
   cannot buy (or sell) anywhere else scales the hurt measured when it was declared; what the nation that keeps it
   cannot sell elsewhere is its own cost. */
function refreshEmbargoes(w, g) {
  const T = g.trade;
  if (!T || !T.v || !(T.embargoes || []).length) return;
  const left = (pool, k, id) => (T[pool] && T[pool][k] ? T[pool][k][id] || 0 : 0);
  for (const e of T.embargoes) {
    if (!e.q0 || !g.nations[e.by].alive || !g.nations[e.on].alive || atWar(g, e.by, e.on)) continue;
    let cut = 0, still = 0, cost = 0;
    for (const [k, q] of Object.entries(e.q0.in)) {
      const v = goodsWorth(g, k, q);
      cut += v; still += v * Math.min(1, left("unmet", k, e.on) / Math.max(1e-6, q));
      cost += goodsWorth(g, k, Math.min(q, left("unsold", k, e.by)));
    }
    for (const [k, q] of Object.entries(e.q0.out)) {
      const v = goodsWorth(g, k, q);
      cut += v; still += v * Math.min(1, left("unsold", k, e.on) / Math.max(1e-6, q));
      cost += goodsWorth(g, k, Math.min(q, left("unmet", k, e.by)));
    }
    if (cut <= 1e-6) continue;
    const f = still / cut, h0 = e.hurt0 ?? e.hurt ?? 0;
    e.hurt = sr(h0 * f, 2);
    if (e.kd0 === undefined) { e.kd0 = e.keyDrop ?? h0 / 6; e.ad0 = e.armyDrop ?? 0; e.lt0 = e.lossThem ?? 0; }
    e.keyDrop = sr(e.kd0 * f, 3); e.armyDrop = sr(e.ad0 * f, 3); e.lossThem = sr(e.lt0 * f, 3);
    e.cost = sr(cost, 3);
  }
}

/* ---------- Rivals buy from friends first (the same preferred-seller choice the player has) ---------- */
function rivalPreferredSellers(w, g) {
  const T = g.trade;
  if (!T || !T.v) return;
  const ix = tradeIndex(g);
  for (const n of liveNations(g)) {
    if (n.isPlayer) continue;
    const b = n.id;
    const friend = s => g.nations[s] && g.nations[s].alive && (hasTreaty(g, b, s, "alliance") || hasTreaty(g, b, s, "trade"));
    for (const p of (T.prefer || []).filter(p => p.by === b)) if (!friend(p.from) || tradeBlocked(g, p.from, b, p.k)) setPreferredSeller(g, b, p.k, null);
    for (const k of TRADE_LOAD_ORDER) {
      if (T.prefer.filter(p => p.by === b).length >= 3) break;
      if (T.prefer.some(p => p.by === b && p.k === k)) continue;
      const flows = ((ix.into[b] || {})[k] || []).filter(f => f.s >= 0 && !tradeBlocked(g, f.s, b, k));
      if (!flows.length) continue;
      const price = s => { const L = tradeLink(g, s, b); return L ? deliveredPrice(g, k, s, b, L.m, L.d).p : Infinity; };
      const cheapest = Math.min(...flows.map(f => price(f.s)));
      // a friend with goods to spare (or already selling to us, though not most of it) within 5% of the cheapest
      const main = flows.slice().sort((a, c) => c.q - a.q || a.s - c.s)[0].s;
      const pick = liveNations(g).filter(z => z.id !== b && z.id !== main && friend(z.id) && tradeLink(g, z.id, b) && !tradeBlocked(g, z.id, b, k)
        && ((T.unsold[k] ? T.unsold[k][z.id] || 0 : 0) > 0.01 || flows.some(f => f.s === z.id)) && price(z.id) <= cheapest * (1 + EMBARGO_AI.preferBand))
        .sort((a, c) => price(a.id) - price(c.id) || a.id - c.id)[0];
      if (pick) setPreferredSeller(g, b, k, pick.id);
    }
  }
}

/* ---------- Early warning: the player hears when a rival weighs cutting off its trade ---------- */
function tradeEarlyWarning(w, g, n, menu, orders, dispatch) {
  const T = g.trade;
  if (!T || !T.v || !menu || !g.nations[PLAYER].alive) return;
  const o = (menu.diplomacy || []).filter(d => d.kind === "embargo" && d.target === PLAYER && d.self >= EMBARGO_AI.warnSelf).sort((a, b) => b.self - a.self)[0];
  if (!o) return;
  if (embargoesBy(g, n.id, PLAYER).some(e => e.since === g.turn)) return;      // it went ahead: the letter says so
  const warned = T.warned || (T.warned = {});
  if (warned[n.id] !== undefined && g.turn - warned[n.id] < EMBARGO_AI.warnEvery) return;
  warned[n.id] = g.turn;
  const heard = embargoWhyHeard(g, { why: o.why, by: n.id, on: PLAYER }, true);
  const d = dependence(g, PLAYER, o.good).find(x => x.from === n.id);
  dispatch.warnings.push(`The ${n.name}'s merchants talk of cutting off your ${tradeGoodWord(o.good)}${heard ? `, ${heard}` : ""}.${d ? ` ${pct(d.share)} of your ${tradeGoodWord(o.good)} comes from them.` : ""} Other sellers, a trade road or a harbor would make you less dependent.`);
}

/* ---------- Food aid from rival governments, after the contracts are signed ----------
   A nation where more than 2% go hungry gets grain from the richest government that can reach it, thinks well of it
   (or is its ally or trade partner) and has 4 months of food in store. Enough for one season of the shortfall. */
function rivalFoodAid(w, g, dispatch) {
  const T = g.trade;
  if (!T || !T.v) return;
  withEconMemo(g, () => rivalFoodAidRaw(w, g, dispatch, T));
}
function rivalFoodAidRaw(w, g, dispatch, T) {
  const hungry = [];
  for (const v of liveNations(g)) { const E = computeEconomy(w, g, v.id); if (E.famineShare > EMBARGO_AI.aidFamine) hungry.push({ v, E }); }
  for (const { v, E } of hungry) {
    const donors = [];
    for (const d of liveNations(g)) {
      if (d.isPlayer || d.id === v.id || atWar(g, d.id, v.id)) continue;
      if ((T.aid || []).some(a => a.from === d.id && a.to === v.id && g.turn - a.turn < EMBARGO_AI.aidCooldown)) continue;
      if (embargoesBy(g, d.id, v.id).some(e => embargoCovers(e, "food"))) continue;
      const friendly = opinionDetail(g, d.id, v.id).value >= 0 || hasTreaty(g, d.id, v.id, "alliance") || hasTreaty(g, d.id, v.id, "trade") || tradeExposure(g, d.id, v.id).material;
      if (!friendly) continue;
      const dPop = (d.history.slice(-1)[0] || {}).pop || 0;
      const stock = (d.granary && d.granary.stock) || 0;
      if (monthsOfFood(stock, dPop) < EMBARGO_AI.aidMonths) continue;
      donors.push({ d, gdp: lastRecordedGdp(g, d.id), spare: stock - EMBARGO_AI.aidKeep * dPop / 12 });
    }
    donors.sort((a, b) => b.gdp - a.gdp || a.d.id - b.d.id);
    for (const x of donors) {
      const months = Math.min(3 * E.famineShare, x.spare / Math.max(1e-6, E.pop / 12));
      if (months <= 0.01) continue;
      const qt = foodAidQuote(w, g, x.d.id, v.id, months);
      if (!qt.ok) continue;
      const r = sendFoodAid(w, g, x.d.id, v.id, months);
      if (!r.ok) continue;
      remember(g, x.d.id, `We sent grain to the hungry ${v.name}.`);
      const text = `Sent grain to the hungry ${v.name}: food for ${fmtPeople(r.q * 12 / Math.max(1e-6, r.months))} people for ${r.months.toFixed(1)} months.`;
      if (v.isPlayer) dispatch.trade.push({ text: `The ${x.d.name} sent us grain while our people go hungry: food for ${fmtPeople(r.q * 12 / Math.max(1e-6, r.months))} people for ${r.months.toFixed(1)} months, into our reserve.`, tone: "good", nid: x.d.id, minister: "agriculture" });
      dispatch.abroad.push({ nid: x.d.id, text, why: `${pct(E.famineShare)} of their people do not have enough food.` });
      noteFor(x.d, g, text, null);
      break;
    }
  }
}

/* ---------- Comparing an imagined world with the real one ---------- */
/* The economy an imagined world (`hypothetical`) is measured against: the real one, unless imagined worlds settle trade
   by a different rule than the real game (merchants finding new sellers), in which case a copy imagined with no change,
   so that only the change itself is valued. */
function econBaseFor(w, g, nid, econ) {
  const h0 = hypothetical(g, {});
  if (!!h0.reroute === !!g.reroute && !!h0.noReroute === !!g.noReroute) return econ || computeEconomy(w, g, nid);
  return computeEconomy(w, h0, nid);
}

/* ---------- War and trade: what a war would cost in trade, and when an embargo is a just cause ---------- */
/* Output x would lose a year if all trade with y stopped (once its merchants have found other sellers), or null when
   there is no trade book yet (the old flat cost of a trade agreement applies then). A war also ends every treaty, so a
   trade agreement's buyers leave the market with it. */
function warTradeLoss(w, g, x, y, econX) {
  const T = g.trade;
  if (!T || !T.v) return null;
  const ix = tradeIndex(g);
  const treaty = hasTreaty(g, x, y, "trade");
  if (!treaty && !((ix.pairV[`${x}>${y}`] || 0) + (ix.pairV[`${y}>${x}`] || 0) > 0)) return 0;
  const h = hypothetical(g, { embargo: { id: -1, by: x, on: y, k: "all", dir: "both", food: true, since: g.turn, why: "war", hurt: 0, answers: null } });
  if (treaty) h.treaties = g.treaties.filter(t => !(t.type === "trade" && ((t.a === x && t.b === y) || (t.a === y && t.b === x))));
  return Math.max(0, econBaseFor(w, g, x, econX).gdp - computeEconomy(w, h, x).gdp);
}
/* y's embargo on x as a cause for war: food cut off while x is hungry (strong), or trade strangled (a real share of
   x's output or a key supply), while it stands or for two years after. */
function strangledTrade(g, x, y, w) {
  const T = g.trade;
  if (!T || !T.v) return null;
  let hurt = 0, food = false;
  for (const e of T.embargoes || []) if (e.by === y && e.on === x) { hurt = Math.max(hurt, e.hurt || 0); if (embargoCovers(e, "food")) food = true; }
  for (const e of T.ended || []) if (e.by === y && e.on === x && g.turn - e.turn <= EMBARGO_AI.justSeasons) hurt = Math.max(hurt, e.hurt || 0);
  if (food && w && computeEconomy(w, g, x).famineShare > EMBARGO_AI.aidFamine) return { food: true, hurt };
  return hurt >= EMBARGO_AI.justHurt ? { food: false, hurt } : null;
}

/* ---------- Letters: what a threat to cut off trade could cost them ---------- */
/* How much E stands to lose if P cut off trade: the share of a key need P fills (or of good k, when the letter names
   one), and E's sales to P against its output. strength 0..1. */
function tradeLeverage(g, E, P, k) {
  const ex = tradeExposure(g, E, P);
  let share = ex.buy ? ex.buy.share : 0, good = ex.buy ? ex.buy.k : null;
  if (k && GOODS[k] && g.trade && g.trade.need && g.trade.need[k]) {
    const q = tradeSells(g, P, E)[k] || 0, need = g.trade.need[k][E] || 0;
    if (need > 0 && q > 0) { share = Math.min(1, q / need); good = k; }
  }
  const sales = ex.sellPct / 0.03;
  const strength = clamp(Math.max(share, sales), 0, 1);
  const byShare = share >= sales && good;
  return { strength, k: good,
    why: byShare ? `they buy ${pct(share)} of their ${tradeGoodWord(good)} from you` : `they sell you goods worth ${pct1(ex.sellPct)} of their output`,
    whyUs: byShare ? `we buy ${pct(share)} of our ${tradeGoodWord(good)} from you` : `we sell you goods worth ${pct1(ex.sellPct)} of our output` };
}
/* A good named in a letter ("your oil", "grain"), or null. */
function goodInText(t) {
  const words = [["food", /\b(food|grain|wheat|bread|harvests?)\b/], ["oil", /\b(oil|gas|petrol|fuel)\b/], ["metals", /\b(metals?|iron|steel|copper)\b/], ["coal", /\bcoal\b/], ["timber", /\b(timber|wood|lumber)\b/],
    ["gold", /\bgold\b/], ["machinery", /\b(machinery|machines|tools)\b/], ["chemicals", /\bchemicals?\b/], ["electronics", /\belectronics\b/], ["goods", /\bconsumer goods\b/]];
  for (const [k, re] of words) if (re.test(t)) return k;
  return null;
}

/* ---------- Briefs for Claude: one line of trade per nation, and per pair ---------- */
function tradeBrief(g, n, econ) {
  const T = g.trade;
  if (!T || !T.v) return "Trade: no contracts yet.";
  const tr = tradeOf(g, n.id);
  const who = id => (id < 0 ? "the world market" : `the ${nameOf(g, id)}`);
  const val = x => x.v || 0;
  // the goods worth most, each with its two main sellers and buyers, grouped by partner
  const goods = Object.entries(tr.goods).map(([k, G]) => ({ k, G, v: G.from.reduce((s, f) => s + (f.code ? 0 : val(f)), 0) + G.to.reduce((s, f) => s + (f.code ? 0 : val(f)), 0) })).sort((a, b) => b.v - a.v).slice(0, 6);
  const buys = new Map(), sells = new Map();
  const put = (m, id, text) => { if (!m.has(id)) m.set(id, []); m.get(id).push(text); };
  for (const { k, G } of goods) {
    for (const f of G.from.filter(f => !f.code).slice(0, 2)) put(buys, f.nid, `${tradeGoodWord(k)}${f.share >= 0.05 ? ` (${pct(f.share)} of our need)` : ""}`);
    for (const f of G.to.filter(f => !f.code).slice(0, 2)) put(sells, f.nid, tradeGoodWord(k));
  }
  const list = m => [...m].map(([id, gs]) => `${bJoin(gs)} ${m === buys ? "from" : "to"} ${who(id)}`).join("; ");
  const on = embargoesOn(g, n.id).map(e => `the ${nameOf(g, e.by)} ${embargoVerb(e)} us since ${seasonLabel(e.since)}`);
  const by = embargoesBy(g, n.id).map(e => `we ${embargoVerb(e)} ${theNation(g, e.on)} since ${seasonLabel(e.since)} (${embargoAim(g, n.id, e.on, e.why)})`);
  const closed = econ && econ.trade && !(econ.trade.worldImportCapRaw > 0);
  return `Trade (a year): we buy ${list(buys) || "nothing from abroad"}; we sell ${list(sells) || "nothing abroad"}${closed ? `; the world market beyond the map is closed to us${tr.goods.gold && tr.goods.gold.to.some(f => f.nid < 0) ? ", except for gold (its banks buy all we mine)" : ""}: we have no harbor on the ocean, and no trade partner with one` : ""}${on.length ? `. Embargoes on us: ${on.join("; ")}` : ""}${by.length ? `. Our embargoes: ${by.join("; ")}` : ""}.`;
}
function tradeRelationBrief(g, a, b) {
  const T = g.trade;
  if (!T || !T.v) return "";
  const t = tradeWith(g, a, b);
  const part = (o, whose) => Object.entries(o).filter(([, x]) => !x.blocked && x.v >= 0.05).sort((p, q) => q[1].v - p[1].v).slice(0, 3).map(([k, x]) => `${tradeGoodWord(k)} ${fmtMoney(x.v)}${x.shareOfNeed >= 0.05 ? ` (${pct(x.shareOfNeed)} of ${whose} need)` : ""}`);
  const weSell = part(t.aSells, "their"), weBuy = part(t.bSells, "our");
  const emb = t.embargoes.map(e => (e.by === a ? `our embargo: we ${embargoVerb(e)} them` : `their embargo: they ${embargoVerb(e)} us`));
  const link = t.link ? { land: "across our border", over: "by caravan across wild land", sea: `by sea, ${Math.round(t.link.d).toLocaleString("en-US")} km` }[t.link.m] : null;
  if (!weSell.length && !weBuy.length && !emb.length) return link ? `; trade: none yet, though goods could pass ${link}` : "";
  return `; trade a year${link ? ` (${link})` : ""}: we sell them ${weSell.join(", ") || "nothing"}, we buy from them ${weBuy.join(", ") || "nothing"}${emb.length ? `; ${emb.join("; ")}` : ""}${t.promise ? `; the ${nameOf(g, t.promise.by)} was paid to lift an embargo on the ${nameOf(g, t.promise.on)} and promised not to bring it back before ${seasonLabel(t.promise.until)}` : ""}`;
}
/* For the letter analyst: who each nation trades with and its embargoes, so claims of dependence can be checked. */
function tradeFacts(g, nid) {
  const T = g.trade;
  if (!T || !T.v) return "";
  const tr = tradeOf(g, nid);
  const ps = tr.partners.filter(p => !p.blocked && p.sellV + p.buyV > 0.01).slice(0, 3).map(p => `${nameOf(g, p.nid)} (sells them ${bJoin(Object.keys(p.sell).map(tradeGoodWord)) || "nothing"}, buys ${bJoin(Object.keys(p.buy).map(tradeGoodWord)) || "nothing"})`);
  const emb = embargoesBy(g, nid).map(e => `${embargoVerb(e)} ${nameOf(g, e.on)}`);
  return `${ps.length ? `, trades with ${ps.join(", ")}` : ""}${emb.length ? `, has ${emb.join(" and ")}` : ""}`;
}

/* ---------- The World Assembly: hunger as a weapon, and a nation that bullies its partners ---------- */
function tradeTopicCandidates(w, g, ready, recent) {
  const T = g.trade;
  const out = [];
  if (!T || !T.v) return out;
  for (const e of T.embargoes || []) {
    if (!embargoCovers(e, "food") || !g.nations[e.on].alive || !g.nations[e.by].alive) continue;
    if (recent("condemn", t => t.target === e.by) || computeEconomy(w, g, e.on).famineShare <= EMBARGO_AI.aidFamine) continue;
    const authors = [e.on, ...alliesOf(g, e.on)].filter(id => id !== e.by && ready(id));
    if (authors.length) out.push({ score: 2.5, spec: { kind: "condemn", author: authors[0], target: e.by, why: "starve" } });
  }
  for (const z of liveNations(g)) {
    const mine = (T.embargoes || []).filter(e => e.by === z.id && e.why !== "retaliation");
    if (mine.length < EMBARGO_AI.bully || recent("condemn", t => t.target === z.id)) continue;
    const author = mine.map(e => e.on).sort((a, b) => a - b).find(id => ready(id));
    if (author !== undefined) out.push({ score: 1.5, spec: { kind: "condemn", author, target: z.id, why: "bully" } });
  }
  return out;
}
/* =====================================================================
   10l. Depth: work and the people who move for it, the national food reserve, smelters at the mines,
        soldiers who learn from battle, and the seasons that every general has to reckon with
   ===================================================================== */

/* ---------- Jobs: who works where, and who has no work ----------
   Farms and the mines, plants and offices built in a town give work first. Everyone else needs a job in the
   shops, transport, offices, schools and hospitals, and there are only as many of those as the town can pay for:
   a share of its people, more where roads reach a big market, more for every job in industry (wages spent in town,
   suppliers, repairs), and the public jobs that healthcare and education laws pay for. */
const JOBS = {
  base: 0.42,          // jobs in shops, transport, repairs and offices any town has, per worker
  market: 0.25,        // more where roads (or ships) reach a big market
  perIndustry: 1.5,    // service jobs each job in a mine, plant or office supports
  public: 0.04, health: 0.015, edu: 0.015, capital: 0.02,   // administration, hospitals, schools; ministries in the capital
  natural: 0.04,       // some people are always between jobs
  stabK: 50, stabCap: 12,
  smallVA: 0.4,        // a smallholder on a family plot makes 40% of what a farm worker makes
  smallMove: 0.35,     // smallholders are less ready to leave than the jobless
};
function pct1(x) { return x > 0 && x < 0.1 ? `${(x * 100).toFixed(1)}%` : pct(x); }
function publicJobShare(n, laws) {
  const L = laws || (n && n.laws) || {};
  return JOBS.public + JOBS.health * Math.max(0, SERVICE_ORDER.indexOf(L.services || "basic")) + JOBS.edu * Math.max(0, EDU_ORDER.indexOf(L.education || "basic")) + modSum(n, "jobs");
}
function unemploymentStabTerm(n, econ, laws) {
  const u = econ.unemployment || 0;
  if (u <= JOBS.natural + 0.005) return null;
  const welfare = { minimal: 1, basic: 0.9, good: 0.75, generous: 0.55 }[(laws || n.laws).services] ?? 1;
  const soft = welfare * (1 - Math.min(0.6, modSum(n, "jobRelief")));
  const v = -Math.min(JOBS.stabCap, JOBS.stabK * (u - JOBS.natural)) * soft;
  if (v > -0.05) return null;
  return { label: `Unemployment: ${pct1(u)} of workers have no job${soft < 0.8 ? " (eased by welfare and relief)" : ""}`, value: v };
}

/* ---------- People move for work: from towns without jobs to towns with work, and away from hunger ---------- */
const MIGR = { share: 0.15, cutoff: 0.4, famine: 0.04, intake: 0.03, minFlow: 0.002, minTown: 0.02, maxIn: 0.25, maxOut: 0.12 };
function townURate(r) { return r.workforce > 1e-6 ? (r.unemployed || 0) / r.workforce : 0; }
/* Who would like to leave a town for work: the jobless, and some of the smallholders scraping by on family plots. */
function townLeaveRate(r) { return r.workforce > 1e-6 ? ((r.unemployed || 0) + JOBS.smallMove * (r.smallholders || 0)) / r.workforce : 0; }
function cellsPop(g, cells) { let s = 0; for (const c of cells) s += g.pop[c]; return s; }
/* Take people out of a town's land, evenly; returns how many actually left. */
function takePeople(g, cells, people) {
  const have = cellsPop(g, cells);
  const take = Math.min(people, have * MIGR.maxOut);
  if (!(take > 0) || !(have > 0)) return 0;
  const f = 1 - take / have;
  for (const c of cells) g.pop[c] *= f;
  return take;
}
/* Settle newcomers in a town's land, more where more people already live (in the town itself if it is empty). */
function givePeople(g, cells, townCell, people) {
  const have = cellsPop(g, cells);
  if (!(have > 1e-4)) { g.pop[townCell] += people; return; }
  for (const c of cells) g.pop[c] += people * g.pop[c] / have;
}
function migrateNation(w, g, n, econ) {
  const regions = econ.regions;
  const out = { turn: g.turn, flows: [], moved: 0 };
  if (regions.length < 2) { n.migr = out; return out; }
  const capNet = econ.networks.findIndex(x => x.capital);
  const lfS = (econ.people && econ.people.lf) || ECON7.workShare;
  const family = 1 / lfS;                      // each worker who moves brings a family
  // how many workers each town can take in this season: the jobs waiting there, a few more, and never more than a quarter of the town
  const room = new Map(regions.map(r => [r, r.pop < MIGR.minTown || cityClosed(g, r.city) ? 0 : Math.max(0, Math.min((r.vacancies || 0) + MIGR.intake * r.workforce, MIGR.maxIn * r.workforce))]));
  const plan = [];
  const add = (a, b, workers, why) => { if (workers * family >= MIGR.minFlow * 0.25) plan.push({ a, b, people: workers * family, why }); };
  // the jobless go where the work is: along the roads (and sea lanes) of their own network, or from a cut-off town to the capital's market
  const sources = regions.filter(r => townLeaveRate(r) > JOBS.natural + 0.02 && (r.unemployed || 0) + (r.smallholders || 0) > 0.002).sort((a, b) => townLeaveRate(b) - townLeaveRate(a));
  for (const a of sources) {
    const ua = townLeaveRate(a);
    const dests = regions.filter(b => b !== a && room.get(b) > 0.0005 && townURate(b) < ua - 0.03 && (b.net === a.net || b.net === capNet) && networkFed(econ, b));
    if (!dests.length) continue;
    const natInc = econ.people ? econ.people.bill / Math.max(0.001, econ.pop) : 0;
    const weight = b => room.get(b) * (1 + (b.market || 0)) * (b.net === a.net ? 1 : MIGR.cutoff) * (ua - townURate(b)) / (1 + dist(a.city.cell, b.city.cell) / 15) * cityPull(g, b.city) * (natInc > 0 ? clamp((b.incomeK || natInc) / natInc, 0.5, 2) : 1);
    const W = dests.reduce((s, b) => s + weight(b), 0);
    if (!(W > 0)) continue;
    const pool = (a.unemployed || 0) + JOBS.smallMove * (a.smallholders || 0);
    const movers = pool * MIGR.share * (a.net === capNet || dests.some(b => b.net === a.net) ? 1 : MIGR.cutoff) * (1 - cityStay(g, a.city));   // after a bust, people hold on (10w)
    for (const b of dests) {
      const m = Math.min(room.get(b), movers * weight(b) / W);
      if (m <= 0) continue;
      room.set(b, room.get(b) - m);
      add(a, b, m, "work");
    }
  }
  // hunger: families leave towns where the food has run out, for any town of the nation that can feed them
  for (const a of regions) {
    if (a.foodRatio >= ECON.famineLine) continue;
    const dests = regions.filter(b => b !== a && b.foodRatio >= 1.05 && b.pop >= MIGR.minTown).sort((x, y) => dist(a.city.cell, x.city.cell) - dist(a.city.cell, y.city.cell)).slice(0, 2);
    if (!dests.length) continue;
    const leave = a.pop * MIGR.famine * lfS;
    dests.forEach((b, k) => add(a, b, Math.min(leave * (k ? 0.35 : 0.65), b.pop * 0.03 * lfS), "hunger"));
  }
  // move them, counting exactly who left and who arrived
  for (const p of plan) {
    const moved = takePeople(g, p.a.cells, p.people);
    if (moved <= 0) continue;
    givePeople(g, p.b.cells, p.b.city.cell, moved);
    const f = out.flows.find(x => x.from === p.a.city.id && x.to === p.b.city.id && x.why === p.why);
    if (f) f.people += moved; else out.flows.push({ from: p.a.city.id, to: p.b.city.id, fromCell: p.a.city.cell, toCell: p.b.city.cell, people: moved, why: p.why });
  }
  out.flows.sort((a, b) => b.people - a.people);
  out.moved = out.flows.reduce((s, f) => s + f.people, 0);
  n.migr = out;
  if (typeof REC !== "undefined" && REC) for (const f of out.flows.slice(0, 6)) if (f.people >= 0.01) REC.events.push({ t: "migrate", from: f.fromCell, to: f.toCell, people: f.people, owner: n.id, phase: "migrate" });
  return out;
}
function networkFed(econ, r) { return r.foodRatio >= ECON.famineLine; }

/* ---------- The national food reserve: grain bought from the farms in good years, released when harvests fail ---------- */
const GRANARY_ORDER = ["none", "small", "medium", "large"];
const GRANARY_LAWS = {
  none:   { label: "None",     months: 0 },
  small:  { label: "2 months", months: 2 },
  medium: { label: "4 months", months: 4 },
  large:  { label: "8 months", months: 8 },
};
const GRAN = {
  priceB: 1.0,       // $B the state pays farmers for a year's food for 1M people
  spoil: 0.01,       // share of the stock lost each season to damp, rot and rats
  fillShare: 0.0625, // at most a sixteenth of the target is bought in one season (a reserve is built up over years)
  startShare: 1,     // new nations start with their reserve full
};
function granaryMonths(laws) { return (GRANARY_LAWS[(laws && laws.granary) || "none"] || GRANARY_LAWS.none).months; }
function granaryFillWant(stock, target, pop) { return target > stock ? Math.min(target - stock, Math.max(GRAN.fillShare * target, 0.005 * pop)) : 0; }
/* The plan for this season, before the harvest is known: what the state wants to buy, and what it holds. */
function granaryPlan(nation, pop) {
  const months = granaryMonths(nation && nation.laws);
  const stock = (nation && nation.granary && nation.granary.stock) || 0;
  const target = pop * months / 12;
  return { months, stock, target, fillWant: granaryFillWant(stock, target, pop), fill: 0, spare: 0, release: 0, short: 0, pop };
}
/* What filling the reserve would cost under a given law (so a law change shows its price before it is made). */
function granaryCost(n, econ, laws) {
  const G = econ.granary;
  if (!G) return { fill: 0, cost: 0 };
  const target = G.pop * granaryMonths(laws) / 12;
  const fill = Math.min(granaryFillWant(G.stock, target, G.pop), G.spare);
  return { fill, cost: fill * GRAN.priceB };
}
function fmt1(v) { return v >= 10 ? Math.round(v).toString() : v.toFixed(1); }
function monthsOfFood(stock, pop) { return pop > 0.001 ? stock / (pop / 12) : 0; }
/* After the season: what was bought goes in, what was released comes out, and some always spoils. */
function settleGranary(n, econ, budget) {
  const G = n.granary || (n.granary = { stock: 0 });
  const E = econ.granary;
  if (!E) return;
  const fill = budget ? budget.granaryFill || 0 : 0;
  const before = G.stock || 0;
  const after = Math.max(0, before - E.release + fill);
  const spoiled = after * GRAN.spoil;
  G.stock = after - spoiled;
  G.last = { turn: E.turn ?? null, fill, release: E.release, spoiled, short: E.short };
  if (E.release > 0.0005) G.lastRelease = E.release;
}

/* ---------- The harvest: brought in each autumn, good or bad, and it feeds the nation for a year ----------
   Weather varies: most years are close to normal, some are rich, and now and then a bad year cuts the harvest hard.
   Fishing does not depend on it. A nation with food to spare hardly notices; one that only just feeds itself goes short. */
const HARVEST = { sd: 0.06, min: 0.8, max: 1.12, badChance: 0.07, bad: 0.85 };
function harvestFactor(n) { return n && n.harvest ? n.harvest : 1; }
function rollHarvests(w, g) {
  const rng = mulberry32((w.seed * 31 + g.turn * 7919 + 99) >>> 0);
  for (const n of g.nations) {
    if (!n.alive) continue;
    let h = 1 + gaussian(rng) * HARVEST.sd;
    if (rng() < HARVEST.badChance) h *= HARVEST.bad;
    if (n.droughtTurn != null && g.turn - n.droughtTurn <= 1) h = Math.min(h, 0.95) * 0.95;   // after a dry summer, a poor harvest at best
    n.harvest = Math.round(clamp(h, HARVEST.min, HARVEST.max) * 1000) / 1000;
    n.harvestTurn = g.turn;
  }
}
function harvestWord(h) { return h < 0.88 ? "a bad harvest" : h < 0.95 ? "a poor harvest" : h > 1.06 ? "a rich harvest" : h > 1.02 ? "a good harvest" : "a normal harvest"; }

/* ---------- Every nation starts able to fuel its first power station ----------
   A coal mine or an oil field joined to a town by road. Without one, the power stations stand idle from the first day. */
function seedFuel(w, g, n) {
  const nid = n.id;
  const has = k => g.sites.some(s => s.kind === k && g.owner[s.cell] === nid);
  if (has("coalmine") || has("oilfield")) return;
  const cities = g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === nid);
  if (!cities.length) return;
  const cands = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N_CELLS; i++) {
    if (g.owner[i] !== nid || (w.dep[i] !== 2 && w.dep[i] !== 3) || g.sites.some(s => s.cell === i)) continue;
    cands.push({ i, t: w.dep[i], d: Math.min(...cities.map(c => dist(c.cell, i))) });
  }
  cands.sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d);
  for (const c of cands.slice(0, 4)) {
    const from = cities.slice().sort((a, b) => dist(a.cell, c.i) - dist(b.cell, c.i))[0];
    const path = from.cell === c.i ? [c.i] : findRoadPath(w, g, nid, from.cell, c.i);
    if (!path || path.length > 16) continue;
    if (path.length > 1) pathEdges(path).forEach(e => g.roads.add(e));
    const kind = RES[c.t].site;
    g.sites.push({ id: g.nextId++, cell: c.i, kind, level: 1, pace: "normal", paused: false, opened: 0, extracted: 0, name: siteName(g, c.i, kind) });
    return;
  }
}

/* ---------- Smelters: the ore is smelted where it is dug ---------- */
const SMELT = { costB: 3.5, seasons: 2, vaPerUnit: 1.6, haulCut: 0.5 };
INDUSTRIES.smelter = { sector: "secondary", sub: "Metal smelting", label: "Smelter", workers: 0.02, va: 80, in: { coal: 0.5 }, power: 0.1, costB: SMELT.costB, seasons: SMELT.seasons,
  does: "Smelts the ore where it is dug. The metal is worth more than the ore and weighs less to haul. Burns coal and needs workers." };
function quoteSmelter(w, g, nid, s, base) {
  const fail = reason => ({ ok: false, kind: "smelter", siteId: s ? s.id : null, reason });
  if (!s || s.kind !== "mine") return fail("Only metal ore is smelted.");
  if (g.owner[s.cell] !== nid) return fail("Not yours.");
  if (g.occ && g.occ[s.cell] >= 0) return fail("Occupied by an enemy army.");
  if (s.exhausted) return fail("The mine is worked out.");
  if (s.smelter) return fail("It already has a smelter.");
  if (g.projects.some(p => p.kind === "smelter" && p.siteId === s.id)) return fail("A smelter is already being built here.");
  const econ = base || computeEconomy(w, g, nid);
  const x = (econ.sites || []).find(y => y.site.id === s.id);
  if (!x || x.status !== "working") return fail("The mine has to be working first.");
  const value = projectValue(w, g, nid, { smelter: s.id }, econ);
  const cost = SMELT.costB * (DIFFICULTY[w.terrain[s.cell]] || 1) * (1 + 0.2 * (s.level - 1)) * econ.constructionIndex;
  const units = s.level * (x.mult || 1);
  return { ok: true, kind: "smelter", nid, cell: s.cell, siteId: s.id, cost, seasons: SMELT.seasons, ...value, units, coal: units * INDUSTRIES.smelter.in.coal, workersNeed: units * INDUSTRIES.smelter.workers, label: `Smelter at ${s.name}` };
}
function smelterCandidates(w, g, n, econ) {
  const out = [];
  const mines = (econ.sites || []).filter(x => x.kind === "mine" && x.status === "working" && !x.site.smelter && (x.outUnits || 0) > 0.3).sort((a, b) => (b.outUnits || 0) - (a.outUnits || 0)).slice(0, 2);
  for (const x of mines) { const q = quoteSmelter(w, g, n.id, x.site, econ); if (q.ok && q.dGdp > 0) out.push(q); }
  return out;
}

/* ---------- Experience: divisions learn from every battle; replacements are green ---------- */
const EXPS = { win: 0.06, loss: 0.03, recruit: 0.1, train: 0.075, trainCap: 0.15, drill: 0.01, drillCap: 0.25, start: 0.2 };
const EXP_LEVELS = [
  { at: 0, label: "Green", note: "new to soldiering" },
  { at: 0.1, label: "Trained", note: "drilled, but untested" },
  { at: 0.3, label: "Seasoned", note: "has seen battle" },
  { at: 0.55, label: "Veteran", note: "battle-hardened" },
  { at: 0.8, label: "Elite", note: "the best troops in the land" },
];
function expFactor(d) { return 0.9 + 0.5 * clamp((d && d.exp) || 0, 0, 1); }
function expLevel(exp) { let L = EXP_LEVELS[0]; for (const x of EXP_LEVELS) if ((exp || 0) >= x.at - 1e-9) L = x; return L; }
function expRank(exp) { return EXP_LEVELS.indexOf(expLevel(exp)); }
function sideExpLine(list, side) {
  if (!list.length) return null;
  const f = list.reduce((s, d) => s + expFactor(d), 0) / list.length;
  if (Math.abs(f - 1) < 0.06) return null;
  const avg = list.reduce((s, d) => s + (d.exp || 0), 0) / list.length;
  const L = expLevel(avg);
  return { label: `${L.label} ${side === "att" ? "attackers" : "defenders"} (${L.note})`, mult: Math.round(f * 100) / 100, already: true, side };
}

/* ---------- The seasons of war ----------
   Spring thaw and autumn rains turn the fields to mud; winter brings snow, frost and frozen rivers; summer is
   the season for campaigning. Roads are the way through any season. */
const SEASON_WAR = [
  { key: "thaw", name: "Spring thaw", icon: "mud", offRoad: 0.5, rugged: 0.5, armorMove: 1.25, armorAttack: 0.8,
    note: "Melting snow turns the fields to mud: armies off the roads march slowly, and tanks bog down." },
  { key: "summer", name: "Summer", icon: "sun",
    note: "Dry ground and long days: the best season to campaign." },
  { key: "rain", name: "Autumn rains", icon: "rain", offRoad: 0.25, rugged: 0.25, armorMove: 1.1, armorAttack: 0.9,
    note: "Autumn rains soften the ground: marches off the roads are slower, and tanks struggle." },
  { key: "winter", name: "Winter", icon: "snow", offRoad: 0.5, rugged: 1, attack: 0.85, ruggedAttack: 0.7, frost: 2, mountainFrost: 0.015, frozen: true, sail: 1.25, landing: 0.8,
    note: "Snow and frost: armies off the roads move slowly and attacks are harder, above all in hills and mountains. Troops without supply freeze. Small rivers freeze over. Storms slow the ships and swamp the landing craft." },
];
function seasonWar(g) { return SEASON_WAR[(((g && g.turn) || 0) % 4 + 4) % 4]; }
function seasonEffectsList(sw) {
  const out = [];
  if (sw.offRoad) out.push(`marches off the roads ${sw.offRoad >= 0.5 ? "much " : ""}slower${sw.rugged > sw.offRoad ? " (slowest in hills and mountains)" : ""}`);
  if (sw.armorAttack) out.push(`tank attacks ${pct(1 - sw.armorAttack)} weaker`);
  if (sw.attack) out.push(`attacks ${pct(1 - sw.attack)} weaker, ${pct(1 - sw.ruggedAttack)} weaker in hills and mountains`);
  if (sw.frost) out.push("troops without supply lose men twice as fast; even supplied troops in the mountains lose some to frostbite");
  if (sw.frozen) out.push("small rivers frozen: no time lost crossing them");
  if (sw.sail) out.push(`voyages take ${pct(sw.sail - 1)} longer, landings ${pct(1 - sw.landing)} weaker`);
  return out;
}
/* The season's weight on one division's attack, for the generals' planning. */
function seasonAttackMult(w, g, d, cell) {
  const sw = seasonWar(g), t = w.terrain[cell];
  let m = 1;
  if (sw.attack) m *= t === T.HILLS || t === T.MOUNTAIN ? sw.ruggedAttack : sw.attack;
  if (sw.armorAttack && DIV_TYPES[d.type].armor) m *= sw.armorAttack;
  return m;
}

/* ---------- Where the people of a nation came from and went, last season ---------- */
function freshPopFlow(n, g) {
  const pf = { turn: g.turn, births: 0, famine: 0, war: 0, events: n.popEvents || 0, moved: 0 };
  n.popEvents = 0;
  n.popFlow = pf;
  return pf;
}

/* ---------- What the player hears about it at the end of the season ---------- */
function depthNews(w, g, n, rep) {
  const out = [];
  const name = id => (g.cities.find(c => c.id === id) || { name: "a town" }).name;
  const mg = rep.migr;
  if (mg && mg.moved >= 0.01) {
    const work = mg.flows.filter(f => f.why === "work"), hunger = mg.flows.filter(f => f.why === "hunger");
    const list = fl => fl.slice(0, 3).map(f => `${fmtPeople(f.people)} from ${name(f.from)} to ${name(f.to)}`).join(", ");
    const total = work.reduce((s, f) => s + f.people, 0);
    if (work.length === 1 && total >= 0.01) out.push({ text: `About ${fmtPeople(total)} people moved from ${name(work[0].from)} to ${name(work[0].to)} to find work.`, tone: "neutral" });
    else if (work.length > 1 && total >= 0.01) out.push({ text: `About ${fmtPeople(total)} people moved to find work: ${list(work)}.`, tone: "neutral" });
    if (hunger.length) out.push({ text: `Hungry families left for towns with food: ${list(hunger)}.`, tone: "bad" });
  }
  const G = rep.granary;
  if (G && G.release > 0.001) {
    const left = monthsOfFood((n.granary && n.granary.stock) || 0, rep.econ.pop);
    out.push({ text: `The harvest fell short, so the national granaries fed ${fmtPeople(G.release * 4)} people this season. ${left >= 0.5 ? `${fmt1(left)} months of food are left in store.` : "The granaries are now empty."}`, tone: left >= 0.5 ? "warn" : "bad" });
  }
  return out;
}


/* =====================================================================
   10m. The cabinet: ministries, the ministers who run them, and the orders they carry out
   Every government has ministers. You establish ministries, appoint ministers, talk to them and give them
   orders. Every order is one of the legal actions the game already knows (a project, a law, a measure with a
   timed effect, a division, an envoy), with its exact cost and effect shown before you approve it.
   A minister's skill makes his area a little better or worse; his character colors his advice and his loyalty.
   ===================================================================== */
const MINISTRIES = {
  interior:    { label: "Interior", icon: "police-badge", title: "Minister of the Interior", start: true,
    looks: "order and stability, roads and new towns, people who move for work, healthcare and schools, wages, pensions and the labour laws", laws: ["services", "education", "hours", "unions", "minwage", "childwork", "women", "pensions"] },
  economy:     { label: "Economy and Trade", icon: "bank", title: "Minister of the Economy",
    looks: "taxes, trade, banks, research, factories, mines and harbors", laws: ["tax", "trade", "finance", "research"] },
  agriculture: { label: "Agriculture", icon: "wheat", title: "Minister of Agriculture",
    looks: "farms, irrigation, fishing, food processing and the national food reserve", laws: ["granary"] },
  energy:      { label: "Energy", icon: "oil-pump", title: "Minister of Energy",
    looks: "power stations, coal mines, and oil and gas fields", laws: [] },
  defence:     { label: "Defence", icon: "shield", title: "Minister of Defence", start: true,
    looks: "the army and the navy, conscription, arms production and the generals", laws: ["army", "arms"] },
  foreign:     { label: "Foreign Affairs", icon: "handshake", title: "Foreign Minister",
    looks: "relations with other nations, envoys and treaties", laws: [] },
};
const MIN_ORDER = ["interior", "economy", "agriculture", "energy", "defence", "foreign"];
const CAB = {
  estShare: 0.01, estMin: 2, estMax: 6,           // establishing a ministry: 1% of a year's output, $2-6B
  upkeepShare: 0.0003, upkeepMin: 0.03,           // each ministry costs 0.03% of a year's output every season
  stab: 0.8, output: 0.005, food: 0.015, power: 0.03, drill: 0.04, opinion: 2,   // per skill level above or below 3
  autoTotal: 0.03,                                 // all ministers together spend at most 3% of a year's output a season on their own
  overrule: 8, approve: 2, resignAt: 20,
  limits: [0, 0.005, 0.015, 0.03],               // what a minister may spend on his own each season, as a share of a year's output
};
const MIN_TRAITS = {
  honest:    { label: "Honest",    note: "never takes a bribe", clash: "corrupt" },
  corrupt:   { label: "Corrupt",   note: "takes bribes: −1% tax revenue, and a scandal may break", clash: "honest" },
  careful:   { label: "Careful",   note: "warns against costly or risky orders", clash: "bold" },
  bold:      { label: "Bold",      note: "likes big plans and seldom objects", clash: "careful" },
  loyal:     { label: "Loyal",     note: "stays loyal even when overruled", clash: "ambitious" },
  ambitious: { label: "Ambitious", note: "works hard to rise (half a skill level more), but hates being overruled", clash: "loyal" },
  popular:   { label: "Popular",   note: "liked by the people: +1 stability; dismissing this minister costs 3 more stability", clash: null },
  stubborn:  { label: "Stubborn",  note: "objects more often, and takes being overruled harder", clash: "bold" },
};
const LAW_NAMES = { tax: "Taxes", services: "Healthcare", education: "Education", research: "Research funding", trade: "Trade policy", finance: "Financial regulation", army: "Conscription", arms: "Arms production", granary: "Food reserve", hours: "Working hours", unions: "Trade unions", minwage: "Minimum wage", childwork: "Child labour", women: "Women at work", pensions: "Pensions" };
function lawSteps(law) {
  return { services: SERVICE_ORDER, education: EDU_ORDER, research: RESEARCH_ORDER, trade: TRADE_ORDER, finance: FINANCE_ORDER, army: ARMY_ORDER, arms: ARMS_ORDER, granary: GRANARY_ORDER }[law] || (LABOUR[law] ? LABOUR[law].order : null);
}
function lawValueLabel(law, v) {
  if (law === "tax") return taxLaw(v).label.toLowerCase() + ` (${v}%)`;
  const T = { services: SERVICE_LAWS, education: EDU_LAWS, research: RESEARCH_LAWS, trade: TRADE_LAWS, finance: FINANCE_LAWS, army: ARMY_LAWS, arms: ARMS_LAWS }[law];
  if (law === "granary") return GRANARY_LAWS[v].months ? `${GRANARY_LAWS[v].months} months of food` : "no store";
  if (LABOUR[law]) { const x = LABOUR[law].vals[v]; return x ? `${x.label.toLowerCase()}${x.sub ? ` (${x.sub})` : ""}` : String(v); }
  return T && T[v] ? (T[v].label || v).toLowerCase() : String(v);
}

/* ---------- Ministers ---------- */
function ministerTaken(g) {
  const s = new Set();
  const add = name => { s.add(name); s.add(name.split(" ").pop()); };
  for (const z of g.nations) {
    if (z.leader) add(z.leader.name);
    const C = z.cabinet;
    if (!C) continue;
    for (const k in C.min) if (C.min[k].minister) add(C.min[k].minister.name);
    for (const k in C.cands || {}) for (const m of C.cands[k].list || []) add(m.name);
  }
  return s;
}
function makeMinister(g, n, key, rng, skillBias = 0) {
  const sex = rng() < 0.42 ? "f" : "m";
  const taken = ministerTaken(g);
  let name = "";
  for (let k = 0; k < 60; k++) {
    const first = pick(rng, LEADER_FIRST[sex]), last = pick(rng, LEADER_LAST);
    name = `${first} ${last}`;
    if (!taken.has(name) && (k >= 20 || !taken.has(last))) break;   // a new surname if possible, never the same full name
  }
  const r = rng() + skillBias;
  const skill = r < 0.12 ? 1 : r < 0.36 ? 2 : r < 0.7 ? 3 : r < 0.92 ? 4 : 5;
  const keys = Object.keys(MIN_TRAITS);
  const weights = { corrupt: 0.55, popular: 0.8, stubborn: 0.8 };
  const traits = [];
  while (traits.length < 2) {
    const t = pickBy(rng, keys, k => weights[k] || 1);
    if (traits.includes(t) || traits.some(x => MIN_TRAITS[x].clash === t || MIN_TRAITS[t].clash === x)) continue;
    traits.push(t);
  }
  const mm = { id: g.nextId++, name, sex, age: 34 + Math.floor(rng() * 30), skill, traits, loyalty: 55 + Math.floor(rng() * 26), since: g.turn, face: Math.floor(rng() * 1e6), key, overruled: 0 };
  mm.group = ministerGroupPick(key, mm.face);
  return mm;
}
function hisHer(m) { return m && m.sex === "f" ? "her" : "his"; }
function himHer(m) { return m && m.sex === "f" ? "her" : "him"; }
function heShe(m) { return m && m.sex === "f" ? "she" : "he"; }
function minHas(m, t) { return !!(m && m.traits && m.traits.includes(t)); }
function ministry(n, key) { return n && n.cabinet ? n.cabinet.min[key] || null : null; }
function ministryActive(n, key) { const M = ministry(n, key); return !!(M && !M.pending && M.minister); }
function ministerSkill(m) { return m ? m.skill + (minHas(m, "ambitious") ? 0.5 : 0) : 3; }
/* How far a ministry's minister lifts (or drags) his area: skill 3 is the plain civil service, 5 is the best, 1 is a liability. */
function cabinetK(n, key) { return ministryActive(n, key) ? ministerSkill(ministry(n, key).minister) - 3 : 0; }
function establishCost(econ) { return clamp(Math.round(econ.gdp * CAB.estShare * 10) / 10, CAB.estMin, CAB.estMax); }
function ministryUpkeep(econ) { return Math.max(CAB.upkeepMin, econ.gdp * CAB.upkeepShare); }
function cabinetUpkeep(n, econ) {
  if (!n || !n.cabinet) return 0;
  let k = 0;
  for (const key of MIN_ORDER) { const M = n.cabinet.min[key]; if (M && !M.pending) k++; }
  return k * ministryUpkeep(econ);
}
function newMinistry(g, minister, pending) { return { minister, pending: !!pending, since: g.turn, auto: false, limit: 1, chat: [], log: [], cool: {} }; }
function initCabinet(g, n, rng) {
  const C = n.cabinet = { min: {}, cands: {} };
  const keys = n.isPlayer || n.minor ? ["interior", "defence"]
    : ["interior", "defence", "economy", "foreign", ...({ agrarian: ["agriculture"], mercantile: [], militarist: [], expansionist: [] }[n.archetype] || [])];
  for (const key of keys) C.min[key] = newMinistry(g, makeMinister(g, n, key, rng, n.isPlayer ? 0.05 : 0), false);
  return C;
}
function initCabinets(g, rng) { if (g.cabSalt === undefined) g.cabSalt = Math.floor(rng() * 1e9); for (const n of g.nations) if (!n.cabinet) initCabinet(g, n, rng); }

/* Three people who could take a ministry; the list stays the same for a year unless someone is appointed. */
function candidatesFor(g, n, key) {
  const C = n.cabinet;
  const c = C.cands[key];
  if (c && g.turn - c.turn < 4 && c.list.length) return c.list;
  let h = 0;
  for (const ch of n.name) h = (h * 31 + ch.charCodeAt(0)) >>> 0;
  if (g.cabSalt === undefined) g.cabSalt = Math.floor(Math.random() * 1e9);
  const rng = mulberry32((g.turn * 7393 + n.id * 131 + MIN_ORDER.indexOf(key) * 17 + 3 + h + g.cabSalt) >>> 0);
  C.cands[key] = { turn: g.turn, list: [0, 1, 2].map(i => makeMinister(g, n, key, rng, i === 0 ? 0.1 : 0)) };
  return C.cands[key].list;
}

/* ---------- What the cabinet does for the nation without being asked: the minister's skill at work ---------- */
function cabinetField(n, field) { return cabinetFieldBase(n, field) + groupField(n, field); }
function cabinetFieldBase(n, field) {
  if (!n || !n.cabinet) return 0;
  if (field === "output") return CAB.output * cabinetK(n, "economy");
  if (field === "food") return CAB.food * cabinetK(n, "agriculture");
  if (field === "power") return CAB.power * cabinetK(n, "energy");
  if (field === "revenue") {
    let s = 0;
    for (const key of MIN_ORDER) if (ministryActive(n, key) && minHas(n.cabinet.min[key].minister, "corrupt")) s -= 0.01;
    return s;
  }
  return 0;
}
function cabinetStabTerms(n) {
  const out = [];
  if (!n || !n.cabinet) return out;
  const k = cabinetK(n, "interior");
  if (Math.abs(k) >= 0.25) out.push({ label: `${n.cabinet.min.interior.minister.name}, ${k > 0 ? "a capable" : "a weak"} Minister of the Interior`, value: CAB.stab * k });
  for (const key of MIN_ORDER) if (ministryActive(n, key) && minHas(n.cabinet.min[key].minister, "popular")) out.push({ label: `${n.cabinet.min[key].minister.name} is a popular minister`, value: 1 });
  return out;
}
function drillCapFor(n) { return EXPS.drillCap + CAB.drill * cabinetK(n, "defence") + groupField(n, "drill"); }
function foreignOpinionItem(B) {
  const k = cabinetK(B, "foreign");
  if (Math.abs(k) < 0.25) return null;
  return { label: `Their foreign minister ${B.cabinet.min.foreign.minister.name}`, value: Math.round(CAB.opinion * k) };
}
/* Which ministry looks after a project. */
function projectArea(q) {
  switch (q.kind) {
    case "road": case "town": return "interior";
    case "irrigation": return "agriculture";
    case "port": case "portup": case "wharf": case "smelter": case "survey": return "economy";
    case "ships": return "defence";
    case "industry": return /^power_/.test(q.ind) ? "energy" : q.ind === "foodproc" ? "agriculture" : "economy";
    case "focus": return FOCI[q.focus] ? FOCI[q.focus].area : "interior";
    case "site": return q.siteKind === "coalmine" || q.siteKind === "oilfield" ? "energy" : q.siteKind === "fishing" ? "agriculture" : "economy";
    default: return null;
  }
}

/* ---------- Orders: everything a ministry can do now, with exact costs and effects ---------- */
function atWarAny(g, nid) { return liveNations(g).some(z => z.id !== nid && atWar(g, nid, z.id)); }
function round1(v) { return Math.round(v * 10) / 10; }
function slugId(s) { return s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, "-").replace(/^-|-$/g, "").slice(0, 48); }
let cabinetCache = null;
/* The projects the government could start, from the same list the rival governments choose from. */
function cabinetProjects(w, g, n, econ) {
  const key = `${g.turn}|${n.id}|${g.projects.length}|${Math.round(n.treasury)}|${g.sites.length}|${g.cities.length}|${g.roads.size}`;
  if (cabinetCache && cabinetCache.key === key && cabinetCache.g === g) return cabinetCache.list;
  let list = [];
  try { list = aiCandidates(w, g, n, econ).filter(q => q && q.ok !== false && projectArea(q)); } catch (e) { console.warn("cabinet projects", e); list = []; }
  for (const x of econ.sites || []) {
    if (x.kind !== "mine" || x.status !== "working" || x.site.smelter) continue;
    if (list.some(q => q.kind === "smelter" && q.siteId === x.site.id)) continue;
    const q = quoteSmelter(w, g, n.id, x.site, econ);
    if (q.ok) list.push(q);
  }
  cabinetCache = { key, g, list };
  return list;
}
function projectOrder(w, g, n, econ, q) {
  const cost = q.cost;
  const lines = [`${fmtMoney(cost)}, ready in ${q.seasons} season${q.seasons > 1 ? "s" : ""}`];
  if (Math.abs(q.dGdp || 0) >= 0.05) lines.push(`Output ${fmtSignedMoney(q.dGdp)} a year`);
  if ((q.dFood || 0) > 0.01) lines.push(`Food for ${fmtPeople(q.dFood)} more people`);
  if ((q.famineRelief || 0) > 0.01) lines.push(`Ends hunger for ${fmtPeople(q.famineRelief)}`);
  if (q.reconnected > 0) lines.push(`Joins ${q.reconnected} cut-off town${q.reconnected > 1 ? "s" : ""} to the capital`);
  const parts = [q.cityId, q.ind, q.siteKind, q.siteId, q.cell, q.site, q.toCell, q.level, q.focus, q.path && q.path.length ? `${q.path[0]}-${q.path[q.path.length - 1]}` : null].filter(v => v !== undefined && v !== null);
  return { id: `p:${q.kind}:${parts.join(":")}`, kind: "project", group: "Projects", label: q.label, cost, lines, q,
    score: ((q.value ?? q.dGdp ?? 0) / Math.max(0.5, cost)) * 2 + (q.famineRelief > 0.05 ? 1 : 0) };
}
function lawOrder(w, g, n, econ, law, value, base) {
  const after = forecast(w, g, n.id, { ...n.laws, [law]: value });
  const dBal = after.budget.balance - base.budget.balance;
  const dStab = after.target - base.target;
  const lines = [];
  if (Math.abs(dBal) >= 0.01) lines.push(`Budget ${fmtSignedMoney(dBal)} a season`);
  if (Math.abs(dStab) >= 0.5) lines.push(`Stability will ${dStab > 0 ? "rise" : "fall"} ${Math.abs(Math.round(dStab))} point${Math.abs(Math.round(dStab)) > 1 ? "s" : ""}`);
  let below = false;
  if (law === "army") {
    const allowed = ARMY_LAWS[value].share * econ.pop * 1e6, now = (n.mil && n.mil.men) || 0;
    below = allowed < now;
    lines.push(`Up to ${fmtCount(allowed)} may serve${below ? ` (fewer than the ${fmtCount(now)} under arms now)` : ""}`);
  }
  if (law === "granary") lines.push(GRANARY_LAWS[value].months ? `Keeps ${GRANARY_LAWS[value].months} months of food in store` : "No food is kept in store");
  if (law === "research") lines.push("Changes how fast new technologies come");
  if (law === "education") lines.push("Changes how skilled your workers become");
  if (law === "trade") lines.push(`Tariff ${pct(TRADE_LAWS[value].tariff)} on imports`);
  if (law === "finance") lines.push(value === "loose" ? "Faster private investment, more risk of a banking crisis" : value === "strict" ? "Safer banks, slower private investment" : "The middle way for banks");
  if (!lines.length) lines.push("Little change this season");
  return { id: `law:${law}:${value}`, kind: "law", group: "Laws", law, value, label: `${LAW_NAMES[law]}: ${lawValueLabel(law, value)}`, cost: 0, lines,
    dBal, dStab, below, score: 0 };
}
function fxOrder(id, label, effects, g, nid, extra = {}) {
  const ge = fxGroupEffect(id, label);
  if (ge) effects = effects.concat([ge]);
  const lines = effects.map(e => effectText(g, e, nid).text).filter(Boolean);
  const cost = Math.max(0, -effects.filter(e => e.t === "money").reduce((s, e) => s + e.v, 0));
  return { id, kind: "fx", group: "Measures", label, effects, lines, cost, score: 0, ...extra };
}
function cooling(n, key, id, seasons, g) { const M = ministry(n, key); return M && M.cool && M.cool[id] !== undefined && g.turn - M.cool[id] < seasons; }
function specialOrders(w, g, n, econ, key) {
  const out = [], Y = econ.gdp, nid = n.id;
  const money = share => -Math.max(0.2, round1(Y * share));
  if (key === "interior") {
    const u = econ.unemployment || 0;
    if (!modFlag(n, "jobs") && !cooling(n, key, "fx:publicworks", 6, g)) out.push(fxOrder("fx:publicworks", "Public works: roads, dams and schools", [{ t: "money", v: money(0.012) }, { t: "mod", key: "public_works", label: "Public works", jobs: 0.03, stab: 1, seasons: 6 }], g, nid, { score: u > 0.05 ? 3 : u > 0.03 ? 1 : -1 }));
    if (!(n.mods || []).some(m => m.key === "relief") && !cooling(n, key, "fx:relief", 8, g)) out.push(fxOrder("fx:relief", "Pay unemployment relief", [{ t: "mod", key: "relief", label: "Unemployment relief", jobRelief: 0.5, revenue: -0.02, seasons: 8 }], g, nid, { score: u > 0.06 ? 2 : -1 }));
    if (n.stability < 50 && !cooling(n, key, "fx:crackdown", 8, g)) out.push(fxOrder("fx:crackdown", "Police crackdown on unrest", [{ t: "stab", v: 4 }, { t: "mod", key: "crackdown_memory", label: "People remember the police crackdown", stab: -1, seasons: 8 }], g, nid, { score: n.stability < 30 ? 2 : -1 }));
    if (!cooling(n, key, "fx:festival", 8, g)) out.push(fxOrder("fx:festival", "A national holiday with parades and fairs", [{ t: "money", v: money(0.002) }, { t: "stab", v: 2 }], g, nid, { score: n.stability < 40 ? 1 : -1 }));
    const sad = econ.regions.filter(r => (r.city.mood ?? 55) < 45 && !(r.city.mods || []).some(m => m.key === "citycare" && (m.until === null || m.until > g.turn))).sort((a, b) => (a.city.mood ?? 55) - (b.city.mood ?? 55))[0];
    if (sad && !cooling(n, key, `fx:citycare:${sad.city.id}`, 6, g)) out.push(fxOrder(`fx:citycare:${sad.city.id}`, `A program for ${sad.city.name}: housing, clinics, schools and police`, [{ t: "money", v: -Math.max(0.2, round1((sad.gdp || 0) * 0.015)) }, { t: "cityMod", cityId: sad.city.id, key: "citycare", label: "A government program for the city", mood: 8, seasons: 6 }], g, nid, { score: (sad.city.mood ?? 55) < 32 ? 2 : 0.5 }));
  }
  if (key === "economy") {
    if (!cooling(n, key, "fx:wealthtax", 8, g)) out.push(fxOrder("fx:wealthtax", "A one-off tax on the rich", [{ t: "money", v: Math.max(0.2, round1(Y * 0.006)) }, { t: "stab", v: -2 }, { t: "capital", v: -round1(Y * 0.01) }], g, nid, { score: n.treasury < -0.2 * Y ? 1 : -1 }));
    if (!(n.mods || []).some(m => m.key === "stimulus") && !cooling(n, key, "fx:stimulus", 6, g)) out.push(fxOrder("fx:stimulus", "Stimulus spending", [{ t: "money", v: money(0.012) }, { t: "mod", key: "stimulus", label: "Stimulus spending", output: 0.02, seasons: 4 }], g, nid, { score: (econ.unemployment || 0) > 0.04 && n.treasury > 0 ? 1 : -1 }));
    if ((n.laws.trade || "balanced") !== "protect" && tradeOpen(econ) && !cooling(n, key, "fx:investors", 12, g)) out.push(fxOrder("fx:investors", "Invite foreign investors", [{ t: "money", v: money(0.002) }, { t: "capital", v: round1(Y * 0.008) }], g, nid, { score: 0.5 }));
    out.push(...economyTradeOrders(w, g, n, econ));
  }
  if (key === "agriculture") {
    if (!(n.mods || []).some(m => m.key === "farm_subsidy") && !cooling(n, key, "fx:farmsub", 8, g)) out.push(fxOrder("fx:farmsub", "Farm subsidies", [{ t: "money", v: money(0.008) }, { t: "mod", key: "farm_subsidy", label: "Farm subsidies", food: 0.05, seasons: 8 }], g, nid, { score: (econ.famineShare || 0) > 0.01 ? 3 : econ.food / Math.max(0.1, econ.pop) < 1.1 ? 1 : -1 }));
    const months = monthsOfFood((n.granary && n.granary.stock) || 0, econ.pop);
    if (months < 8 && !cooling(n, key, "fx:buygrain", 2, g)) {
      // the grain comes from the cheapest seller we can reach, at its price at our border (10s); without a book, the old world-market price
      const offer = g.trade && g.trade.v ? grainOffers(w, g, nid)[0] || null : econ.access > 0 ? { nid: -1, p: GRAN.priceB * 1.6 } : null;
      const score = months < 1 && harvestFactor(n) < 0.95 ? 2 : -1;
      if (offer) {
        const o = fxOrder("fx:buygrain", offer.nid < 0 ? "Buy grain on the world market for the reserve" : `Buy grain from the ${nameOf(g, offer.nid)} for the reserve`, [{ t: "money", v: -Math.max(0.1, round1(econ.pop / 12 * offer.p)) }, { t: "granary", months: 1 }], g, nid, { score, good: "food", target: offer.nid >= 0 ? offer.nid : undefined });
        if (offer.price) o.lines.push(`Price at our border: ${bMoney(offer.p)} for a year's food for a million people (the cheapest seller we can reach)`);
        out.push(o);
      } else if (g.trade && g.trade.v) out.push({ id: "fx:buygrain", kind: "fx", group: "Measures", label: "Buy grain abroad for the reserve", effects: [], lines: [], cost: 0, score: -9, good: "food",
        blocked: tradeOpen(econ) ? "No nation we can reach has grain to spare, and the world market is closed to us." : "We cannot buy grain abroad: no nation can reach us, and the world market is closed to us (we need a harbor on the ocean, or a trade partner who has one)." });
    }
    out.push(...grainTradeOrders(w, g, n, econ, key, months));
  }
  if (key === "energy") {
    for (const x of (econ.sites || []).filter(x => (x.kind === "coalmine" || x.kind === "oilfield") && x.status === "working")) {
      const s = x.site;
      if (s.pace !== "fast" && !modFlag(n, "noFast")) out.push(fxOrder(`pace:${s.id}:fast`, `Work ${s.name} intensively`, [{ t: "sitePace", siteId: s.id, pace: "fast" }], g, nid, { group: "Mines and fields", score: (econ.sat.power ?? 1) < 0.9 ? 1.5 : -1, lines2: ["More coal or oil now; the deposit runs out sooner"] }));
      if (s.pace === "fast") out.push(fxOrder(`pace:${s.id}:normal`, `Work ${s.name} at a normal pace`, [{ t: "sitePace", siteId: s.id, pace: "normal" }], g, nid, { group: "Mines and fields", score: -1 }));
    }
  }
  if (key === "defence") {
    const towns = g.cities.filter(c => c.owner === nid && g.occ[c.cell] < 0).sort((a, b) => (b.capital ? 1 : 0) - (a.capital ? 1 : 0));
    const threatR = atWarAny(g, nid) ? 3 : liveNations(g).some(z => z.id !== nid && (warRisk(w, g, z.id, nid) || { level: 0 }).level >= 2) ? 2 : 0;
    for (const type of ["inf", "art", "arm", "air"]) {
      let q = null, cap = null;
      for (const c of towns) { const t = raiseQuote(w, g, nid, type, c.id); if (t.ok) { q = t; cap = c; break; } }
      if (!q) {
        if (nid === PLAYER && type !== "air" && towns.length) { const t = raiseQuote(w, g, nid, type, towns[0].id); out.push({ id: `raise:${type}`, kind: "noraise", group: "Forces", label: `Raise an ${DIV_TYPES[type].label.toLowerCase()} division`, cost: 0, lines: [], blocked: t.reason || "It cannot be done now.", score: -9 }); }
        continue;
      }
      const lines = [type === "air" ? `${q.planes} planes from the depots` : `${fmtCount(q.men)} soldiers, equipped ${pct(q.fill)}`, `${fmtMoney(q.cost)}, trains for ${MIL.trainSeasons} seasons at ${cap.name}`];
      out.push({ id: `raise:${type}`, kind: "raise", group: "Forces", label: type === "air" ? `Raise an air wing at ${cap.name}` : `Raise an ${DIV_TYPES[type].label.toLowerCase()} division at ${cap.name}`, cost: q.cost, lines, q,
        score: threatR ? (type === "inf" ? threatR : threatR - 1) : -1 });
    }
    const stance = (n.warPlan && n.warPlan.stance) || "defensive";
    out.push({ id: `stance:${stance === "offensive" ? "defensive" : "offensive"}`, kind: "stance", group: "Forces", value: stance === "offensive" ? "defensive" : "offensive",
      label: stance === "offensive" ? "Order the generals to hold the line" : "Order the generals onto the offensive", cost: 0,
      lines: [stance === "offensive" ? "In war they defend and attack only with 2 to 1 odds" : "In war they press the attack where the odds favor them"], score: -1 });
    const drillable = g.divisions.filter(d => d.owner === nid && !d.training);
    const threat = atWarAny(g, nid) ? 3 : liveNations(g).some(z => z.id !== nid && (warRisk(w, g, z.id, nid) || { level: 0 }).level >= 2) ? 2 : 0;
    if (!cooling(n, key, "fx:exercises", 4, g) && drillable.some(d => (d.exp || 0) < 0.4)) out.push(fxOrder("fx:exercises", "Army exercises", [{ t: "money", v: money(0.003) }, { t: "drill", v: 0.05, cap: 0.4 }], g, nid,
      { score: threat && drillable.reduce((s, d) => s + (d.exp || 0), 0) / drillable.length < 0.35 ? 1 : -0.5 }));
    out.push(...warGoodsOrders(w, g, n, econ));
  }
  if (key === "foreign") {
    // nations near us first; then up to two more that could sell us what we lack (offered only a trade agreement)
    const all = liveNations(g).filter(z => z.id !== nid);
    const lack = new Map(all.map(z => [z.id, sellsWhatWeLack(g, nid, z.id)]));
    const near = all.slice().sort((a, b) => (sharesBorder(g, nid, b.id) ? 1 : 0) - (sharesBorder(g, nid, a.id) ? 1 : 0) || (a.minor ? 1 : 0) - (b.minor ? 1 : 0)).slice(0, 5);
    const traders = all.filter(z => !near.includes(z) && lack.get(z.id).v >= 0.002 * Y && !hasTreaty(g, nid, z.id, "trade") && !atWar(g, nid, z.id)).sort((a, b) => lack.get(b.id).v - lack.get(a.id).v || a.id - b.id).slice(0, 2);
    const others = near.concat(traders);
    for (const z of others) {
      const op = opinionDetail(g, z.id, nid).value;
      const war = atWar(g, nid, z.id);
      const onlyTrade = traders.includes(z);
      if (!war && !onlyTrade && !cooling(n, key, `goodwill:${z.id}`, 4, g)) out.push(fxOrder(`goodwill:${z.id}`, `Goodwill visit to the ${z.name}`, [{ t: "money", v: money(0.0015) }, { t: "opinion", from: z.id, key: "goodwill", label: "Visits from their foreign minister", v: 6, cap: 12 }], g, nid,
        { group: "Relations", score: !z.minor && (warRisk(w, g, z.id, nid) || { level: 0 }).level >= 2 ? 2 : op < -10 ? 0.5 : -1, target: z.id }));
      if ((g.lastLetter || {})[z.id] === g.turn) continue;
      const types = war ? ["peace"] : onlyTrade ? ["trade"] : ["trade", "nap", "alliance", ...(sharesBorder(g, nid, z.id) ? ["border"] : [])];
      for (const type of types) {
        if (validateDeal(g, w, nid, z.id, [{ type }])) continue;
        const L = lack.get(z.id);
        const sells = type === "trade" && L.v >= 0.002 * Y;
        out.push({ id: `envoy:${type}:${z.id}`, kind: "envoy", group: "Relations", type, target: z.id, cost: 0,
          label: type === "peace" ? `Propose peace to the ${z.name}` : `Propose a ${TREATY_INFO[type].label.toLowerCase()} to the ${z.name}`,
          lines: [`They answer at once. Their opinion of you now: ${op > 0 ? "+" : ""}${op} (${opinionLabel(op).toLowerCase()})`].concat(sells ? [lackText(g, L)] : []),
          score: type === "trade" && op > 0 ? 1 + (sells ? 1 : 0) : type === "trade" && sells && op > -10 ? 0.5 : type === "peace" ? 0.5 : -1, op });
      }
    }
  }
  return out;
}

/* ---------- Trade orders (10s): embargoes, lifting them, preferred sellers, grain and food aid ----------
   Every one is an engine action the Trade panel and rival governments use too; the numbers come from the same
   embargo preview. Ids use only [a-z0-9:_-] so the minister's answer can name them. None is in AUTO_FX: a
   minister never starts or ends an embargo on his own. */
const EMB_PV_CACHE = { g: null, stamp: "", m: new Map() };
/* An embargo preview costs a few what-if economies: keep it while nothing in the world changes. */
function embargoPreviewCached(w, g, by, on, k, dir, food) {
  const stamp = `${g.turn}|${g.ver || 0}|${g.trade ? `${g.trade.turn}:${(g.trade.embargoes || []).length}:${g.trade.nextId}` : ""}`;
  if (EMB_PV_CACHE.g !== g || EMB_PV_CACHE.stamp !== stamp) { EMB_PV_CACHE.g = g; EMB_PV_CACHE.stamp = stamp; EMB_PV_CACHE.m = new Map(); }
  const key = `${by}|${on}|${k}|${dir}|${food ? 1 : 0}|${JSON.stringify(g.nations[by].laws)}`;
  if (!EMB_PV_CACHE.m.has(key)) EMB_PV_CACHE.m.set(key, embargoPreview(w, g, by, on, k, dir, food));
  return EMB_PV_CACHE.m.get(key);
}
/* "Their output −$0.4B a year, ours −$0.2B; their opinion of you −1 → −16 (wary)". */
function embargoConsequenceText(pv) {
  return `Their output ${bSigned(pv.them)} a year, ours ${bSigned(pv.self)}; their opinion of you ${signed(pv.op0)} → ${signed(pv.op1)} (${pv.word.toLowerCase()})`;
}
/* One embargo order, with its preview; null when that embargo is already in force. */
function embargoOrder(w, g, n, econ, on, k, dir, extra = {}) {
  const nid = n.id, id = `embargo:${dir}:${k}:${on}`, good = k === "all" ? null : k;
  const label = extra.label || embargoEffectText(g, { on, k, dir });
  const block = embargoBlock(g, nid, on, k, dir);
  if (block && /already in force/.test(block)) return null;
  if (block) return { id, kind: "fx", group: "Trade", label, effects: [], lines: [], cost: 0, blocked: block, score: -9, good, target: on, allGoods: k === "all" };
  const pv = embargoPv(embargoPreviewCached(w, g, nid, on, k, dir, false));
  const o = fxOrder(id, label, [{ t: "embargo", on, k, dir, why: "choice", pv }], g, nid, { group: "Trade", good, target: on, allGoods: k === "all", score: extra.score ?? -1 });
  const hungry = k === "food" && computeEconomy(w, g, on).famineShare > 0.02;
  // how our own groups take it while it lasts (the same terms as their mood: 30q)
  const groups = dir !== "buy" ? banGroupDelta(g, n, econ, pv.lost, k === "food" || (k === "all" && !!extra.food)) : {};
  o.emb = { pv, k, dir, on, hungry, groups };
  o.lines = [embargoConsequenceText(pv)].concat(pv.lost > 0.005 ? [`Our exporters lose ${bMoney(pv.lost)} of sales a year until they find other buyers`] : [], embargoPvLines(pv),
    pv.ends ? ["It ends our treaty with them"] : [], pv.broken ? ["It BREAKS our promise to them: every nation will see it"] : [], hungry ? ["They are hungry: every nation would see us let them go hungry"] : [],
    [lastingGroupText(groups, "while it lasts")].filter(Boolean));
  return o;
}
function economyTradeOrders(w, g, n, econ) {
  if (!g.trade || !g.trade.v) return [];
  const nid = n.id, out = [], Y = Math.max(1, econ.gdp);
  // embargoes on our main partners: the good we sell them most, the good we buy from them most, and all trade
  const TO = tradeOf(g, nid);
  const top = o => Object.entries(o).filter(([k]) => k !== "food").map(([k, q]) => ({ k, v: goodWorth(g, k, q) })).sort((a, b) => b.v - a.v)[0];
  const embs = [];
  for (const p of TO.partners.slice(0, 4)) {
    if (atWar(g, nid, p.nid) || !g.nations[p.nid] || !g.nations[p.nid].alive) continue;
    const s = top(p.sell), b = top(p.buy);
    if (s && s.v >= 0.01) embs.push([p.nid, s.k, "sell"]);
    if (b && b.v >= 0.01) embs.push([p.nid, b.k, "buy"]);
    if (p.sellV + p.buyV >= 0.02) embs.push([p.nid, "all", "both"]);
  }
  // a nation with an embargo on us can be answered with a full embargo, even when it has cut all our trade already
  for (const by of [...new Set(embargoesOn(g, nid).map(e => e.by))].sort((a, b) => a - b))
    if (g.nations[by] && g.nations[by].alive && !atWar(g, nid, by) && !embs.some(x => x[0] === by && x[1] === "all")) embs.push([by, "all", "both"]);
  for (const [on, k, dir] of embs.slice(0, 8)) { const o = embargoOrder(w, g, n, econ, on, k, dir, k === "all" ? { label: `Stop all trade with the ${nameOf(g, on)} (a full embargo; food still allowed)` } : {}); if (o) out.push(o); }
  // lifting our own embargoes
  for (const e of embargoesBy(g, nid)) {
    const young = g.turn - e.since < TRADE.minEmbargo;
    const o = fxOrder(`lift:${e.id}`, `Lift our embargo on the ${nameOf(g, e.on)} (${e.k === "all" ? "all trade" : goodWord(e.k)})`, [{ t: "lift", id: e.id, on: e.on }], g, nid, { group: "Trade", target: e.on, good: e.k === "all" ? null : e.k, score: -0.5 });
    const groups = liftGroupDelta(g, n, econ, e);
    o.lift = { young, since: e.since, groups };
    o.lines = [young ? `No goodwill: it began less than a year ago (${seasonLabel(e.since)})` : "Their opinion of us rises a little, and their grudge halves", "Our merchants may trade with them again at once; the full contracts are signed at the end of the season"]
      .concat([lastingGroupText(groups, "once it ends")].filter(Boolean));
    out.push(o);
  }
  // a second seller for the key goods we buy most
  const imp = TRADE_GOODS.filter(k => k !== "food" && (econ.goods.imports[k] || 0) > 1e-3).map(k => ({ k, v: goodWorth(g, k, econ.goods.imports[k]) })).filter(x => x.v >= 0.005 * Y || TRADE.key.includes(x.k)).sort((a, b) => b.v - a.v).slice(0, 3);
  const prefCount = (g.trade.prefer || []).filter(p => p.by === nid).length;
  for (const { k } of imp) {
    const cur = (g.trade.prefer || []).find(p => p.by === nid && p.k === k);
    if (cur) {
      const o = fxOrder(`prefer:${k}:none`, `Stop preferring the ${nameOf(g, cur.from)} for ${goodWord(k)}`, [{ t: "prefer", k, from: null }], g, nid, { group: "Trade", good: k, target: cur.from, score: -1 });
      out.push(o);
      continue;
    }
    const offers = tradeOffers(w, g, nid, k).sellers.filter(s => !s.whyNot && s.price);
    const cheapest = offers.slice().sort((a, b) => a.price.p - b.price.p)[0];
    const dep = dependence(g, nid, k)[0];
    const alt = offers.filter(s => s.nid >= 0 && s.offered > 1e-3 && (!dep || s.nid !== dep.from)).sort((a, b) => a.price.p - b.price.p || a.nid - b.nid)[0];
    const risky = dep && dep.share >= 0.6 && TRADE.key.includes(k);
    if (alt && prefCount >= 3) out.push({ id: `prefer:${k}:${alt.nid}`, kind: "fx", group: "Trade", label: `Buy ${goodWord(k)} from the ${nameOf(g, alt.nid)} first (a second seller)`, effects: [], lines: [], cost: 0, good: k, target: alt.nid, score: -9,
      blocked: "We already prefer three sellers, the most our merchants will follow: stop preferring one of them first" });
    else if (alt) {
      const o = fxOrder(`prefer:${k}:${alt.nid}`, `Buy ${goodWord(k)} from the ${nameOf(g, alt.nid)} first (a second seller)`, [{ t: "prefer", k, from: alt.nid }], g, nid, { group: "Trade", good: k, target: alt.nid, score: risky ? 0.5 : -1 });
      const dearer = cheapest ? alt.price.p / cheapest.price.p - 1 : 0;
      o.pref = { dearer };
      o.lines.push(`Their price at our border: ${pct(alt.price.p / Math.max(1e-6, alt.price.base))} of the world price${dearer > 0.005 ? ` (${pct(dearer)} more than the cheapest seller)` : " (the cheapest seller)"}`);
      if (risky) o.lines.push(`Today ${pct(dep.share)} of our ${goodWord(k)} comes from the ${nameOf(g, dep.from)}`);
      out.push(o);
    } else if (risky) out.push({ id: `prefer:${k}:find`, kind: "fx", group: "Trade", label: `Find a second seller of ${goodWord(k)}`, effects: [], lines: [], cost: 0, good: k, score: -9,
      blocked: `No other nation we can reach has ${goodWord(k)} to sell${econ.trade && econ.trade.worldImportCapRaw > 0 ? "; the world market sells some, at the middlemen's price" : ", and the world market is closed to us"}. A trade road, a harbor on the ocean or a trade agreement would open new sellers` });
  }
  return out;
}
/* Agriculture: food aid to hungry nations we can reach, and a ban on selling grain to a buyer. */
function grainTradeOrders(w, g, n, econ, key, months) {
  if (!g.trade || !g.trade.v) return [];
  const nid = n.id, out = [];
  const hungry = liveNations(g).filter(z => z.id !== nid).map(z => ({ z, e: computeEconomy(w, g, z.id) })).filter(x => x.e.famineShare > 0.02).sort((a, b) => b.e.famineShare - a.e.famineShare || a.z.id - b.z.id).slice(0, 3);
  for (const { z, e } of hungry) {
    const id = `aid:${z.id}`, label = `Send grain to the ${z.name} (food aid)`;
    const qt = foodAidQuote(w, g, nid, z.id, 1);
    if (!qt.ok) { out.push({ id, kind: "fx", group: "Trade", label, effects: [], lines: [], cost: 0, score: -9, target: z.id, good: "food", blocked: qt.reason }); continue; }
    if (cooling(n, key, id, 4, g)) continue;
    const ours = monthsOfFood(qt.q, econ.pop);
    const o = fxOrder(id, label, [{ t: "foodAid", to: z.id, months: 1, got: sr(qt.months, 2), q: sr(qt.q, 4), opinion: Math.round(qt.opinion), ours: sr(ours, 2) }], g, nid,
      { group: "Trade", target: z.id, good: "food", score: months - ours >= 3 && qt.opinion > 0 && !atWar(g, nid, z.id) ? 0.5 : -1 });
    o.aid = { after: months - ours, recent: qt.recent };
    o.lines.push(`${pct(e.famineShare)} of their people go hungry`);
    if (qt.recent) o.lines.push("No new goodwill: we sent them grain less than a year ago");
    // the faithful are proud of a nation that feeds the hungry (30q: for two years after the last aid)
