// which group a new minister comes from, by ministry
const MINISTER_GROUPS = {
  interior:    { workers: 0.35, faith: 0.3, business: 0.2, farmers: 0.15 },
  economy:     { business: 0.6, workers: 0.2, farmers: 0.1, faith: 0.1 },
  agriculture: { farmers: 0.7, faith: 0.15, business: 0.15 },
  energy:      { business: 0.5, workers: 0.4, army: 0.1 },
  defence:     { army: 0.75, business: 0.1, faith: 0.15 },
  foreign:     { business: 0.4, faith: 0.3, army: 0.15, workers: 0.15 },
};
function ministerGroupPick(key, face) {
  const W = MINISTER_GROUPS[key] || { workers: 0.2, business: 0.2, army: 0.2, farmers: 0.2, faith: 0.2 };
  let x = ((face || 0) % 1000) / 1000;
  for (const k of GROUP_ORDER) { const p = W[k] || 0; if (x < p) return k; x -= p; }
  return GROUP_ORDER.find(k => W[k]) || "workers";
}
function ministerGroup(m) { return m ? (m.group && GROUPS[m.group] ? m.group : ministerGroupPick(m.key, m.face)) : null; }
function groupWord(v) { return v >= 75 ? "loyal" : v >= GRP.happyAt ? "pleased" : v >= 45 ? "content" : v >= GRP.angryAt ? "unhappy" : v >= 18 ? "angry" : "furious"; }

/* ---------- Their state, kept on the nation ---------- */
function ensureGroups(w, g, n, econ) {
  if (n.groups && GROUP_ORDER.every(k => n.groups[k])) return n.groups;
  n.groups = n.groups || {};
  const e = econ || computeEconomy(w, g, n.id);
  const S = groupShares(g, n, e);
  const ctx = groupCtx(w, g, n, e);
  for (const k of GROUP_ORDER) {
    if (n.groups[k]) continue;
    const t = groupTarget(w, g, n, e, n.laws, k, ctx);
    n.groups[k] = { approval: t, target: t, share: S.share[k], mods: [], demand: null, lastDemand: -99, hist: [Math.round(t)] };
  }
  return n.groups;
}
function groupOf(n, k) { return n && n.groups ? n.groups[k] || null : null; }
function addGroupMod(g, n, k, key, label, v, seasons) {
  const s = groupOf(n, k);
  if (!s || !v) return;
  s.mods = (s.mods || []).filter(m => m.key !== key);
  s.mods.push({ key, label, v, until: seasons ? g.turn + seasons + 1 : null });
}
function groupModsActive(g, s) { return (s.mods || []).filter(m => m.until === null || m.until === undefined || m.until > g.turn); }

/* ---------- Power: what the nation is made of decides who has weight ---------- */
function groupShares(g, n, econ) {
  const W = Math.max(0.01, econ.workforce || 0);
  const sec = (econ.sectors && econ.sectors.secondary) || { workers: 0, va: 0 };
  const ter = (econ.sectors && econ.sectors.tertiary) || { workers: 0, va: 0 };
  const pri = (econ.sectors && econ.sectors.primary) || { workers: 0, va: 0 };
  const subs = Array.isArray(econ.subs) ? econ.subs : Object.values(econ.subs || {});
  const agri = subs.find(s => s.sub === "Agriculture") || { workers: pri.workers, va: pri.va };
  const mines = Math.max(0, pri.workers - agri.workers);
  const small = econ.smallholders || 0;
  const L = n.laws;
  const P = {};
  const add = (k, label, pts) => { P[k] = P[k] || { pts: 0, lines: [] }; if (Math.abs(pts) >= 0.3) { P[k].pts += pts; P[k].lines.push({ label, pts: Math.round(pts * 10) / 10 }); } };
  // workers
  add("workers", `${fmtPeople(sec.workers + mines)} in mines, plants and works`, 100 * (sec.workers + mines) / W);
  add("workers", `${fmtPeople(ter.workers)} in shops, transport and offices`, 35 * ter.workers / W);
  add("workers", `${fmtPeople(econ.unemployed || 0)} without a job`, 50 * (econ.unemployed || 0) / W);
  { const U = labourLaw(L, "unions"); if (U.power) add("workers", U.power > 0 ? "Strong unions organize the workers" : "Unions are banned: workers cannot organize", U.power); }
  // business
  const nonFarm = econ.gdp > 0 ? clamp(1 - agri.va / econ.gdp, 0, 1) : 0.5;
  add("business", `Industry, trade and services make ${pct(nonFarm)} of the economy`, 35 * nonFarm);
  add("business", "Banks, head offices and broadcasters", Math.min(8, 2 * (((econ.levels || {}).business || 0) + ((econ.levels || {}).broadcast || 0))));
  if (L.finance === "loose") add("business", "Loose banking rules give bankers sway", 4);
  if (L.finance === "strict") add("business", "Strict banking rules keep bankers in check", -3);
  if (L.trade === "free") add("business", "Free trade enriches the merchants", 3);
  // army
  const men = (n.mil && n.mil.men) || n.soldiers || 0;
  add("army", `${fmtCount(men)} soldiers under arms`, 400 * (men / 1e6) / W);
  if (g.wars && g.wars.some(x => x.sideA.includes(n.id) || x.sideB.includes(n.id))) add("army", "The nation is at war", 10);
  if (L.arms === "high") add("army", "High arms production", 4);
  if (L.arms === "war") add("army", "A war economy", 8);
  // farmers
  add("farmers", `${fmtPeople(agri.workers)} work the farms`, 80 * agri.workers / W);
  add("farmers", `${fmtPeople(small)} live on family plots`, 40 * small / W);
  if ((econ.famineShare || 0) > 0.01) add("farmers", "Food is short: whoever has grain has power", 5);
  // faith
  add("faith", "Temples, old families and old customs", 10);
  add("faith", "Village and farm people hold to tradition", 25 * (agri.workers + small) / W);
  const old = (econ.cities || []).filter(c => (c.roles || []).includes("heritage")).length;
  if (old) add("faith", `Old towns (${old})`, Math.min(6, 2 * old));
  const edu = { minimal: 6, basic: 3, good: 0, excellent: -3 }[L.education || "basic"] || 0;
  if (edu) add("faith", edu > 0 ? "Few schools: tradition rules the villages" : "Good schools teach new ideas", edu);
  if ((g.era || 0) > 0) add("faith", "The modern age", -1.5 * (g.era || 0));
  for (const k of GROUP_ORDER) { P[k] = P[k] || { pts: 0, lines: [] }; P[k].pts = Math.max(k === "faith" ? 4 : 1, P[k].pts); P[k].lines.sort((a, b) => b.pts - a.pts); }
  const tot = GROUP_ORDER.reduce((s, k) => s + P[k].pts, 0);
  const share = {};
  for (const k of GROUP_ORDER) share[k] = P[k].pts / tot;
  return { pow: P, share };
}

/* ---------- What each group feels, and why ---------- */
function groupCtx(w, g, n, econ) {
  const wars = (g.wars || []).filter(x => x.sideA.includes(n.id) || x.sideB.includes(n.id));
  const attacking = wars.find(x => x.sideA[0] === n.id && g.turn - (x.since ?? g.turn) >= 6) || null;
  const h = n.history || [];
  const gNow = h.length ? h[h.length - 1].gdp : econ.gdp, gYear = h.length > 4 ? h[h.length - 5].gdp : null;
  const lost = g.cities.filter(c => c.origin === n.id && c.owner !== n.id && g.nations[c.owner] && g.nations[c.owner].alive && (c.loyalty ?? 92) < CITY.integrate).sort((a, b) => (b.imp || 0) - (a.imp || 0))[0] || null;
  return {
    econ, budget: computeBudget(n, econ, n.laws), wars, atWar: wars.length > 0, attacking,
    warScore: wars.length ? Math.min(...wars.map(x => sideScore(x, n.id))) : 0,
    growth: gYear && gYear > 0 ? gNow / gYear - 1 : null,
    divs: (g.divisions || []).filter(d => d.owner === n.id).length,
    lost, threat: maxThreatTo(w, g, n.id).level,
  };
}
function groupTerms(w, g, n, econ, L, k, ctx) {
  const out = [];
  const T = (label, v) => { if (Math.abs(v) >= 0.4) out.push({ label, value: Math.round(v * 10) / 10 }); };
  const tax = { 15: 1, 25: 0, 35: -1, 45: -2 }[L.tax] ?? 0;
  const u = econ.unemployment || 0;
  if (k === "workers") {
    T(`${SERVICE_LAWS[L.services].label} healthcare and welfare`, { minimal: -12, basic: 0, good: 7, generous: 12 }[L.services] || 0);
    if (tax) T(`${taxLaw(L.tax).label} taxes`, { 1: 2, [-1]: -3, [-2]: -8 }[tax] || 0);
    if (L.education === "excellent") T("Excellent schools for their children", 2);
    if (L.education === "minimal") T("Hardly any schools for their children", -3);
    if (u > 0.05) T(`${pct1(u)} of workers have no job`, -clamp((u - 0.05) * 200, 0, 20));
    else if (u < 0.02) T("Plenty of work", 4);
    if (econ.sat && econ.sat.goods < 0.6) T(`Empty shops (${pct(econ.sat.goods)} of goods wanted)`, -clamp((0.6 - econ.sat.goods) * 20, 0, 10));
    if (L.army === "large") T("Their sons are drafted (broad draft)", -3);
    if (L.army === "mobilized") T("Total mobilization takes their sons", -8);
    if (L.arms === "high") T("Long shifts in the arms factories", -3);
    if (L.arms === "war") T("A war economy: rationing and endless shifts", -7);
    if (L.trade === "protect") T("Protected industries keep jobs safe", 3);
    if (L.trade === "free") T("Free trade puts jobs at risk", -4);
    if ((econ.famineShare || 0) > 0.002) T("Hunger in the cities", -clamp(econ.famineShare * 60, 0, 15));
  } else if (k === "business") {
    T(`${taxLaw(L.tax).label} taxes`, { 1: 10, 0: 0, [-1]: -8, [-2]: -18 }[tax] ?? 0);
    T(`Banking rules: ${FINANCE_LAWS[L.finance || "balanced"].label.toLowerCase()}`, { strict: -6, balanced: 0, loose: 5 }[L.finance || "balanced"] || 0);
    T(`Trade policy: ${TRADE_LAWS[L.trade || "balanced"].label.toLowerCase()}`, { protect: -4, balanced: 0, free: 6 }[L.trade || "balanced"] || 0);
    if (L.services === "generous") T("Universal healthcare means high taxes on firms", -4);
    if (RESEARCH_ORDER.indexOf(L.research || "low") >= 2) T("Research money helps new industries", 2);
    if (ctx.budget && ctx.budget.debtRatio > 0.6) T(`Debt at ${pct(ctx.budget.debtRatio)} of output`, -clamp((ctx.budget.debtRatio - 0.6) * 20, 0, 10));
    if (ctx.growth !== null && ctx.growth > 0.03) T(`A growing economy (+${pct1(ctx.growth)} in a year)`, 4);
    else if (ctx.growth !== null && ctx.growth < 0) T(`A shrinking economy (${pct1(ctx.growth)} in a year)`, -6);
    if (n.crisisUntil > g.turn) T("A banking crisis", -10);
    if (ctx.atWar) T(ARMS_ORDER.indexOf(L.arms || "low") >= 3 ? "War brings arms contracts" : "War disrupts trade", ARMS_ORDER.indexOf(L.arms || "low") >= 3 ? 3 : -4);
    // trade between nations (10s): our own bans cost the exporters; a rival's ban hurts our merchants
    const ban = ourBanLoss(g, n);
    if (ban) T(ban.v >= 0.005 ? `Our trade bans cost exporters ${bMoney(ban.v)} a year (goods nobody else buys)` : "Our trade bans (merchants dislike them)", banTerm(ban.v, econ));
    const hit = [...new Set(embargoesOn(g, n.id).filter(e => g.nations[e.by] && g.nations[e.by].alive).map(e => e.by))];
    if (hit.length) T(hit.length === 1 ? `The ${nameOf(g, hit[0])}'s trade ban hurts our merchants` : `Trade bans by ${bJoin(hit.map(b => `the ${nameOf(g, b)}`))} hurt our merchants`, -2);
  } else if (k === "army") {
    T(`Conscription: ${ARMY_LAWS[L.army].label.toLowerCase()}`, { small: -12, standard: -4, large: 3, mobilized: 6 }[L.army] || 0);
    T(`Arms production: ${ARMS_LAWS[L.arms || "low"].label.toLowerCase()}`, { none: -10, low: -4, medium: 0, high: 4, war: 6 }[L.arms || "low"] || 0);
    if (ctx.atWar && ctx.warScore > 20) T("Winning the war", 6);
    else if (ctx.atWar && ctx.warScore < -20) T("Losing the war", -8);
    if ((econ.armsSat ?? 1) < 0.6 && ctx.divs) T("Soldiers without enough weapons", -5);
    if (ctx.lost) T(`${ctx.lost.name} is in foreign hands`, -3);
    if (ctx.threat > 0.6 && ARMY_ORDER.indexOf(L.army) < 2) T("A dangerous neighbor, and too few soldiers", -4);
  } else if (k === "farmers") {
    T(`Trade policy: ${TRADE_LAWS[L.trade || "balanced"].label.toLowerCase()}`, { protect: 6, balanced: 0, free: -7 }[L.trade || "balanced"] || 0);
    T(`Food reserve: the state buys ${GRANARY_LAWS[L.granary || "none"].months ? `${GRANARY_LAWS[L.granary || "none"].months} months of grain` : "no grain"}`, { none: -4, small: 0, medium: 3, large: 5 }[L.granary || "none"] || 0);
    if ((n.mods || []).some(m => m.key === "farm_subsidy" && (m.until === null || m.until > g.turn))) T("Farm subsidies", 8);
    if (harvestFactor(n) < 0.95) T("A poor harvest", -5);
    if (tax) T(`${taxLaw(L.tax).label} taxes`, { 1: 2, [-1]: -2, [-2]: -5 }[tax] || 0);
    if (L.army === "mobilized") T("Total mobilization takes the farm hands", -4);
    const irr = (econ.cities || []).filter(c => c.irrigated).length;
    if (irr) T(`Irrigated fields (${irr} town${irr > 1 ? "s" : ""})`, Math.min(3, irr));
    if (embargoesBy(g, n.id).some(e => e.dir !== "buy" && (e.k === "food" || (e.k === "all" && e.food)))) T("Our ban on selling grain abroad", -3);
  } else if (k === "faith") {
    T(`${EDU_LAWS[L.education || "basic"].label} schools`, { minimal: 3, basic: 0, good: -2, excellent: -5 }[L.education || "basic"] || 0);
    T(`${SERVICE_LAWS[L.services].label} help for the poor`, { minimal: -4, basic: 0, good: 2, generous: 3 }[L.services] || 0);
    if (ctx.attacking) T(`A long war of our own making against the ${nameOf(g, ctx.attacking.sideB[0])}`, -5);
    else if (ctx.atWar && ctx.wars.some(x => x.sideB.includes(n.id))) T("Defending the homeland", 2);
    if (n.stability < 35) T("Disorder in the country", -5);
    if (L.trade === "free") T("Foreign goods and foreign ways", -2);
    if (((g.trade && g.trade.aid) || []).some(a => a.from === n.id && g.turn - a.turn < 8)) T("We fed the hungry abroad", 2);
  }
  peopleGroupTerms(n, econ, L, k, T);
  // their people in the government
  const mins = MIN_ORDER.filter(key => ministryActive(n, key) && ministerGroup(n.cabinet.min[key].minister) === k);
  if (mins.length) T(`Their people in the government: ${mins.map(key => `${n.cabinet.min[key].minister.name} (${MINISTRIES[key].label})`).join(", ")}`, Math.min(GRP.ministerCap, GRP.ministerBonus * mins.length));
  const s = groupOf(n, k);
  if (s) for (const m of groupModsActive(g, s)) T(m.label, m.v);
  return out.sort((a, b) => Math.abs(b.value) - Math.abs(a.value));
}
/* What our own embargoes cost our exporters, a year: goods we have left unsold that the nations we embargo still
   buy from the world market or go without (what they would buy from us without the ban). Read from the book.
   `skip`: leave one embargo out (what lifting it would change). */
function ourBanLoss(g, n, skip) {
  const E = embargoesBy(g, n.id).filter(e => g.nations[e.on] && g.nations[e.on].alive && e.id !== skip);
  if (!E.length) return null;
  const T = g.trade, ix = tradeIndex(g), left = {};
  let v = 0;
  for (const e of E) {
    if (e.dir === "buy") continue;
    for (const k of TRADE_GOODS) {
      if (!embargoCovers(e, k)) continue;
      if (!(k in left)) left[k] = (T.unsold[k] || [])[n.id] || 0;
      if (left[k] <= 1e-4) continue;
      const theirWorld = ((ix.into[e.on] || {})[k] || []).filter(f => f.s < 0).reduce((s, f) => s + f.q, 0);
      const q = Math.min(left[k], ((T.unmet[k] || [])[e.on] || 0) + theirWorld);
      left[k] -= q;
      v += goodWorth(g, k, q);
    }
  }
  return { v, count: E.length };
}
// business people's mood about our trade bans: −1, and −4 more for each 1% of output our exporters lose (at most −8)
function banTerm(v, econ) { return -clamp(1 + 4 * 100 * v / Math.max(1, econ.gdp), 1, 8); }
function grainBanOf(g, nid, skip) { return embargoesBy(g, nid).some(e => e.id !== skip && e.dir !== "buy" && (e.k === "food" || (e.k === "all" && e.food))); }
/* How a new embargo of ours would move the groups' mood while it lasts (the same terms as groupTerms): business by
   the sales our exporters would lose (from the embargo preview), farmers when it stops grain sales. */
function banGroupDelta(g, n, econ, lost, food) {
  const cur = ourBanLoss(g, n), out = {};
  const b = Math.round(banTerm((cur ? cur.v : 0) + Math.max(0, lost), econ) - (cur ? banTerm(cur.v, econ) : 0));
  if (b) out.business = b;
  if (food && !grainBanOf(g, n.id)) out.farmers = -3;
  return out;
}
/* And what lifting one of our embargoes would give back. */
function liftGroupDelta(g, n, econ, e) {
  const cur = ourBanLoss(g, n), rest = ourBanLoss(g, n, e.id), out = {};
  const b = Math.round((rest ? banTerm(rest.v, econ) : 0) - (cur ? banTerm(cur.v, econ) : 0));
  if (b) out.business = b;
  if (grainBanOf(g, n.id) && !grainBanOf(g, n.id, e.id)) out.farmers = 3;
  return out;
}
/* "Business −3, Farmers −3 (approval, while it lasts)": the lasting mood change of a trade action, for its order. */
function lastingGroupText(d, when) {
  const parts = GROUP_ORDER.filter(k => d[k]).map(k => `${GROUPS[k].short} ${signed(d[k])}`);
  return parts.length ? `${parts.join(", ")} (approval, ${when})` : "";
}
function groupTarget(w, g, n, econ, L, k, ctx) {
  return Math.round(clamp(50 + groupTerms(w, g, n, econ, L, k, ctx || groupCtx(w, g, n, econ)).reduce((s, t) => s + t.value, 0), 5, 95) * 10) / 10;
}
/* How a law would change each group's mood: shown on the law buttons. */
function groupLawDelta(w, g, n, law, value) {
  const econ = computeEconomy(w, g, n.id);
  const ctx = groupCtx(w, g, n, econ);
  const L2 = { ...n.laws, [law]: law === "tax" ? Number(value) : value };
  const out = {};
  for (const k of GROUP_ORDER) out[k] = Math.round(groupTarget(w, g, n, econ, L2, k, ctx) - groupTarget(w, g, n, econ, n.laws, k, ctx));
  return out;
}

/* ---------- Demands: one at a time per group, with a deadline ---------- */
const lawIs = (n, law, list) => list.includes(n.laws[law]);
const GROUP_DEMANDS = {
  workers: [
    { key: "health", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "services", ["minimal", "basic"]), met: (n) => lawIs(n, "services", ["good", "generous"]), law: () => ({ law: "services", value: "good" }), label: () => "Raise healthcare and welfare to good" },
    { key: "jobs", applies: (n, c) => (c.econ.unemployment || 0) > 0.07, met: (n, c) => (c.econ.unemployment || 0) < 0.06, label: () => "Bring unemployment below 6% (public works, new factories, mines)" },
    { key: "draft", applies: (n, c) => lawIs(n, "army", ["large", "mobilized"]) && !c.atWar, met: (n) => lawIs(n, "army", ["small", "standard"]), law: () => ({ law: "army", value: "standard" }), label: () => "End the broad draft (limited draft or volunteers)" },
    { key: "shifts", applies: (n, c) => lawIs(n, "arms", ["high", "war"]) && !c.atWar, met: (n) => lawIs(n, "arms", ["none", "low", "medium"]), law: () => ({ law: "arms", value: "medium" }), label: () => "Cut arms production to medium" },
    { key: "tax", applies: (n) => n.laws.tax >= 45, met: (n) => n.laws.tax <= 35, law: () => ({ law: "tax", value: 35 }), label: () => "Lower taxes to 35% or less" },
  ],
  business: [
    { key: "tax", applies: (n) => n.laws.tax >= 35, met: (n) => n.laws.tax <= 25, law: () => ({ law: "tax", value: 25 }), label: () => "Lower taxes to 25% or less" },
    { key: "trade", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "trade", ["protect"]), met: (n) => !lawIs(n, "trade", ["protect"]), law: () => ({ law: "trade", value: "balanced" }), label: () => "End protectionism (balanced or free trade)" },
    { key: "banks", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "finance", ["strict"]), met: (n) => !lawIs(n, "finance", ["strict"]), law: () => ({ law: "finance", value: "balanced" }), label: () => "Ease the banking rules (balanced or loose)" },
    { key: "debt", applies: (n, c) => c.budget && c.budget.debtRatio > 0.8, met: (n, c) => !c.budget || c.budget.debtRatio < 0.6, label: () => "Bring the debt below 60% of a year's output" },
    { key: "free", applies: (n, c) => lawIs(n, "trade", ["balanced"]) && (n.groups.business.share || 0) >= 0.25 && tradeOpen(c.econ), met: (n) => lawIs(n, "trade", ["free"]), law: () => ({ law: "trade", value: "free" }), label: () => "Free trade" },
  ],
  army: [
    { key: "winback", applies: (n, c) => !!c.lost, met: (n, c, d) => !!c.econ.cities.find(z => z.id === d.cityId), gone: (g, n, c, d) => { const city = g.cities.find(z => z.id === d.cityId); return !city || city.origin !== n.id; }, label: (n, c) => `Win back ${c.lost.name}`, extra: (n, c) => ({ cityId: c.lost.id }), deadline: 16 },
    { key: "draft", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "army", ["small", "standard"]), met: (n, c, d) => ARMY_ORDER.indexOf(n.laws.army) > ARMY_ORDER.indexOf(d.from), law: (n) => ({ law: "army", value: ARMY_ORDER[ARMY_ORDER.indexOf(n.laws.army) + 1] }), label: (n) => `Raise conscription to ${ARMY_LAWS[ARMY_ORDER[ARMY_ORDER.indexOf(n.laws.army) + 1]].label.toLowerCase()}`, extra: (n) => ({ from: n.laws.army }) },
    { key: "arms", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "arms", ["none", "low"]), met: (n) => !lawIs(n, "arms", ["none", "low"]), law: () => ({ law: "arms", value: "medium" }), label: () => "Raise arms production to medium" },
    { key: "divs", applies: (n, c) => c.divs < 6 || c.threat > 0.5, met: (n, c, d) => c.divs >= d.target, label: (n, c) => `Raise 2 more divisions (to ${c.divs + 2})`, extra: (n, c) => ({ target: c.divs + 2 }) },
  ],
  farmers: [
    { key: "reserve", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "granary", ["none", "small"]), met: (n) => lawIs(n, "granary", ["medium", "large"]), law: () => ({ law: "granary", value: "medium" }), label: () => "Buy our grain: a food reserve of 4 months or more" },
    { key: "nofree", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "trade", ["free"]), met: (n) => !lawIs(n, "trade", ["free"]), law: () => ({ law: "trade", value: "balanced" }), label: () => "End free trade in food (balanced or protected trade)" },
    { key: "protect", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "trade", ["balanced"]) && (n.groups.farmers.share || 0) >= 0.3, met: (n) => lawIs(n, "trade", ["protect"]), law: () => ({ law: "trade", value: "protect" }), label: () => "Protect the farms from cheap imports" },
  ],
  faith: [
    { key: "poor", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "services", ["minimal"]), met: (n) => !lawIs(n, "services", ["minimal"]), law: () => ({ law: "services", value: "basic" }), label: () => "Help the poor: healthcare and welfare of at least basic" },
    { key: "peace", applies: (n, c) => !!c.attacking, met: (n, c) => !c.attacking, label: () => "Make peace", labelG: (g, c) => `Make peace with the ${nameOf(g, c.attacking.sideB[0])}` },
    { key: "schools", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "education", ["excellent"]), met: (n) => !lawIs(n, "education", ["excellent"]), law: () => ({ law: "education", value: "good" }), label: () => "Schools of the old kind (education good or lower)" },
    { key: "holiday", applies: (n) => !!ministry(n, "interior"), met: (n, c, d) => { const M = ministry(n, "interior"); return !!(M && M.cool && M.cool["fx:festival"] >= d.since); }, label: () => "A national holiday with parades (an order of the Interior minister)" },
  ],
};
function demandDef(k, key) { return (GROUP_DEMANDS[k] || []).find(d => d.key === key) || null; }

/* ---------- Each season: power, approval, demands ---------- */
function seasonGroups(w, g, dispatch) {
  const news = dispatch ? (dispatch.groups = dispatch.groups || []) : null;
  for (const n of g.nations) {
    if (!n.alive) continue;
    const econ = computeEconomy(w, g, n.id);
    ensureGroups(w, g, n, econ);
    const S = groupShares(g, n, econ);
    const ctx = groupCtx(w, g, n, econ);
    for (const k of GROUP_ORDER) {
      const s = n.groups[k], G = GROUPS[k];
      s.mods = groupModsActive(g, s);
      s.share = Math.round(S.share[k] * 1000) / 1000;
      const before = s.approval;
      s.target = groupTarget(w, g, n, econ, n.laws, k, ctx);
      s.approval = Math.round(clamp(s.approval + GRP.pull * (s.target - s.approval), 0, 100) * 10) / 10;
      s.hist = (s.hist || []).concat([Math.round(s.approval)]).slice(-GRP.histMax);
      const mine = n.id === PLAYER && news;
      // demands
      if (s.demand) {
        const D = demandDef(k, s.demand.key);
        if (D && D.gone && D.gone(g, n, ctx, s.demand)) { s.demand = null; s.lastDemand = g.turn; }
        else if (!D || D.met(n, ctx, s.demand)) {
          addGroupMod(g, n, k, `kept:${s.demand.key}`, `You did what they asked: ${s.demand.label.charAt(0).toLowerCase()}${s.demand.label.slice(1)}`, GRP.met, GRP.modSeasons);
          if (mine) news.push({ group: k, tone: "good", text: `${G.label}: you did what they asked (${s.demand.label.charAt(0).toLowerCase()}${s.demand.label.slice(1)}). Their approval rises.` });
          s.demand = null; s.lastDemand = g.turn;
        } else if (g.turn >= s.demand.until) {
          addGroupMod(g, n, k, `broken:${s.demand.key}`, `You ignored their demand: ${s.demand.label.charAt(0).toLowerCase()}${s.demand.label.slice(1)}`, GRP.broken, GRP.modSeasons);
          if (mine) news.push({ group: k, tone: "bad", text: `${G.label}: the time for their demand (${s.demand.label.charAt(0).toLowerCase()}${s.demand.label.slice(1)}) has run out. They feel ignored.` });
          s.demand = null; s.lastDemand = g.turn;
        }
      } else if (s.approval < 48 && g.turn >= 4 && g.turn - (s.lastDemand ?? -99) >= GRP.demandAfter) {
        const D = (GROUP_DEMANDS[k] || []).find(d => d.applies(n, ctx));
        if (D) {
          const L = D.law ? D.law(n, ctx) : null;
          s.demand = { key: D.key, label: D.labelG ? D.labelG(g, ctx) : D.label(n, ctx), since: g.turn, until: g.turn + (D.deadline || GRP.deadline), ...(L ? { law: L.law, value: L.value } : {}), ...(D.extra ? D.extra(n, ctx) : {}) };
          if (mine && s.share >= 0.1) news.push({ group: k, tone: "warn", text: `${G.label} (${pct(s.share)} of the power) ${G.are === "is" ? "demands" : "demand"}: ${s.demand.label.charAt(0).toLowerCase()}${s.demand.label.slice(1)}. You have ${s.demand.until - g.turn} seasons.` });
        }
      }
      // crossing into anger or pleasure
      if (mine && s.share >= 0.12) {
        if (before >= GRP.angryAt && s.approval < GRP.angryAt) {
          const why = groupTerms(w, g, n, econ, n.laws, k, ctx).filter(t => t.value < 0).slice(0, 2).map(t => t.label.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + t.label.slice(1));
          news.push({ group: k, tone: "bad", text: `${G.label} ${G.are} now angry (approval ${Math.round(s.approval)})${why.length ? `: ${why.join("; ")}` : ""}.` });
          addChronicle(g, `${G.label} turned against the government (approval ${Math.round(s.approval)}).`, "warn", PLAYER);
        } else if (before < GRP.happyAt && s.approval >= GRP.happyAt) news.push({ group: k, tone: "good", text: `${G.label} ${G.are} pleased with the government (approval ${Math.round(s.approval)}). ${G.happy}` });
      }
    }
  }
  return news;
}

/* ---------- What they do to the nation ---------- */
function groupStabilityTerms(g, n) {
  if (!n || !n.groups) return [];
  const out = [];
  let sum = 0;
  for (const k of GROUP_ORDER) {
    const s = n.groups[k];
    if (!s) continue;
    const v = (s.share || 0) * ((s.approval ?? 50) - 50) * GRP.stabK;
    if (Math.abs(v) < 0.3) continue;
    out.push({ label: `${GROUPS[k].label} ${GROUPS[k].are} ${groupWord(s.approval)} (approval ${Math.round(s.approval)}, ${pct(s.share)} of the power)`, value: v });
    sum += v;
  }
  if (Math.abs(sum) > GRP.stabCap) { const f = GRP.stabCap / Math.abs(sum); for (const t of out) t.value *= f; }
  return out;
}
/* Passive effects of a pleased or angry group, in proportion to its power (full effect from 25% of the power). */
function groupField(n, field) {
  if (!n || !n.groups) return 0;
  const f = k => { const s = n.groups[k]; return s ? Math.min(1, (s.share || 0) / 0.25) * (s.approval >= GRP.happyAt ? 1 : s.approval < GRP.angryAt ? -1 : 0) : 0; };
  if (field === "output") { const x = f("workers"); return x > 0 ? 0.02 * x : 0.02 * x; }
  if (field === "food") return 0.03 * f("farmers");
  if (field === "invest") { const x = f("business"); return x > 0 ? 0.25 * x : 0.4 * x; }
  if (field === "drill") { const x = f("army"); return x > 0 ? 0.03 * x : 0; }
  return 0;
}
/* A minister who is dismissed takes his group's goodwill with him. */
function groupMinisterDismissed(g, n, m) {
  const k = ministerGroup(m);
  if (!k || !n.groups) return;
  addGroupMod(g, n, k, `dismissed:${m.id}`, `${m.name}, one of theirs, was dismissed`, -6, 8);
}
/* Land won and lost: the army remembers. */
function groupsCityChanged(g, city, from, to) {
  if (to < 0 || to === from) return;
  const war = atWar(g, from, to);
  const A = g.nations[to], B = g.nations[from];
  if (A && A.groups) addGroupMod(g, A, "army", `won:${city.id}`, `${city.name} was won${war ? " in war" : ""}`, war ? 5 : 2, 12);
  if (B && B.groups && B.alive) {
    addGroupMod(g, B, "army", `lost:${city.id}`, war ? `${city.name} was lost in war` : `${city.name} was given away`, war ? -5 : -8, 16);
    if (!war) addGroupMod(g, B, "faith", `lost:${city.id}`, `${city.name} was given away`, -3, 12);
  }
}
/* What a rival government does for its strongest unhappy group: the law it asks for. */
function groupLawWishes(g, n) {
  if (!n.groups) return [];
  return GROUP_ORDER.map(k => ({ k, s: n.groups[k] })).filter(x => x.s && x.s.demand && x.s.demand.law && x.s.approval < 45 && (x.s.share || 0) >= 0.18)
    .sort((a, b) => b.s.share * (50 - b.s.approval) - a.s.share * (50 - a.s.approval)).slice(0, 1)
    .map(x => ({ law: x.s.demand.law, value: x.s.demand.value, why: `satisfy ${GROUPS[x.k].the}` }));
}

/* ---------- Effects on groups from decisions and orders ---------- */
function groupEffectText(e) {
  const parts = GROUP_ORDER.filter(k => e.v && e.v[k]).map(k => `${GROUPS[k].short} ${signed(e.v[k])}`);
  return { text: `${parts.join(", ")} (approval, ${e.seasons ? `${e.seasons} seasons` : "for good"})`, tone: toneOf(GROUP_ORDER.reduce((s, k) => s + (e.v[k] || 0), 0)) };
}
function applyGroupEffect(g, n, e, why) {
  if (!n.groups) return;
  for (const k of GROUP_ORDER) if (e.v && e.v[k]) addGroupMod(g, n, k, `fx:${e.key || why || "x"}:${k}`, e.label || why || "A government decision", e.v[k], e.seasons || GRP.modSeasons);
}
function groupEffectScore(n, e) {
  if (!n || !n.groups) return 0;
  return GROUP_ORDER.reduce((s, k) => s + (e.v[k] || 0) * ((n.groups[k] && n.groups[k].share) || 0.2) * (n.groups[k] && n.groups[k].approval < 40 ? 0.5 : 0.3), 0);
}

function decisionGroupEffects(key, d) {
  const T = DEC_GROUPS[key];
  if (!T || !d || !d.options) return;
  for (const o of d.options) if (T[o.id] && !o.effects.some(e => e.t === "group")) o.effects = o.effects.concat([{ t: "group", v: T[o.id], seasons: GRP.modSeasons, key: `${key}:${o.id}`, label: d.title }]);
}

/* ---------- Crises: what an angry, powerful group does ---------- */
function groupCrisis(c, k, at = GRP.crisisAt, share = GRP.crisisShare) {
  const s = groupOf(c.n, k);
  if (!s || s.approval >= at || (s.share || 0) < share) return null;
  return { s, w: 1.2 + (at - s.approval) * 0.08 + (s.share - share) * 4 };
}
function topGrievances(c, k, m = 2) {
  const terms = groupTerms(c.w, c.g, c.n, c.econ, c.n.laws, k, groupCtx(c.w, c.g, c.n, c.econ)).filter(t => t.value < 0).slice(0, m);
  return terms.map(t => t.label.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + t.label.slice(1)).join("; ") || "the government's choices";
}
function demandLawOption(c, k, id, extra = []) {
  const s = groupOf(c.n, k);
  if (!s || !s.demand || !s.demand.law) return [];
  return [{ id, tag: "kind", label: `Give them what they ask: ${s.demand.label.charAt(0).toLowerCase()}${s.demand.label.slice(1)}`, effects: [{ t: "law", law: s.demand.law, value: s.demand.value }, ...extra] }];
}

DECISIONS.genstrike.make = c => {
  const L = c.n.laws;
  const up = SERVICE_ORDER[SERVICE_ORDER.indexOf(L.services) + 1];
  const lower = TAX_LAWS[TAX_LAWS.findIndex(t => t.v === L.tax) - 1];
  const dem = groupOf(c.n, "workers") && c.n.groups.workers.demand;
  return {
    title: "General strike", cell: c.econ.cities[0].cell,
    body: `The unions have called a general strike. Trains stand still and factories are silent. The workers' complaint: ${topGrievances(c, "workers")}.`,
    options: [
      ...(dem && dem.law && !(dem.law === "services" && up) && !(dem.law === "tax" && lower) ? demandLawOption(c, "workers", "e", [{ t: "stab", v: 2 }]) : []),
      ...(up ? [{ id: "a", tag: "kind", label: `Raise healthcare to ${SERVICE_LAWS[up].label.toLowerCase()}`, effects: [{ t: "law", law: "services", value: up }, { t: "stab", v: 2 }] }] : []),
      ...(lower ? [{ id: "b", tag: "kind", label: `Cut taxes to ${lower.label.toLowerCase()}`, effects: [{ t: "law", law: "tax", value: lower.v }, { t: "stab", v: 2 }] }] : []),
      { id: "c", tag: "force", label: "Break the strike", effects: [{ t: "stab", v: -6 }, { t: "mod", key: "strike_broken", label: "Strike broken by force", output: -0.03, seasons: 1 }] },
    ], def: "c",
  };
};

/* ---------- For the ministers' files: one line on who holds power ---------- */
function groupsFileLine(g, z) {
  if (!z || !z.groups) return "Interest groups: unknown.";
  const order = GROUP_ORDER.slice().sort((a, b) => z.groups[b].share - z.groups[a].share);
  const dem = order.filter(k => z.groups[k].demand).map(k => `${GROUPS[k].label}: ${z.groups[k].demand.label.toLowerCase()} (${z.groups[k].demand.until - g.turn} seasons left)`);
  const st = groupStabilityTerms(g, z).reduce((s, t) => s + t.value, 0);
  return `Interest groups (who holds power): ${order.map(k => `${GROUPS[k].label} ${pct(z.groups[k].share)} of the power, approval ${Math.round(z.groups[k].approval)} (${groupWord(z.groups[k].approval)})`).join("; ")}. Together they move stability ${signed1(st)}.${dem.length ? ` Their demands: ${dem.join("; ")}.` : ""}`;
}
function groupFileLines(w, g, n) {
  if (!n.groups) return ["Unknown."];
  const econ = computeEconomy(w, g, n.id), ctx = groupCtx(w, g, n, econ);
  return GROUP_ORDER.slice().sort((a, b) => n.groups[b].share - n.groups[a].share).map(k => {
    const s = n.groups[k];
    const why = groupTerms(w, g, n, econ, n.laws, k, ctx).slice(0, 4).map(t => `${t.label.toLowerCase()} ${t.value > 0 ? "+" : ""}${Math.round(t.value)}`).join("; ");
    return `${GROUPS[k].label}: ${pct(s.share)} of the power, approval ${Math.round(s.approval)} (${groupWord(s.approval)}, heading to ${Math.round(s.target ?? s.approval)})${why ? `; why: ${why}` : ""}${s.demand ? `; DEMAND: ${s.demand.label.toLowerCase()} (${s.demand.until - g.turn} seasons left)` : ""}. When pleased: ${GROUPS[k].happy.toLowerCase()} When angry: ${GROUPS[k].angry.toLowerCase()}`;
  });
}

/* =====================================================================

   (hours, unions, minimum wage, child labour, women at work, pensions).

function labourLaw(L, k) { const D = LABOUR[k]; return D.vals[(L && L[k]) || D.def] || D.vals[D.def]; }
function labourDefaults() { return Object.fromEntries(LABOUR_ORDER.map(k => [k, LABOUR[k].def])); }
/* What each kind of government would choose, given time and calm. */
const LAB_PREFS = {
  expansionist: { hours: "long", unions: "banned", minwage: "none", childwork: "limited", women: "some", pensions: "none" },
  mercantile:   { hours: "normal", unions: "allowed", minwage: "low", childwork: "banned", women: "equal", pensions: "basic" },

/* ---------- Three kinds of workers ---------- */
const SKILL_LEVELS = ["u", "s", "e"];
const SKILL_INFO = {
  u: { label: "Unskilled", short: "unskilled", color: "#a59a86", who: "labourers, farm hands, dockers, shop and factory hands" },
  s: { label: "Skilled", short: "skilled", color: "#d9a441", who: "trained trades: machinists, electricians, foremen, nurses, clerks" },
  e: { label: "Educated", short: "educated", color: "#6fb6e0", who: "university people: engineers, doctors, teachers, scientists, managers" },
};
const PEOPLE = {
  skillBase: 0.144, skillS: 0.6, skillE: 1.2,   // the old single "workforce skill" number, worked out from the mix
  wageW: { u: 1, s: 1.6, e: 2.6 },              // how pay is shared inside a workplace
  renew: 0.02,                                  // each season the mix moves 2% of the way to what the schools give
  train: 0.006,                                 // where skilled hands are short, unskilled workers learn on the job (share of them a season)
  pm: 0.95,                                     // men of working age who work
  natRef: 0.0165,                               // a year's natural growth that the food-based growth was tuned for
  lamRef: 0.4,                                  // the owners' share of output at the default laws
  pwPull: 0.06,                                 // how fast customs change: women's work moves 6% of the way to the law a season
};
const EDU_ENTRY = { minimal: { s: 0.15, e: 0.01 }, basic: { s: 0.35, e: 0.04 }, good: { s: 0.47, e: 0.11 }, excellent: { s: 0.5, e: 0.27 } };
/* What share of the jobs in each kind of workplace needs each kind of worker. */
const JOB_MIX = {
  farm: [0.92, 0.08, 0], services: [0.58, 0.33, 0.09], public: [0.4, 0.45, 0.15],
  fishing: [0.8, 0.2, 0], logging: [0.8, 0.2, 0], mine: [0.62, 0.34, 0.04], coalmine: [0.66, 0.31, 0.03], goldmine: [0.55, 0.38, 0.07], oilfield: [0.45, 0.45, 0.1],
  smelter: [0.5, 0.44, 0.06], power_coal: [0.45, 0.45, 0.1], power_gas: [0.4, 0.48, 0.12], power_hydro: [0.4, 0.48, 0.12], power_nuclear: [0.15, 0.45, 0.4],
  light: [0.6, 0.35, 0.05], foodproc: [0.65, 0.31, 0.04], heavy: [0.45, 0.48, 0.07], chemical: [0.3, 0.52, 0.18], electronics: [0.22, 0.5, 0.28],
  resort: [0.62, 0.33, 0.05], university: [0.15, 0.3, 0.55], techpark: [0.1, 0.35, 0.55], broadcast: [0.2, 0.45, 0.35], business: [0.15, 0.45, 0.4],
};
function jobMix(kind) { return JOB_MIX[kind] || JOB_MIX.light; }
const LAMBDA = { farm: 0.62, primary: 0.5, secondary: 0.55, tertiary: 0.64, quaternary: 0.6 };   // workers' share of what a workplace makes, at the default laws
const JOB_PLACE = { farm: "Farms", primary: "Mines, oil fields, forests and fishing", secondary: "Factories and power stations", quaternary: "Offices, universities and research", tertiary: "Shops, transport and services", public: "Hospitals, schools and government" };

function skillIndex(s, e) { return PEOPLE.skillBase + PEOPLE.skillS * s + PEOPLE.skillE * e; }
/* An old save, or a new nation: the mix that gives the workforce skill it had. */
function eduFromSkill(skill) {
  const sk = skill ?? 0.36;
  const e = clamp(0.03 + (sk - 0.36) * 0.45, 0.005, 0.4);
  const s = clamp((sk - PEOPLE.skillBase - PEOPLE.skillE * e) / PEOPLE.skillS, 0.05, 0.6);
  return { s, e };
}
function eduOf(n) { return (n && n.edu) || eduFromSkill(n ? n.skill : 0.36); }

/* ---------- Young and old ---------- */
function demoRates(n, kp, L, g) {
  L = L || (n && n.laws) || {};
  const svRaw = { minimal: -4, basic: 0, good: 5, generous: 9 }[L.services || "basic"] || 0;
  const staff = n && n.demo && n.demo.staff != null ? n.demo.staff : 1;
  const sv = svRaw > 0 ? svRaw * staff : svRaw;
  const hungry = n && n.lastFamine ? -12 * clamp(n.lastFamine, 0, 1) : 0;
  const e0 = clamp(46 + sv + (hasTech(n, "medicine") ? 6 : 0) + 22 * (1 - Math.exp(-Math.max(0, kp) / 30)) + labourLaw(L, "hours").e0 + hungry, 30, 86);
  const eduT = { minimal: 0.1, basic: 0, good: -0.05, excellent: -0.15 }[L.education || "basic"] || 0;
  const tfr = clamp(1.6 + 3.2 * Math.exp(-Math.max(0, kp - 8) / 18) + labourLaw(L, "women").tfr + labourLaw(L, "childwork").tfr + labourLaw(L, "pensions").tfr + eduT, 1.1, 6.5);
  return { e0, tfr, mk: 0.02 * Math.exp(-(e0 - 48) / 8), mw: 0.011 * Math.exp(-(e0 - 48) / 25), mo: 1 / Math.max(6, 0.25 * e0) };
}
/* A year's births, deaths and ageing, as shares of the population. */
function demoFlows(d, R) {
  const K = d.kids, O = d.old, W = 1 - K - O;
  const births = R.tfr * 0.43 * W / 35;
  const dk = K * R.mk, dw = W * R.mw, dold = O * R.mo;
  const r = births - dk - dw - dold;
  // in a growing nation the young outnumber those about to grow up or grow old
  return { births, deaths: dk + dw + dold, dk, dw, dold, kOut: K / 15 * Math.exp(-r * 7), wOut: W / 50 * Math.exp(-r * 24) * 0.8, r };
}
function stableAges(n, kp, L) {
  const R = demoRates(n, kp, L);
  let d = { kids: 0.36, old: 0.06 };
  for (let y = 0; y < 300; y++) {
    const f = demoFlows(d, R);
    const K = d.kids + f.births - f.kOut - f.dk, W = 1 - d.kids - d.old + f.kOut - f.wOut - f.dw, O = d.old + f.wOut - f.dold;
    const T = K + W + O;
    d = { kids: K / T, old: O / T };
  }
  return d;
}
const DEMO_DEFAULT = { kids: 0.36, old: 0.063, pw: 0.6, r: 0.0165, e0: 50, tfr: 4.8 };
function demoOf(n) { return (n && n.demo) || DEMO_DEFAULT; }
function ensurePeople(w, g, n, econ) {
  n.laws = { ...labourDefaults(), ...n.laws };
  if (!n.edu) n.edu = eduFromSkill(n.skill);
  n.skill = skillIndex(n.edu.s, n.edu.e);
  if (!n.demo) {
    const e = econ || computeEconomy(w, g, n.id);
    const kp = e.people ? e.people.lsRaw : (e.gdp / Math.max(0.01, e.pop)) * 0.55;
    const d = stableAges(n, kp, n.laws);
    const R = demoRates(n, kp, n.laws);
    const f = demoFlows(d, R);
    n.demo = { kids: d.kids, old: d.old, pw: labourLaw(n.laws, "women").pw, r: f.r, e0: R.e0, tfr: R.tfr, births: f.births, deaths: f.deaths, hist: [] };
  }
}
/* Who works: men and women of working age, children where the law lets them, old people without a pension. */
function labourForce(n, L) {
  L = L || (n && n.laws) || {};
  const D = demoOf(n);
  const K = D.kids, O = D.old, W = 1 - K - O;
  const pw = D.pw ?? labourLaw(L, "women").pw;
  const men = W * 0.5 * PEOPLE.pm, women = W * 0.5 * pw, kids = K * labourLaw(L, "childwork").work, old = O * labourLaw(L, "pensions").oldWork;
  return { lf: men + women + kids + old, men, women, kids, old, adults: men + women };
}

/* ---------- Filling the jobs ---------- */
function poolSum(p) { return p.u + p.s + p.e; }
/* Take n workers for jobs any worker can do: the unskilled first, then the skilled, then the educated. */
function takeAny(p, n, into) {
  let left = n;
  for (const l of SKILL_LEVELS) { const t = Math.min(p[l], left); p[l] -= t; left -= t; into[l] += t; }
  return n - left;
}
/* Take workers for a mix of jobs: educated jobs need the educated, skilled jobs the skilled or educated, the rest anyone. */
function takeMix(p, need, mix, into) {
  const Ne = need * mix[2], Ns = need * mix[1], Nu = need * mix[0];
  let t = Math.min(p.e, Ne); p.e -= t; into.e += t; into.posE = (into.posE || 0) + t;
  into.ne = (into.ne || 0) + Ne; into.fe = (into.fe || 0) + t; into.ns = (into.ns || 0) + Ns;
  let ns = Ns; t = Math.min(p.s, ns); p.s -= t; into.s += t; ns -= t; into.fs = (into.fs || 0) + t; t = Math.min(p.e, ns); p.e -= t; into.e += t; into.over = (into.over || 0) + t; into.fs += t;
  let nu = Nu; t = Math.min(p.u, nu); p.u -= t; into.u += t; nu -= t;
  t = Math.min(p.s, nu); p.s -= t; into.s += t; nu -= t; into.over = (into.over || 0) + t;
  t = Math.min(p.e, nu); p.e -= t; into.e += t; nu -= t; into.over = (into.over || 0) + t;
}
/* How much of a workplace can work with the people on hand, and which kind of worker holds it back. */
function mixFill(need, mix, E, S, U) {
  if (!(need > 0)) return { f: 0, lack: null };
  const Ne = need * mix[2], Ns = need * mix[1];
  const fe = Ne > 1e-9 ? E / Ne : Infinity, fs = Ne + Ns > 1e-9 ? (E + S) / (Ne + Ns) : Infinity, fa = (E + S + U) / need;
  const f = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, fe, fs, fa));
  const lack = f >= 0.999 ? null : fa <= Math.min(fe, fs) ? "u" : fe <= fs ? "e" : "s";
  return { f, lack };
}
function jobFill(x, need, pool) {
  const mix = jobMix(x.kind);
  x.need = need;
  const { f, lack } = mixFill(need, mix, pool.e, pool.s, pool.u);
  x.take = { u: 0, s: 0, e: 0 };
  takeMix(pool, need * f, mix, x.take);
  x.workers = poolSum(x.take);
  x.fill = need > 0 ? x.workers / need : 0;
  x.lack = lack;
  return x.workers;
}
/* Skilled and educated people move within a road network to the workplaces that are short of them. */
function shareSkills(regions, networks) {
  for (let k = 0; k < networks.length; k++) {
    const regs = regions.filter(r => r.net === k);
    if (regs.length < 2) continue;
    for (const r of regs) for (const x of r.ind) {
      if (!(x.need > 0) || x.fill >= 0.999 || (x.lack !== "s" && x.lack !== "e")) continue;
      const others = regs.filter(o => o !== r);
      const oE = others.reduce((s, o) => s + o.pool.e, 0), oS = others.reduce((s, o) => s + o.pool.s, 0);
      if (oE + oS < 1e-6) continue;
      // give back what it holds, then hire again with the whole network's skilled people
      const back = x.take; r.pool.u += back.u; r.pool.s += back.s; r.pool.e += back.e;
      r.indWorkers -= x.workers;
      const mix = jobMix(x.kind), need = x.need;
      const { f, lack } = mixFill(need, mix, r.pool.e + oE, r.pool.s + oS, r.pool.u);
      const want = { e: need * f * mix[2], s: need * f * mix[1] };
      // the skilled positions: own town first, then the others
      const borrow = { u: 0, s: 0, e: 0 };
      const take = { u: 0, s: 0, e: 0 };
      const fromOthers = (lvl, amt) => { let left = amt; for (const o of others) { const t = Math.min(o.pool[lvl], left); o.pool[lvl] -= t; left -= t; borrow[lvl] += t; o.lent = (o.lent || 0) + t; if (left <= 1e-12) break; } return amt - left; };
      let t = Math.min(r.pool.e, want.e); r.pool.e -= t; take.e += t; take.posE = t; if (want.e - t > 1e-12) { const b = fromOthers("e", want.e - t); take.e += b; take.posE += b; }
      let ns = want.s; t = Math.min(r.pool.s, ns); r.pool.s -= t; take.s += t; ns -= t;
      if (ns > 1e-12) { const b = fromOthers("s", ns); take.s += b; ns -= b; }
      if (ns > 1e-12) { t = Math.min(r.pool.e, ns); r.pool.e -= t; take.e += t; ns -= t; take.over = t; if (ns > 1e-12) { const b = fromOthers("e", ns); take.e += b; take.over += b; } }
      const rest = { u: 0, s: 0, e: 0 };
      takeAny(r.pool, need * f * mix[0], rest);
      take.u += rest.u; take.s += rest.s; take.e += rest.e; take.over = (take.over || 0) + rest.s + rest.e;
      x.take = take;
      x.workers = take.u + take.s + take.e;
      x.fill = need > 0 ? x.workers / need : 0;
      x.lack = lack;
      x.borrowed = borrow.s + borrow.e;
      r.indWorkers += x.workers;
    }
  }
  for (const r of regions) r.unfilledInd = r.ind.reduce((s, x) => s + Math.max(0, (x.need || 0) - (x.workers || 0)), 0);
}
/* Each town's people by kind: the nation's mix, with more educated people in the capital and university towns, fewer in towns cut off. */
function peoplePools(nation, regions, networks, adultsShare) {
  const ed = eduOf(nation);
  const sN = ed.s * adultsShare, eN = ed.e * adultsShare;
  const wE = regions.map(r => r.workforce * (r.city.capital ? 1.3 : 1) * (r.cm && r.cm.learning ? 1.5 : 1) * (networks[r.net].capital ? 1 : 0.6) * (r.pop > 4 ? 1.15 : 1));
  const wS = regions.map(r => r.workforce * (networks[r.net].capital ? 1 : 0.85));
  const W = regions.reduce((s, r) => s + r.workforce, 0);
  const sE = wE.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0), sS = wS.reduce((s, v) => s + v, 0);
  regions.forEach((r, k) => {
    const e = sE > 0 ? Math.min(0.9 * r.workforce, eN * W * wE[k] / sE) : 0;
    const s = sS > 0 ? Math.min(r.workforce - e, sN * W * wS[k] / sS) : 0;
    r.pool = { u: Math.max(0, r.workforce - e - s), s, e };
    r.mix0 = { s: r.workforce > 0 ? s / r.workforce : 0, e: r.workforce > 0 ? e / r.workforce : 0 };
  });
}
/* Service jobs: hospitals, schools and government hire first (doctors, nurses, teachers), then shops, transport and offices.
   Posts nobody qualified could fill are filled by whoever is left. */
function takeServices(pool, n, pubN) {
  const pub = { u: 0, s: 0, e: 0 }, rest = { u: 0, s: 0, e: 0 };
  const np = Math.min(n, Math.max(0, pubN));
  takeMix(pool, np, JOB_MIX.public, pub);
  takeMix(pool, n - np, JOB_MIX.services, rest);
  const into = { u: pub.u + rest.u, s: pub.s + rest.s, e: pub.e + rest.e, over: (pub.over || 0) + (rest.over || 0), pub };
  const got = poolSum(into);
  if (got < n - 1e-9) { const extra = { u: 0, s: 0, e: 0 }; takeAny(pool, n - got, extra); into.u += extra.u; into.s += extra.s; into.e += extra.e; }
  return into;
}
/* How well the public services are staffed: doctors, nurses, teachers and officials who have the training. */
function publicStaffing(regions) {
  let ne = 0, fe = 0, ns = 0, fs = 0;
  for (const r of regions) { const p = r.svcTake && r.svcTake.pub; if (!p) continue; ne += p.ne || 0; fe += p.fe || 0; ns += p.ns || 0; fs += p.fs || 0; }
  const e = ne > 1e-9 ? fe / ne : 1, s = ns > 1e-9 ? fs / ns : 1;
  return { e, s, f: 0.6 * e + 0.4 * s, ne, fe, ns, fs };
}

/* ---------- Wages, pensions and the living standard ---------- */
function labourLam(n, L) {
  L = L || (n && n.laws) || {};
  return labourLaw(L, "hours").lam + labourLaw(L, "unions").lam + labourLaw(L, "minwage").lam + modSum(n, "wage");
}
function strikeCut(n, kind) {
  let c = 0;
  for (const m of (n && n.mods) || []) if (m.strike === kind) c = Math.max(c, m.strikeCut || 0.5);
  return c;
}
function pensionPlan(pop, D, L, avgWage) {
  const P = labourLaw(L, "pensions");
  const old = pop * D.old;
  const pensioners = old * (1 - P.oldWork);
  const per = P.rate * avgWage;
  return { old, pensioners, per, cost: pensioners * per };
}
/* Who earns what: each workplace pays its workers a share of what it makes, split by kind of worker. */
function peopleWages(nation, regions, all, econ, LF) {
  const L = (nation && nation.laws) || {};
  const dLam = labourLam(nation, L);
  const acts = [];
  const add = (place, r, va, take, lam) => { if (va > 0 && take && poolSum(take) > 1e-9) acts.push({ place, r, va, take, lam: clamp(lam + dLam, 0.2, 0.9) }); };
  for (const x of all) {
    const def = INDUSTRIES[x.kind];
    add(def.sector === "primary" ? "primary" : def.sector, x.region, x.va || 0, x.take, LAMBDA[def.sector] || 0.55);
  }
  for (const r of regions) {
    add("farm", r, r.farmVA || 0, r.farmTake, LAMBDA.farm);
    if (r.svcTake && r.svcVA > 0) {
      const pub = Math.min(r.publicJobs || 0, r.serviceWorkers || 0), all2 = Math.max(1e-9, r.serviceWorkers || 0);
      const fp = pub / all2;
      const split = (t, f) => ({ u: t.u * f, s: t.s * f, e: t.e * f });
      add("tertiary", r, r.svcVA * (1 - fp), split(r.svcTake, 1 - fp), LAMBDA.tertiary);
      add("public", r, r.svcVA * fp, split(r.svcTake, fp), LAMBDA.tertiary);
    }
  }
  // first pass: what each workplace pays each kind of worker
  let bill = 0, workers = 0;
  for (const a of acts) {
    a.bill = a.va * a.lam;
    const units = a.take.u * PEOPLE.wageW.u + a.take.s * PEOPLE.wageW.s + a.take.e * PEOPLE.wageW.e;
    a.unit = units > 0 ? a.bill / units : 0;
    bill += a.bill; workers += poolSum(a.take);
  }
  const avg0 = workers > 0 ? bill / workers : 0;
  // a minimum wage lifts the lowest pay (out of the owners' share)
  const floor = labourLaw(L, "minwage").floor * avg0;
  let lifted = 0;
  if (floor > 0) for (const a of acts) {
    const wu = a.unit * PEOPLE.wageW.u;
    if (wu < floor && a.take.u > 0) { const extra = (floor - wu) * a.take.u; a.bill += extra; a.floorU = floor; lifted += extra; bill += extra; }
  }
  const lv = { u: { pay: 0, n: 0 }, s: { pay: 0, n: 0 }, e: { pay: 0, n: 0 } };
  const places = {};
  for (const a of acts) {
    const wu = a.floorU ? a.floorU : a.unit * PEOPLE.wageW.u;
    const pay = { u: wu * a.take.u, s: a.unit * PEOPLE.wageW.s * a.take.s, e: a.unit * PEOPLE.wageW.e * a.take.e };
    for (const l of SKILL_LEVELS) { lv[l].pay += pay[l]; lv[l].n += a.take[l]; }
    const P = places[a.place] || (places[a.place] = { pay: 0, n: 0, va: 0 });
    P.pay += pay.u + pay.s + pay.e; P.n += poolSum(a.take); P.va += a.va;
    a.r.wages = (a.r.wages || 0) + pay.u + pay.s + pay.e;
  }
  const avg = workers > 0 ? bill / workers : 0;
  const pop = Math.max(0.001, econ.pop);
  const D = demoOf(nation);
  const pen = pensionPlan(pop, D, L, avg);
  const benefit = { minimal: 0, basic: 0.15, good: 0.3, generous: 0.45 }[L.services || "basic"] || 0;
  const wageU = lv.u.n > 0 ? lv.u.pay / lv.u.n : avg;
  const jobless = (econ.unemployed || 0) * benefit * wageU;
  const plots = regions.reduce((s, r) => s + (r.smallholders || 0), 0) * wageU * 0.5;
  const goods = 0.8 + 0.2 * Math.min(1, econ.sat ? econ.sat.goods ?? 1 : 1);
  const income = bill + pen.cost + jobless + plots;
  for (const r of regions) r.incomeK = (r.wages || 0) / Math.max(0.001, r.pop);
  return {
    bill, lifted, avg, wage: { u: wageU, s: lv.s.n > 0 ? lv.s.pay / lv.s.n : avg, e: lv.e.n > 0 ? lv.e.pay / lv.e.n : avg },
    places, lam: econ.gdp > 0 ? bill / econ.gdp : 0, dLam, pension: pen, benefit, joblessPay: jobless, plotsPay: plots,
    lsRaw: income / pop, ls: income / pop * goods, goodsK: goods, income,
  };
}
/* After the economy is worked out: the nation's people and work in one place. */
function peopleSummary(nation, regions, all, econ, LF, armed) {
  const tot = { u: 0, s: 0, e: 0 }, have = { u: 0, s: 0, e: 0 }, short = { s: 0, e: 0 }, posNeed = { s: 0, e: 0 };
  let over = 0, borrowed = 0;
  const shortages = [];
  for (const r of regions) {
    have.u += r.workforce * (1 - r.mix0.s - r.mix0.e); have.s += r.workforce * r.mix0.s; have.e += r.workforce * r.mix0.e;
    for (const x of r.ind) {
      if (!(x.need > 0)) continue;
      const mix = jobMix(x.kind);
      posNeed.s += x.need * mix[1]; posNeed.e += x.need * mix[2];
      over += (x.take && x.take.over) || 0;
      borrowed += x.borrowed || 0;
      if (x.lack === "s" || x.lack === "e") {
        const miss = x.need * (x.lack === "e" ? mix[2] : mix[1]) * (1 - x.fill);
        short[x.lack] += miss;
        if (miss > 0.0005) shortages.push({ town: r.city.name, cityId: r.city.id, kind: x.kind, site: !!x.site, fill: x.fill, lack: x.lack, miss });
      }
    }
    for (const t of [r.farmTake, r.svcTake]) if (t) over += t.over || 0;
  }
  shortages.sort((a, b) => b.miss - a.miss);
  const W = Math.max(1e-6, regions.reduce((s, r) => s + r.workforce, 0));
  const wages = peopleWages(nation, regions, all, econ, LF);
  return {
    lf: LF.lf, parts: { men: LF.men, women: LF.women, kids: LF.kids, old: LF.old }, adultsShare: LF.lf > 0 ? LF.adults / LF.lf : 1, armed,
    have, need: posNeed, short, shortages: shortages.slice(0, 12), over, borrowed, W, staff: publicStaffing(regions),
    ...wages,
  };
}
function pensionCostYear(n, econ, laws) {
  const P = econ.people;
  if (!P) return 0;
  return pensionPlan(econ.pop, demoOf(n), laws || n.laws, P.avg).cost;
}

/* ---------- Each season: children are born, people grow old, workers learn ---------- */
function peopleSeason(w, g, n, econ, pf, popBefore) {
  ensurePeople(w, g, n, econ);
  const D = n.demo, P = econ.people;
  const kp = P ? P.lsRaw : 10;
  n.lastFamine = econ.famineShare || 0;
  n.era = g.era || 0;
  const R = demoRates(n, kp, n.laws, g);
  const f = demoFlows(D, R);
  const q = 0.25;
  const actual = popBefore > 0 ? ((pf.births || 0) + (pf.famine || 0)) / popBefore : 0;
  // where food is short, fewer children are born and live; where the land feeds more, the nation grows faster at every age
  let B = f.births * q + Math.min(0, actual - f.r * q);
  if (B < 0) B = 0;
  let K = D.kids + B - f.kOut * q - f.dk * q;
  let Wk = 1 - D.kids - D.old + f.kOut * q - f.wOut * q - f.dw * q - (popBefore > 0 ? Math.max(0, -(pf.war || 0)) / popBefore : 0);
  let O = D.old + f.wOut * q - f.dold * q;
  K = Math.max(0.05, K); Wk = Math.max(0.2, Wk); O = Math.max(0.005, O);
  const T = K + Wk + O;
  D.kids = K / T; D.old = O / T;
  D.e0 = R.e0; D.tfr = R.tfr; D.r = f.r; D.births = B * 4; D.deaths = f.deaths;
  D.staff = P && P.staff ? P.staff.f : 1;
  // women's work changes with the law, slowly; in a great war they take the places of the men at the front
  const atWarNow = enemiesOf(g, n.id).length > 0;
  const boost = atWarNow && ARMY_ORDER.indexOf(n.laws.army) >= 2 && n.laws.women !== "home" ? 0.12 : 0;
  const pwT = labourLaw(n.laws, "women").pw + boost;
  D.pw = (D.pw ?? pwT) + (pwT - (D.pw ?? pwT)) * (boost ? 0.25 : PEOPLE.pwPull);
  D.warWork = boost > 0;
  D.hist = (D.hist || []).concat([{ t: g.turn, ls: Math.round((P ? P.ls : 0) * 100) / 100 }]).slice(-24);
  peopleSkills(n, econ);
}
/* What the young bring from school, and what adults learn. */
function skillTarget(n, econ, L) {
  L = L || n.laws;
  const want = EDU_ENTRY[L.education || "basic"] || EDU_ENTRY.basic, low = EDU_ENTRY.minimal;
  const st = econ.people && econ.people.staff ? econ.people.staff.f : 1;
  const base = { s: low.s + (want.s - low.s) * st, e: low.e + (want.e - low.e) * st };
  const C = labourLaw(L, "childwork");
  const uni = Math.min(0.1, 0.02 * ((econ.levels && econ.levels.university) || 0));
  const bonus = ((econ.skillBonus || 0) + (econ.citySkill || 0)) / PEOPLE.skillE;
  return { s: clamp(base.s + C.entryS, 0.03, 0.6), e: clamp(base.e + C.entryE + uni + bonus, 0.005, 0.42) };
}
function peopleSkills(n, econ) {
  const ed = n.edu || (n.edu = eduFromSkill(n.skill));
  const T = skillTarget(n, econ);
  ed.s += (T.s - ed.s) * PEOPLE.renew;
  ed.e += (T.e - ed.e) * PEOPLE.renew;
  // learning on the job, where skilled hands are short
  const P = econ.people;
  if (P && P.short && P.W > 0 && P.short.s > 0) {
    const u = Math.max(0, 1 - ed.s - ed.e);
    ed.s += Math.min(P.short.s / P.W, PEOPLE.train * u);
  }
  ed.s = clamp(ed.s, 0.02, 0.65); ed.e = clamp(ed.e, 0.003, 0.45);
  if (ed.s + ed.e > 0.95) { const k = 0.95 / (ed.s + ed.e); ed.s *= k; ed.e *= k; }
  n.skill = skillIndex(ed.s, ed.e);
}
/* A decision or great work that raises "skill" by v: shared between trades and universities. */
function peopleSkillAdd(n, v) {
  const ed = n.edu || (n.edu = eduFromSkill(n.skill));
  ed.s = clamp(ed.s + v * 0.7 / PEOPLE.skillS, 0.02, 0.65);
  ed.e = clamp(ed.e + v * 0.3 / PEOPLE.skillE, 0.003, 0.45);
  n.skill = skillIndex(ed.s, ed.e);
}
/* Natural growth sets how fast people multiply where food allows: richer, older nations grow slowly or shrink. */
function peopleGrowth(fed, n) {
  const r = n && n.demo && n.demo.r != null ? n.demo.r : PEOPLE.natRef;
  const k = r / PEOPLE.natRef;
  return k >= 0 ? fed * Math.min(k, 2) : r / 4;
}
/* The owners' share of output: lower pay leaves more to invest, higher pay less. */
function profitFactor(n) { return clamp((PEOPLE.lamRef - labourLam(n)) / PEOPLE.lamRef, 0.6, 1.4); }

/* ---------- Stability ---------- */
function peopleStabTerms(n, econ, laws) {
  const L = laws || n.laws;
  const out = [];
  const H = labourLaw(L, "hours"), U = labourLaw(L, "unions");
  if (H.stab) out.push({ label: `Working hours: ${H.label.toLowerCase()} (${H.sub} a week)`, value: H.stab });
  if (U.stab) out.push({ label: "Trade unions banned", value: U.stab });
  const D = demoOf(n);
  if (labourLaw(L, "pensions").rate === 0 && D.old > 0.08) out.push({ label: `Old people without pensions (${pct(D.old)} of the people are over 65)`, value: -Math.min(6, (D.old - 0.08) * 60) });
  const era = n.era || 0;
  if (L.childwork === "allowed" && era >= 2) out.push({ label: "Children in the mines and mills shock the public", value: -2 });
  return out;
}

/* ---------- What the groups think of it all ---------- */
function peopleGroupTerms(n, econ, L, k, T) {
  const lv = (key, map) => { const v = map[(L && L[key]) || LABOUR[key].def] || 0; if (v) T(`${LABOUR[key].name}: ${labourLaw(L, key).label.toLowerCase()}${labourLaw(L, key).sub ? ` (${labourLaw(L, key).sub})` : ""}`, v); };
  const D = demoOf(n), P = econ.people;
  if (k === "workers") {
    lv("hours", { long: -8, short: 6 });
    lv("unions", { banned: -12, strong: 8 });
    lv("minwage", { low: 3, high: 7 });
    lv("childwork", { allowed: -3, banned: 2 });
    lv("pensions", { basic: 3, generous: 6 });
    if (labourLaw(L, "pensions").rate === 0 && D.old > 0.08) T("Old workers with no pension", -Math.min(6, (D.old - 0.08) * 80));
    const tr = lsTrend(n);
    if (tr !== null && tr > 0.03) T(`Living standards rising (${signedPct(tr, 1)} in a year)`, 4);
    else if (tr !== null && tr < -0.02) T(`Living standards falling (${signedPct(tr, 1)} in a year)`, -clamp(-tr * 150, 2, 10));
  } else if (k === "business") {
    lv("hours", { long: 5, short: -6 });
    lv("unions", { banned: 6, strong: -8 });
    lv("minwage", { low: -3, high: -7 });
    lv("childwork", { allowed: 3, banned: -2 });
    lv("women", { home: -3, equal: 3 });
    lv("pensions", { generous: -3 });
    if (P && P.need && P.need.s + P.need.e > 0.01) {
      const sh = (P.short.s + P.short.e) / (P.need.s + P.need.e);
      if (sh > 0.03) T(`Factories and offices can't find skilled people (${pct(sh)} of the posts empty)`, -clamp(sh * 40, 2, 8));
    }
  } else if (k === "farmers") {
    lv("childwork", { allowed: 3, banned: -4 });
    lv("minwage", { high: -3 });
  } else if (k === "faith") {
    lv("women", { home: 5, equal: -7 });
    lv("childwork", { allowed: -2 });
    lv("pensions", { basic: 2, generous: 3 });
  }
}
function lsTrend(n) {
  const h = (n.demo && n.demo.hist) || [];
  if (h.length < 5) return null;
  const a = h[h.length - 5].ls, b = h[h.length - 1].ls;
  return a > 0 ? b / a - 1 : null;
}
/* What workers and employers ask for. */
const PEOPLE_DEMANDS = {
  workers: [
    { key: "unions", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "unions", ["banned"]), met: (n) => !lawIs(n, "unions", ["banned"]), law: () => ({ law: "unions", value: "allowed" }), label: () => "Allow trade unions" },
    { key: "hours", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "hours", ["long"]), met: (n) => !lawIs(n, "hours", ["long"]), law: () => ({ law: "hours", value: "normal" }), label: () => "A 48-hour week (normal working hours)" },
    { key: "pension", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "pensions", ["none"]) && demoOf(n).old > 0.08, met: (n) => !lawIs(n, "pensions", ["none"]), law: () => ({ law: "pensions", value: "basic" }), label: () => "Pensions for old workers" },
    { key: "minwage", applies: (n, c) => lawIs(n, "minwage", ["none"]) && (lsTrend(n) ?? 0) < 0, met: (n) => !lawIs(n, "minwage", ["none"]), law: () => ({ law: "minwage", value: "low" }), label: () => "A minimum wage" },
  ],
  business: [
    { key: "unions", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "unions", ["strong"]), met: (n) => !lawIs(n, "unions", ["strong"]), law: () => ({ law: "unions", value: "allowed" }), label: () => "Curb the unions (allowed, not strong)" },
    { key: "minwage", applies: (n) => lawIs(n, "minwage", ["high"]), met: (n) => !lawIs(n, "minwage", ["high"]), law: () => ({ law: "minwage", value: "low" }), label: () => "Lower the minimum wage" },
    { key: "skills", applies: (n, c) => { const P = c.econ.people; return !!P && P.need.s + P.need.e > 0.01 && (P.short.s + P.short.e) / (P.need.s + P.need.e) > 0.06 && EDU_ORDER.indexOf(n.laws.education || "basic") < 3; }, met: (n, c, d) => EDU_ORDER.indexOf(n.laws.education || "basic") > EDU_ORDER.indexOf(d.from), law: (n) => ({ law: "education", value: EDU_ORDER[EDU_ORDER.indexOf(n.laws.education || "basic") + 1] }), label: (n) => `Train more skilled people: education to ${EDU_LAWS[EDU_ORDER[EDU_ORDER.indexOf(n.laws.education || "basic") + 1]].label.toLowerCase()}`, extra: (n) => ({ from: n.laws.education || "basic" }) },
  ],
};

/* ---------- Strikes: workers stop one industry until they are heard ---------- */
const STRIKERS = {
  mine: "iron miners", coalmine: "coal miners", goldmine: "gold miners", oilfield: "oil workers", logging: "loggers", fishing: "fishermen", smelter: "smelter workers",
  power_coal: "power station workers", power_gas: "power station workers", power_hydro: "dam and power workers", power_nuclear: "nuclear plant workers",
  light: "textile and workshop hands", foodproc: "food factory workers", heavy: "steel and machine workers", chemical: "chemical workers", electronics: "electronics workers",
  resort: "hotel workers", university: "university staff", techpark: "technicians", broadcast: "printers and broadcasters", business: "office clerks",
};
function strikeTarget(c) {
  const by = {};
  for (const r of c.econ.regions) for (const x of r.ind) if (x.workers > 0) by[x.kind] = by[x.kind] || { kind: x.kind, workers: 0, va: 0, town: r.city, top: 0 };
  for (const r of c.econ.regions) for (const x of r.ind) if (x.workers > 0) { const b = by[x.kind]; b.workers += x.workers; b.va += x.va || 0; if (x.workers > b.top) { b.top = x.workers; b.town = r.city; } }
  return Object.values(by).sort((a, b) => b.workers - a.workers)[0] || null;
}
const PEOPLE_DECISIONS = {
  walkout: {
    cat: "Economy", icon: "people", tone: "bad",
    find: c => {
      const U = labourLaw(c.n.laws, "unions");
      const s = groupOf(c.n, "workers");
      if (!U.strikes || !s || (c.n.mods || []).some(m => m.strike)) return null;
      const at = c.n.laws.unions === "strong" ? 55 : 46;
      if (s.approval >= at) return null;
      const t = strikeTarget(c);
      if (!t || t.workers < 0.01) return null;
      return { w: (0.5 + (at - s.approval) * 0.08) * U.strikes, t };
    },
    make: (c, f) => {
      const t = f.t || strikeTarget(c);
      if (!t) return null;
      const who = STRIKERS[t.kind] || "workers";
      const strong = c.n.laws.unions === "strong";
      const loss = Math.max(0.05, round1(t.va * 0.5 / 4));
      return {
        title: `The ${who} go on strike`, cell: t.town.cell, cityId: t.town.id,
        body: `${fmtPeople(t.workers)} ${who} have walked out${t.town ? `, starting in ${t.town.name}` : ""}. The ${strong ? "powerful unions" : "unions"} say: ${topGrievances(c, "workers")}. While they are out, the ${who} produce half as much (about ${fmtMoney(loss)} a season).`,
        options: [
          { id: "a", tag: "kind", label: "Give them a pay rise", effects: [{ t: "mod", key: "payrise", label: "Pay rise after the strike", wage: 0.02, seasons: 12 }, { t: "group", v: { workers: 8, business: -4 }, seasons: 12 }] },
          { id: "b", tag: "thrift", label: "Meet them halfway", effects: [{ t: "mod", key: "strike", label: `The ${who} on strike`, strike: t.kind, strikeCut: 0.5, seasons: 1 }, { t: "mod", key: "payrise", label: "A small pay rise", wage: 0.01, seasons: 8 }, { t: "group", v: { workers: 3, business: -1 }, seasons: 8 }] },
          { id: "c", tag: "proud", label: "Wait them out", effects: [{ t: "mod", key: "strike", label: `The ${who} on strike`, strike: t.kind, strikeCut: 0.6, seasons: 3 }, { t: "group", v: { workers: -6, business: 3 }, seasons: 12 }] },
          ...(strong ? [] : [{ id: "d", tag: "force", label: "Send in the police", effects: [{ t: "stab", v: -2 }, { t: "group", v: { workers: -12, business: 2 }, seasons: 16 }, { t: "mod", key: "strikepolice", label: "Strikers beaten by the police", stab: -1, seasons: 4 }] }]),
        ], def: "b",
      };
    },
  },
};

Object.assign(DECISIONS, PEOPLE_DECISIONS);
GROUP_DEMANDS.workers.splice(1, 0, ...PEOPLE_DEMANDS.workers);
GROUP_DEMANDS.business.splice(1, 0, ...PEOPLE_DEMANDS.business);

/* ---------- Rival governments: labour laws by character, and as they grow richer ---------- */
function peopleLawWishes(g, n, econ, push, budget) {
  const L = n.laws, P = econ.people, D = demoOf(n);
  const pref = LAB_PREFS[n.archetype] || {};
  const atWarNow = enemiesOf(g, n.id).length > 0;
  const ls = P ? P.ls : 0;
  if (atWarNow && ARMY_ORDER.indexOf(L.army) >= 2 && L.women === "home") push("women", "some", "bring women into the war factories");
  if (L.childwork === "allowed" && ls > 22) push("childwork", "limited", "send the children to school");
  if (L.childwork === "limited" && ls > 35 && pref.childwork !== "allowed") push("childwork", "banned", "every child at school");
  const afford = law => { const v = LABOUR.pensions.order[LABOUR.pensions.order.indexOf(L.pensions) + 1]; if (!v) return false; const extra = (pensionCostYear(n, econ, { ...L, pensions: v }) - pensionCostYear(n, econ, L)) / 4; return budget && budget.balance > extra * 1.2 && n.treasury > 0; };
  if (L.pensions === "none" && D.old > 0.09 && afford()) push("pensions", "basic", "care for the old");
  if (L.unions === "banned" && n.stability < 35) push("unions", "allowed", "let the workers organize before they revolt");
  if (g.turn >= 8 && n.stability > 50 && !atWarNow) for (const k of LABOUR_ORDER) {
    if (!pref[k] || L[k] === pref[k]) continue;
    const O = LABOUR[k].order, i = O.indexOf(L[k]), j = O.indexOf(pref[k]);
    if (k === "childwork" && j < i) continue;   // nobody goes back to child labour
    if (k === "pensions" && j > i && !afford()) continue;
    push(k, O[i + (j > i ? 1 : -1)], "its own ideas about work");
    break;
  }
}

/* ---------- What a law change would do (shown on the law buttons) ---------- */
function peopleLawPreview(w, g, nid, law, value) {
  const n = g.nations[nid];
  const base = computeEconomy(w, g, nid);
  const L2 = { ...n.laws, [law]: value };
  const n2 = { ...n, laws: L2 };
  if (law === "women") n2.demo = { ...demoOf(n), pw: labourLaw(L2, "women").pw };
  const g2 = { ...g, nations: g.nations.map(z => (z.id === nid ? n2 : z)) };
  const after = computeEconomyRaw(w, g2, nid);
  const P0 = base.people, P1 = after.people;
  const R0 = demoRates(n, P0 ? P0.lsRaw : 10, n.laws), R1 = demoRates(n, P0 ? P0.lsRaw : 10, L2);
  const pen0 = pensionCostYear(n, base, n.laws), pen1 = pensionCostYear(n, base, L2);
  return {
    dGdp: after.gdp / Math.max(1e-6, base.gdp) - 1,
    dLs: P0 && P1 ? P1.ls / Math.max(1e-6, P0.ls) - 1 : 0,
    dU: (after.unemployment || 0) - (base.unemployment || 0),
    dWorkers: (after.workforce || 0) - (base.workforce || 0),
    dTfr: R1.tfr - R0.tfr, dE0: R1.e0 - R0.e0,
    dPension: (pen1 - pen0) / 4,
    dInvest: profitFactor(n2) / profitFactor(n) - 1,
    dSkill: (() => { const a = skillTarget(n, base, n.laws), b = skillTarget(n, base, L2); return { s: b.s - a.s, e: b.e - a.e }; })(),
  };
}

/* ---------- Ministers' files ---------- */
function peopleFileLines(w, g, n, econ) {
  const P = econ.people, D = demoOf(n), ed = eduOf(n);
  if (!P) return [];
  const L = n.laws;
  const T = skillTarget(n, econ);
  const out = [
    `Ages: ${pct(D.kids)} children under 15, ${pct(1 - D.kids - D.old)} of working age, ${pct(D.old)} over 65. Children per woman ${D.tfr.toFixed(1)}; life expectancy ${Math.round(D.e0)} years; natural growth ${signedPct(D.r, 1)} a year.`,
    `Who works: ${fmtPeople(P.lf * econ.pop)} (${pct(P.lf)} of the people): men ${fmtPeople(P.parts.men * econ.pop)}, women ${fmtPeople(P.parts.women * econ.pop)}${P.parts.kids > 0.0005 ? `, children ${fmtPeople(P.parts.kids * econ.pop)}` : ""}${P.parts.old > 0.0005 ? `, old people ${fmtPeople(P.parts.old * econ.pop)}` : ""}${D.warWork ? "; women have taken the places of the men at the front" : ""}.`,
    `Skills: ${pct(1 - ed.s - ed.e)} unskilled, ${pct(ed.s)} skilled, ${pct(ed.e)} educated (the schools are heading to ${pct(T.s)} skilled and ${pct(T.e)} educated). ${P.shortages.length ? `SHORT of skilled people: ${P.shortages.slice(0, 4).map(x => `${industryWord(x.kind)} in ${x.town} works at ${pct(x.fill)} for want of ${fmtPeople(x.miss)} ${SKILL_INFO[x.lack].short} workers`).join("; ")}.` : "Every workplace finds the skilled people it needs."}${P.over > 0.01 ? ` ${fmtPeople(P.over)} skilled or educated people work below their training.` : ""}${P.staff.f < 0.95 ? ` Hospitals, schools and offices of state are SHORT of trained staff: ${pct(P.staff.e)} of the posts for doctors, teachers and officials are filled, ${pct(P.staff.s)} for nurses and clerks; the healthcare and schools laws work only that far.` : ""}`,
    `Living standard: $${fmt1(P.ls)}k a year per person (wages, pensions and benefits${P.goodsK < 0.99 ? ", less what empty shops cannot sell" : ""}); ${(() => { const tr = lsTrend(n); return tr === null ? "" : `${signedPct(tr, 1)} in a year; `; })()}average wage $${fmt1(P.avg)}k (unskilled $${fmt1(P.wage.u)}k, skilled $${fmt1(P.wage.s)}k, educated $${fmt1(P.wage.e)}k). Workers take ${pct(P.lam)} of what the nation makes.`,
    `Labour laws: ${LABOUR_ORDER.map(k => `${LABOUR[k].name.toLowerCase()} ${labourLaw(L, k).label.toLowerCase()}`).join(", ")}.${P.pension.cost > 0.001 ? ` Pensions cost ${fmtMoney(P.pension.cost / 4)} a season for ${fmtPeople(P.pension.pensioners)} pensioners.` : ""}`,
  ];
  return out;
}
function industryWord(kind) {
  if (SITE_KINDS[kind]) return SITE_KINDS[kind].label;
  return (INDUSTRIES[kind] && INDUSTRIES[kind].label) || kind;
}
function peopleBriefLine(g, n, econ) {
  const P = econ.people, D = demoOf(n);
  if (!P) return "";
  return `People: living standard $${fmt1(P.ls)}k a person; ${pct(D.old)} over 65, ${D.tfr.toFixed(1)} children per woman; skills ${pct(eduOf(n).s)} skilled, ${pct(eduOf(n).e)} educated${P.shortages.length ? `; workplaces short of ${P.short.e > P.short.s ? "educated" : "skilled"} people` : ""}.`;
}

/* =====================================================================
   12. Formatting
   ===================================================================== */
function fmtArea(cells) { return `${(cells * KM2_PER_CELL).toLocaleString("en-US")} km²`; }
function fmtPop(m) { return `${m.toFixed(1)}M`; }
function fmtMoney(b) {
  const a = Math.abs(b);
  const s = a < 100 ? a.toFixed(1) : Math.round(a).toLocaleString("en-US");
  return `${b < 0 ? "−" : ""}$${s}B`;
}
function fmtSignedMoney(b) { return b >= 0 ? `+${fmtMoney(b)}` : fmtMoney(b); }
function fmtCount(n) { return Math.round(n).toLocaleString("en-US"); }
function pct(x) { return `${Math.round(x * 100)}%`; }
function signedPct(x, digits = 2) {
  const v = (Math.abs(x) * 100).toFixed(digits);
  if (Number(v) === 0) return `±${v}%`;
  return x > 0 ? `+${v}%` : `−${v}%`;
}
function signed(n) { const r = Math.round(n); return r > 0 ? `+${r}` : r < 0 ? `−${Math.abs(r)}` : "±0"; }
function signed1(n) { const v = Math.abs(n).toFixed(1); return v === "0.0" ? "±0.0" : n > 0 ? `+${v}` : `−${v}`; }
function toneOf(n, eps = 0) { return n > eps ? "good" : n < -eps ? "bad" : "neutral"; }
function escapeHtml(s) { return String(s).replace(/[&<>"']/g, ch => ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" }[ch])); }
function cleanName(raw) { return String(raw || "").replace(/\s+/g, " ").trim().slice(0, 32) || "Unnamed Nation"; }
function seasonLabel(turn) { return `${SEASONS[turn % 4]}, Year ${Math.floor(turn / 4) + 1}`; }


/* =====================================================================
   12b. What the ministers know: each ministry's file, the cabinet briefing, and the files they can look up
   A real minister knows his ministry inside out and the state of the country in outline, and he can ask a
   colleague's ministry for its file. Everything here is read from the game itself, the same numbers the panels
   show, so a minister can never say something the game does not know. Used by Claude (as the minister's briefing
   and as lookups) and by the built-in replies when Claude is not available.
   ===================================================================== */
const BRIEF_ORD = ["", "1st", "2nd", "3rd"];
function ordinalWord(k) { return BRIEF_ORD[k] || `${k}th`; }   // "second": not ordinal() ("2nd", 10h), which it used to replace
function bMoney(v) { return Math.abs(v) < 0.05 && v !== 0 ? `$${Math.round(Math.abs(v) * 1000)}M` : fmtMoney(v); }
function bSigned(v) { return Math.abs(v) < 0.0005 ? "±$0" : `${v > 0 ? "+" : "−"}${bMoney(Math.abs(v))}`; }   // a change of money, small ones in $M
function bPeople(m) { return m >= 1 ? `${m.toFixed(1)}M` : m >= 0.001 ? `${Math.round(m * 1000)}k` : `${Math.round(m * 1e6)}`; }   // m in millions
function bCount(v) { return v >= 1e6 ? `${(v / 1e6).toFixed(1)}M` : v >= 1e4 ? `${Math.round(v / 1000)}k` : fmtCount(v); }
function goodWorth(g, k, q) { return q * GOODS[k].price * priceOf(g, k); }   // a year's quantity of a good, in $B
function bJoin(a) { return a.length <= 1 ? a.join("") : `${a.slice(0, -1).join(", ")} and ${a[a.length - 1]}`; }

/* ---------- The world in numbers: every nation, the same figures the Statistics window uses ---------- */
function worldTable(w, g) {
  return withEconMemo(g, () => liveNations(g).map(z => {
    const e = computeEconomy(w, g, z.id);
    let divs = 0, men = 0, tanks = 0, planes = 0;
    for (const d of g.divisions) if (d.owner === z.id) { divs++; men += d.men; tanks += d.tanks || 0; }
    for (const a of g.airwings) if (a.owner === z.id) planes += a.planes;
    const nc = g.sea ? navyCounts(g, z.id) : { destroyer: 0, cruiser: 0, freighter: 0 };
    const h = z.history && z.history.length > 4 ? z.history[z.history.length - 5] : null;
    return { id: z.id, name: z.name, minor: !!z.minor, gdp: e.gdp, growth: h && h.gdp > 0 ? e.gdp / h.gdp - 1 : null, pop: e.pop, area: e.area, towns: e.cities.length,
      divs, men, tanks: Math.round(tanks), planes: Math.round(planes), depotTanks: Math.round((z.stock && z.stock.tanks) || 0), ships: nc.destroyer + nc.cruiser, freighters: nc.freighter,
      power: armyPower(g, z.id), stability: z.stability, treasury: z.treasury, techs: Object.keys(z.techs || {}).length, exp: e.exportValue || 0, imp: e.importBill || 0,
      prestige: z.prestige || 0, unemp: e.unemployment || 0, food: e.pop > 0.01 ? e.food / e.pop : 0, econ: e };
  }));
}
function rankIn(table, key, id, majorsOnly) {
  const rows = table.filter(r => !majorsOnly || !r.minor || r.id === id).slice().sort((a, b) => b[key] - a[key]);
  return { k: rows.findIndex(r => r.id === id) + 1, of: rows.length };
}
function rankText(table, key, id) {
  const me = table.find(r => r.id === id), v = me ? me[key] : 0;
  const above = table.filter(r => r[key] > v + 1e-9).length, same = table.filter(r => Math.abs(r[key] - v) <= 1e-9).length;
  return same > 1 ? `${ordinalWord(above + 1)} of ${table.length}, tied with ${same - 1} other${same > 2 ? "s" : ""}` : `${ordinalWord(above + 1)} of ${table.length}`;
}
function natLabel(g, z) { return `the ${z.name}${z.minor ? " (a small state)" : ""}`; }
function ratioText(r) { return r >= 0.95 && r <= 1.05 ? "about equal to ours" : r > 1 ? `${r.toFixed(1)} times ours` : `${Math.round(r * 100)}% of ours`; }

/* ---------- A good: made, needed, bought and sold (and from whom, by this season's contracts) ---------- */
function goodLine(g, econ, k, nid = PLAYER) {
  const G = econ.goods, d = G.demand[k] || 0, s = G.supply[k] || 0, im = G.imports[k] || 0, ex = G.exports[k] || 0, sat = econ.sat[k] ?? 1;
  const T = econ.trade || {};
  if (d < 0.02 && s < 0.02) return `${GOODS[k].label}: we neither make nor use any.`;
  const parts = [`we make ${bMoney(goodWorth(g, k, s))} a year and need ${bMoney(goodWorth(g, k, d))}`];
  if (im > 0.01) { const from = tradeShareText(g, T.importsFrom && T.importsFrom[k], "from", im); parts.push(`we import ${bMoney(goodWorth(g, k, im))} (${pct(im / Math.max(0.01, d))} of our need)${from ? `: from ${from}` : ""}`); }
  if (ex > 0.01) { const to = tradeShareText(g, T.exportsTo && T.exportsTo[k], "to", ex); parts.push(`we export ${bMoney(goodWorth(g, k, ex))}${to ? `: to ${to}` : ""}`); }
  if (im <= 0.01 && ex <= 0.01 && !GOODS[k].local) parts.push("no trade abroad");
  // a contract an embargo, a war or a lost harbor has cut since the merchants signed it
  for (const x of ((T.cut && T.cut[k]) || []).slice(0, 2)) {
    parts.push(x.from !== undefined
      ? `CUT OFF: ${bMoney(goodWorth(g, k, x.q))} a year we bought from ${whoName(g, x.from)} cannot come (${tradeBlockedText(g, x.code, x.from, nid, k)})`
      : `CUT OFF: ${bMoney(goodWorth(g, k, x.q))} a year we sold to ${whoName(g, x.to)} cannot go (${tradeBlockedText(g, x.code, nid, x.to, k)})`);
  }
  if (sat < 0.95) parts.push(`SHORTAGE: only ${pct(sat)} of the need is met${GOODS[k].local ? "" : shortWhy(g, econ, k, nid)}`);
  else if (G.util[k] < 0.9 && s > 0.05) parts.push(`${pct(1 - G.util[k])} of what we make finds no buyer`);
  const p = GOODS[k].local ? 1 : priceOf(g, k);
  if (Math.abs(p - 1) >= 0.08) parts.push(`world price ${p > 1 ? "high" : "low"} (${pct(p)} of normal)`);
  return `${GOODS[k].label}: ${parts.join("; ")}.`;
}
/* Why we could not buy the rest of a good we are short of. */
function shortWhy(g, econ, k, nid) {
  if (!g.trade || !g.trade.v) return "";
  if (!tradeOpen(econ)) return " (we cannot trade: no nation can reach us, and the world market is closed to us)";
  const unmet = (g.trade.unmet[k] || [])[nid] || 0;
  if (unmet <= 0.005) return "";
  return (econ.trade && econ.trade.worldImportCapRaw > 0) ? " (no nation we can reach had more to sell, and our harbors bring only so much from the world market)" : " (no nation we can reach had more to sell, and the world market is closed to us)";
}
/* How this nation trades: its routes, the world market, what trade costs and earns, agreements, embargoes, sanctions. */
function tradeAccessLine(g, n, econ) {
  const nid = n.id;
  if (!g.trade || !g.trade.v) {
    // a game with no merchants' book yet (the founding preview): the old rule, world market only
    if (!(econ.access > 0)) return "We have no harbor and no trade partner, so we can neither import nor export anything. A port or a trade agreement would open trade.";
    const partners0 = (g.treaties || []).filter(t => t.type === "trade" && (t.a === nid || t.b === nid)).map(t => nameOf(g, t.a === nid ? t.b : t.a));
